chapters.title: Chapter 1751: Conversation
paragraphs: "Arrogant prick!" The man, who was the embodiment of the heavens, roared. "I will—"

"What? Do you want to kill me?" Zhang Fei sneered. "How many times have you tried to kill me? The result? You fail every time! If you’re not satisfied with that, you can try again, but I will always thwart your plans!"

Long Wuzhao and all the cultivators present could clearly hear Zhang Fei’s loud voice, and they smiled bitterly as they listened to his words. Some of them thought he was being too arrogant, but many of them didn’t dare to think so because he was the only one who could move in the presence of those hidden forces.
"You—"

"Tian." The man, who was the embodiment of the heavens, fell silent as soon as one of the women among them spokes. "Zhang Fei may be arrogant, but his words are also true. You have brought down his lightning tribulations countless times, and you even manifested yourself several times to kill him, but you always failed to do so."
Tian choked on his words and fiercely glared at the smug Zhang Fei. "Humph! I’ll kill him when he breaks through to the Celestial God Realm in the future!"
The others laughed when they heard that; Tian’s ears and face heated up as he glared at them.
The woman looked at Zhang Fei. "My name is Ming, and we came to talk to you about this universe."
"Ming? Fate?" Zhang Fei was a little surprised.
"That’s right." Ming waved her hand, and hundreds of chains emerged from the bodies of all the cultivators, including those hidden forces.

Long Wuzhao and the others were shocked by the appearance of those chains that bound them; they had never known about them before. However, their gazes were fixed on Zhang Fei and his four clones; those chains did not appear and bind their bodies. ’This? Why aren’t there any chains binding them?’
"As Xin told you before, you are the only living being who is not bound to this universe because you have died and come back to life."
"Xin?"
"Her," Ming pointed to Feng Yao.

"Oh? Xin is the core, right?" Ming nodded to Zhang Fei. "Why did you choose me? You are the hidden forces of this universe, and your strength is unmatched. Even if I use my full strength, I won’t be able to defeat either of you."
"Humph! You finally realized your weakness!" Tian snorted mockingly.
Zhang Fei narrowed his eyes. "If you keep acting like that, don’t blame me if I beat you up right here and now!"
"You bastard!" Tian wanted to move, but a young man immediately stopped him. "What are you doing, Jiang?"

Jiang shook his head slightly. "We didn’t come here to fight with Zhang Fei, and we need his help to save this universe, so you should hold back your anger. Otherwise, this universe will be destroyed, and all its inhabitants will be wiped out, including us."
’Saving the universe? Is there something going on without us knowing?’ The cultivators below pondered their thoughts.

Unlike them, Zhang Fei wasn’t confused by this, as he had already heard several things from the two spirits of the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus. They told him that the universe was facing great danger, and the past disaster was one of them, which had caused the lotus’s weakening.
"Tch!" Tian gritted his teeth, looking at Zhang Fei hatefully.
Zhang Fei looked at Jiang. "Are you the Will?"
"That’s right." Jiang nodded at him. "However, I am in my weak state because this universe is unstable, and I will disappear if this universe is destroyed."
"What actually happened? How and when did it start?" Zhang Fei asked.

"Her." They pointed to Feng Yao, which made Zhang Fei frown. "As you already know, Xin is the embodiment of the core of this universe. The disaster began with her decision to manifest herself as Shen Yuanzhi, and several other disasters followed that."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao, surprised to learn that all the disasters had started because of her selfish past decision.

Ming spoke. "Her decisions threw Yin and Yang in this universe out of balance, and the first disaster struck in the Primordial Realm. The second disaster occurred in the Ancient Realm, and you must have heard about it. Soon, the third disaster will occur in the Paradise Realm, and you should be able to guess the cause."
"Those shadowy creatures."

"Yes," Ming nodded. "The main creature was born along with this universe, and it was sealed within the core. It was freed after Xin decided to manifest herself, but it never made a move before because it was still too weak at the time. However, it has become increasingly powerful, so it decided to break out and order its subordinates to wreak havoc in this universe, and their main target is you."
"Why me?"

"Because you are the only living being that is not tied to this universe, Zhang Fei. If the main core manages to find you and take over your body, it will do whatever it wants to destroy this universe."
Zhang Fei frowned as he looked at Tian. "So, that’s why that stupid guy has been trying to kill me ever since my cultivation broke through to the Earth Realm?"
"You—"

Ming waved her hand to stop Tian. "Your lightning tribulation appeared because of all your past actions, and it’s natural that Tian would want to punish you. His actions had nothing to do with the danger, and he was angry because you managed to pass all your lightning tribulations. Even though his actions were childish, you reaped many benefits from them."

Zhang Fei admitted that his lightning tribulations had indeed provided him with many benefits, and he was impatient to face his next lightning tribulation, but Tian had been holding them off ever since his cultivation broke through to the Celestial King Realm. "So, what you’re saying is that we have to stop the main creature from destroying this universe, right? Why don’t you guys stop it yourselves?"

"We want to stop it, but we can’t do it." Zhang Fei frowned. "As I said before, the main creature was born at the same time as this universe, and we were born after this universe was formed, so it is much stronger than us. The only living creature that can stop the main creature is you, especially since you no longer have any ties to this universe."

"Why should I bother with the safety of this universe?" Ming and the others’ faces darkened as soon as Zhang Fei asked. "As you just said, I no longer have any ties to this universe, so I don’t need to bother with its safety. If this universe is destroyed, then so be it. I just need to bring all my acquaintances to my soul world, and they will be safe there."
"Bastard!" Tian roared.
"You have to be quiet when your parents are talking, you little brat!"
"Hahaha!" Ming burst out laughing as soon as Zhang Fei said that.
Tian’s facial muscles bulged out from under his skin, and he was eager to attack Zhang Fei, but the others immediately stopped him because he would never be able to defeat him.
"Tch!"
Zhang Fei spoke to them again. "I no longer have any ties to the universe, and I also owe you nothing, so—"
"Her," Ming pointed at Feng Yao again. "It’s true that you no longer have any ties to this universe, so you don’t have to be responsible for its safety, but you don’t think about her fate."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow.

"Do you want to see her die?" Zhang Fei caught the meaning of Ming’s question straight away. "Even though she has manifested herself and reincarnated countless times, she is still the embodiment of the core of this universe. If the main creature succeeds in destroying this universe, she will also die. You have no responsibility for the safety of this universe, but she is your wife, and you can’t possibly let her die, right?"
Huo Ling’s expression became ugly after hearing that. "Husband, you can’t let my master die."
"Have you known about this matter for a long time, Ling’er?"
"I—" Huo Ling stopped and nodded to Zhang Fei. "Please, husband, you must do something to stop the main creature, or my master will die along with this universe."
Zhang Fei sighed. "Do you think I can stop the main creature with my current strength?"

"No," Huo Ling replied with a shake of her head. "The main creature is simply too powerful, and the two primordial beasts are no match for it, so you can’t possibly defeat it with your current strength. However, you still have plenty of time in the future, and I believe you will surpass all living creatures in this universe, so I believe you can defeat the main creature."
Zhang Fei smiled. "Why do you trust me so much now? Didn’t you always underestimate me before?"
"Can you stop bringing up the past?" Huo Ling pouted. "I didn’t believe in your abilities in the past, but my opinion about you changed a long time ago. I am your wife, so I believe in you."

"I’ll teach you a lesson after this." Huo Ling’s face turned red as she understood the lesson Zhang Fei was going to teach her. He ignored her and looked at those hidden forces. "I won’t say anything now because my strength isn’t enough to face the main creature, and I even had to escape from its subordinates. However, you’re right that Feng Yao is my wife, and I won’t let her die along with this universe."
Ming and the others were relieved to hear that. "If you need any help, just let us know, and we’ll do our best."

chapters.title: Chapter 1752: Two Requests
paragraphs: Since Ming offered such a favor, Zhang Fei shamelessly made his request. "Speaking of favors, I need one from you guys, and I hope you don’t mind."
Tian frowned and wanted to say something, but Ming stopped him. "What do you need?"
"I need the void elemental seed stored in the void core. Can any of you retrieve it for me?"
"This—"

"I already have ten elements, but they are a bit useless against those creatures, let alone fight the main creature." Zhang Fei created a qi screen that showed his fight with Feng Yao against those creatures in the Changxuan Domain. "As you can see for yourself, I used my full strength when facing them, but all my attacks were almost useless against them. In fact, Yao’er and I had to escape from that domain because the main creature came there, and it destroyed that domain after we left."
Ming and the others wore serious expressions as they watched Zhang Fei and Feng Yao fight against those creatures, but they didn’t see the scene when the domain was destroyed on the qi screen.

"You said yourself that the main creature is targeting me, and this universe will face even greater danger if it manages to capture and control me." Ming looked at Zhang Fei thoughtfully. "I don’t know if the void element can help me fight it, but at least it can help me fight my other enemies, such as Qian Yan, the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God. Among the ten demon gods, he is the most dangerous, and I’m not sure I can hide from him if his middle eye locks on my location. Thus, I need the void element to face him and those creatures, so I hope one of you is willing to help me to take the seed."

A young man immediately spoke to Zhang Fei. "Even if you have the void elemental seed, you will not necessarily succeed in obtaining the void element, and the probability that you will succeed in obtaining it is only 60%."

"Do you think I don’t know about that?" Zhang Fei activated his ten elements, which shocked all the cultivators below them. "When I first became a cultivator, I only had three elements: light, darkness, and fire. Over the years. I got the other six elements through those elemental seeds, and the last element I got was the metal element."
"Where did you find the metal elemental seed?" The young man asked.
"I obtained it at the Tower of Eternity about five months ago."
"I see."
Ming looked at the young man. "You should be able to retrieve the void elemental seed from the void core, right, Yuan?"
"I can do that." Yuan nodded. "However, this kid still—"

"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei called Bing Xingying and asked her to come to him. Soon, she arrived beside him, but she was frightened by the sight of the people in front of her. "Do you recognize my sister-in-law’s identity?"

Yuan was momentarily taken aback when he recognized Bing Xingying’s identity. "The one and only void spirit, huh? No wonder you’re so confident in obtaining the void element, especially since she can help you get it. Since you have her beside you, I will take the void elemental seed for you now."
"Thank you."
Yuan immediately disappeared from his sight.
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao after sensing the change in her. Ming and the others could also sense it, and her strength had increased significantly, even though it hadn’t reached her past peak.
At the same time, the sky split by itself, and a bright light fell from above, covering Feng Yao’s body.
"She can’t stay in this Paradise Realm any longer," Ming said.
"I know." Zhang Fei moved next to Feng Yao and caressed her face. "I will send you to my beast space now."
Feng Yao looked at Ming and the others for a moment. "Send me there now, husband."
The light disappeared, and the sky returned to normal after Zhang Fei sent Feng Yao into his beast space. He then returned to Ming and the others. "What level is her cultivation at now?"

"The Supreme God Realm." Zhang Fei was confused to hear this because Feng Yao was still holding back her cultivation, which should have already reached the Exalt Supreme Realm. "If she restores her cultivation to the peak stage, she can’t stay by your side anymore."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "What do you mean by that?"

"I can’t explain the details to you, but I can tell you that the Exalt Supreme Realm is entirely different from all the cultivation stages below it, and you have to experience it yourself to know the difference. You won’t be able to borrow her strength if she reaches that stage, so she’s holding back her cultivation for your sake," Ming explained.

"I see." Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something. "Can you tell me where the portal to the Ancient Calamity Sect is? One of my wives is under a curse from that sect, and I want to reverse the curse, but Feng Yao can’t find the portal to enter the sect."

Ming touched Zhang Fei’s forehead and shared the location of one of the portals leading to the sect. "Since you want to go to the Myriad Abyss Domain, you can find the portal to the sect there. Is there anything else you need?"
"Can I find the five demon materials to upgrade the demon ranks in the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
"You can find all of them in that domain, but you need countless Perfect Demon Cores to get them. That domain is a demon domain, so your jewels will be useless there."
Zhang Fei’s lips twitched after hearing that because he didn’t have any Perfect Demon Cores at all. "I guess I’ll have to slaughter demon beasts to buy those five demon materials."
"I think it won’t be difficult for you to collect them with the help of your five clones," Ming said with a smile.
After they waited for some time, Yuan returned to them. He handed Zhang Fei a transparent seed, which was the void elemental seed.

Bing Xingying gawked when she saw the void elemental seed. Back then, Feng Yao said that she was the only person who could retrieve the seed from the void core, but her cultivation was still not enough to go to that place.
Zhang Fei received the seed with excitement. "Thank you."
"No problem."
Ming spoke to Zhang Fei directly. "Since you don’t need anything else, we will leave now, and we hope you will succeed in defeating the main creature in the future."

"I can only promise you to try my best." Ming nodded to Zhang Fei before disappearing along with the others, and the pressure that was pressing down on all the cultivators in the domain disappeared on its own. "I need your help to absorb this void elemental seed, sister-in-law."
Bing Xingying nodded with a smile. "I will definitely help you to obtain the void element, brother-in-law."

"Let’s meet the others first." Zhang Fei and Bing Xingying landed in front of Long Wuzhao and the others. "Sigh! My wedding party became a mess because of the appearance of those two primordial beasts."

Tianshi Shengjie was also disappointed by the appearance of those two primordial beasts. "It’s okay, husband. The most important thing is that we are married, and many people already know about our marriage."
"Zhang Fei, who exactly were the people before?" Puyang Shangren asked.
"They are the embodiment of the hidden forces of this universe."
"Hidden forces?"
"Those hidden forces are Fate, the heavens, and several others."
"So, Senior Feng is one of those hidden forces?"
"Not really." Zhang Fei looked at a man in the distance. "You must capture that man, Emperor Long."
Long Wuzhao and the others looked at the man Zhang Fei was pointing at, causing him to frown.
"What do you mean by that, Kid?" Feng Jinhuang asked as he looked at the man. "Xue Zhandi is one of the overseers, so—"

"He may be one of the overseers, but he is the reason behind the Primordial Genesis Beast’s appearance today." Xue Zhandi was shocked by this and tried to escape, but Zhang Fei hastily restricted his movements. "Since you are hesitant to capture him, I will kill him today."
Before Xue Zhandi could plead, a transparent sword swiftly moved and beheaded him. Zhang Fei’s swift and ruthless actions shocked everyone present, including those from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans.
Zhang Fei turned to Tianshi Shengjie. "Sorry, Shengjie. I was forced to stain our wedding day with blood, but I couldn’t let a traitor like him live."
"You don’t need to apologize to me, husband." Tianshi Shengjie looked at the man’s corpse. "Since he ruined our wedding party, he deserves to die."
Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue smiled bitterly upon hearing their daughter’s words. They felt that her character had changed quite a bit, and she unhesitatingly followed Zhang Fei’s decision.

Feng Jinhuang and the rest of the overseers could only sigh inwardly. After all, Xue Zhandi was one of them, but Zhang Fei killed him without batting an eye. However, no one dared protest, especially after what they had witnessed earlier.

At first, Zhang Fei wanted to tell them about Feng Yao’s identity, but he decided against it. He sent the people from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans back to their domains, and he brought all his wives to the residence prepared by Tianshi Bailong two days ago.
"Why do I feel like that kid is getting more and more ruthless?"

Long Wuzhao agreed with Feng Jinhuang. "There’s nothing we can do, right? Unlike us, he has a great responsibility for the future of this universe, and he will face many powerful enemies in the future."

"I can’t explain the details to you, but I can tell you that the Exalt Supreme Realm is entirely different from all the cultivation stages below it, and you have to experience it yourself to know the difference.
You won’t be able to borrow her strength if she reaches that stage, so she’s holding back her cultivation for your sake," Ming explained.
"I see." Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something.
"Can you tell me where the portal to the Ancient Calamity Sect is?
One of my wives is under a curse from that sect, and I want to reverse the curse, but Feng Yao can’t find the portal to enter the sect."
Ming touched Zhang Fei’s forehead and shared the location of one of the portals leading to the sect.
"Since you want to go to the Myriad Abyss Domain, you can find the portal to the sect there.
Is there anything else you need?"
"Can I find the five demon materials to upgrade the demon ranks in the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
"You can find all of them in that domain, but you need countless Perfect Demon Cores to get them.
That domain is a demon domain, so your jewels will be useless there."
Zhang Fei’s lips twitched after hearing that because he didn’t have any Perfect Demon Cores at all.
"I guess I’ll have to slaughter demon beasts to buy those five demon materials."
"I think it won’t be difficult for you to collect them with the help of your five clones," Ming said with a smile.
After they waited for some time, Yuan returned to them.
He handed Zhang Fei a transparent seed, which was the void elemental seed.
Bing Xingying gawked when she saw the void elemental seed.
Back then, Feng Yao said that she was the only person who could retrieve the seed from the void core, but her cultivation was still not enough to go to that place.
Zhang Fei received the seed with excitement.
"Thank you."
"No problem."
Ming spoke to Zhang Fei directly.
"Since you don’t need anything else, we will leave now, and we hope you will succeed in defeating the main creature in the future."

"I can only promise you to try my best." Ming nodded to Zhang Fei before disappearing along with the others, and the pressure that was pressing down on all the cultivators in the domain disappeared on its own.
"I need your help to absorb this void elemental seed, sister-in-law."
Bing Xingying nodded with a smile.
"I will definitely help you to obtain the void element, brother-in-law."
"Let’s meet the others first." Zhang Fei and Bing Xingying landed in front of Long Wuzhao and the others.
"Sigh!
My wedding party became a mess because of the appearance of those two primordial beasts."
Tianshi Shengjie was also disappointed by the appearance of those two primordial beasts.
"It’s okay, husband.
The most important thing is that we are married, and many people already know about our marriage."
"Zhang Fei, who exactly were the people before?" Puyang Shangren asked.
"They are the embodiment of the hidden forces of this universe."
"Hidden forces?"
"Those hidden forces are Fate, the heavens, and several others."
"So, Senior Feng is one of those hidden forces?"
"Not really." Zhang Fei looked at a man in the distance.
"You must capture that man, Emperor Long."
Long Wuzhao and the others looked at the man Zhang Fei was pointing at, causing him to frown.
"What do you mean by that, Kid?" Feng Jinhuang asked as he looked at the man.
"Xue Zhandi is one of the overseers, so—"

"He may be one of the overseers, but he is the reason behind the Primordial Genesis Beast’s appearance today." Xue Zhandi was shocked by this and tried to escape, but Zhang Fei hastily restricted his movements.
"Since you are hesitant to capture him, I will kill him today."
Before Xue Zhandi could plead, a transparent sword swiftly moved and beheaded him.
Zhang Fei’s swift and ruthless actions shocked everyone present, including those from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans.
Zhang Fei turned to Tianshi Shengjie.
"Sorry, Shengjie.
I was forced to stain our wedding day with blood, but I couldn’t let a traitor like him live."
"You don’t need to apologize to me, husband." Tianshi Shengjie looked at the man’s corpse.
"Since he ruined our wedding party, he deserves to die."
Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue smiled bitterly upon hearing their daughter’s words.
They felt that her character had changed quite a bit, and she unhesitatingly followed Zhang Fei’s decision.
Feng Jinhuang and the rest of the overseers could only sigh inwardly.
After all, Xue Zhandi was one of them, but Zhang Fei killed him without batting an eye.
However, no one dared protest, especially after what they had witnessed earlier.
At first, Zhang Fei wanted to tell them about Feng Yao’s identity, but he decided against it.
He sent the people from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans back to their domains, and he brought all his wives to the residence prepared by Tianshi Bailong two days ago.
"Why do I feel like that kid is getting more and more ruthless?"
Long Wuzhao agreed with Feng Jinhuang.
"There’s nothing we can do, right?
Unlike us, he has a great responsibility for the future of this universe, and he will face many powerful enemies in the future."

chapters.title: Chapter 1753: Obtain The Void Element
paragraphs: After Zhang Fei’s four clones sent most of his wedding guests back to their respective domains, Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue ordered the members of the Celestial Dragon Race to clean up the wedding area.

Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue were regretful that Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding banquet was ruined by the unexpected appearance of the two primordial beasts, but they were satisfied that their only daughter was finally married, and she married the man who would be the pillar for the future of their universe.
The appearance of the two primordial beasts and the power they displayed earlier left a bittersweet feeling in everyone’s hearts, and they were fully aware that they were not their opponents.

The remaining overseers had already returned to their respective domains, except for Feng Jinhuang, who lived in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. Long Wuzhao told them that he would meet them after talking to Zhang Fei, so he asked them to go back first.
Long Wuzhao wanted to talk to Zhang Fei about the future after the two primordial beasts knew about them, but the dragon emperor knew he wouldn’t be coming out anytime soon.

All the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain decided not to return to their domains and await instructions from their leader, so Long Wuzhao invited them to his dragon palace. Feng Jiu and Feng Tian organized them while waiting for Zhang Fei or Feng Yao to meet them.

Long Wuzhao invited the two void cultivators, Kong Bai and Nu Liexi, to his palace to discuss something. He also asked Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, Feng Jinhuang, Feng Shizhu, and the leaders of other beast races to join them.
The natural races were the same as the beast races, and their leaders gathered in one place to discuss several matters, including the emergence of the two primordial beasts and those hidden forces.
In the Heavenly Mistveil Domain, Long Huoyan gathered all the higher-ups of the demihuman races, discussing the events at Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding.

Unlike the beast and natural races, not many humans attended Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding, so not many knew about the appearance of the two primordial beasts and those hidden forces. The humans from several domains gathered their members together, discussing everything they had witnessed before.
In the Forgotten Land, Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the other ancestors gathered their clan members to discuss the same incident.

In the Ancient Realm, specifically at the Puyang Clan, Puyang Shangren and the others immediately went to meet Puyang Shenmi at the sacred ground. They informed her of the previous incident and discussed their next steps.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei sat cross-legged in the middle of the room, and he immediately swallowed the void elemental seed. Yuan Xiajie joined all his wives, waiting for him to obtain the void element.
[Ding]
[A peak-grade void elemental seed was detected.]
[The process of absorbing the void elemental seed begins.]
[The chance for the host to get the void element is 60%.]
"Sister-in-law." Bing Xingying touched Zhang Fei’s back and injected her void qi into his body. "Thank you."
"Brother-in-law, you’ve helped me so much, so it’s my turn to help you."
Zhang Fei nodded and closed his eyes, sensing Bing Xingying’s void qi stimulated the void elemental seed in his body.
[The chance for the host to get the Void element is 100%.]
"It’s done."
Bing Xingying withdrew her void qi and Zhang Fei’s body, and she waited for the process to complete with all her wives.
"Why did you send your son back first, sister-in-law?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
Bing Xingying sighed. "My son was frightened by what happened earlier, so I asked my mother-in-law to take him back first."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "The appearance of these two primordial beasts was indeed unexpected, and their strength was too terrifying."
"The main problem now is that they already know our husband’s identity as the sole heir of Hu Tianlang and the heir of the Calamity Demon Dragon." Qi Qingxiu said with a frown.

Ye Mingran nodded in agreement. "Since they already know our husband’s identity, I’m sure that they will never stop hunting him. Besides, Sister Yao can’t get out of his beast space because of the improvement of her cultivation, so only Sister Ling can protect him."
"Humph!" Huo Ling coldly snorted. "If those two primordial beasts dare to appear in front of our husband again, I will kill them, and we will use their beast meat for the banquet."
All the women turned their gazes to Huo Ling with strange looks.

"Why are you guys looking at me like that?" Huo Ling asked, shaking her head. "Even though they are primordial beasts, they are no different from other beasts. Their beast meat is more nutritious and richer in qi, so I’m sure it will taste delicious."
"Haha," Zhang Lin laughed. "Big Sis Ling, I thought you were the only person in the universe who would think of eating the meat of those two primordial beasts."
"Do you think their meat is really delicious, Big Sis Ling?" Wu Lianzhi asked.
Xu Ling’er glared at her. "Do you really dare to eat their meat, Lianzhi?"
"Why not?" Wu Lianzhi shrugged. "There are only two primordial beasts in this universe, and their meat should be delicious, so I thought I’d like to taste it."

In fact, some of Zhang Fei’s other wives thought the same as Wu Lianzhi, especially the female beasts. They were female beasts, and they knew the benefits of consuming the meat of the primordial beasts, so they imagined tasting it.

"I think our husband will never kill those two primordial beasts, sisters." They looked at Shen Yu. "His soul world doesn’t have any guardians yet, right? That’s why I think he will capture them and contract them, and he will make them the guardians of his soul world."

They felt that Shen Yu’s opinion made sense, especially considering Zhang Fei’s character. However, they knew that their fight wouldn’t happen anytime soon because the two primordial beasts resided in the Primordial Realm, and their husband’s strength hadn’t yet reached their level.
*Swoosh*
After they waited for some time, a transparent aura suddenly erupted from Zhang Fei’s body, indicating that he had successfully obtained the void element.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the void element.]
[The host’s void element has reached the lower stage.]

Since they had witnessed Zhang Fei obtain new elements several times, and Bing Xingying had helped him, all the women present around him were not surprised that he had successfully obtained the void element.

Even though he had obtained the void element, Zhang Fei didn’t stop there. He still had the final task, and he tried to form his new cultivation core based on his void element. With his past experience forming his other cores, he found it much easier to create the new one, needing less than an hour to do so.
[Ding]
[The host successfully formed the peak-grade void element core.]
All the women smiled when they saw the transparent cultivation core floating above Zhang Fei.
After the void element core entered Zhang Fei’s body, Bing Xingying immediately touched his forehead and shared a few things with him, one of which was the method to master the void elemental law.
[You obtained the Void Sovereign Immortal Body Art.]

Zhang Fei was overjoyed after the notification appeared, especially because it was a body technique. He really thanked Bing Xinying for that because it would make his physique stronger. He ignored it for now and focused on mastering the void elemental law first.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host has mastered the initial stage of the void elemental law.]

Another notification appeared in Zhang Fei’s mind an hour later, and he immediately opened his eyes. His speed in acquiring the void element and mastering the void elemental law was truly astonishing in Bing Xingying’s eyes.

Zhang Fei looked at Bing Xingying with a smile. "Thank you so much, sister-in-law! Not only did you help me obtain the void element, but you also gave me the method to master the void elemental law and the void body cultivation technique."

"Hehe," Bing Xingying chuckled. "At first, Big Sis asked me to take you to the void core to retrieve the void elemental seed, but I didn’t expect that you would get it before I was ready to take you there. Since you’re done, you can send me back to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary; otherwise, my son will be whining for me."
"Alright." Bing Xingying immediately disappeared into the gate after Zhang Fei opened it, and he immediately closed it again. "What’s wrong with you guys?"
"Hehe," Wu Lianzhi moved beside Zhang Fei and hugged his arm. "Big Brother, are you going to kill those two primordial beasts in the future?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow, sensing something was different. "Why do you ask that, Lianzhi?"
Wu Lianzhi pointed at Huo Ling. "Big Sis Ling gave us the idea of eating the meat of the two primordial beasts, and we are looking forward to it."

"Cough... Cough..." Zhang Fei choked as he observed their expressions, especially those female beasts, including Zhang Yue. He shook his head and dashed their hopes. "I will not kill the two primordial beasts, and I will make them guardians of my soul world."
"Aiyo!" Wu Lianzhi and a few others were disappointed by that. "You’re no fun, big brother! We want to taste their meat!"
Zhang Fei smiled amusedly at their expressions. "Rather than thinking about their meat, isn’t my meat more delicious?"
"A pervert!" All the women shouted at Zhang Fei before bursting into laughter.
"So, will you be continuing your journey to the Myriad Abyss Domain right away, husband?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1754: People’s Worries I
paragraphs: "Although everything has become a mess due to the appearance of the two primordial beasts, I have already married Tianshi Shengjie today, so I have decided not to leave, and I will leave in a few days." Zhang Fei looked at all the women before being stunned. He only then realized that Wang Jingzhi was among his wives, and she seemed to have a good relationship with them, especially Xian Xianqin. "How did you end up with them here?"

Wang Jingzhi felt embarrassed to explain everything to Zhang Fei, so Xian Xianqin spoke directly to him. "We asked Sister Jingzhi to stay with us, husband. In fact, she has been staying with us at our residence in the sect for the past few days, but you were too busy with your wedding preparations with Sister Shengjie, so you didn’t notice her presence."

Zhang Fei remembered his last conversation with Wang Jingzhi in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley over a month ago. At that time, she had said that she would grant any of his wishes if he were willing to help her Wang Clan prosper again. However, he hadn’t done anything for her clan because he was still busy preparing for his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie, so he didn’t expect her to take the initiative to approach and live with all his wives.

Yuan Xiajie, who was standing while leaning against the door, couldn’t help but shake her head. She knew that Zhang Fei had more than a hundred women, but she didn’t expect that every one of them was a peerless beauty. Their beauty made her quite envious because some of them were simply too beautiful, such as Feng Yao, Tianshi Shengjie, and several others.

"Big Brother! Why are you in a daze?" Wu Lianzhi’s question brought Zhang Fei back to his senses. "Big Sis Jingzhi is pretty, right? Since she decided to join us of her own free will, and she took the initiative to give herself to you, you should eat her as soon as possible."

Zhang Fei nodded. "She’s pretty and sexy, and she’s stronger than most of you. However, our relationship is still in its early stages, and we don’t have any feelings for each other yet, so it’s still too early to take her as my woman."

Wang Jingzhi felt somewhat relieved after hearing Zhang Fei’s words. She had been considering this matter ever since he brought her to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. She had told herself that she would fulfill any of his requests as long as he was willing to help her Wang Clan. Even though he hasn’t done anything for her clan, she has realized that it will prosper again with his help, so she made such a decision.

"If I think about it, among all of us, my mother was the woman who became Big Brother’s wife the fastest." Ru Xue glared at her daughter, Xu Ling’er. After all, her first sexual experience with Zhang Fei was truly unusual, and they had sex for the first time while he was unconscious. "Hehe! Mom! You are his first wife, so you don’t need to be embarrassed anymore, right?"

"Humph!" Ru Xue nodded slightly. "Honestly, I still feel that our situation at that time was truly bizarre! After all, I was your father’s wife, and Fei’er was unconscious at that time. I didn’t know that he was in the process of awakening his two other bloodlines, and the pink gas affected me, which ended with us having sex."
Xu Ling’er teased her mother again. "Yet, you enjoyed your first sexual experience with our husband, right, Mom?"

"I did," Ru Xue admitted without hiding her shame. "Even though I was under the influence of his pink gas at the time, I thoroughly enjoyed my first experience with him. However, it also left a feeling of guilt in my heart, especially since I was still your father’s wife at that time."

"Big Sis Xue, I think your first experience was a little innocent compared to my mother’s because you did it with our husband in such a situation." Ru Xue certainly remembered the incident that Chu Qing was referring to. "Hehe! Our husband deliberately seduced my mother, even though he knew that she had a husband and three daughters at that time."

Liu Qingyu massaged her forehead. "Back then, I didn’t want to do such a thing with our husband, but I couldn’t hold myself back after I witnessed him and Hua’er having sex. After we returned to the Chu Clan, he deliberately approached me and seduced me, and we ended up being together from then on."
"Haha," Liu Hua softly laughed. "Big Sis, you could have left us at that time, but you chose to stay and peek at us, so it was your own fault."
Liu Qingyu was speechless about refuting Liu Hua. She could have left that cave at that time, but she decided to stay and watch her have sex with Zhang Fei.
After that, all the women took turns recounting their first sex with Zhang Fei, starting with Chu Ying and ending with Helian Xun’er.

Wang Jingzhi and Yuan Xiajie, who were listening to their story for the first time, were speechless because Zhang Fei was so lustful. However, they were not surprised by that because he was a lust demon, and members of that demon race were notoriously lustful.
At the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
Bing Xingying, who had just returned, was confused by the expressions of the five Luo Ancestors. She didn’t ask anything and sat beside her husband, with their son on her lap.

"I know the five of you are still thinking about what happened in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, but you guys have seen Zhang Fei’s progress for yourselves." Luo Fenghan paused and looked at his ancestors one by one. "My son-in-law has become stronger than all of us, and you have also seen his ruthlessness with your own eyes when he killed Xue Zhandi in front of everyone. Even though the five of you are our family, he has made it clear that he will not hesitate to kill you if you choose to become his enemy. Therefore, I hope you can throw away the envy and hatred in your hearts; otherwise, we won’t be able to save you from him."

Luo Qifeng sighed. "You don’t need to worry, Fenghan. Although we are greedy, we are not stupid. We are fully aware of the difference in strength between us and Zhang Fei, so we will not seek trouble with him."
"Since everything is over, we will enter seclusion again, and we will not interfere in external matters." After saying that, Luo Jieyi got up and left the room, followed by the other four.

Huang Xiaoyi was relieved that the five ancestors weren’t blinded by their greed. "What do you think will happen next, husband? Without our son-in-law, we have no chance against the two primordial beasts, and they could kill us as easily as turning over their palms."

"I don’t know what will happen in the future, but I’m certain that the two primordial beasts will not invade our domain." Luo Fenghan thought for a while before continuing. "Their targets are Emperor Long and our son-in-law, right? Fortunately, their real bodies cannot descend to this realm, and they can only use their avatars. Since our son-in-law can defeat them today, he will definitely be able to defeat them in the future. Even so, we must not slack off and relax, and we must prepare ourselves for any unforeseen eventualities."

"Since the leaders of the sects and clans in this realm have already witnessed the previous incident, we don’t need to bother with them, and they must have the same thoughts as us." Huang Xiaoyi looked at Bing Xingying. "Did Zhang Fei manage to obtain the void element?"
Bing Xingying nodded. "My brother-in-law has already obtained the void element, and he has also mastered the void elemental law, so he has ten elements now."

"Sigh." Huang Xiaoyi sighed. "In the past, Zhang Fei was just an ordinary human, so we decided not to bring him and his family into this realm with us. He only then realized that Wang Jingzhi was among his wives, and she seemed to have a good relationship with them, especially Xian Xianqin.
"How did you end up with them here?"
Wang Jingzhi felt embarrassed to explain everything to Zhang Fei, so Xian Xianqin spoke directly to him.
"We asked Sister Jingzhi to stay with us, husband.

Zhang Fei remembered his last conversation with Wang Jingzhi in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley over a month ago.
At that time, she had said that she would grant any of his wishes if he were willing to help her Wang Clan prosper again.

However, he hadn’t done anything for her clan because he was still busy preparing for his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie, so he didn’t expect her to take the initiative to approach and live with all his wives.
Yuan Xiajie, who was standing while leaning against the door, couldn’t help but shake her head.
She knew that Zhang Fei had more than a hundred women, but she didn’t expect that every one of them was a peerless beauty.
Their beauty made her quite envious because some of them were simply too beautiful, such as Feng Yao, Tianshi Shengjie, and several others.
"Big Brother!
Why are you in a daze?" Wu Lianzhi’s question brought Zhang Fei back to his senses.
"Big Sis Jingzhi is pretty, right?
Since she decided to join us of her own free will, and she took the initiative to give herself to you, you should eat her as soon as possible."

You are his first wife, so you don’t need to be embarrassed anymore, right?"

I didn’t know that he was in the process of awakening his two other bloodlines, and the pink gas affected me, which ended with us having sex."
Xu Ling’er teased her mother again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1755: People’s Worries II
paragraphs: Dugu Yuanshen looked at them one by one. "Do you think we can stop those two primordial beasts? Emperor Long, Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, and the demon gods are stronger than us, but they are powerless against their pressure. Our secret technique can indeed increase our strength, but we won’t be able to do anything against those two primordial beasts."

"Master." Dugu Yuanshen looked at Dugu Liangsen. "Our hope is Zhang Fei and Empress Huo because they can move and fight the two primordial beasts. However, we can’t rely on them; we must do something to protect ourselves and our domain."

Dugu Yuanshen agreed with his first disciple. "I had already known that Zhang Fei was different from other cultivators since I first saw him on the third floor of the tower, but I seem to have underestimated him. Besides, Empress Huo was one of his wives, and her cultivation had already surpassed the Five Celestial Realms, so they were our hope to fight the two primordial beasts."
"Do you know the stages after the Five Celestial Realms, Master?"

"Zhang Fei said that it was the Three God Realms: The God King Realm, the God Emperor Realm, and the Supreme God Realm." Dugu Yuanshen let out a sigh with a hint of disappointment. "He said that cultivators from the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm would never be able to reach that stage, and Empress Huo was able to reach it because she was a special existence."
Dugu Liangsen and the others had also heard Zhang Fei’s conversation with the hidden forces earlier. One of them said that Feng Yao was Xin, the embodiment of the core of their universe.
"Master—"

"That’s enough." Dugu Yuanshen stopped them. "There’s no point in discussing Zhang Fei and Empress Huo’s strength and identities. Our main focus right now is to increase our strength so that we can handle those creatures if they invade this Paradise Realm."

After discussing a few other matters, they left the room. Dugu Yuanshen walked to the window, looking up at the sky in thought. "What are your next plans, young man? At first, I thought we could help you deal with those creatures, but that seems impossible now."

The humans from several other domains had the same thoughts as Dugu Yuanshen; they would rather not rely on Zhang Fei and Feng Yao, and they began to prepare themselves to deal with the threat from those creatures.

The situation in the Floral Mirage Domain was relatively calm compared to other domains. Although the members of the natural races were worried about the threat posed by these creatures, they didn’t let it weigh them down. They believed Zhang Fei would lead them in their extermination, and they awaited his next order.

Just like the natural races, the demihuman races of the Heavenly Mistveil Domain didn’t dare underestimate those creatures, but they didn’t want the matter to become a burden for them. Long Huoyan urged all races in his domain not to rely on Zhang Fei; he also ordered them to cultivate harder and prepare themselves for the worst.
In the Forgotten Land.
Xuanyuan Fenglei, the patriarch of the Xuanyuan Clan, listened to stories from Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the other five ancestors regarding the events in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

"The Eternal Flame is in Zhang Fei’s hands, and he needs Huo Ling’s help to defeat those creatures." Xuanyuan Qian sighed. "We have long wanted to return to the Ancient Realm, but the domain will remain sealed before the flame returns to the temple."
"Zhang Fei can take us to the Paradise Realm, so he should be able to send us to one of the domains in the Ancient Realm, right?" Xuanyuan Wuyue asked.

Xuanyuan Changyi nodded. "Zhang Fei should be able to send us there, but are we really going to abandon our ancestral land? I know that our lives will be better if we move to other domains, but I don’t have the heart to leave."

"The main problem is that those creatures have taken over many domains, and they are constantly trying to break into the Puyang Clan." Xuanyuan Shun looked at the others. "Although our domain has been in this state for a long time, it is still part of the Ancient Realm, so I’m worried that those creatures will break into our domain one day."

"You’re right," Xuanyuan Hao agreed with him. "Those creatures and the two primordial beasts are a real threat to this universe, and those hidden forces say that Zhang Fei is our only hope of defeating them."

"Even if Zhang Fei is our hope for defeating those creatures, we cannot stand idly by and let him fight alone for the future of this universe. The strength of those creatures and the two primordial beasts far surpasses ours, but we are the inhabitants of this universe, so we are also responsible for its safety." Xuanyuan Zhuanxu sighed. "We can’t do anything because they are far beyond our reach, and the only thing we can do is focus on ourselves, so we will be ready if he needs our help in the future."
At the Puyang Clan.

Puyang Shenmi listened to Puyang Shangren and the others’ explanation of the previous incident. She was shocked after they told her Feng Yao’s identity as Xin, the embodiment of the core of their universe.

Puyang Shenmi had long suspected that Feng Yao’s true identity was beyond her comprehension, but she never expected that she was the embodiment of the core of their universe, and their universe would be destroyed if she died.
"So, what should we do, Ancestor?" Puyang Zong asked gloomily.

Puyang Shangren spoke again. "Those two primordial beasts are indeed powerful, but I don’t think they pose a threat to us right now. They’re targeting Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao because they are the Calamity Demon Dragon and the Five-Clawed Gold Dragon of this era, so I’m sure they won’t attack us. On the contrary, those creatures are a terrible threat to this universe, and we don’t know when and where the main creature will appear."

"I can’t make a decision right now." Puyang Shenmi looked at them. "Since Senior Feng can’t appear before us anymore, I’ll wait for Zhang Fei to come to our domain again, and I’ll discuss this matter with him. For now, I want all of you to focus on the matters within our clan, and you guys must do your best to prevent those creatures from breaching our barrier."
"Yes, Ancestor."

Puyang Shenmi watched them leave while thinking. "The Three God Realms, huh? Last time she came to my clan, Senior Feng said that cultivators in the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm would never be able to reach that stage, and we would have to go to the Primordial Realm to reach it. Unfortunately, she didn’t explain to me the path to get there, so I was blind about those stages. I hope Zhang Fei will come here soon, and we will discuss many things at that time."

The situation in the Twin Flames Domain was much calmer than the other domains after Zhang Fei’s clones went to meet all the residents. They told those people not to worry too much about those two primordial beasts, but they asked them to stay alert and watch out for their sudden appearances.
"I didn’t expect that the two primordial beasts would find you and Long Wuzhao, Master." Serpentera said with a serious expression.
Tian Kui was anxious about it. "Do you think they will find us here, Master?"

"I don’t think so." Zhang Fei [5] patted their shoulders. "Old Kui and Old Snake, I can’t return to this domain often because the two primordial beasts already know about me, and I’m afraid they’ll attack here if they find me here, so I’ll leave the protection of this domain to you two. Although I will rarely return, I will often send Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling back, and you two can discuss with them if there are any problems."
Serpentera sighed. "What about your plan to move all your acquaintances to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, Master?"

"Those creatures are simply too powerful, and the main creature is even more powerful. Yao’er and I aren’t ready to face them yet, so I won’t risk moving them there. When we succeed in defeating those creatures and the two primordial beasts, I will move them all there." Zhang Fei[5] looked away, and the two women appeared before him. They were Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi who were sent by Feng Yao to protect the domain and the sect. "Yao’er can’t return to this realm anymore, and she has already handed over everyone from the Blazing Nirvana Domain to me. Old Snake and Old Kui are strong, but they won’t be able to protect this domain by themselves, so I hope the two of you are willing to help them."
Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "You are our master’s husband, so you are also our master, and we will protect this domain according to your wishes."
"Thank you." Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi immediately disappeared from Zhang Fei [5]’s sight. "I’ll be leaving now, and you two can contact me if there’s an emergency."
"Yes, Master."
Before long, Zhang Fei [5] walked into the meeting room in the golden dragon palace, where Long Wuzhao and the others were already waiting for him.
"What should we do now, Zhang Fei?"

Zhang Fei [5] sighed and sat down in an empty chair. "Emperor Long, you must leave this domain; otherwise, the two primordial beasts will attack this domain again. Yao’er can’t return to this realm, and I don’t have the confidence to face them. I can defeat them today because their two avatars aren’t that strong, but they might send even stronger avatars in the future, so we must eliminate your traces from this domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 1756: Take Long Wuzhao Away
paragraphs: "Hey, kid! The two primordial beasts must have locked onto his aura, and they can find him no matter where he hides."
Zhang Fei [5] let out a helpless sigh. "Senior Xukong, you are young, but you are already senile."
"You—"

"Have you forgotten my beast space?" Long Xukong was momentarily stunned before nodding. "Emperor Long can stay there space for a while, and the facilities there are quite useful for him. The two primordial beasts won’t know about it, so they won’t be able to find him. As for the position of leader of the beast races, aren’t my father-in-law and Senior Feng Jinhuang still here? After you send me to the Myriad Abyss Domain, you can come straight back here to assist them."
Long Xukong stared at Long Wuzhao before letting out a soft sigh. "When will you continue your journey to the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
"In three days." Long Wuzhao raised an eyebrow. "Today is my wedding day with Tianshi Shengjie, so I can’t possibly leave her on our special day, right?"
Tianshi Bailong nodded with a smile. "Why don’t you take my daughter with you? That way, you won’t have to waste three days, and you can arrive at the Myriad Abyss Domain on schedule."
"Well? I can take my wife with me, but—" Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Long Xukong before continuing. "But someone already complained to me because I was having fun with my wives on his back."
"Cough... Cough..." Long Xukong slammed the table. "You little bastard! You are slandering me!"
"Hahaha," Long Wuzhao and the others laughed, listening to their banter.
Long Xukong gnashed his teeth. "Hey, Brother Bailong! I can tell you that there’s an interesting place in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley! I’m sure you and my sister-in-law will love that place."
"You mean the Yin-Yang Spirit River, right?"
"Huh? You knew?" Long Xukong was surprised.

"How could I not know about that place?" Tianshi Bailong smiled bitterly. "Your wife has repeatedly discussed it with my wife, and Lingyue insisted that I ask my son-in-law to take us there. Besides, she also told my wife that my son-in-law had already fixed your tool, and she was satisfied with the results."

"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed out loud, looking at Long Xukong’s embarrassed face. "Father-in-law, they spent the whole day at the Yin-Yang Spirit River, you know? If I didn’t want to go to the Frozen Yin Domain, they probably wouldn’t have stopped then."
"You little bastard!" Long Xukong roared.
"Hey! Can someone explain to me about the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley and the Yin-Yang Spirit River?" Feng Jinhuang and the other leaders looked at Zhang Fei [5].

"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley is one of the domains in the Ancient Realm, and the Yin-Yang Spirit River is a river there." Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen that displayed the latest situation in that domain; he explained to them every area there. "I have already begun rebuilding that domain, and I will bring my close friends to move there in the future."
Long Wuzhao was quite surprised to hear that. "Are you going to move the people of the Twin Flames Domain there?"

"I will only bring those who have a close relationship with me," Zhang Fei [5] paused. "Apart from them, I am also considering bringing some people from other domains there, and I will be their sole leader."

Long Wuzhao and the others were stunned upon hearing this. However, they had to admit that Zhang Fei [5] was the right leader to lead them, and one of the factors was his relationship with Feng Yao. They had already felt her rise in strength before, and there was no cultivator who could match her in the Paradise Realm.

Aside from Feng Yao, Zhang Fei [5] had close ties with the Puyang Clan, which was one of the clans in the Ancient Realm. He also took Puyang Yeyu as his woman, so the clan would definitely side with him.

Zhang Fei [5] continued. "Honestly, I have never been interested in becoming the leader of all races, and I only want a quiet and peaceful life for all my wives. The situation in the Ancient Realm is different from this Paradise Realm, and the cultivators there are much stronger, even though their cultivation levels are the same. Besides, that domain will become my home domain, and the people of this realm will never be able to move there without me."
"Then?"

Zhang Fei [5] waved his hand. "I don’t want to talk about that matter now because the situation in the Ancient Realm is much more dangerous than this Paradise Realm, and I will gather everyone after I defeat that main creature in the future. If I rush to bring them to that domain, those creatures will attack us, and they will die in vain."
Long Wuzhao and the others nodded in understanding of Zhang Fei’s concern. Currently, two dangers were threatening their future: primordial beasts and those creatures.
"So, what is your decision, Emperor Long? If you continue to stay in this domain, you will endanger your people, and it will be too late if the two primordial beasts come here again."
Long Wuzhao sighed. "Alright, I’ll stay in your beast space for now. Brother Bailong will handle all the affairs in this domain, and Feng Jinhuang will assist him in handling everything."

Tianshi Bailong and Feng Jinhuang had no problem with that. After all, the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain was the home of the Celestial Dragon Race and the Phoenix Race, so they felt obligated to protect it while Long Wuzhao was away.
"That’s great!" Zhang Fei [5] rose from his seat and walked beside Long Wuzhao. "Senior Xukong, we’ll be leaving in three days, so you can accompany Senior Lingyue for the next few days."

"You little brat!" Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly took Long Wuzhao into his beast space, leaving Long Xukong helpless. "Brother Bailong, I will help you handle the affairs in this domain after I return in two months."
"Alright."
Thereafter, all the leaders of the beast races left the golden palace and returned to their respective places.
"So, this is your beast space, huh?" Long Wuzhao looked around. "This place is indeed the most suitable environment for beasts."
Feng Yao appeared beside them. "I knew you would bring him here, husband."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "I have no other choice, right? If he stays in his domain, the two primordial beasts will come there again, and they might destroy the domain."
Feng Yao nodded at him. "Your beast space is the safest place to hide him, and those two primordial beasts won’t be able to track his whereabouts, so he and his domain will be safe."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei [5] looked at Long Wuzhao. "I’ll leave you here with Yao’er, Emperor Long."
"Alright." After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Long Wuzhao asked Feng Yao. "Has your cultivation really reached the Supreme God Realm now?"

Feng Yao smiled. "Didn’t Ming say it clearly before? Unfortunately, I can’t help you reach the Three God Realms because the qi here is insufficient for that, so your cultivation will be stuck at this level unless you go to the Primordial Realm."
"I know." Long Wuzhao looked at the beasts in the distance. "Who are they?"

Feng Yao looked at them. "Jiu Shui, Lei Que, Tianguo, Long Jishan, and I are my husband’s contract beasts. You Bai is Tang Ziyu’s contract beast. Hu Yi and Hu Er are Chu Ying and Xu Ling’er’s contract beasts. Hai Ma is Zhang Lin’s contract beast. Lan Zhen is Shen Yu’s contract beast. Shui Huoyan and Shou Yunzhi are Wu Lianzi and Xian Xianqin’s contract beasts. Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan have no master, but my husband is interested in taking them as his wives."
"I see," Long Wuzhao asked another question. "Are you sure that Zhang Fei won’t encounter any problems in the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
"You underestimate him too much." Feng Yao led Long Wuzhao to another area. "Besides, Ling’er is by my husband’s side, and she’s no less powerful than me, so he’ll be fine in that domain."

Long Wuzhao nodded slightly. "I find it hard to believe that you are the embodiment of the core of this universe. No wonder you are so powerful, and no cultivator in the Paradise Realm can defeat you, including me."

"Haha," Feng Yao chuckled softly. "You may have felt lonely in your life, but your loneliness is different from mine. When I first found out that I was alive, I was alone in this universe, and I had to wait a long time for the Primordial Era to begin. At that time, I thought of many ways to live like the Primordials, and I took the Immortal Reincarnation Physique for myself before I manifested myself as Shen Yuanzhi. However, my selfishness brought disaster to this universe, and I reincarnated several times to find the savior."
"Zhang Fei."
"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded. "The appearance of that young girl changed the destiny of this universe, and Zhang Fei was born with the destiny of being the savior."
"Let me ask you one thing."
"What?"
"How did you fall in love with Zhang Fei? I don’t know about your past life, but I remember your character when you lived as Huo Yanling, and you were devoid of feelings at that time."

Feng Yao shook her head. "To be honest, I don’t understand when and how I fell in love with Zhang Fei. From our first meeting in the Sky Jade Realm until he ascended to the Paradise Realm, I didn’t have that kind of feeling for him, and I only wanted to guide him on the path of the savior. My feelings for him grew uncontrollably, and I fell in love with him without realizing it."
"So, have you completely fallen in love with him now?"
"I am." Feng Yao fell silent. "However, I can’t predict the future of our relationship, and I might die by his hands one day."

chapters.title: Chapter 1757: Continue Their Journey
paragraphs: Long Wuzhao looked at Feng Yao, bewildered. He stared at her silently for a while and then asked. "Do you think Zhang Fei will dare to kill you in the future?"
"He will; he has no choice." Feng Yao didn’t elaborate further and sat down in her spot.

Long Wuzhao was confused by Feng Yao’s words. Although he wasn’t that close to Zhang Fei personally, he wasn’t a fool, and he could see that the kid loved all of his wives so much that he was obsessed with protecting them.
Since Feng Yao didn’t want to say it clearly, Long Wuzhao didn’t disturb her and looked away. He looked at Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan, observed them, and approached them.

Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan opened their eyes when Long Wuzhao stood in front of them. The two women immediately stood up and cupped their hands. "Please accept our respect, Golden Dragon Emperor."

"No need to be so formal." Long Wuzhau pushed their hands down. "You two come from the Sky Dragon Realm, right? Lei Huoting is a qilin—a lightning and fire qilin, which is extremely rare for your race. Yuwen Xingyuan is a kunpeng, right?"
Yuwen Xingyuan nodded. "I do come from the kunpeng race, Emperor. Zhang Fei brought all my family to the Paradise Realm, and they lived in the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"I’ve been to the sect before, so I know about you all, but I’ve never seen you two there before." Long Wuzhao deliberately suppressed his aura so as not to frighten the two women.
Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting didn’t expect Long Wuzhao to be so easy to talk to, which made them feel at ease talking to him.
Yuwen Xingyuan spoke again. "When you came to the sect that time, the two of us were training in Zhang Fei’s private place, Emperor."
"We trained there since we were still living in the Sky Dragon Realm, and we moved to his beast space after we got stuck with our training." Lei Huoting calmly and carefully spoke.
Long Wuzhao gave them repeated nods. "Even though you two haven’t become Zhang Fei’s wives yet, you’re quite impressive with your cultivation, having already reached the Five Celestial Realms."

Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting were truly embarrassed to hear that from Long Wuzhao. They had known that Zhang Fei had wanted them as his wives for a long time, and he had also given them many benefits over the years, but they had never considered accepting him.

Seeing Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting’s awkwardness, Long Wuzhao could guess their feelings, but he didn’t say anything about it. "If you two feel bored here, you should go to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain for sightseeing, and you will meet many beasts from various races there."
"Actually, we had wanted to visit that domain for a long time, but we chose to postpone it and focus on our cultivation first." Lei Huoting said.
Then, Yuwen Xingyuan asked. "Is there a kunpeng race in your domain, Emperor?"

"No," Long Wuzhao shook his head slightly. "The Kunpeng race also exists in the Paradise Realm, but their numbers are not large, around twenty. They are unwilling to stay in my domain, and they have chosen to spread out to several other domains. I have repeatedly persuaded them, but they always refuse my requests, so I let them live as they wish."
"Huh?" Yuwen Xingyuan was shocked. "Why are there so few of them? Even in my family, there are more than fifty kunpeng."
"That is their choice, and I can’t do anything to change their choice." Long Wuzhao released a regretful sigh. "You two can continue your cultivation, and I won’t bother you anymore."
"Yes, Emperor."

After Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting sat down again, Long Wuzhao left them and went to see the other beasts. He wasn’t surprised that Lei Que and the others had transformed into humans, but he didn’t expect You Bai and Tianguo to do it as well, and he guessed that it was Zhang Fei who helped them.

"Interesting! This is the first time I’ve seen a wind weasel and a black demon dog turn into humans." Long Wuzhao shifted his gaze to Jiu Shui, who was focused on cultivating. "The Nine-Headed Serpent, huh? Based on his cultivation level, his fourth head should have appeared, so only five heads have yet to appear. If he evolves to his perfect form with nine heads in the future, he will be the second strongest after Empress Huo."

Long Wuzhao looked at the other beasts, such as Hai Ma, Hu Yi, Hu Er, Lan Zhen, Long Jishan, Sha Huoyan, and Shao Yunzhi. Compared to the others, he was more curious about the last two. ’That kid! I don’t know where Zhang Fei found the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant and the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth because their races should have long been extinct in the outside world, and their cultivation is quite high in the Celestial Emperor Realm.’
Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi opened their eyes, and they immediately knew that Long Wuzhao was the Five Clawed Golden Dragon, but they did not have the same respect for him as the other beasts..
"I don’t know how Zhang Fei found you two, but your two races should have been extinct a long time ago, right?"

Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi hummed in acknowledgment. "Although both our races were extinct in the past, we still live today, and we have our masters. We believe that both our races will rise again in the future because Zhang Fei has promised to help us revive our races."
"I see." Long Wuzhao nodded with a smile. "Since Zhang Fei has promised you both that, you only need to wait for the day to come, and I will personally witness the revival of both your races."
"Yes."

Long Wuzhao didn’t talk much with Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi, and he went to Feng Yao’s side to cultivate. ’Sigh! I am the one and only golden dragon in this universe, and I have long been the emperor of the beast races, but I feel so powerless now.’
At the residence.

Zhang Fei didn’t dual cultivate with all his wives, and he enjoyed his time with them like a normal extended family. There were no boundaries between the women, and they didn’t care whether they were senior or junior.

Although Zhang Chen had been Zhang Fei’s wife for a long time, all the women respected her as an elder, including Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Puyang Yeyu, Dong Xuanyin, Tian Yaoqin, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin. Even the noble Celestial Dragon Princess, Tianshi Shengjie, positioned herself beneath her. After all, she was their husband’s grandmother, and he always had high respect for her.

Although Qing Yi could be considered their mother-in-law, not all of the women had too much respect for her, except those who came from the Three Mortal Realms. Instead, they considered her as Zhang Fei’s other wife, just like them.

Although Wang Jingzhi had been living with them for a few days before, she felt awkward around them, especially with Zhang Fei present among them. However, the women’s demeanor erased her awkwardness, and she slowly blended with them like an old sister.

Seeing the situation inside the residence and the relationships between all the women, Yuan Xiajie felt a sense of jealousy rise within her. Her family members were long dead, and she had lived alone in the vastness of the Ancient Realm since their deaths. Since then, she had thought of nothing but revenge, and she went to extreme lengths to take revenge against the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhou. ’If only that bastard hadn’t slaughtered my family, we would still be living happily like them.’
Zhang Fei could understand Yuan Xiajie’s feelings, but he didn’t ask her anything, and he focused more on accompanying all his wives.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei’s four clones had returned to the pavilion in the training space, and they continued to absorb the Yin Qi from the female yin demon. As Feng Yao had said before, the Yin Qi within the female demon’s body was simply too abundant, and it would take them a very long time to absorb it clean.
In the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain.

Taotie and the other three evil beasts knelt on the floor, listening to Xu Yuanzhi’s orders. They were completely shocked after he informed them that he and Huang Yuanzhi had been defeated by Zhang Fei, and both of them had to flee the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

Xu Yuanzhi gave them the location of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and he ordered them to prepare troops to attack the beast race to capture Long Wuzhao. As for Zhang Fei, he forbade them from taking action against him, especially with Feng Yao behind him.

After everything was finished, Xu Yuanzhi disappeared from the domain, and the four perils immediately carried out their master’s orders by preparing their troops to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
Three days passed quickly, and Zhang Fei was already inside the void with Yuan Xiajie and several of his wives, who were curious about the situation there.
Although Zhang Fei had obtained the void element, it was still too weak, so he asked Long Xukong to take them to the Myriad Abyss Domain.

For the past three days, Zhang Fei sent his parents-in-law to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley because Tianshi Lingyue was eager to try the benefits of the Yin-Yang Spirit River. He also helped them by slightly modifying their bodies, which completely satisfied his mother-in-law.
As for Mo Shentian’s movements, Zhang Fei handed the task over to Wu Mian, and he asked him to inform him if the Celestial Demon God had arrived in the Endless Domain.
"How long will it take to get to that domain, Big Brother?"

Zhang Fei hugged Wu Lianzhi, who was sitting on his lap. "We’ll arrive at that domain in about twenty-five days, but I won’t take you inside because it’s a demon domain, and the demonic aura there will transform you into a demon."
"Oh."
