I have repeatedly persuaded them, but they always refuse my requests, so I let them live as they wish."
"Huh?" Yuwen Xingyuan was shocked.
"Why are there so few of them?
Even in my family, there are more than fifty kunpeng."
"That is their choice, and I can’t do anything to change their choice." Long Wuzhao released a regretful sigh.
"You two can continue your cultivation, and I won’t bother you anymore."
"Yes, Emperor."
After Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting sat down again, Long Wuzhao left them and went to see the other beasts.
He wasn’t surprised that Lei Que and the others had transformed into humans, but he didn’t expect You Bai and Tianguo to do it as well, and he guessed that it was Zhang Fei who helped them.
"Interesting!
This is the first time I’ve seen a wind weasel and a black demon dog turn into humans." Long Wuzhao shifted his gaze to Jiu Shui, who was focused on cultivating.
"The Nine-Headed Serpent, huh?
Based on his cultivation level, his fourth head should have appeared, so only five heads have yet to appear.
If he evolves to his perfect form with nine heads in the future, he will be the second strongest after Empress Huo."
Long Wuzhao looked at the other beasts, such as Hai Ma, Hu Yi, Hu Er, Lan Zhen, Long Jishan, Sha Huoyan, and Shao Yunzhi.
Compared to the others, he was more curious about the last two. ’That kid!

I don’t know where Zhang Fei found the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant and the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth because their races should have long been extinct in the outside world, and their cultivation is quite high in the Celestial Emperor Realm.’
Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi opened their eyes, and they immediately knew that Long Wuzhao was the Five Clawed Golden Dragon, but they did not have the same respect for him as the other beasts..
"I don’t know how Zhang Fei found you two, but your two races should have been extinct a long time ago, right?"
Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi hummed in acknowledgment.
"Although both our races were extinct in the past, we still live today, and we have our masters.
We believe that both our races will rise again in the future because Zhang Fei has promised to help us revive our races."
"I see." Long Wuzhao nodded with a smile.
"Since Zhang Fei has promised you both that, you only need to wait for the day to come, and I will personally witness the revival of both your races."
"Yes."
Long Wuzhao didn’t talk much with Sha Huoyan and Shao Yunzhi, and he went to Feng Yao’s side to cultivate. ’Sigh!
I am the one and only golden dragon in this universe, and I have long been the emperor of the beast races, but I feel so powerless now.’
At the residence.
Zhang Fei didn’t dual cultivate with all his wives, and he enjoyed his time with them like a normal extended family.
There were no boundaries between the women, and they didn’t care whether they were senior or junior.

Although Zhang Chen had been Zhang Fei’s wife for a long time, all the women respected her as an elder, including Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Puyang Yeyu, Dong Xuanyin, Tian Yaoqin, Fei Lian, and Yao Qilin.
Even the noble Celestial Dragon Princess, Tianshi Shengjie, positioned herself beneath her.
After all, she was their husband’s grandmother, and he always had high respect for her.
Although Qing Yi could be considered their mother-in-law, not all of the women had too much respect for her, except those who came from the Three Mortal Realms.
Instead, they considered her as Zhang Fei’s other wife, just like them.
Although Wang Jingzhi had been living with them for a few days before, she felt awkward around them, especially with Zhang Fei present among them.
However, the women’s demeanor erased her awkwardness, and she slowly blended with them like an old sister.
Seeing the situation inside the residence and the relationships between all the women, Yuan Xiajie felt a sense of jealousy rise within her.
Her family members were long dead, and she had lived alone in the vastness of the Ancient Realm since their deaths.

Since then, she had thought of nothing but revenge, and she went to extreme lengths to take revenge against the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhou. ’If only that bastard hadn’t slaughtered my family, we would still be living happily like them.’
Zhang Fei could understand Yuan Xiajie’s feelings, but he didn’t ask her anything, and he focused more on accompanying all his wives.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei’s four clones had returned to the pavilion in the training space, and they continued to absorb the Yin Qi from the female yin demon.
As Feng Yao had said before, the Yin Qi within the female demon’s body was simply too abundant, and it would take them a very long time to absorb it clean.
In the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain.
Taotie and the other three evil beasts knelt on the floor, listening to Xu Yuanzhi’s orders.
They were completely shocked after he informed them that he and Huang Yuanzhi had been defeated by Zhang Fei, and both of them had to flee the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
Xu Yuanzhi gave them the location of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and he ordered them to prepare troops to attack the beast race to capture Long Wuzhao.
As for Zhang Fei, he forbade them from taking action against him, especially with Feng Yao behind him.

After everything was finished, Xu Yuanzhi disappeared from the domain, and the four perils immediately carried out their master’s orders by preparing their troops to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
Three days passed quickly, and Zhang Fei was already inside the void with Yuan Xiajie and several of his wives, who were curious about the situation there.
Although Zhang Fei had obtained the void element, it was still too weak, so he asked Long Xukong to take them to the Myriad Abyss Domain.
For the past three days, Zhang Fei sent his parents-in-law to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley because Tianshi Lingyue was eager to try the benefits of the Yin-Yang Spirit River.
He also helped them by slightly modifying their bodies, which completely satisfied his mother-in-law.
As for Mo Shentian’s movements, Zhang Fei handed the task over to Wu Mian, and he asked him to inform him if the Celestial Demon God had arrived in the Endless Domain.
"How long will it take to get to that domain, Big Brother?"
Zhang Fei hugged Wu Lianzhi, who was sitting on his lap.
"We’ll arrive at that domain in about twenty-five days, but I won’t take you inside because it’s a demon domain, and the demonic aura there will transform you into a demon."
"Oh."

chapters.title: Chapter 1758: Long Xukong - Yuan Xiajie
paragraphs: Wu Lianzhi turned to Zhang Fei when his two hands slipped into her dress, kneading her breasts. She couldn’t possibly refuse him because she was his wife; instead, she smiled flirtatiously and teased him. "Big Brother Fei~ Are you losing control of your lust after three days of abstaining from sex?"

"Lianzhi, your body developed so well, you know?" Zhang Fei whispered into Wu Lianzhi’s ear. "Do you still remember our first meeting in the Wasteland Realm? You were only eleven years old at that time, but you tried to flirt with me."
"Hehe," Wu Lianzhi giggled. "Of course, I still remember those days, Big Brother Fei~! Back then, I thought you were a pedophile because you didn’t refuse when I flirted with you."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed. "You’re still young, but you’re already senile, huh? I’ll concoct a pill to refresh your memory so you won’t go senile easily."

"Ugh! You’re so mean!" Wu Lianzhi pouted. "In the past, I didn’t have many male friends, and I spent most of my time with my father. When we first met, I thought you were handsome and dashing, and I fell in love with you. I didn’t want to be separated from you, and I wanted to be your wife when I grew up, so I tried to flirt with you. My parents were very understanding, and they were aware that I had fallen in love with you. They didn’t say anything because I was a little girl at the time, but I’m grateful that they supported my feelings for you."
Zhang Fei smiled. "If your mother wasn’t my senior sister, she wouldn’t support your feelings, and she would forbid you from being close to me."

"Well, that’s true." Wu Lianzhi nodded several times. "Fortunately, you have the training space, and the flow of time there helped me mature much faster. If you didn’t have it, I would still be a young girl now, and I wouldn’t be your wife yet."
"But you still waited quite a long time before becoming my wife, right?"
"Isn’t that your fault? You knew about my feelings, and my parents agreed with my wish to become your wife, but you made me wait too long."
Zhang Fei squeezed Wu Lianzhi quite hard, and her moans startled the other women, including Yuan Xiajie. "Although you had to wait quite a long time, you finally got your wish to be my wife."
"Humph!" Wu Lianzhi huffed. "The day you took me as your wife was the happiest day of my life. That day my dream finally came true, and I am truly grateful to have you as my husband."
"Have you ever regretted being my wife?"

"Why should I regret it?" Wu Lianzhi turned to face Zhang Fei, wrapping both her arms around his neck. "People say that first love has its own meaning, but not everyone has the chance to be one with their first love. Even though I have to share you with over a hundred of my sisters, I have never once felt any regret in my heart. You are my first love, and you will always be my husband until the end of my life. You agree with me, right, Ling’er?"

Xu Ling’er, who was sitting beside them, nodded. "I will never regret my past decision to become your wife because you are my first love, and I will accompany you through all circumstances until the end of time. Fortunately, you had an accident that day; otherwise, I would never have had the chance to be your wife because of your relationship with my mother."

"Haha! Aren’t you wrong about that, Ling’er?" Zhang Fei stretched out his right hand, rubbing Xu Ling’er’s cheek. "If that accident never happened, I would never have had a relationship with your mother, and you two would be with Brother Xu to this day."

Xu Ling’er agreed with that. "After the accident, you and my mother were entangled together. Although your relationship with her was caused by an accident, it changed our lives, and we ultimately became your wives. However, there is still one thing missing in our lives, and I hope you will fulfill it soon."

"Children." Wu Lianzhi, Xu Ling’er, and the other women looked at Zhang Fei expectantly. They had been his wives for decades, and they had long harbored a desire to have children with him. "Hmm? What if I impregnate all of you after I defeat that main creature?"
All the women’s ears perked up. "Really? Are you really going to impregnate us at that time?"

Seeing the impatience and expectation in their expressions, Zhang Fei felt deep guilt toward them. They had long wanted to have children with him, but he was never ready to impregnate them because there were too many powerful enemies out there who could destroy their joyful life.
Zhang Fei nodded at them. "I promise I’ll impregnate all of you at that time, and we’ll have many children then."
"Fei! I want to have two children with you." Chu Qing raised two fingers. "A son and a daughter."
Chu Ying looked at her youngest sister. "I don’t need too many children, and I only want to have a son."
"Me too!" Chu Xing exclaimed with excitement. "I don’t want to have a daughter because I won’t be able to accept the situation if our daughter falls in love with her father."
Zhang Fei looked at Chu Xing dumbfounded. "Do you guys really think that I will take my future daughters as my wives?"
"Yes!"
They shouted at Zhang Fei at the same time.
"You took Grandma Chen, Mother Qing, Sister Yue, and Sister Ling as your wives, remember?"
"You are too lustful; we believe you will take our future daughters as your wives, so we don’t want to give birth to daughters."
"Oh!" Chu Qing just realized that. "I still want to have two children, but they have to be sons."
"Hahaha!"

Zhang Fei rolled his eyes, but he didn’t deny them, even though he didn’t have such thoughts. Naturally, he wanted to have daughters, and he was sure that they would be beautiful women when they grew up.

Yuan Xiajie, who was sitting on Long Xukong’s dragon head, smiled to herself, listening to all the women. ’Even though they have to share Zhang Fei with so many of them, all of them look happy to be his wives, and they even plan to have many children with him.’
"What are you thinking, Senior?" Long Xukong asked.
Yuan Xiajie sighed. "Are you happy with your life now?"
"Hmm?" Long Xukong was taken aback. "The point of your question is, am I happy with my family life?"

"Yes!" Yuan Xiajie nodded. "Unlike all of you, my family was slaughtered by Meng Zhou when I was young. Since then, my life has been consumed by sorrow, and I’ve strived to improve myself in order to avenge their deaths, so I have no time for romantic matters."
"Have you ever been in love before that day?"
"In love, huh?" Yuan Xiajie murmured softly. "At that time, I was still too young and immature, so I had never fallen in love with anyone."

"I see." Long Xukong nodded in understanding. "Falling in love and having a family is everyone’s dream, including me. When I fell in love with my wife for the first time, we were still too young, but we were responsible for our feelings. When we got married, that day was the happiest day in our lives. We became even happier when our son was born, and his birth made our lives perfect."
"How long have you been married to your wife?"

"Hmm? We’ve been married for hundreds of thousands of years." Long Xukong paused and thought. "We often face ups and downs in our married life, but we always communicate eloquently, allowing us to resolve any problems that arise quickly."
"What do you think of Zhang Fei?"

Long Xukong did not immediately answer Yuan Xiajie’s question. "That kid is too lustful because he is a lust demon, a celestial fox, and a dragon. The number of his wives is the most I have ever met, but I don’t know the details or the depth of their relationship, so I can’t give my assessment. You’ve met all of his wives before, and you’ve seen their situations with your own eyes, so you should be able to judge their relationship."

"All of them looked so happy to be Zhang Fei’s wives, and they also had a good relationship with each other, which was truly rare. I envy their lives because they are so happy, and they have a husband who always cares for them." Yuan Xiajie stole a quick glance at Zhang Fei, who was chatting with all the women. "When my family was alive, I never lacked affection because everyone loved me so much. Everything disappeared after their deaths, and all that remains in my life is hatred and grudge."

Even though he had never experienced such an incident in his life, Long Xukong could understand Yuan Xiajie’s feelings. "You’re not wrong if you hate the person who killed your family, but you shouldn’t let your revenge and hatred consume your heart and mind. If you let them consume your heart and mind, you will lose the opportunity for a better future."
"Do you think I will have a better future if I am with Zhang Fei?"

’Tch! That brat! All the women will eventually throw themselves at him!’ Long Xukong inwardly cursed. "Zhang Fei is not the only man in this universe, right? He is indeed extraordinary, and his future is bright. However, not all women can accept such a situation like all his wives, and you also may not be able to accept it, right?"
Yuan Xiajie did not reply to Long Xukong, but she thought deeply about his words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1759: Enter Seclusion Again
paragraphs: For the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Domain, Zhang Fei thought that Serpentera, Tian Kui, Huo Mingyi, and Huo Mengyi were enough to protect both of them.

After they accompanied him for a while, Zhang Fei sent Wu Lianzhi and the others to the training space. His first clone picked up his other women who still stayed in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain and sent them to the training space, as most of them had previously spent too much time in the Tower of Eternity.

Zhang Fei’s second clone sent people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, the Celestial Moon Sect and the Hidden Moon Sect to the Zenith Solar Sanctum, including the families of all his wives, Tian Shuixiang, Lin Jingxia, Tian Huangjin, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and many others.
Zhang Fei’s third clone sent Feng Tian, Feng Jiu, and all the women of the Blazing Nirvana Domain to the Zenith Solar Sanctum after he discussed it with Feng Yao.

Zhang Fei’s fourth and fifth clones went to the Radiant Starfall Domain, the Lotus Expanse Domain, the Azure Cloud Domain, the Twilight Domain, and the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to pick up all his people. He decided to close his alchemy shops temporarily in those domains, and he wanted his closest people to focus on themselves.

At first, Luo Fengyan and Huang Xiaoyi were hesitant to leave their sect, but they eventually agreed to cultivate in the Zenith Solar Sanctum. Naturally, they left with their two sons, two daughters-in-law, and two grandchildren.
As for Liao Hanxue, Gong Ren, and Chen Gongji, Zhang Fei allowed them to stay at the Puyang Clan. They could learn many things there, and they could also cultivate more quickly.

Zhang Fei had carefully considered everything, and he did that because he would be bringing those people to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley in the future. Thus, they had to prepare themselves early, as the situation in the Ancient Realm was not peaceful. He thought about sending his acquaintances from other domains there, but he abandoned his intention on second thought.
After everything was done, Zhang Fei’s three clones returned to the pavilion in the training space again to absorb the yin qi from the female yin demon.

Zhang Fei decided to let Mo Zainan, Puyang Yeyu, Sha Qingge, and Wang Jingzhi continue their training in the training space. Despite their high cultivation bases, they still needed time to catch up with his other women.
Huo Ling emerged from Zhang Fei’s body and sat on his lap. "What are you thinking about?"
"Do you think I should send those demons to the Zenith Solar Sanctum for now, Ling’er?"

"Hmm?" Huo Ling considered several possibilities before answering Zhang Fei. "I think you shouldn’t send those demons there for now, and you can send them there after those close to you have finished cultivating there. Even though some of their leaders are your wives, you should prioritize all your wives, family, and acquaintances before them."

Zhang Fei nodded. "I think the same as you; the people closest to me should be superior to those demons. As for the other three races, I don’t think I need to send them there, and they can cultivate as usual in their respective domains."
"Are you looking forward to adventuring in the Myriad Abyss Domain?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "I’m not going to that domain for adventure; I’m going there to search for those demon materials. I’m curious about the increase in their strength if their demon ranks break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks."

Huo Ling shook her head slightly. "Even if their demon ranks break through to that stage, their strength won’t increase too significantly, but their demon essence will be increasingly useful to help you increase your demon rank."

"The Seven Supreme Demon Ranks sure are troublesome!" Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "My demon rank has already broken through to the Demon Overlord Rank for quite some time, but it’s still a long way to go before I can break through to the Demon Venerable Rank. As for my beast evolution, the amount of my beast essence has long since maxed out, but I still have to defeat Hu Tianlang’s Wrath soul, and I also have to retrieve the hearts of those two heavenly foxes before I can evolve to ten tails."
"If you evolve to ten tails later, you won’t have to fear the two primordial beasts anymore."
Zhang Fei looked at Huo Ling. "Even if I inherit Hu Tianlang’s past abilities later, the two primordial beasts are still much stronger than me, right?"

"That’s true." Huo Ling nodded. "However, Hu Tianlang has the ability to control yin and yang, and you will inherit his past abilities when you become a ten-tailed fox, so they are no longer your opponents."

Zhang Fei exhaled softly. "I’m not confident enough to face Hu Tianlang’s Wrath soul, so I won’t rush into the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain to fight him. When my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm, I will go there to challenge him, and I will defeat him then."

"Hehe," Huo Ling cupped Zhang Fei’s face. "I can’t wait to see you evolve into the ten-tailed fox, husband. You haven’t witnessed Hu Tianlang’s true strength, but I’ve seen him fight those primordials in the past, and none of them could defeat him."
"Even if I evolve into a ten-tailed fox and defeat the two primordial beasts, I am still not the opponent of the Chaos Beast, right?"

"No," Huo Ling chose not to hide it. "The chaos beast is on a whole different level, and it was born at the same time as the birth of this universe, so it’s truly powerful. Even my primordial flame can’t hurt it, so you have to think of another way to fight it and take the Chaos Flame."
Since Huo Ling and Feng Yao had already said the same thing, Zhang Fei didn’t dare underestimate the Chaos Beast. "Do you have a solution to defeat that beast?"
"Unfortunately, I can’t be of much help to you in dealing with the Chaos Beast, husband." Huo Ling’s tone was filled with disappointment.

Zhang Fei was amused by Huo Ling’s expression and pinched her cheeks. "Why do I believe you’ve changed, Ling’er? In the past, you were never afraid of anyone, and you always looked down on weak cultivators, including me."

"Ugh!" Huo Ling pouted her lips. "As long as we live in the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm, I will never fear anyone. "Let’s stop talking about the Chaos Beast for now, and I will think of other ways to defeat it in the future," Zhang Fei sighed. "For now, I will focus on my goal of going to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and I will help all my demon wives upgrade their demon ranks."

Huo Ling stared into Zhang Fei’s eyes for a while. "Aren’t you going to dual cultivate with them? They haven’t dual cultivated with you for a long time, and they must miss you, so I think you should satisfy their longing for you."
"You’ve changed, Ling’er."
"Hmm?"
"Back then, you never cared about them, but you always considered their feelings after you became one of them."
"Do you like my changes?"
"I do." Zhang Fei nodded seriously. "Back then, you were like a soulless woman, but you have become much livelier and more understanding of other people’s feelings now, so I really like your change."
Huo Ling smiled. "After all, they’re my sisters, so I can’t be indifferent to their feelings, right?"
"You’re such a good girl, Ling’er!" Zhang Fei pinched Huo Ling’s nose before opening the portal to the training space, and one of his clones walked out of it. "Let’s go!"
"Yeah."

"Hey!" Zhang Fei and Huo Ling looked at Yuan Xiajie. "Can you take me with you? I’m bored here, and this dragon only needs to follow the direction that Feng Yao pointed out a few days ago, so there’s no point in me staying here."
Huo Ling glanced at Yuan Xiajie. "Bring her with us, husband."
Zhang Fei didn’t say anything else and brought the two women into the training space directly.
Zhang Fei’s first clone sat on Long Xukong’s dragon head. "Now it’s just the two of us, Senior Xukong."
"Are you thinking of taking that female demon as your woman, kid?" Long Xukong asked.
"I haven’t thought about her yet."

"She’s quite pitiful, kid. She no longer has anyone, and her heart is filled with revenge. Besides, she is much stronger than all your wives except Empress Huo, so I think you should take her as your wife."
"Why do you care so much about her?"
"I’m not as heartless as you!"
"Hey! I’m not heartless, okay?"
"Humph! If you are not heartless, then not a single living creature in this universe is heartless!"
"Hahaha,"
"What are those two women doing there?" Yuan Xiajie pointed at Mo Zainan and Puyang Yeyu.

"They’re training using the gravity feature." Yuan Xiajie turned to Zhang Fei with a questioning look on her face, forcing him to explain. "If you want to train with them, you can go there now, and I’ll dual cultivate with all my wives."
Yuan Xiajie considered her options. "Can I join you guys?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei had clearly heard Long Xukong and Yuan Xiajie’s conversation earlier. "You don’t need to rush into a decision, and you can think things through while training with them first."
"Alright." Yuan Xiajie walked to one of the areas of the training ground, and Zhang Fei immediately activated the gravity feature for her.
Zhang Fei smiled faintly when he saw Yuan Xiajie fall, but he ignored her and entered the pavilion, where he dual cultivated and dual soul cultivated with all his wives.

chapters.title: Chapter 1760: Xuanyuan Yue - Huli Chenying
paragraphs: A woman with white hair and a white dress, with two fox ears above her head and a white foxtail behind her hips, walked into the modern control room. Her eyes lit up when she saw the young woman sitting in front of several monitors. "Master Xuanyuan Yue! Did you miss your cute fox? I’ve been in seclusion for decades, and I can finally come out to accompany you."
"Hmm?" Xuanyuan Yue turned to the woman with a smile. "Has your cultivation fully stabilized, Sister Chenying?"
Huli Chenying ran to Xuanyuan Yue’s side, sat on her lap, and wrapped her arms around her master’s neck. "My cultivation just stabilized, so I came to see you straight away."
"That’s great!" Xuanyuan Yue cupped Huli Chenying’s face and briefly kissed her lips. "Did you just eat the Fox Essence Berry?"
"Hehe," Huli Chenying nodded several times. "I purposely saved that berry for today, so I ate it after my cultivation stabilized."

Xuanyuan Yue nodded slightly and looked at the monitors, provoking Huli Chenying’s curiosity. "Who is that young man, Master? His women are no less numerous than your father’s, and they come from various races."
"His name is Zhang Fei, and he holds the key to the future of this universe." Xuanyuan Yue explained some things to Huli Chenying. "If he dies, this universe will be destroyed."

Huli Chenying stared at Zhang Fei’s face, her eyes glinting, and her fox tail wagging repeatedly. "He’s handsome, Master! Most importantly, he’s a fox! I didn’t expect you to give the results of your experiment to someone from this universe, and the results were much better than you expected back then."
"Hahaha," Xuanyuan Yue laughed. "Zhang Fei’s fox race is different from yours, and he will become a ten-tailed fox in the future."
"Ten-tailed fox, huh?" Huli Chengying muttered. "Tian Hu and Yun Mingyue are ten-tailed foxes, right?"
Xuanyuan Yue nodded. "In fact, I used Tian Hu’s celestial fox bloodline as the basis of my experiment, and I combined several other things into it."

"No wonder Zhang Fei became so lustful, and he has so many wives." Even though Huli Chenying made that statement, her tone showed no disgust; rather, her reaction seemed completely natural. "Are you interested in him, Master?"
"Huh?" Xuanyuan Yue’s jaw dropped. "Why are you asking that? You know that’s impossible, right?"

Huli Chenying looked at Xuanyuan Yue with a faint smile on her face. "Master, we’ve been together since you were a teenager, remember? Since then, countless men have tried to win your heart, but you never spared them a glance. Even when you did look at them, there was only disdain in your eyes. However, I can see a difference in the expression in your eyes when you look at Zhang Fei; you don’t seem disgusted by his activities, which makes me believe that you are interested in him."
"You’re wrong about that," Xuanyuan Yue retorted. "I’m not paying attention to Zhang Fei because I’m attracted to him, but—"

"Humph!" Huli Chenying snorted. "Who are you trying to fool? I’ve been following you since you were a teenager to this day, and I know you better than your mother, so your rebuttal is nothing more than nonsense to me. You’re so old now, but you’ve never paid attention to any man, let alone have a boyfriend. If you are really interested in Zhang Fei, I will support you."
Xuanyuan Yue pouted her lips. "You’re much older than me, remember? If I’m an old woman, then you’re an old ancestor."
"Hahaha," Huli Chenying laughed before returning her gaze to the monitors. "Have you ever met him, Master?"

Xuanyuan Yue thought for a moment. "I met him on the day I accidentally killed him, and I used the special feature embedded in his system to meet him again some time ago. After all, I’m not part of this universe, and I don’t want to cause a chain reaction by meeting him directly."

Huli Chenying shook her head. "Master, didn’t you already cause a chain reaction by giving the results of your experiment to Zhang Fei and asking Senior Lingzhu to revive him? If you hadn’t done that, he would have been dead since you accidentally killed him, and the lives of the people around him would never have changed. Since the situation in this universe is already a mess because of your accidental action, I don’t think you need to worry about other things."

Xuanyuan Yue could only sigh after hearing that. She had long been aware of the situation in Zhang Fei’s universe, and she was also aware that the fate of many people had changed because of her carelessness. Since that day, she has consistently monitored his progress, witnessing numerous events linked to his actions.

Ru Xue was the first of many women whose fates changed as a result of Zhang Fei’s transformation. Thereafter, the fates of Liu Qingyu, Liu Hua, Chu Qing, Chu Ying, Qing Yi, and many other women also changed, even to this day.

If Zhang Fei had never changed, Xuanyuan Yue was certain that Ru Xue would never have divorced Xu Xuan, and Liu Qingyu would never have cheated on Chu Hong. Moreover, the change in fate was not only experienced by all his women but also by everyone else who had a direct or indirect relationship with him.
Huli Chenying looked at Xuanyuan Yue again. "Master, tell me the truth, do you have any interest in Zhang Fei?"

"I do," Xuanyuan Yue sighed. "I don’t know when this feeling rose in my heart, but I unknowingly fell in love with him. Since that day, I’ve been following his daily life and progress, and I feel that he’s entirely different from all the men who have approached me in the past. In fact, he’s quite similar to my father, especially his affection for those closest to him. He is crueller and more merciless than my father, and he has killed far more people than him."
"Shall we go see Zhang Fei now?" Huli Chenying’s eyes sparkled.
"Zhang Fei has entered seclusion, and he will finish his seclusion in three weeks or so." Xuanyuan Yue pinched Huli Chenying’s cheeks. "Are you also interested in him?"

"Hehe," Huli Chenying giggled. "There are no male foxes equal to me in our universe, and Zhang Fei should be much better than them since he’ll evolve into the ten-tailed fox in the future. So, it’s natural that I’m interested in him, right?"

Xuanyuan Yue couldn’t help but shake her head. "Let’s wait for Zhang Fei to come out of his seclusion, and we’ll go see him then. By the way, he’s already created his soul world like my father, so we can ask him to take us there."
"Oh?" Huli Chenying was taken aback. "So, you gave the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art to Zhang Fei, huh?"

"Yes," Xuanyuan Yue nodded. "My father created the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art to spend time with all his wives, but he never learned the final stage of the technique. Zhang Fei, on the other hand, was ambitious to master that stage, and he wanted to create his own soul universe."
Huli Chenying nodded in understanding. "Is Zhang Fei not tied to his universe?"
"Zhang Fei was no longer tied to this universe after I accidentally killed him."

"I didn’t expect that method would be useful for breaking the chains of the universe." Huli Chenying mumbled softly, got off Xuanyuan Yue’s lap, and pulled her to her feet. "Let’s go, Master! We haven’t seen each other for decades, so I wanted to spend some time with you."
Xuanyuan Yue smiled and left the room with Huli Chenying. "Anyway, I forbid you from talking about my feelings for Zhang Fei to my mother; otherwise, I will ignore you for thousands of years."
"You are so mean, Master!"
"Hahaha."
Meanwhile, all of Zhang Fei’s wives gathered in the main garden, watching his five clones absorb the yin qi from the female yin demon.
"How much yin qi is in her body, husband?" Qi Qingxiu asked.

Ye Mingran and the others were also confused because Zhang Fei’s clones had been absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon for over a month, but the yin qi in her body hadn’t shown any signs of depletion.
Dong Xuanyin turned to Zhang Fei. "How much yin qi have you gotten from her?"

"I can’t be sure for now, and I’ll know the result after I absorb all of her yin qi." Zhang Fei created a qi screen, which showed the situation in the Frozen Yin Domain. "There are tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands, of female yin demons in that domain, and I have all of you by my side, so I think my cultivation will reach the Celestial Venerable Realm faster than I originally calculated."

All the women agreed with Zhang Fei, but they knew the process would take a very long time. After all, his clones had been absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon for over a month, but her yin qi still showed no signs of depletion.

Zhang Fei removed the qi screen. "Alright, you guys don’t have to think about it anymore, and her yin qi will run out on its own eventually. I’ll be arriving at the Myriad Abyss Domain in about twenty-five days, so we should begin our seclusion now, and I’ll bring some of you there."

Since his five clones were busy absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon, Zhang Fei brought the first ten women to his room. As usual, he dual cultivated with Ru Xue first, as she was his first woman, and he also dual soul cultivated with the other nine women.
Meanwhile, the other women kept themselves busy, with some of them cultivating manually and some others practicing on the training ground.

"How much yin qi is in her body, husband?" Qi Qingxiu asked.

Ye Mingran and the others were also confused because Zhang Fei’s clones had been absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon for over a month, but the yin qi in her body hadn’t shown any signs of depletion.
Dong Xuanyin turned to Zhang Fei.
"How much yin qi have you gotten from her?"
"I can’t be sure for now, and I’ll know the result after I absorb all of her yin qi." Zhang Fei created a qi screen, which showed the situation in the Frozen Yin Domain.

"There are tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands, of female yin demons in that domain, and I have all of you by my side, so I think my cultivation will reach the Celestial Venerable Realm faster than I originally calculated."
All the women agreed with Zhang Fei, but they knew the process would take a very long time.
After all, his clones had been absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon for over a month, but her yin qi still showed no signs of depletion.
Zhang Fei removed the qi screen.
"Alright, you guys don’t have to think about it anymore, and her yin qi will run out on its own eventually.
I’ll be arriving at the Myriad Abyss Domain in about twenty-five days, so we should begin our seclusion now, and I’ll bring some of you there."
Since his five clones were busy absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon, Zhang Fei brought the first ten women to his room.
As usual, he dual cultivated with Ru Xue first, as she was his first woman, and he also dual soul cultivated with the other nine women.
Meanwhile, the other women kept themselves busy, with some of them cultivating manually and some others practicing on the training ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 1761: Myriad Abyss Domain First Arrival
paragraphs: A month later, Zhang Fei and his group finally arrived at the Myriad Abyss Domain. His five clones still hadn’t finished absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon. As Huo Ling said a few months ago, it would take him months to absorb the female demon’s yin qi cleanly, depending on their cultivation.

Fortunately, the flow of time inside Zhang Fei’s training space was much faster than in the outside world, and almost five months had passed since his five clones began absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon.
Since he wasn’t a demon dragon, Long Xukong couldn’t enter the domain, so Zhang Fei sent him back to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain through the gate.
After that, Zhang Fei brought Yuan Xiajie out of the void and entered the domain directly. "We’re here."

The Myriad Abyss Domain is a vast expanse of eternal darkness, shrouded in a starless sky, where black rivers flow through endless mountains and plains. Every breath in this domain is saturated with such pure demon qi that ordinary cultivators would be corrupted in an instant, while demons become stronger simply by remaining within its boundaries.
Zhang Fei tried to absorb the demon qi within the domain. "This demon qi is much stronger than any other demon domain I’ve visited in the past. So, where does that female demon god live?"
"Are you impatient to seduce her?" Yuan Xiajie teased. Ever since Zhang Fei brought her to train in his training space, Yuan Xiajie had made quite a bit of progress, especially in her speed.

Although Yuan Xiajie couldn’t train at a high level yet, she had already adapted to level four in just a few months, which made her speed increase quite a bit. However, she was disappointed because Zhang Fei never came to see her during that time, and he was fully focused on all his wives.

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I haven’t seen her face and figure, and I still don’t know her character, so I have no interest in her. I just want to collect those demon materials so all my demon wives can upgrade their demon ranks and evolve."
"Haha," Yuan Xiajie softly laughed. "Her name is Hua Qianmei, and her title is Bewitching Demon God. Judging from her name and title, you should be able to imagine her face and figure, right?"
"Bewitching Demon God, huh?" Zhang Fei smirked faintly. "Show me her image."

"There are three female demon gods in this domain, but Hua Qianmei is the best of the best, and her beauty is not inferior to your several wives. The other two female demon gods are the Venomous Demon God, Gongsun Zhilan, and the Dream Demon God, Tang Zhiyao." Yuan Xiajie touched Zhang Fei’s forehead, sharing the three female demon gods’ images with him. "What do you think about them?"

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Compared to Gongsun Zhilan and Tang Zhiyao, Hua Qianmei’s beauty indeed surpasses theirs. However, you’re exaggerating by saying her beauty is not inferior to some of my wives."
"Hey! Which husband wouldn’t praise the beauty of all his wives?" Yuan Xiajie asked, shaking her head.

"All my wives don’t need praise because their beauty is unmatched, for example Luo Yunxiao, Feng Yao, Tianshi Shengjie, and several others." Yuan Xiajie was speechless to reply to Zhang Fei because no woman could match their beauty, and she herself felt envious of it. "Have you told Hua Qianmei that we have arrived?"

Yuan Xiajie pointed to the southeast. "I’ve already informed her of our arrival, and she asked us to meet her at her palace, which is located in the southeast of this domain. Fortunately, we’re in the southern area now, so we can go directly there to meet her."
"Let’s go now!"
With Zhang Fei’s movement technique, they could arrive in front of a city in no time. After Yuan Xiajie handed over one hundred demon cores to the guard, she led him into the city.

The city wasn’t huge, and the demon cities in the Netherworld Realm were much larger. However, the city’s population was so large that it felt a little crowded, and they came from various demon races, including the lust demon race.

Zhang Fei looked at every bustling area they passed while checking the strength of those demons. He discovered that the weakest demon in the city had a cultivation in the Seven Divine Realm, which made him think that all the demon cities in the Paradise Realm were too weak.

"Are you confused about why there are no demons with cultivation in the Ten Mortal Realms in this city?" Zhang Fei nodded to Yuan Xiajie. "Honestly, the division of areas in this domain is not balanced, and demons at that level are not allowed to enter the cities ruled by the demon gods, so they are forced to live in other cities. The strongest city in this domain is the Myriad Abyss Imperial City, where Mo Qingwen lives. That city is right in the heart of this domain, and demons with cultivation below the Five Celestial Realms cannot enter that city. Even so, those ordinary cities are much better off compared to the cities in the human domains, so none of them dare to complain or protest."

On their way to Hua Qianmei’s place, Zhang Fei found some quite useful demon items, and he immediately purchased them. However, he hadn’t found the demon materials for upgrading demon ranks, and Yuan Xiajie informed him that he could only find them in the Myriad Abyss Imperial City.
Sometime later, Zhang Fei and Yuan Xiajie arrived in front of a black palace that wasn’t particularly magnificent. In fact, Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran’s palace was much more magnificent.

When the guards saw Yuan Xiajie, they allowed the two to enter the palace, which proved her close relationship with Hua Qianmei. As the two walked into the palace, the guards looked at Zhang Fei with strange looks because he was using his lust demon form, with nine tails dancing behind his waist. ’Since when did a lust demon have nine tails?’

Zhang Fei didn’t hide his other eight tails because that would only make him look too ordinary, especially since they were about to meet one of the demon gods of that domain. Normally, other demons would be afraid of meeting a demon god, but he had no fear at all because he could borrow the power of Feng Yao, who resided in his beast space. Additionally, he had Huo Ling by his side, and she was much stronger than all demon gods.
’This palace is much more ordinary than it looks.’ Zhang Fei observed the areas of the palace, as well as the demons who served there.

Soon, they arrived at the throne room, and they saw Hua Qianmei sitting on her throne, propping her head with her right hand. She wore a luxurious black gown accented with intricate gold embroidery and delicate ornamental patterns. Her dress has a deep V-shaped neckline emphasizing her sexy upper body.

Hua Qianmei has a delicate yet mature oval-shaped face. Her big, almond-shaped eyes have warm amber-brown irises and naturally long, curled eyelashes, which give her an alluring yet composed look. She has a slim, straight nose, combined with full, softly tinted lips with a subtle rosy hue.

Hua Qianmei’s long, silky dark brown to black hair cascaded down past her waist. It was styled in an elegant half-up bun, with loose strands framing her cheeks and neck. She has fair, smooth, porcelain-like skin. She has a curvaceous yet graceful figure, with a slim, hourglass-like waist, round hips, and long, shapely legs. Her breasts were full and voluptuous with a naturally rounded shape.

Hua Qianmei looked at Zhang Fei for a moment before speaking to Yuan Xiajie. "You’ve finally arrived, Xiajie. I haven’t seen you in a long time, so I didn’t expect that you would bring a male lust demon with you. Besides, he’s not an ordinary lust demon, especially with his nine tails."
"Haha," Yuan Xiajie laughed heartily, stunning Hua Qianmei. "Why are you looking at me like that, Big Sis?"
"I haven’t seen you this happy in a long time, Xiajie." Hua Qianmei glanced at Zhang Fei. "Are you this happy because of him?"

"Not really." Yuan Xiajie shook her head. "I’m happy because I’ve become stronger than before, and I can’t wait to defeat Meng Zhuo. By the way, his name is Zhang Fei, and he’s no ordinary lust demon."

Hua Qianmei nodded slightly. "Where did you meet him? He’s still young, but his cultivation has already reached the Celestial Venerable Realm. Unfortunately, his demon rank is only at the Demon Overlord Rank, and he still needs a long time to break through."

Zhang Fei deliberately borrowed the power of some beasts inside his beast space, but he limited his power to be equivalent to a cultivator at the Celestial Venerable Realm. He didn’t interrupt the two women’s conversation; instead, he focused on reading Hua Qianmei’s status, which Mei displayed for him.

Yuan Xiajie thought for a moment before answering Hua Qianmei. "Big Sis, my avatar met Zhang Fei in the Three Mortal Realms many years ago, and I met him in person a few months ago in the Frozen Yin Domain."

"Oh?" Hua Qianmei was taken back. "Is he a friend of those female demons? I remember you captured several female demons from the Three Mortal Realms many years ago, and you wanted to use them to fight Meng Zhuo."
"Yes." Yuan Xiajie nodded. "One of the female demons is an undead demon named Wang Yin, and she is one of his women."

"A lust demon and a corpse demon, huh? A truly strange and unusual pairing in my opinion." Hua Qianmei looked at Zhang Fei. "Why aren’t you saying anything? Are you so mesmerized by my beauty that you can’t speak?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1762: Spar With Hua Qianmei
paragraphs: Zhang Fei looked at Hua Qianmei with a smile. "Do you want to hear the truth?"

"Hmm?" Hua Qianmei squinted her eyes, observing Zhang Fei’s expression seriously. As a demon god, she was familiar with the lust demon’s character, but his expression and demeanor made her feel that he was different from other lust demons. Besides, no lust demon had nine tails, and his nine tails were clearly not the result of his ability to modify his body. "Of course, I want to hear the truth! If you dare lie to me, I will seal your cultivation and lock you in the basement of my palace for the rest of your life."

"Hehe," Zhang Fei chuckled in a relaxed manner. "Senior, I have to admit that your beauty is mesmerizing, and your figure is deathly alluring. I dare to say that you are almost perfect as a woman... but..."
"But what?"
"But this universe is too vast, and there are many women who are prettier and much more perfect than you out there."

Hua Qianmei’s jaw dropped because of Zhang Fei’s boldness. During her lifetime, countless men were obsessed with her, and they tried their best to win her. She looked down on them, and she felt that they were not worthy to stand beside her, so she rejected all her suitors.

Hua Qianmei always felt that her beauty was matchless, which earned her the title of bewitching demon god. Yet, the young lust demon in front of her said that there were still many women who were much prettier and more perfect than her.

Hua Qianmei furrowed her brows and sharpened her eyes, but she saw no disdain or contempt in Zhang Fei’s eyes. She also saw no enthusiasm on his face, as if he considered her no different from any other woman. "Oh? Does that mean you’ve met lots of women prettier and sexier than me?"
"Meet them?" Zhang Fei laughed softly. "Not only did I meet them, but they also became my wives."
Hua Qianmei didn’t believe Zhang Fei, and she glanced at Yuan Xiajie, who returned her glance with a wry smile. "Have you met all of his wives?"
"I’ve met them, Big Sis." Yuan Xiajie nodded.
"Are they really that beautiful and sexy?"
"Not all of them are that sexy." Yuan Xiajie paused, afraid of offending Hua Qianmei.
Hua Qianmei raised an eyebrow. "Why are you hesitating? You’re my little sister, so you can tell the truth, and I won’t punish you."

"Sigh." Yuan Xiajie stole a glance at Zhang Fei. "Big Sis, not all of them are as sexy as you, but all of them are much prettier than you. When I first met them, I felt jealous of them. Even though I’m not as pretty as you, I’ve always been confident in my beauty, but my beauty is like a wilted flower in front of them."
"Oh? Aren’t you exaggerating?" Hua Qianmei was still skeptical about it.
"Not at all." Yuan Xiajie turned to Zhang Fei. "Why don’t you bring some of them here? That way, she can see their beauty for herself, and she won’t realize the truth of my words."
"Sure."
Hua Qianmei was shocked when Zhang Fei opened a portal to one of his private spaces, and she saw four women walk out from within. They were Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and Dong Xuanyin.

Hua Qianmei’s expression changed from shock to stupefaction after seeing their beauty, especially Qi Qingxiu. As a demon god, she could tell that the four women before her were also demon gods like her, and their cultivation was at the same level.
"Are they really your wives?"
"One of them is my mother-in-law." Zhang Fei pulled Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Dong Xuanyin into his arms, kissing them in turn. "They are my wives, and they are demon gods like you."

Hua Qianmei watched the four women seriously. "Your two wives are the Seven Emotions Demon God and the Eternal Night Demon God, right? As for your mother-in-law, she should be the Soul-Devouring Demon God. I don’t know the fourth woman’s identity, but I’m certain she’s a demon beast."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe looked shocked when Hua Qianmei mentioned their three races.

"Hehe," Hua Qianmei chuckled. "You three don’t need to be confused about how I know your three demon races. The Seven Emotions Demon Race once existed in this domain, but all members of their race suddenly disappeared. As for the Eternal Night Demon Race and the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, they still exist in this domain."
"Is it true that our two demon races exist in this domain?" Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe asked at the same time.

"Yes," Hua Qianmei nodded to them. "They exist in this domain, but I don’t recommend the two of you meet them. Their demon gods are truly wicked and ruthless, and they will capture both of you if you go there. Even though our demon rank and cultivation level are equal, the two of you are much weaker than me, and they are stronger than me."

"I don’t think you two need to mind them," Dong Xuanyin spoke to Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu. "Our purpose in coming to this domain is to cultivate and look for those demon items, so we don’t need to waste our time with strangers."

Hua Qianmei nodded in agreement. "You two should listen to her, and you don’t need to think about those demons. As long as you don’t approach their two cities, they won’t be aware of your presence in this domain. However, the supreme demon god, Mo Qingwen, should have noticed your presence by now."

Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe looked at Zhang Fei with worried looks. Unlike them, he seemed relaxed about the matter, and he actually hoped that Mo Qingwen would come to them. "Alright! You guys don’t need to worry about all those demon gods, and I will protect you from them."

"You’re too naive," Hua Qianmei said, shaking her head. "You manage to obtain three demon gods as your wives, but you underestimate the demon gods of this domain too much. Let’s not talk about Mo Qingwen; the other demon gods can defeat you easily, so you shouldn’t underestimate them."

Yuan Xiajie spoke immediately. "Big Sis, you only met Zhang Fei today, so you don’t know him yet. Mo Qingwen and those demon gods’ cultivation is above his, but they might not be able to defeat him, let alone capture him."
"Hmm?" Hua Qianmei looked at Yuan Xiajie with astonishment. "Xiajie, you still remember Mo Qingwen’s strength and abilities, right? He—"

"Big Sis, I couldn’t possibly forget about Mo Qingwen’s strength and abilities, but I’ve fought Zhang Fei myself, so I dare to say it like that." Yuan Xiajie was silent for a moment. "If you don’t believe me, you can try sparring with him, and you will know the truth of my words."
Hua Qianmei immediately got down from her throne and walked away. "Follow me."
A few minutes later, they arrived at the training ground. Hua Qianmei and Zhang Fei immediately stood face to face in the arena. "You—"
"Senior, you don’t need to hold back, and you can use all your strength to attack me."
Hua Qianmei frowned for a moment, but she could tell that Zhang Fei wasn’t underestimating her, which meant he was confident in his fighting abilities.
Hua Qianmei said nothing and moved to attack Zhang Fei.
*Boom*
A loud explosion rings out.
Yuan Xiajie and the four women could see that Hua Qianmei’s expression was filled with shock because Zhang Fei had blocked her fist so easily, and he hadn’t even retreated from his spot.

"Your physical strength is truly extraordinary, young demon!" Hua Qianmei raised her leg and kicked towards Zhang Fei’s stomach, but he immediately somersaulted behind her to avoid her kick. She didn’t stop there and kicked backwards, but he stepped on her leg and jumped away from her. "Your reactions and reflexes are fast too!"
Hua Qianmei disappeared from her previous spot, but Zhang Fei still maintained his calm, and his eyes moved along with her movements.
Yuan Xiajie and the four women just smiled when they saw that, and they were sure that Zhang Fei could easily see Hua Qianmei’s movements because he had already adapted to level eight gravity.
Hua Qianmei reappeared behind Zhang Fei and tried to kick him once again, but the result betrayed her expectations because he caught her leg and threw her far away, which shocked her.

Hua Qianmei landed a little way in front of Zhang Fei. "How did you do that? My speed is one of the fastest in this domain, and I’m sure that your speed isn’t on par with mine due to your cultivation level."

"Haha! A common mistake many people make is being overconfident and thinking they’re superior to their enemies. My cultivation and demon rank are indeed below yours, but you don’t have any information about me, and you don’t know about my training." Hua Qianmei’s face did not show anger but curiosity, and she was truly curious about Zhang Fei’s training methods, especially his methods for training his speed. "Since you’ve already attacked me three times, I’m going to attack you now, so you have to get ready."

"Then—" Hua Qianmei didn’t continue her words, and she swallowed her saliva because Zhang Fei’s fist was only an inch from her face. She didn’t even have time to blink, and he had suddenly moved in front of her. ’Damn it! If he hadn’t held back his punch at the last second, my face would have been disfigured by it.’ "How... how can you move that fast?"
Zhang Fei pulled his hand back. "In fact, I haven’t used my true speed yet, and you wouldn’t be able to see my movements if I used my full speed."

Hua Qianmei’s jaw dropped because of Zhang Fei’s boldness.
During her lifetime, countless men were obsessed with her, and they tried their best to win her.
She looked down on them, and she felt that they were not worthy to stand beside her, so she rejected all her suitors.
Hua Qianmei always felt that her beauty was matchless, which earned her the title of bewitching demon god.
Yet, the young lust demon in front of her said that there were still many women who were much prettier and more perfect than her.
Hua Qianmei furrowed her brows and sharpened her eyes, but she saw no disdain or contempt in Zhang Fei’s eyes.
She also saw no enthusiasm on his face, as if he considered her no different from any other woman.
"Oh?
Does that mean you’ve met lots of women prettier and sexier than me?"
"Meet them?" Zhang Fei laughed softly.
"Not only did I meet them, but they also became my wives."
Hua Qianmei didn’t believe Zhang Fei, and she glanced at Yuan Xiajie, who returned her glance with a wry smile.
"Have you met all of his wives?"
"I’ve met them, Big Sis." Yuan Xiajie nodded.
"Are they really that beautiful and sexy?"
"Not all of them are that sexy." Yuan Xiajie paused, afraid of offending Hua Qianmei.
Hua Qianmei raised an eyebrow.
"Why are you hesitating?
You’re my little sister, so you can tell the truth, and I won’t punish you."
"Sigh." Yuan Xiajie stole a glance at Zhang Fei.
"Big Sis, not all of them are as sexy as you, but all of them are much prettier than you.
When I first met them, I felt jealous of them.
Even though I’m not as pretty as you, I’ve always been confident in my beauty, but my beauty is like a wilted flower in front of them."
"Oh?
Aren’t you exaggerating?" Hua Qianmei was still skeptical about it.
"Not at all." Yuan Xiajie turned to Zhang Fei.
"Why don’t you bring some of them here?
That way, she can see their beauty for herself, and she won’t realize the truth of my words."
"Sure."
Hua Qianmei was shocked when Zhang Fei opened a portal to one of his private spaces, and she saw four women walk out from within.
They were Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and Dong Xuanyin.
Hua Qianmei’s expression changed from shock to stupefaction after seeing their beauty, especially Qi Qingxiu.
As a demon god, she could tell that the four women before her were also demon gods like her, and their cultivation was at the same level.
"Are they really your wives?"
"One of them is my mother-in-law." Zhang Fei pulled Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Dong Xuanyin into his arms, kissing them in turn.
"They are my wives, and they are demon gods like you."
Hua Qianmei watched the four women seriously.
"Your two wives are the Seven Emotions Demon God and the Eternal Night Demon God, right?
As for your mother-in-law, she should be the Soul-Devouring Demon God.
I don’t know the fourth woman’s identity, but I’m certain she’s a demon beast."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe looked shocked when Hua Qianmei mentioned their three races.
"Hehe," Hua Qianmei chuckled.
"You three don’t need to be confused about how I know your three demon races.
The Seven Emotions Demon Race once existed in this domain, but all members of their race suddenly disappeared.
As for the Eternal Night Demon Race and the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, they still exist in this domain."
"Is it true that our two demon races exist in this domain?" Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe asked at the same time.
"Yes," Hua Qianmei nodded to them.
"They exist in this domain, but I don’t recommend the two of you meet them.
Their demon gods are truly wicked and ruthless, and they will capture both of you if you go there.
Even though our demon rank and cultivation level are equal, the two of you are much weaker than me, and they are stronger than me."
"I don’t think you two need to mind them," Dong Xuanyin spoke to Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu.
"Our purpose in coming to this domain is to cultivate and look for those demon items, so we don’t need to waste our time with strangers."
Hua Qianmei nodded in agreement.
"You two should listen to her, and you don’t need to think about those demons.
As long as you don’t approach their two cities, they won’t be aware of your presence in this domain.
However, the supreme demon god, Mo Qingwen, should have noticed your presence by now."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe looked at Zhang Fei with worried looks.
Unlike them, he seemed relaxed about the matter, and he actually hoped that Mo Qingwen would come to them.
"Alright!
You guys don’t need to worry about all those demon gods, and I will protect you from them."
"You’re too naive," Hua Qianmei said, shaking her head.
"You manage to obtain three demon gods as your wives, but you underestimate the demon gods of this domain too much.
Let’s not talk about Mo Qingwen; the other demon gods can defeat you easily, so you shouldn’t underestimate them."
Yuan Xiajie spoke immediately.
"Big Sis, you only met Zhang Fei today, so you don’t know him yet.
Mo Qingwen and those demon gods’ cultivation is above his, but they might not be able to defeat him, let alone capture him."
"Hmm?" Hua Qianmei looked at Yuan Xiajie with astonishment.
"Xiajie, you still remember Mo Qingwen’s strength and abilities, right?
He—"
"Big Sis, I couldn’t possibly forget about Mo Qingwen’s strength and abilities, but I’ve fought Zhang Fei myself, so I dare to say it like that." Yuan Xiajie was silent for a moment.
"If you don’t believe me, you can try sparring with him, and you will know the truth of my words."
Hua Qianmei immediately got down from her throne and walked away.
"Follow me."
A few minutes later, they arrived at the training ground.
Hua Qianmei and Zhang Fei immediately stood face to face in the arena.
"You—"
"Senior, you don’t need to hold back, and you can use all your strength to attack me."
Hua Qianmei frowned for a moment, but she could tell that Zhang Fei wasn’t underestimating her, which meant he was confident in his fighting abilities.
Hua Qianmei said nothing and moved to attack Zhang Fei.
*Boom*
A loud explosion rings out.
Yuan Xiajie and the four women could see that Hua Qianmei’s expression was filled with shock because Zhang Fei had blocked her fist so easily, and he hadn’t even retreated from his spot.
"Your physical strength is truly extraordinary, young demon!" Hua Qianmei raised her leg and kicked towards Zhang Fei’s stomach, but he immediately somersaulted behind her to avoid her kick.
She didn’t stop there and kicked backwards, but he stepped on her leg and jumped away from her.
"Your reactions and reflexes are fast too!"
Hua Qianmei disappeared from her previous spot, but Zhang Fei still maintained his calm, and his eyes moved along with her movements.
Yuan Xiajie and the four women just smiled when they saw that, and they were sure that Zhang Fei could easily see Hua Qianmei’s movements because he had already adapted to level eight gravity.
Hua Qianmei reappeared behind Zhang Fei and tried to kick him once again, but the result betrayed her expectations because he caught her leg and threw her far away, which shocked her.
Hua Qianmei landed a little way in front of Zhang Fei.
"How did you do that?
My speed is one of the fastest in this domain, and I’m sure that your speed isn’t on par with mine due to your cultivation level."
"Haha!
A common mistake many people make is being overconfident and thinking they’re superior to their enemies.

My cultivation and demon rank are indeed below yours, but you don’t have any information about me, and you don’t know about my training." Hua Qianmei’s face did not show anger but curiosity, and she was truly curious about Zhang Fei’s training methods, especially his methods for training his speed.
"Since you’ve already attacked me three times, I’m going to attack you now, so you have to get ready."
"Then—" Hua Qianmei didn’t continue her words, and she swallowed her saliva because Zhang Fei’s fist was only an inch from her face.
She didn’t even have time to blink, and he had suddenly moved in front of her. ’Damn it!
If he hadn’t held back his punch at the last second, my face would have been disfigured by it.’ "How... how can you move that fast?"
Zhang Fei pulled his hand back.
"In fact, I haven’t used my true speed yet, and you wouldn’t be able to see my movements if I used my full speed."

chapters.title: Chapter 1763: Assert His Dominance
paragraphs: Hua Qianmei nodded slightly. "My speed may not be as fast as yours, but I have another ability that I’ve always been proud of; otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to reach this position today."
"Oh," Zhang Fei smiled as he jumped backwards. "Then, show me the ability you’ve always been so proud of."
Hua Qianmei stretched her hand forward, and a purple domain enveloped her and Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei looked around, finding several eyes similar to Hua Qianmei’s eyes in several areas of the domain. "The bewitching domain, huh? This domain suits your title as the Bewitching Demon God, Senior."
"Don’t you feel anything?" Hua Qianmei asked in shock after seeing the calmness on Zhang Fei’s expression.

"Senior, you seem to have forgotten that I am a lust demon, and a special one at that." Hua Qianmei took a deep breath as she stared at Zhang Fei. She was familiar with lust demons’ abilities, but none of them could resist the effects of her bewitching domain, and the male lust demon in front of her was the first to do so. "Let me show you something."

Hua Qianmei staggered back as Zhang Fei activated several of his domains at once, one of which was his light domain. Her body trembled in fear as she looked at him like she was looking at a freak; the light element was the demon’s weakness. "How... how can a demon like you have the light element?"
"Because I’m special?" Zhang Fei replied with a casual smile. "Have you ever met a lust demon with nine tails before? You’re a powerful demon god, so you should already know that my tails are real."

Hua Qianmei had never felt so frightened before. She focused her gaze on Zhang Fei’s light domain, and she could feel that his light element was extremely pure, combined with his light elemental law. She jumped in fright when she saw countless swords appear, all pointing at her; this was a result of Zhang Fei’s sword domain. "Sword domain."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei grabbed one of the swords. "I’m a god-ranked swordmaster, so you shouldn’t be surprised by my sword domain."

Hua Qianmei looked at Yuan Xiajie, who was standing beside the four female demons. "Xiajie, you’ve found a monster! With all his abilities, I’m not confident that the other demon gods, including Mo Qingwen, can stand up to him."
Yuan Xiajie scratched her head sheepishly. She herself hadn’t expected Zhang Fei to show off some of his abilities to Hua Qianmei, but she could guess his motives. "He’s still holding back, Big Sis."
"What?" Hua Qianmei let out a cry of shock, returning her gaze to Zhang Fei. "Is Xiajie joking with me? Are you really still holding back?"

Zhang Fei actually didn’t want to show off his abilities in front of Hua Qianmei, but Feng Yao told him that he should do so to assert his dominance, especially since he wanted to bring his demon wives into that domain. The Myriad Abyss Domain was different from other demon domains, and there were too many powerful demon gods there.

Hua Qianmei was terrified as soon as Zhang Fei summoned all the mythical beasts’ silhouettes. Her eyes opened so wide they almost popped out of their sockets. The most frightening thing to her was the pitch-black dragon silhouette. "The Calamity Demon Dragon! How... how did you know about that dragon?"

"Because I am the current Calamity Demon Dragon." Zhang Fei transformed into his dragon form, instilling fear in Hua Qianmei. Since the two primordial beasts already knew the identities of the four, he felt no need to hide it from the public, and he would fight them again if they sent their avatars to ambush him. "Are you shocked to see my dragon form?"

Hua Qianmei was at a loss for words to answer Zhang Fei’s question, and she felt that the scene before her was too bizarre. She knew he was a lust demon due to his demon aura, but she never imagined that he would have another, even more terrifying identity: the Calamity Demon Dragon.

Zhang Fei returned to his lust demon form and canceled all his domains. "As long as you don’t become my enemy, I will never do anything to you. Honestly, I don’t want to scare you, and I’m doing this because I need your help."
"What... what do you need from me?" Hua Qianmei stammered.
Zhang Fei glanced at Yuan Xiajie. "A few months ago, Xiajie contacted you and asked you to find a special place for me, right?"
"Yes," Hua Qianmei nodded. "I’ve already found a place, and it’s a bit far from my city. If you want to see it, I can take you there now. But what will you do there?"

Zhang Fei created a qi screen that displayed images of dozens of female demons, which shocked Hua Qianmei again. "They are my wives, and their demon ranks are stuck at the Empress Rank. That’s why I came to the domain to find those demon materials, and I’ll take them there to cultivate."
Hua Qianmei looked at the qi screen, and she immediately recognized the identities of some of the demons, but she couldn’t recognize the rest. "Are they really your wives?"
"Yeah," Zhang Fei nodded and removed the qi screen. "Do you think Mo Qingwen will come to me soon?"
Hua Qianmei was taken aback. "Did you show me all your abilities to lure Mo Qingwen to you?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei admitted. "I do want to meet Mo Qingwen, but he doesn’t seem to have any intention of coming here today."

"I feel like you’re really crazy." Hua Qianmei massaged her forehead. "Mo Qingwen should have sensed your actions just now, and I’m sure he’ll be interested in you. However, I heard that he’s in seclusion, and he won’t be leaving his palace for the next few months or years."
Zhang Fei sighed in disappointment. "Forget it then! For now, let’s take a look at that place, and I will bring all my demon wives to this domain after I make sure that the place is safe for them."
"Let’s go there."

Hua Qianmei was increasingly afraid of Zhang Fei because he could bring them all to that place in the blink of an eye, something that she and all the other demon gods could not do. "How fast is your speed exactly?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "Do you really want to know?"
Hua Qianmei nodded several times. "Can you show me your maximum speed?"
"Sure." Zhang Fei hugged Hua Qianmei’s waist and spoke to the others. "I will take her around this domain."
"Alright." After the four women agreed, Zhang Fei took Hua Qianmei into an invisible state and took her with him to surround the domain.
"Haha," Ye Mingran laughed. "It seems we will be getting a new sister, and she is much stronger than us."

"I don’t think so," Qi Qingxiu denied with a small shake of her head. "That woman is indeed exceptional in both beauty and cultivation, but our husband has shown no interest in her, at least not yet."
Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement. "If he showed any interest in that woman, he would have acted like a rogue, and she would never be able to resist his advances."
"Hehe," Qi Qingxiu giggled and teased Nalan Shizhe. "Just like what you experienced a few years ago, right?"

Nalan Shizhe naturally remembered the incident six and a half years ago, when he nearly fell into Zhang Fei’s embrace due to the influence of his lust domain, combined with Qi Qingxiu’s actions. Since that incident, she had struggled to resist the urge to surrender to him, but fortunately, he didn’t make a move on her, and she managed to suppress the urge.

"Big Sister Qianmei will likely fall into Zhang Fei’s arms in the future." Qi Qingxiu and the others looked at Yuan Xiajie. "She has been waiting for a long time for the right man to be her companion, and he is far superior in many aspects to other men."
"Isn’t that great? If he can get that woman, the number of powerful women by his side will increase by one." Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Nalan Shizhe agreed with Dong Xuanyin.

A few minutes later, Zhang Fei and Hua Qianmei returned to their presence, and the female demon god was stunned with her mouth open. "I’m at a loss for words about you! This domain is quite vast, but you just took me around the entire area!"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "So, where is that place?"

"Follow me." Hua Qianmei touched the empty space in front of her, and they could see previously invisible walls surrounding the area. "This place used to be my master’s private quarters, and the entire area is covered by a concealing formation, so no one can find it."
"Is your master dead?"
Hua Qianmei nodded. "Since you have several female demon gods by your side, you should already know where our powers come from, right?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded solemnly. "Honestly, I’m still thinking about the method of inheriting power in the demon race, and I feel that it’s too ridiculous, so I’m thinking of another method for that. I can’t possibly let all my wives weaken or die, so I have to find another method to prevent that."

Hua Qianmei did not expect that Zhang Fei loved all his wives so much, especially since their number was simply numerous. "Honestly, you don’t need to think too much about it, right? Since their cultivation has reached the Celestial God Realm, they can live for at least five hundred million years, and you should be satisfied with that."
"No," Zhang Fei shook his head. "I want them to accompany me for eternity, so I have to find another way to prevent that from happening."

chapters.title: Chapter 1764: Ancient Four-Pillar Demon Array
paragraphs: "Hmm?"

Zhang Fei, Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, and Dong Xuanyin stopped in their tracks as soon as they entered the formation. The demon qi outside the formation was already stronger than in any of the demon domains in the Paradise Realm, but the demon qi inside the formation was even stronger.
Zhang Fei looked at Hua Qianmei. "What kind of formation is this?"

"The Ancient Four-Pillar Demon Array." Hua Qianmei winked at him. "This formation is similar to a qi gathering array, but it only works on demon qi, and its effect is that the demon qi inside this formation is two times denser compared to the demon qi outside."

"I will try absorbing the demon qi." Zhang Fei hurriedly sat cross-legged, followed by four female demons. They forgot about everything else and focused on absorbing the demon qi within the formation; their expressions changed with excitement even though they had just started absorbing it.
Hua Qianmei looked at Zhang Fei thoughtfully. She recalled their short spar and all of his abilities, including his ability to use the light element.
"What are you thinking, Big Sis?"
Hua Qianmei snapped out of her thoughts. "How could he use the light element, Xiajie? How did he summon those mythical beasts’ silhouettes earlier?"

"Can’t you sense all the beast bloodlines within Zhang Fei, Big Sis?" Hua Qianmei looked at Yuan Xiajie, shaking her head. "He had many female mythical beasts by his side, and they passed their bloodlines to him."

Once again, Hua Qianmei fell into thought while looking at Zhang Fei. "Who is the strongest among all his wives? These four women are strong, but they are not as strong as all the demon gods in this domain."
"You know that woman, Big Sis."
"Who?"

"Guang Zhiyi." Hua Qianmei looked at Yuan Xiajie with an expression full of shock. "You don’t believe me, do you? At first, I also found it difficult to believe that Feng Yao was her reincarnation, but that’s the fact, and she is the strongest among all of Zhang Fei’s women. Actually, there is still one more woman, and her identity will shock you even more."
Hua Qianmei pondered. "Who is that woman?"
"The spirit of the Eternal Flame." Yuan Xiajie’s answer shocked Hua Qianmei, but she found it incredulous. "Actually, Zhang Fei is the current owner of the Eternal Flame, Big Sis."

Hua Qianmei returned her gaze to Zhang Fei, who still had not stopped absorbing the demon qi in the formation. She was familiar with the aloof and arrogant Guang Zhiyi, but she did not expect that her reincarnation would choose the male demon in front of her, which was entirely different from her past self.

Hua Qianmei’s master was one of the ancient cultivators who had searched for the whereabouts of the Eternal Flame in the past, but unfortunately, her master never managed to find it. Yet, Yuan Xiajie said that Zhang Fei managed to find the flame and became its master, which made her expression a little unusual.

"The demon qi in this place is truly astonishing!" Hua Qianmei and Yuan Xiajie looked at Zhang Fei, who had stopped cultivating. "This place is truly suitable for all my demon wives, so I will bring them here today."

Nalan Wangzi agreed with her sister. "Since our husband gave his two beauty pills to Senior Qianmei, he must be interested in her."

In the palace main chamber.

"Big Sis, I already have a little feeling for Zhang Fei because I have lived in his private space for several months, but I have never considered becoming his wife."
"Then?"

Yuan Xiajie pressed Hua Qianmei to her cheek. "I need Zhang Fei’s help to become strong, and I will kill Meng Zhuo with my own hands in the future. "Is Meng Zhuo really that strong, Big Sis?"

"Strong isn’t the right word to describe Meng Zhuo, Xiajie. His strength is second only to Jiu Tou Sen, and his abilities are far more terrifying than you can imagine." The light in Yuan Xiajie’s eyes dimmed. "If what you said earlier is true, Zhang Fei is the only person who can help you kill Meng Zhuo.
