chapters.title: Chapter 1765: Ghost Demon God First Mention
paragraphs: Yuan Xiajie hung her head down. "If that’s the case, I won’t ask Zhang Fei for help against Meng Zhuo, and I’ll leave as soon as I finish my training in his private space."
"Isn’t your decision stupid? Haven’t you started to fall in love with Zhang Fei?"
Yuan Xiajie pursed her lips. "I’ve started to fall in love with Zhang Fei, but my feelings for him are still shallow, and they will fade away if I don’t see him again."

"Why would you consider choosing such a path? I understand you want to take revenge for the death of your family, but you shouldn’t sacrifice your feelings." Even though she asked that, Hua Qianmei already knew the answer.

Yuan Xiajie sighed as she looked at Hua Qianmei. "Big Sis, I want to take revenge for the deaths of my family and members of my race, but I don’t want to be tied down to any man. Even though I’ve lived in Zhang Fei’s private space for months, he doesn’t have feelings for me, and we rarely talk to each other. He was busy with all his wives, and he almost never took a break from dual cultivation with them."

Hua Qianmei didn’t believe that Zhang Fei didn’t have feelings for Yuan Xiajie, especially after they had lived together for several months. Besides, he was a lust demon, and he already had over a hundred wives, so she felt it was impossible for him not to have feelings for her sister.

"Forget it! I’ve already decided to leave after I finish my training there, and I’ll find another way to take revenge against Meng Zhuo in the future." Hua Qianmei felt that Yuan Xiajie was too stubborn, and she only had grudges in her heart. "Besides, I don’t want to leave you, Big Sis. You’ve taken care of me since that night, and I love you very much, so I will never leave you for Zhang Fei."
Hua Qianmei smiled and placed a gentle kiss on Yuan Xiajie’s lips. "You should already know my feelings for you, right, Xiajie?"
"I know you love me as a sister and a lover, but you also want me to find a good man to be my husband." Yuan Xiajie’s eyes were brimming with love when she said that.

"That’s right." Hua Qianmei nodded with a smile. "I love you as a sister and a lover, but you must remember that you are the last descendant of your demon race. Your race will disappear forever if you die, so I can’t be selfish for your sake. That’s why I want you to find a man worthy of being your husband, so your race will continue to exist through your descendants. I don’t know Zhang Fei yet, so I dare not say whether he is worthy of being your husband or not. However, Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation is one of his wives, and he is also talented, so you have to consider him to be your future husband."
"But—"
"What are you worried about? Are you worried that he will forbid you from being with me?"
Yuan Xiajie nodded. "That’s one of the reasons, Big Sis."

"How is Zhang Fei’s relationship with all his wives? Have you ever seen their relationship firsthand?" Yuan Xiajie shook her head in response to Hua Qianmei. She was fully focused on her training over the past few months, and she had never been with any of his wives, so she didn’t know for sure about their relationship. "If that’s the case, you should try to observe their relationship the next time Zhang Fei takes you to train in his private space, so you can assess everything."
Yuan Xiajie thought for a moment before deciding. "Alright, I’ll follow your advice, Big Sis. By the way, you should take Zhang Fei’s two pills so I can see their effects on you."
"Didn’t Zhang Fei give you those two pills?"

"Zhang Fei didn’t give me those two pills, but he did give me several other pills, and their effects are truly remarkable." Seeing the curiosity on Hua Qianmei’s face, Yuan Xiajie explained to her about the effects of all the pills. "Since he needs a lot of perfect demon cores, I’ll persuade him to sell his pills in this domain, and you can buy them later."
Since Zhang Fei didn’t give her those pills, and she couldn’t possibly ask for them directly, Hua Qianmei agreed with Yuan Xiajie’s idea.
Hua Qianmei wanted to swallow Zhang Fei’s two beauty pills, but Yuan Xiajie stopped her and helped her remove her dress. "Did you miss me that much, Xiajie?"

"I did." Yuan Xiajie began to remove her dress until both of them were naked. "I’ve been gone for too long, and I was forced to hide in the Frozen Yin Domain because those creatures wanted to capture me, so I missed you so much. Fortunately, Zhang Fei came to that domain and took me away with him, so I didn’t have to hide there anymore."
"How did you guys come to this domain without encountering those creatures?" Hua Qianmei herself was afraid of those creatures, but fortunately, they couldn’t enter her domain.

"We went to this domain through the void." Hua Qianmei was shocked to hear that, and Yuan Xiajie told her about Long Xukong, who was a void dragon. "Zhang Fei is quite famous in the Paradise Realm, and he has connections with all races. They even attended his wedding with the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, which I have never seen before."

Since she had seen and heard many things about Zhang Fei before, Hua Qianmei was no longer surprised to hear that. "From my birth until now, I have never seen all the races gathered in one place before. In my opinion, you must never leave his side, and you must try your best to win his heart. That way, you will get an outstanding husband, and your wish to avenge your family’s death will be fulfilled."
"Let’s stop talking about other things, Big Sis." Yuan Xiajie pulled Hua Qianmei to the bed. "You should swallow those two pills first."
Hua Qianmei simply nodded, sat cross-legged on her bed, and swallowed the pills in order. Meanwhile, Yuan Xiajie was standing in front of her, and her eyes were glued to her face.
Sometime later, black liquid covered Hua Qianmei’s body, but Yuan Xiajie immediately cleaned it up. After that, she swallowed a second pill, and the process lasted quite a while.

"What about my changes?" Yuan Xiajie took out a small mirror and handed it to Hua Qianmei so she could see the changes in her appearance for herself. "Oh my gosh! Zhang Fei’s two pills are beauty pills, and their effects are too amazing! My face has become much younger, and my whole body has also been rejuvenated!"

"You have become prettier and sexier, Big Sis." Yuan Xiajie blushed, and her heart fluttered. "If Gongsun Zhilan and Tang Zhiyao see your current appearance, they will visit you every day to get those two pills. There are various beauty pills out there, but their effects are not comparable to Zhang Fei’s two pills. If people know about those two pills, they will definitely be willing to spend a lot of money to get them."

"You’re right about that." Hua Qianmei furrowed her brows after remembering the two female demon gods, Gongsun Zhilan and Tang Zhiyao. She wasn’t worried about the latter, but she knew that the former was extremely venomous, and she would do anything to obtain both pills, including attacking Zhang Fei. "I’ll use a little disguise if I meet them, so they won’t have any ill intentions towards that kid."

"Hehe," Yuan Xiajie chuckled. "Big Sis, Gongsun Zhilan and Tang Zhiyao aren’t Zhang Fei’s opponents, okay? Even though they’re demon gods, he has many ways to defeat them, and they’ll suffer if they mess with him. However, he will be in big trouble if he meets the Ghost Demon God, Gui Ye."

Hua Qianmei released a heavy sigh. "That damn Gui Ye is indeed troublesome! Although his strength isn’t as high as Mo Qingwen’s, his ability to control ghosts is truly troublesome. Even so, Zhang Fei has Feng Yao and Huo Ling by his side, so I believe that the dead ghost will not be able to harm him."
"Zhang Fei is truly lucky to have them by his side." Yuan Xiajie pushed Hua Qianmei to lie down on the bed, with her legs hanging off the side. "Big Sis, your new appearance tempts me."
Hua Qianmei wrapped her arms around Yuan Xiajie’s neck. "What are you waiting for? You miss me, and I miss you too, so we’ll spend our time together."
"Big Sis." Yuan Xiajie lowered her head and sealed Hua Qianmei’s lips directly. The female demon god had no problem with that, and she embraced her neck tighter while reciprocating her kiss.

Since their position was uncomfortable, Hua Qianmei carried her to the middle of the bed without stopping their kiss. They kissed for a while before stopping, and Yuan Xiajie began to stimulate her, kissing and licking her ears in turn.

Hua Qianmei closed her eyes to enjoy Yuan Xiajie’s stimulation, and her sensual lips kept parting as she let out soft moans. Her two hands move down to her sister’s back, caressing her fair, smooth back.
Hearing Hua Qianmei’s low, seductive moans, Yuan Xiajie became even more eager to stimulate her. Her head moved down to her neck; she kissed it a few times and started licking it.
"Mhmm... Xiajie, you’re getting better at arousing me." Hua Qianmei softly spoke; her hands moved to Yuan Xiajie’s buttocks and gently massaged them. "Mhmm..."
Yuan Xiajie said nothing and focused her attention on Hua Qianmei’s neck. She licked her neck and occasionally bit her skin gently, with her right hand starting to explore her plump, springy breasts.

"Hehe," Huli Chenying laughed softly. "Master, you’re no longer young, so you should start thinking about your future. Besides, your mother has long wanted a grandchild, and you’ve fallen in love with Zhang Fei, so I think you should meet him and give yourself to him."
Xuanyuan Yue smiled bitterly when she recalled her mother’s words about grandchildren. "Let’s follow Zhang Fei for now."

"Wait a minute, Master." Huli Chenying transformed into her fox beast form, opened her mouth wide, and sucked in all the beast corpses beneath them. Soon, she returned to her human form and licked her lips. "The demon beasts in this universe aren’t as tasty as the ones in our universe, but I have no choice but to eat them."
"Haha," Xuanyuan Yue tugged at Huli Chenying’s ear. "You are such a foodie, Sister Chenying! You say that, but your appetite is never satisfied even if you eat hundreds of beasts in our universe."
Huli Chenying pouted her lips. "Did you forget that I became like this because of you, Master? If you didn’t—"
"Alright... Alright... my bad... you don’t need to discuss it anymore." Xuanyuan Yue took Huli Chenying and followed Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei had already arrived at his next destination, and he encountered several demon beasts with cultivation at the Celestial Venerable Realm. He was still unaware that Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying were following him because they were stronger than him, and the system was the former’s creation.

After he deactivated the soul link, Zhang Fei went to the location of those beasts and fought with them. He didn’t borrow Feng Yao’s power because he wanted to use them as his training opponents, and he believed that his strength was enough to fight them.
Unbeknownst to Zhang Fei, someone was watching him from a faraway area, and that person was none other than Mo Qingwen. "That kid is interesting, and he wants to lure me to him."
"What are you thinking, husband?" A mature and graceful female demon asked as she walked toward Mo Qingwen.
Mo Qingwen embraced the woman’s waist. "I found a young male demon, and he tried to lure me to him, Gu Yanshu."
"Oh?" Gu Yanshu was taken aback for a moment. "Who is that man? Where is he now?"
"There." Mo Qingwen pointed in Zhang Fei’s direction. "I don’t know his name, but he seems to have a close relationship with Hua Qianmei."
"Hua Qianmei?" Gu Yanshu frowned. "Was that woman the one who brought him to our domain?"
"You’re wrong about that," Mo Qingwen denied with a shake of his head. "The one who brought him to our domain was the little female demon by Hua Qianmei’s side."
Gu Yanshu raised an eyebrow. "If I remember correctly, her name is Yuan Xiajie, and she is the only remaining descendant of her demon race."
"That’s right." Mo Qingwen nodded. "That little girl is quite pitiful because Meng Zhou slaughtered her demon race, and Hua Qianmei took her as her sister."

sentences.text: "Return." The Demon Extermination Sword returned to Zhang Fei’s hand as soon as he jumped down from the tree, with Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an sitting on his shoulders.
Zhang Fei checked the heads of dozens of beast corpses, but he couldn’t find a single perfect demon core, and he only discovered other grades of demon cores.
"Tch!

[I think you should hunt demon beasts with a cultivation at the Celestial Venerable Realm, Master.

"Yes," Zhang Fei thought the same as Mei.
"The upgrade will be completed in half a year, right?"
[Yes, Master.
You have been so busy over the past few months, and the system will undergo major changes in six months.]
"I can’t wait for the changes."
"Master!" Jian Guang’an pointed towards the front.
"There are many powerful demon beasts in that area."
Zhang Fei looked in that direction and checked the system map.
"Sigh!

We must go to other forests to find stronger demon beasts, specifically those in the Celestial Venerable Realm."
Jian Guang’an and Jian Hei’an exchanged glances for a moment.
"The two of us will follow wherever you go, Master."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"Guang’an and Hei’an, I’m really lucky to have you two by my side!

"I myself am happy to stay by your side, Master.

"Our family should be at peace in the afterlife, Master." Jian Hei’an said, her eyes filled with longing.

"Xereth is still alive in the Star Tower now, so—"
"You don’t have to do that, Master," The two female sword spirits interrupted.
"Even though Xereth is still alive, he will never be able to leave that place, so we are satisfied with the result."
"Do you two really not want to kill Xereth?"
The two female sword spirits shook their heads at Zhang Fei.
"Living in torment is far more painful than dying, right, Master?"
"Yes."
"Just let Xereth remain imprisoned in the Star Tower, Master."
Zhang Fei pondered for a while before speaking to them.
"Since you two want it that way, I will send one of my clones to the Star Tower, and I will ask that old man to torture Xereth more severely."

chapters.title: Chapter 1768: Gu Yanshu Visit Hua Qianmei
paragraphs: "Husband, that young demon is really weird! I’ve never seen a lust demon with nine tails before, and his tails should be real." Gu Yanshu frowned deeply.
Mo Qingwen agreed with his wife. "His current cultivation is at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but his cultivation was at the Celestial Venerable Realm when he entered this domain and met Hua Qianmei."
"He used a strengthening technique to increase his cultivation."

"That’s right." Mo Qingwen nodded. "However, I find his strengthening technique peculiar because the qi in his body remains stable. Normally, the qi in our bodies won’t be stable when we use such a technique, and our strength will decrease as the technique’s duration nears its end, but that problem doesn’t apply to him."
"That’s really weird!" Gu Yanshu softly muttered. "Do you want to see him?"
"Since he wants to meet me, I will meet him, but I won’t meet him now."
"If that’s the case, I’ll go to Hua Qianmei’s palace now, and I’ll ask her about that young demon."
"You can go see her now." After Gu Yanshu left, Mo Qingwen walked away from the place, but he ran into a young woman and a young man. "Why are you two here, Cangyue and Luoxie?"

Mo Cangyue moved beside Mu Qingwen and hugged his arm. "Father, you have to do something about Yan Tianling! He’s so disgusting, and he keeps pestering me! I’ve asked my brother to keep him away from me, but he doesn’t listen to him!"
"Father, that guy is really crazy, and I’m powerless to keep him away from my sister." Mo Luoxie said helplessly.
Mo Qingwen patted his daughter’s head. "I’ll talk to Yan Washeng later, and I’ll ask him to keep his son away from you."
"Hehe! Thank you, Father!" Mo Cangyue replied happily.
"I have other business, so I have to go now."
Mo Cangyue and Mo Luoxie watched their father leave.
"Hey, Brother! Did you see our father’s expression just now?"
"There’s something bothering our father, Sister."
"What do you think is our father’s problem?"

"I think it has something to do with the other demon gods." Mo Cangyue looked at Mo Luoxie with a raised eyebrow. "I heard rumors that the Crimson Demon God, Yan Washeng, conspired with several other demon gods, including Gui Ye, to overthrow our father. Our father is still the strongest among them, but the problem will not be simple if they join forces to fight him."
Mo Cangyue clicked her teeth. "Yan Washeng and Yan Tianling are indeed bastards! Our father must kill them so they won’t bring us any trouble! Do you think that venomous woman will join them?"

"There’s a high possibility that Gongsun Zhilan will join them." Mo Cangyue’s face turned ugly. "In the past, that bitch liked our father, but he rejected her and chose our mother. Her hatred for them is deeply ingrained in her heart, so you shouldn’t be surprised if she joins them."
"What about Tang Zhiyao?"
"Tang Zhiyao and Hua Qianmei have always been neutral, and they have no ambition to become the ruler of this domain."
Mo Cangyue felt relieved after hearing that. "Hmm? Where did our mother go?"
"Our mother went to Hua Qianmei’s palace."
"Oh! I’ll follow our mother, Brother!"
Mo Luoxie could only shake his head seeing his sister disappear so quickly, and he immediately left the room and went to the training ground.
"Mother!" Gu Yanshu, who was flying leisurely, turned to her daughter directly. "Why do you want to go to Hua Qianmei’s palace?"

"I want to ask Hua Qianmei about a male lust demon." Mo Cangyue was surprised to hear that from Gu Yanshu. "He’s not a native of our domain, and he went to see her before. He’s a unique lust demon, so I decided to meet her to ask about him."
"What’s so special about that lust demon?" Mo Cangyue felt strange about it because her parents never cared about the lust demon race.
Gu Yanshu touched her daughter’s forehead, sharing Zhang Fei’s image with her. "Huh? A nine-tailed lust demon? Where did he come from?"

"We don’t have any information about him yet, and he lured your father to go see him." Mo Cangyue was shocked to hear that a lust demon did that. "We don’t need to speculate about him, and we will know everything after we meet Hua Qianmei."
Mo Cangyue nodded slightly. "Has Yuan Xiajie returned to our domain, Mother?"
"Yuan Xiajie brought that male lust demon to our domain."
Mo Cangyue’s eyes sparkled. "Let’s go, Mother! We must reach Hua Qianmei’s palace as soon as possible!"
Gu Yanshu raised an eyebrow slightly, as she could see that her daughter was eager to meet Yuan Xiajie. She didn’t ask anything, and the two women accelerated their flying speed.
A few minutes later, Gu Yanshu and Mo Cangyue arrived at Hua Qianmei’s palace. They didn’t enter through the front door, and no one dared to stop them.
Mo Cangyue startled Hua Qianmei and Yuan Xiajie, who were enjoying their time cuddling, by opening the door from the outside.

"Xiajie! You didn’t tell me you had already returned to this domain!" Yuan Xiajie smiled bitterly at the anger in Mo Cangyue’s voice. The latter didn’t give her a chance to speak, and she jumped on top of her before kissing her. "Hateful! I’ve been waiting for you to come back for so long!"
"Haha," Yuan Xiajie laughed awkwardly. "Sister Cangyue, I just arrived at this domain today, and I was thinking of contacting you tomorrow."
"Humph!" Mo Cangyue snorted and kissed Yuan Xiajie again, and she kissed her passionately.
Yuan Xiajie was helpless by Mo Cangyue’s aggressive actions, but she did not complain about it; instead, she hugged her and kissed her back.
Hua Qianmei got out of bed and asked Gu Yanshu a question. "What brings you here today?"
"Could you get dressed first? Even though we’re both women, it’s uncomfortable to see you naked like this."
Hua Qianmei took her dress from the floor and put it on straight away, much to Gu Yanshu’s relief.

Gu Yanshu couldn’t help but sigh when she saw Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie kissing hotly. She ignored them and sat with Hua Qianmei. "Who is the male lust demon that Yuan Xiajie brought to this domain? Where did he come from?"

"His name is Zhang Fei, and he comes from the Paradise Realm." Hua Qianmei’s answer shocked Gu Yanshu. "He and Xiajie are old friends, and she brought him to this domain because he wanted to buy hundreds of demon materials to upgrade his demon ranks."
Gu Yanshu furrowed her brows. "How could a lust demon from the Paradise Realm ascend to this Ancient Realm? We are natives of this realm, but we can only descend there every few hundred years."
"Guang Zhiyi."
"Hmm? What do you mean by that? Guang Zhiyi has been dead for so long, so that’s impossible."
"Guang Zhiyi was dead a long time ago, but her reincarnation has returned."
Gu Yanshu took a deep breath. "Has Guang Zhiyi really returned to this domain?"
"Yes," Hua Qianmei nodded. "Guang Zhiyi has returned to this domain, but she’s not here now, and she’s staying with Zhang Fei to protect him."
"What’s the relationship between Zhang Fei and Guang Zhiyi?"
"A husband and a wife."
Gu Yanshu was completely shocked. "Are... are you serious about that? Are... are those two really married?"

"Aunt Yanshu, Zhang Fei is Guang Zhiyi’s husband," Yuan Xiajie replied after she finished kissing Mo Cangyue. "I’ve met her, and I’ve also witnessed their dual cultivation, so you don’t need to doubt the truth of their relationship."
"This—" Gu Yanshu was speechless and felt dizzy, not expecting that Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation would marry a lust demon.
Mo Cangyue pouted her lips. "Hey, Xiajie! Did you really watch them dual cultivate? Haven’t you always hated men? How could you do that?"

"I had no other choice at the time, Sister Cangyue." Yuan Xiajie explained to Mo Cangyue about their situation while they were on their way to the Myriad Abyss Domain after leaving the Frozen Yin Domain. "In fact, Zhang Fei and I were enemies before that day, so you shouldn’t be surprised if he treated me like that."
"Were you two really enemies before that day?"

"Yes," Yuan Xiajie nodded. "Back then, I did something to one of his women in the Paradise Realm, and I did it several times. He hated me, and he wanted to kill me. However, he changed his mind when we met in the Frozen Yin Domain, and I’ve been with him ever since."
Mo Cangyue nodded in understanding. "So, you brought him to this domain because he forced you?"

"He didn’t force me, and I brought him here because he was looking for demon materials." Mo Cangyue still couldn’t believe it. "If he forced me, I wouldn’t be as free as I am now. In fact, he gave me a chance to improve myself, despite our past enmity."
Mo Cangyue snorted. "What can a demon from the Paradise Realm do to help you? He is a lust demon, and he definitely wants your body."
"Haha," Yuan Xiajie laughed. "Sister Cang Yue, you don’t know anything about Zhang Fei. All of his women, including Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, are far better than me."
Mo Cangyue hugged Yuan Xiajie tightly. "I don’t care if Guang Zhiyi is his woman, but I will never allow him to touch you! You are mine, and no man is allowed to touch you!"
Gu Yanshu shook her head at her daughter’s behavior towards Yuan Xiajie. "Can you ask Zhang Fei to come over, Xiajie?"
"I can contact him, but I doubt he will come here today, Aunt."
"Please give it a try."
"Okay."

"Aunt Yanshu, Zhang Fei is Guang Zhiyi’s husband," Yuan Xiajie replied after she finished kissing Mo Cangyue.
"I’ve met her, and I’ve also witnessed their dual cultivation, so you don’t need to doubt the truth of their relationship."
"This—" Gu Yanshu was speechless and felt dizzy, not expecting that Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation would marry a lust demon.
Mo Cangyue pouted her lips.
"Hey, Xiajie!
Did you really watch them dual cultivate?
Haven’t you always hated men?
How could you do that?"

"I had no other choice at the time, Sister Cangyue." Yuan Xiajie explained to Mo Cangyue about their situation while they were on their way to the Myriad Abyss Domain after leaving the Frozen Yin Domain.
"In fact, Zhang Fei and I were enemies before that day, so you shouldn’t be surprised if he treated me like that."
"Were you two really enemies before that day?"
"Yes," Yuan Xiajie nodded.
"Back then, I did something to one of his women in the Paradise Realm, and I did it several times.
He hated me, and he wanted to kill me.
However, he changed his mind when we met in the Frozen Yin Domain, and I’ve been with him ever since."
Mo Cangyue nodded in understanding.
"So, you brought him to this domain because he forced you?"
"He didn’t force me, and I brought him here because he was looking for demon materials." Mo Cangyue still couldn’t believe it.
"If he forced me, I wouldn’t be as free as I am now.
In fact, he gave me a chance to improve myself, despite our past enmity."
Mo Cangyue snorted.
"What can a demon from the Paradise Realm do to help you?
He is a lust demon, and he definitely wants your body."
"Haha," Yuan Xiajie laughed.
"Sister Cang Yue, you don’t know anything about Zhang Fei.
All of his women, including Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, are far better than me."
Mo Cangyue hugged Yuan Xiajie tightly.
"I don’t care if Guang Zhiyi is his woman, but I will never allow him to touch you!
You are mine, and no man is allowed to touch you!"
Gu Yanshu shook her head at her daughter’s behavior towards Yuan Xiajie.
"Can you ask Zhang Fei to come over, Xiajie?"
"I can contact him, but I doubt he will come here today, Aunt."
"Please give it a try."
"Okay."

chapters.title: Chapter 1769: Dong Xuanyin - Mo Cangyue
paragraphs: "What about Zhang Fei, Xiajie?" Gu Yanshu impatiently asked.
Yuan Xiajie didn’t answer Gu Yanshu directly and listened to Zhang Fei’s reply first. "Big Sis Qianmei, he asked the two of us to bring Aunt Yanshu to that place."
"Oh." Hua Qianmei nodded in understanding.
"What place is Xiajie referring to?"

"My late master’s private place." Gu Yanshu knew about that place because she visited it several times, but she didn’t expect her to take Zhang Fei there. "Zhang Fei didn’t come alone, and he brought many of his demon wives."
Mo Cangyue’s ears perked up. "Are all Zhang Fei’s wives beautiful and sexy?"
Gu Yanshu wanted to slap her daughter’s forehead because Mo Cangyue had never liked any men, and she was more interested in women, which gave her a headache.
Hua Qianmei glanced at Mo Cangyue, but she did not say anything to her.
Yuan Xiajie, on the other hand, warned Mo Cangyue. "Sister Cangyue, you should forget about your wish; otherwise, you will regret it and lament your fate."

"Hmm?" Mo Cangyue squinted her already narrow eyes, looking at Yuan Xiajie. "All of Zhang Fei’s women are truly beautiful, and some of them are sexy. However, he doesn’t like it when others touch them, regardless of whether they are men or women. If you use your abilities against them, he will be furious, and he might kill you."
"Humph!" Mo Cangyue snorted. "Do you think he dares to kill me?"

Yuan Xiajie sighed. "You mustn’t underestimate Zhang Fei, Sister Cangyue. He’s younger than us, but he’s extremely ruthless. Besides, you’ve never met or fought him, so you don’t know his strength, but I can tell you that he can defeat you in one move."
"He—"

"You have to listen to her, Cangyue." Mo Cangyue turned to Gu Yanshu. "Do you think the man who managed to conquer Guang Zhiyi’s heart is an ordinary man? She may have been dead for a long time, but I’m sure that she’s still as powerful as ever, so you shouldn’t go looking for trouble with Zhang Fei."
"That’s impossible, right?" Mo Cangyue didn’t believe it at all. "Even though Guang Zhiyi has reincarnated, I’m sure she hasn’t regained her past strength, so—"

"Sister Cangyue, Feng Yao is much stronger than in the past, and she is capable of defeating all the demon gods in this domain." Mo Cangyue and Gu Yanshu looked at Yuan Xiajie in disbelief. "About a month and a half ago, Zhang Fei married the Princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, and the two avatars of the primordial beasts descended to cause chaos at their wedding."
"What? Did the two avatars of the primordial beasts really do that?" Mo Cangyue and Gu Yanshu were equally shocked.

"Wait." Yuan Xiajie pushed Mo Cangyue aside, got out of bed, and got dressed. After she got dressed, she created a qi screen that displayed Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding. "The woman who was breaking through was Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, Feng Yao. That young man was Zhang Fei, and the other two men were Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi."
"Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi?"

"Huang Yuanzhi is the Primordial Genesis Beast, and Xu Yuanzhi is the Primordial Nihility Beast. Although those two men are their avatars, they are much stronger than all the cultivators in the Ancient Realm." Hua Qianmei, Mo Cangyue, and Gu Yanshu watched the battle on the qi screen with serious looks. "I don’t know what kind of technique he used to increase his strength, but you guys can see that those two people are not his opponents."

Yuan Xiajie inwardly sighed after she said all that, but she didn’t show them all the events that happened in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain that day, and she only showed a few things. She knew that Zhang Fei didn’t want to have a conflict with Mo Qingwen, so she previously asked his permission to show the events of that day to his wife and daughter.

"Unbelievable!" The expressions of Hua Qianmei, Mo Cangyue, and Gu Yanshu were full of astonishment and disbelief after Zhang Fei drove the two primordial beasts out of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

Yuan Xiajie spoke to them again. "All demon gods, including Uncle Mo, have high cultivation and strength. They are still not opponents of the two avatars of the primordial beasts, yet Zhang Fei managed to defeat the two of them and force them to flee the domain, so you should be able to estimate his strength."

"Cangyue, we will go to see Zhang Fei now, and you have to behave yourself when you meet all his wives later. Do you understand?" Mo Cangyue pouted her lips and did not refute Gu Yanshu, but she was still curious about all those women. "Qianmei, please bring us to that place."
"Let’s go."
A few minutes later, Hua Qianmei and the others arrived inside the Ancient Four-Pillar Demon Array.

Gu Yanshu was taken back for a moment when she saw Zhang Fei [5] cultivating while dual soul cultivating with ten female demons at once, with dozens of female demons cultivating around them. Her gaze was suddenly diverted to the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror that continued to rotate above their souls. ’A soul artifact?’

Unlike her mother, Mo Cangyue’s attention was drawn to all the women, and their beauty aroused feelings of jealousy in her heart. She always felt that she was beautiful and sexy, but her beauty was nothing compared to them. ’How could they all be so beautiful? Tch! Their beauty is wasted by their decision to become Zhang Fei’s wives!’

Dong Xuanyin was the first to open her eyes. She raised an eyebrow when she saw Gu Yanshu and Mo Cangyue. She wasn’t afraid of the latter, but the former was a demon god like her, and her strength surpassed hers.
Gu Yanshu looked at Dong Xuanyin. "A demon beast with a cultivation at the Celestial God Realm? Oh! I forgot to introduce myself; I am Mo Qingwen’s wife, Gu Yanshu. Can you tell me your name?"
"My name is Dong Xuanyin, Senior." Dong Xuanyin rose to her feet. "You’re right, I’m a demon beast, but I’m not sure about my race."
"That’s weird." Gu Yanshu tried to find out Dong Xuanyin’s demon beast race, but she was unfamiliar with her aura. "I’ve never felt an aura like yours before, so I can’t guess your race."
"It’s okay." Dong Xuanyin glanced at Zhang Fei before asking. "Did you come here to meet my husband?"

"Yes," Gu Yanshu nodded. "Initially, I didn’t know about all of you being in this domain, and I only found out after my husband told me. I saw that your husband is a lust demon, but he was different from other lust demons because he has nine tails, so I came here to meet him."
Dong Xuanyin nodded in understanding. "My husband and sisters are currently focused on their cultivation, so you’ll have to wait some time if you want to speak with him, Senior."

"I don’t have anything else to do, so I’ll wait for them to finish." Gu Yanshu looked at Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe. "I heard from Yuan Xiajie that you all came from the Paradise Realm, and Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation brought you to this domain."
Dong Xuanyin stole a glance at Yuan Xiajie, who nodded at her. "We came from the Paradise Realm, and Sister Feng Yao brought us all to this realm a few months ago."
"Feng Yao is the reincarnation of Guang Zhiyi, right?"
"That’s right."
"Where is she now?"
"She lives in our husband’s beast space."
Gu Yanshu immediately realized that Feng Yao was a female beast. "How many demon gods are there in the Paradise Realm?"
"There are eleven demon gods in total, including me."
"I see." Gu Yanshu held her daughter back as Mo Cangyue was about to step forward. "Behave yourself."
Mo Cangyue pouted and looked at Dong Xuanyin. "Hey, Xuanyin, why did you guys choose to share a husband?"
"Because he’s great?" Dong Xunyin’s nonchalant response made Mo Cangyue’s face darken. "Let me guess! You are a lily, so you dislike men. Did I guess right?"
"That’s right," Mo Cangyue candidly admitted. "I don’t look down on any man because I’m my father’s daughter, but I’ve never been attracted to any man, and I prefer pretty women."

Dong Xuanyin smiled in amusement, but she liked Mo Cangyue’s outspoken character. "Actually, some of my sisters were like you in the past, but they changed after they met our husband, and they decided to become his wives since then."
"Who among them are lilies?"
Dong Xuanyin pointed to Yan Luan’er, Xi Zihua, Luo Yu, Gu Yan, and Ashreth. "They used to be lilies."

"Oh." Mo Cangyue looked at the five female demons. "Hmm? The Abyssal Widow Queen, the Crysalith Ice Demon, the Silver Silkworm Demon Beast, the Infernal Demon, and a Dark Elf. How can you guys be this beautiful?"
Doang Xuanyin smirked faintly. "We became this beautiful thanks to our husband’s Yang Qi."
Gu Yanshu and Mo Cangyue were stunned by Dong Xuanyin’s answer, but they did not believe her and suspected that Zhang Fei had used a different method to transform them into such beauties.
Hua Qianmei and Yuan Xiajie smiled to themselves. They did not intend to tell Gu Yanshu and Mo Cangyue about Zhang Fei’s two beauty pills or his status as an alchemy god.
"Are you joking with me on purpose?" Mo Cangyue asked coldly.
Dong Xuanyin shrugged. "You asked me, and I’ve already given you my answer, so it’s up to you whether you believe me or not."
"You—"
Before Mo Cangyue could finish speaking, Zhang Fei [5]’s voice reached their ears. "Oh? You two are impatient to meet me, eh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1770: Equivalent Exchange
paragraphs: "Hey! Your attitude is really disrespectful!"
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow, stealing a glance at Mo Cangyue. "You are a woman, but your attitude is not like a woman! No wonder no man likes you, and you ended up choosing to be a lily."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [5]’s words made Yuan Xiajie laugh out loud while clutching her stomach.

Hua Qianmei smiled in amusement as she looked at Zhang Fei [5] and Mo Cangyue, especially the latter’s expression. Mo Qingwen was the strongest demon god in the Myriad Abyss Domain, so almost everyone dared not say something like that to his daughter. ’This kid is quite interesting! No wonder he has so many women!’
"Humph!" Mo Cangyue coldly snorted, placing both hands on her waist. "So what? I’m proud to be a lily compared to being with a rotten man like you!"

"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled, looking Mo Cangyue’s figure up and down. "Only a blind man wants to have you as his wife! I know you are beautiful, but your breasts are too small, and your curves are barely visible."
Gu Yanshu was dumbfounded to hear Zhang Fei [5] say such things to her daughter. However, she admitted that her daughter’s body was indeed... er... undeveloped.
Hua Qianmei, who had been trying to hold back her laughter, finally burst out laughing. Yuan Xiajie’s laughter became louder and louder, with her feet stomping the ground again and again.

Mo Cangyue was stunned for a moment, but her face quickly turned red and black with anger. She immediately moved to attack Zhang Fei [5], but he shifted to the side and tripped her leg, causing her to stagger forward and fall face first.
"Ahh!" Mo Cangyue hurriedly turned around, sat on the ground, and wiped the dirt from her face. "You—"
"That’s enough, Cangyue!" Mo Cangyue shuddered at Gu Yanshu’s stern voice. "Please forgive my daughter, Zhang Fei [5]. She is too spoiled, and she likes to talk as she pleases."
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged. "I don’t take a spoiled little girl like her seriously."
"You—" Mo Cangyue instinctively covered her mouth with both hands as soon as Gu Yanshu narrowed her eyes. ’Tch! Mother, I am your daughter, but you are siding with this bastard!’

Zhang Fei [5] glanced briefly at Mo Cangyue before asking Gu Yanshu, "So, what’s your purpose in coming to see me? Frankly speaking, I didn’t come to the domain to look for trouble, and I came here to look for demon materials to upgrade my demon ranks. After all, those materials are quite rare in the Paradise Realm, and I have dozens of demon wives."

"Actually, those materials are quite scarce in this Ancient Realm, especially after the emergence of those creatures." Zhang Fei [5] frowned, but he did not interrupt Gu Yanshu. "I don’t know what exactly happened, but those creatures are after those materials. A few months ago, they managed to enter this domain, but my husband and the other demon gods managed to drive them out; otherwise, this domain would have been destroyed because of them."
Zhang Fei [5] looked outside the domain, and he didn’t expect those creatures to have invaded it. "Did your husband and the others manage to kill those creatures?"

"No," Gu Yanshu replied in a disappointed tone. "Even though we are demon gods, our strength isn’t enough to kill those creatures. We used some means to drive them out, and we strengthened the barrier after that incident."
"Did those creatures ever attack the domain again after that day?"
"After that day, those creatures disappeared, and they never appeared again."
Zhang Fei [5] fell into thinking. "When did that incident happen?"
"Six months ago, to be exact."
"Six months ago, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] remembered something. "I know the reason behind the disappearance of those creatures at that time."
"What was the reason they disappeared?"
"The main creature summoned them to the Cangxuan Domain."
"The Cangxuan Domain?" Hua Qianmei and Gu Yanshu were both surprised to hear that, as it was an empty domain.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I went to the Cangxuan Domain to look for something six months ago, and the number of those creatures in the domain was numerous at that time. After I got the item I needed, the main creature appeared in that domain and destroyed it."
"The Cangxuan Domain is destroyed?" Gu Yanshu and the others were shocked.

Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen, which showed when he and Feng Yao were fighting those creatures in the Changxuan Domain that time. He also displayed the destruction of the domain, which shocked them even more. "As you can see, we were fighting with those creatures, but they were too strong. We managed to kill some of them, but we were forced to escape before the main creature arrived."

Gu Yanshu, Hua Qianmei, Mo Cangyue, and Yuan Xiajie looked at the qi screen with various expressions. "If you left before the main creature arrived, how could you have memories of the domain’s destruction?"
"I have my own way to obtain those memories." Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Yuan Xiajie, signaling her not to reveal Feng Yao’s true identity to anyone, including Hua Qianmei.

Gu Yanshu looked at Zhang Fei [5] thoughtfully. "Forget it! I hope those creatures won’t invade this domain again, or the situation will be dangerous for us. By the way, you are a lust demon, but you can use the light element."
"That is my secret, and I will not reveal it to anyone except those closest to me." Then, Zhang Fei [5] asked her. "Is there no other way to obtain those materials?"
"You can still buy them in the Myriad Abyss Imperial City, but there aren’t as many of them as before, and we need time to replenish their stock."
"Since they don’t have much stock, I won’t rush to look for them." Zhang Fei [5] looked at the female demons behind them. "Did you bring any of those materials with you?"
Mo Cangyue wanted to say something to Gu Yanshu, but she ultimately chose to swallow her words. ’Tch! This bastard wants to take advantage of my mother!’
Gu Yanshu took out a set of demon materials. "I only have one set now, but they’re not cheap."
Since this was their first meeting and they had no previous connections, Gu Yanshu was unwilling to give those materials to Zhang Fei [5] for free.
"What’s their total price?"
"One hundred million perfect demon cores."

"Damn!" Zhang Fei [5] cursed loudly, as he didn’t have a single perfect demon core. He actually didn’t want to reveal his identity as the alchemy god to Gu Yanshu, but he needed those materials, and he didn’t have demon cores to buy them.
"Humph! As expected, you don’t have the money to buy them!" Mo Cangyue said disdainfully.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Mo Cangyue. "I may not have perfect demon cores right now, but I have some items that are much more valuable than demon cores."
"A braggart!" Mo Cangyue snorted.
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Little girl, I—"
Mo Cangyue was snapped instantly. "Who’s a little girl? I’m not a little girl! Your mother and your ancestors are little girls!"
"Look at your body! Your body is no different from a little girl!" Zhang Fei [5] sneered at her.
"You—"
"That’s enough, Cangyue." Gu Yanshu asked directly. "What items do you have to exchange for these materials?"
Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Hua Qianmei. "You definitely won’t believe me if I tell you the effects of my item, so you can ask her directly."
Gu Yanshu and Mo Cangyue looked at Hua Qianmei, who immediately removed her disguise. "What? How did you become this young? Did you use a rejuvenation technique?"
"I swallowed Zhang Fei [5]’s two pills before, and their effects made me young again." Hua Qianmei explained a little.
"Two pills?"

Zhang Fei [5] inwardly sighed. "Do you believe that I can snatch those materials from you?"
"Hmm?" Gu Yanshu raised an eyebrow.
Mo Cangyue pointed at Zhang Fei [5]. "You’re too arrogant! Do you think you can do that?"

Zhang Fei [5]’s behavior irritated Mo Cangyue. She tugged at the hem of her mother’s dress sleeve. "Mother—"

Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow, stealing a glance at Mo Cangyue.
"You are a woman, but your attitude is not like a woman!
No wonder no man likes you, and you ended up choosing to be a lily."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [5]’s words made Yuan Xiajie laugh out loud while clutching her stomach.
Hua Qianmei smiled in amusement as she looked at Zhang Fei [5] and Mo Cangyue, especially the latter’s expression.
Mo Qingwen was the strongest demon god in the Myriad Abyss Domain, so almost everyone dared not say something like that to his daughter. ’This kid is quite interesting!
No wonder he has so many women!’
"Humph!" Mo Cangyue coldly snorted, placing both hands on her waist.
"So what?
I’m proud to be a lily compared to being with a rotten man like you!"
"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled, looking Mo Cangyue’s figure up and down.
"Only a blind man wants to have you as his wife!
I know you are beautiful, but your breasts are too small, and your curves are barely visible."
Gu Yanshu was dumbfounded to hear Zhang Fei [5] say such things to her daughter.
However, she admitted that her daughter’s body was indeed... er... undeveloped.
Hua Qianmei, who had been trying to hold back her laughter, finally burst out laughing.
Yuan Xiajie’s laughter became louder and louder, with her feet stomping the ground again and again.
Mo Cangyue was stunned for a moment, but her face quickly turned red and black with anger.
She immediately moved to attack Zhang Fei [5], but he shifted to the side and tripped her leg, causing her to stagger forward and fall face first.
"Ahh!" Mo Cangyue hurriedly turned around, sat on the ground, and wiped the dirt from her face.
"You—"
"That’s enough, Cangyue!" Mo Cangyue shuddered at Gu Yanshu’s stern voice.
"Please forgive my daughter, Zhang Fei [5].
She is too spoiled, and she likes to talk as she pleases."
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged.
"I don’t take a spoiled little girl like her seriously."
"You—" Mo Cangyue instinctively covered her mouth with both hands as soon as Gu Yanshu narrowed her eyes. ’Tch!
Mother, I am your daughter, but you are siding with this bastard!’

"I don’t know what exactly happened, but those creatures are after those materials.

"Did your husband and the others manage to kill those creatures?"
"No," Gu Yanshu replied in a disappointed tone.
"Even though we are demon gods, our strength isn’t enough to kill those creatures.

"Did those creatures ever attack the domain again after that day?"
"After that day, those creatures disappeared, and they never appeared again."

"When did that incident happen?"
"Six months ago, to be exact."
"Six months ago, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] remembered something.
"I know the reason behind the disappearance of those creatures at that time."
"What was the reason they disappeared?"
"The main creature summoned them to the Cangxuan Domain."
"The Cangxuan Domain?" Hua Qianmei and Gu Yanshu were both surprised to hear that, as it was an empty domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1771: Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon
paragraphs: Mo Cangyue’s eyes sparkled when she saw the two pills in Gu Yanshu’s hand. "Mother—"

"No!" Gu Yanshu hurriedly put the two pills into her storage ring, knowing her daughter wanted them. "You like women, so you don’t need a pretty face! Unlike you, I want to make your father happy, and he will be satisfied if I become young again."
"Huft!" Mo Cangyue pouted her lips, stealing glances at Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] pretended not to see that and walked in front of Ru Xue. "Xue’er, you should use these materials first; it’s time for you to increase your demon rank."

Zhang Lingxue and the other female demons didn’t feel jealous or disappointed by their husband’s decision because Ru Xue was his first woman in his life, and they always believed that he would never forget them, so they just needed to wait for their turn.
"Thank you, Fei’er." Ru Xue stood up and entered the training space, which shocked both Gu Yanshu and Mo Changyue.
"I’ll find those materials for you all, and you guys will be able to increase your demon ranks then."
Ling Long and the others smiled broadly after Zhang Fei [5] said that, and they resumed their cultivation.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Gu Yanshu and asked her. "You are a Gu Insect Queen, right?"
"Hmm?" Gu Yanshu was shocked to hear Zhang Fei [5]’s question. "How can you recognize my demon identity?"
"Please check my body."

Gu Yanshu and Mo Cangyue were curious about that, and they checked Zhang Fei [5]’s inner body with their senses. A few minutes later, the two women’s eyes widened in shock, discovering the Gu Heart inside her body. In addition to the Gu Heart, they also discovered that his original heart was unusual because it had been replaced by the Cursed Demon Heart.
"Mother, he has the Gu Heart, but he only has one Gu insect inside." Mo Cangyue said.
"Yes," Gu Yanshu nodded and asked Zhang Fei [5]. "How did you create the Gu Heart?"

"About twelve years ago, I met a Gu cultivator in the Three Mortal Realms, and he helped me create my Gu Heart." Gu Yanshu and Mo Cangyue did not expect that there were Gu cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms. "Unfortunately, there aren’t many useful Gu insects there, so I haven’t looked for them yet."
Gu Yanshu nodded in understanding. "If you want to look for Gu insects, I can take you to another domain, and that domain is my original nest before I married my husband."
"Is there a teleportation portal that connects the two domains?"
"There is one in my husband’s palace."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] wanted to look for Gu insects, but he was not as eager to look for them as in the past. With his current strength and abilities, he felt that they were enough to fight with stronger cultivators. However, Feng Yao advised him to look for those Gu insects because they would be useful to deal with those creatures, but he had to nurture those insects first. "I want to go to that domain, but I won’t be going there anytime soon. I want to focus on finding those demon materials first. Where can I look for them?"
"The Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon!"
"The Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon? What kind of place is that?"

Gu Yanshu explained. "The dungeon existed long before the demon races decided to live in this domain, but I have no information about how or when it was formed. The dungeon consists of five floors and below, and each floor is inhabited by demons from all races, including the Infernal Demon Race."
"I can only obtain the Infernal Blood Core from the Infernal Demon Race," Zhang Fei [5] muttered.
"That’s right." Gu Yanshu nodded. "You can find four of the five materials in the dungeon, but you won’t be able to get the Demon Soul Elixir there, and—"
Zhang Fei [5] continued Gu Yanshu’s words directly. "Only the demon witch race can concoct the Demon Soul Elixir. Are there any members of the witch demon race in this domain?"

"There are only three members of the witch demon race in this domain, and the rest live in other domains." Zhang Fei [5] frowned after Gu Yanshu mentioned it because the situation of the witch demon race was the same as the ones in the Paradise Realm. "The materials for concocting the Demon Soul Elixir are easy to find in the dungeon, but those three witches are quite troublesome, and they are quite arrogant."

Dong Xuanyin immediately spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "You don’t need to think about those witches, right, husband? You have Wu Zu by your side, and she can help you concoct the Demon Soul Elixir at any time as long as you have the ingredients."
"Oh? Is there really a witch by your side?"

"I’ll bring her here." After a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] opened a portal to the Yin-Yang Space, and Wu Zu walked out from it. "This domain is the Myriad Abyss Domain, one of the domains in the Ancient Realm, and you can cultivate in this domain with all my wives."
"Okay." Wu Zu was delighted to hear that, but her attention fell on Gu Yanshu. "Huh? This is the first time I’ve met a Gu Insect Queen that has transformed into human form."
"Her name is Gu Yanshu, and she is the wife of the ruler of this domain."

Wu Zu’s eyes widened so much they nearly popped out of their sockets. "Your connections really make me dizzy! You have connections with powerful cultivators in the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Isn’t that great? By the way, there is the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon in this domain, and I will be going there to look for ingredients to concoct the Demon Soul Elixir, so I will need your help to concoct it later."

Wu Zu didn’t have a problem with that because Zhang Fei [5] had already given him many good opportunities to improve himself, including bringing him to the Ancient Realm. "Okay! You can hand over all the ingredients to me after you get them, and I’ll concoct the Demon Soul Elixir for you."

"I have all the ingredients to concoct the Demon Soul Elixir." Gu Yanshu took out a storage ring and handed it to Wu Zu. "If I remember correctly, you should be able to concoct a hundred elixirs using all the ingredients in the ring."

"A hundred." Wu Zu checked the storage ring to confirm the quantity of ingredients. "You are right, these ingredients are enough to concoct one hundred elixirs. Since all the ingredients are available, I will start concocting the elixir today, and I can finish everything in a month or two."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded and opened a portal to the training space. "You can concoct the elixir in there, and I will take you back to this domain after you finish all the ingredients."
"Alright."
"How do you know that female witch?" Gu Yanshu asked Zhang Fei [5] after Wu Zu disappeared.
Mo Cangyue was also curious about the matter because Wu Zu was no ordinary member of the witch demon race, and all members of that race were too proud to bow down to others, including her father.

Zhang Fei [5] pointed to Dong Xuanyin. "Wu Zu is my wife’s old friend, and she agreed to join us after I shared some things with her. About the Demon Soul Elixir, I’ll give it all to you after she finishes concocting it, and—"
"No need." Gu Yanshu waved her hand. "After the woman finishes concocting the elixir, you can take the elixir according to your needs, and you can leave the rest to me."
Mo Cangyue’s lips twitched. ’Mother, why are you so kind to him? You should charge a huge price for each elixir!’

Zhang Fei [5] naturally wouldn’t reject that. "Since you’ve said that, I won’t refuse your good intentions, and I’ll take the elixir according to the number of wives I have later. Where is the dungeon located? Do I need any special conditions to enter it?"

"The only requirement is that your cultivation has reached the Five Celestial Realm." Gu Yanshu touched Zhang Fei [5]’s forehead, sharing the location of the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon. "There are no rules inside the dungeon."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised. "Does that mean I can kill whoever tries to kill me first?"

Gu Yanshu nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "You can kill anyone in there, and no one will stop you. However, you must avoid the descendants of those demon gods; otherwise, you won’t be able to live in this domain freely, and they will hunt you down to kill you."

"Got it." Zhang Fei [5] naturally wasn’t afraid of those demon gods, let alone their descendants. After all, he could borrow Feng Yao’s power using the soul link, and he also had Huo Ling by his side. "I’ll go into the dungeon today, and I won’t come out until I’ve collected all those materials."

"All your wives are truly fortunate to have a husband like you." Gu Yanshu glanced at those female demons. "I’ll return to my palace now, and you can visit us whenever you want. After all, you want to meet my husband, right?"
Zhang Fei [5] smiled. "Thank you for your invitation, but I won’t be visiting your palace anytime soon, and I will go there when I have free time."
"Alright." Then, Gu Yanshu asked her daughter. "Are you coming back with me, Cangyue?"
Mo Cangyue shook her head. "You can go back first, Mother. I’ll stay here for now, and I’ll come back later."
"Alright."

paragraphs: Since the matter was over and Gu Yanshu had left, Hua Qianmei decided to return to her palace. Yuan Xiajie wanted to follow her, but she asked her to accompany Zhang Fei [5] to the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon.
"Why are you still here?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Mo Cangyue indifferently.
"Why should I leave?" Mo Cangyue retorted. "I’m a native of this domain, and you’re a newcomer, remember?"
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged, ignoring Mo Cangyue. "I will send the five of you to the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon, and you can join my real body there."
Yuan Xiajie, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe agreed with that.
Mo Cangyue was confused by Zhang Fei [5]’s last sentence. "Hey! What do you mean by your real body? Isn’t this your real body?"
"This body is just my clone."
"Huh?" Mo Cangyue was shocked. "Are you serious? Is this really your clone? How can your clone have the same cultivation as your real body?"

"Do you know about the lust demon’s body double ability?" Mo Cangyue thought for a moment before shaking her head at Zhang Fei [5]. "Lust demons have several abilities that other demons don’t have, such as my demon body double, body modification ability, and several others. Unlike a clone technique, I can use my demon body double ability to create a clone that is exactly the same as my real body, both in appearance and cultivation."
"Oh." Mo Cangyue nodded in understanding. "Then, what about your body modification ability? I never liked lust demons because they always think about sex, so I don’t know their abilities."
"Do you think I’m different from them?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I’m a lust demon, so I like sex."
Mo Cangyue pouted her lips. "You haven’t answered my question just now."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Mo Cangyue’s breast.
"A lustful pervert!" Mo Cangyue shouted as she covered her breasts with her hands. "Stop looking at me like that! I don’t like men!"
Yuan Xiajie, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe laughed in amusement because of Mo Cangyue’s overreaction.
Zhang Fei [5] snorted. "I already told you that I’m not interested in you! Your breasts are too small, and your curves are barely visible, so you don’t fit my criteria."

"You—" Mo Cangyue was frustrated to face Zhang Fei [5], but she immediately pointed at Zhang Lin instead. "Look at her! Her breasts are also too small, and her curves are barely visible like mine! Yet, you took her as your wife; doesn’t that mean you’re a hypocrite?"
"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "She is my little sister, Zhang Lin."
"Huh?" Mo Cangyue was dumbfounded.
"Since Lin’er is my sister, I don’t care about her figure, and I accept her as she is." Zhang Fei [5] created a warp portal. "Enter now, and you will arrive at the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe entered the portal without hesitation. Yuan Xiajie grabbed Mo Cangyue’s hand and pulled her into the portal, following the others.

After removing the portal, Zhang Fei [5] asked his ten wives to sit around him to dual soul cultivate. Although their cultivation levels were already quite high, their soul powers remained significantly lower than his, so he wanted to help them improve.

Mo Cangyue was stunned again once they arrived at the gate leading to the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon. The area was too far from Hua Qianmei’s city, but Zhang Fei was able to send them there so quickly. "Hey, Xiajie! As far as I know, lust demons don’t have the ability to open a portal, right?"
"No." Yuan Xiajie glanced at Zhang Fei. "That previous portal wasn’t his lust demon ability but something else, and I can’t explain it to you without his permission."
Mo Cangyue glared fiercely at her lover, but Yuan Xiajie refused to explain Zhang Fei’s three other identities to her. "Tch! Have you fallen in love with him?"
"A little."
As soon as Yuan Xiajie said that, Mo Cangyue hugged her and kissed her. "You are mine! I will never let you fall in love with him, let alone have sex with him!"
"Haha," Yuan Xiajie laughed awkwardly. "I like Zhang Fei a little, but he never liked me. I’m aware of my position, so I won’t force myself."
"That’s good!" Mo Cangyue nodded in satisfaction. "If you dare fall in love with him, I will lock you up in my room, and I will never let you go."
Yuan Xiajie pouted. "Do you dare stop Big Sis Qianmei from seeing me?"

"No! Only a madman would dare stop Hua Qianmei." Mo Cangyue always felt helpless in front of that female demon god; even her parents had given her a strict warning not to look for trouble with her. "Hey, Zhang Fei! Are we going in now?"
Zhang Fei looked at Mo Cangyue and wanted to answer her, but a man’s loud voice beat him to it. "Yueyue, were you waiting here on purpose? Since you’re already here, we should go together."
Mo Cangyue shuddered and hid behind Yuan Xiajie, causing her and Zhang Fei to frown.

Soon, a male demon landed in front of them, followed by another male demon and two female demons. His face looked surprised when he saw Yuan Xiajie, but he immediately smiled. "Oh? When did you return to this domain, Xiajie? How about you and Yueyue join me?"

Zhang Fei didn’t care about them, nor did Qi Qingxiu and the other three. He didn’t care about the male demon and the two female demons behind, and he only checked the status of the male demon leading them. ’The Crimson Demon Yan Tianling, eh? He should be the son of the Crimson Demon God, Yan Washeng, right?’
Before they arrived at the Myriad Abyss Domain, Yuan Xiajie had already briefed Zhang Fei about the situation of the domain, especially about the identities of the demon gods who ruled there.
Yuan Xiajie rejected Yun Tianling without a second thought. "I will not join your group, Prince Yun. If you want me to join you, you must ask Big Sis Hua Qianmei for permission first."
’This bitch always brings up Hua Qianmei’s name in front of me!’ Yan Tianling maintained his smile. "I won’t force you if you don’t want to join me, Xiajie. What about you, Yueyue?"
"Humph!" Mo Cangyue snorted. "If you want me to join you, you should go see my father first! If you can get his permission, I’ll join you."

’Humph! You can still act arrogant now, but I’ll make you submit to me after my father and the others kill your father!’ Yan Tianling was taken aback when he saw Qi Qingxiu and the others. Although he didn’t know their identities, he knew that they were demon gods like his father. He didn’t have the courage to greet them, but he informed Yan Washeng about them. ’Hahaha! If my father manages to capture them, I’ll ask him to hand them over to me!’
Yan Tianling looked at Zhang Fei before snorting in disdain. He said nothing and led his three subordinates into the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon.
After they left, Mo Cangyue warned Zhang Fei, "Hey! You must be careful of Yan Tianling! If you mess with him, his father will find you and kill you, and they will also capture your wives!"
"I’m not afraid of Yun Washeng, and I will kill him if he dares to touch my wives." Zhang Fei immediately led Qi Qingxiu and the others into the dungeon.
Mo Cangyue felt that Zhang Fei was too arrogant with his words just now, but she remembered that her mother had so much respect for him when they met before, so she didn’t dare to underestimate him.

Yuan Xiajie pulled Mo Cangyue along with her, following Zhang Fei and the others into the dungeon. "You don’t need to worry about Zhang Fei, Sister Cangyue. Yan Washeng is powerful, but he will never win against him."
"Why do you and my mother have so much confidence in his abilities, Xiajie?" Mo Cangyue’s tone sounded helpless.
Yuan Xiajie smiled. "Because I’ve witnessed Zhang Fei fighting with the two avatars of the two primordial beasts, and he managed to drive them out of his domain."

"Huh?" Mo Cangyue’s jaws dropped, forming a wide O. "Did he really manage to defeat them? Even though they only used their avatars, they were powerful and formidable; even my father had to think twice about fighting them."

"This is your best chance to see Zhang Fei’s fighting prowess firsthand, Sister Cangyue." Mo Cangyue found it difficult to believe Yuan Xiajie’s previous words, as Zhang Fei’s cultivation was still far below hers. "If Yan Tianling dares to disturb him, he will never leave the dungeon again."
Mo Cangyue sighed. "I can’t say anything for now, and I’ll watch his fighting abilities firsthand."
After they disappeared, Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying hurriedly followed them. "We’re probably going to see an interesting show in the dungeon, Master."
"Yes," Xuanyuan Yue nodded in agreement. "If Yan Tianling acts stupidly, he will surely die in Zhang Fei’s hands."
"Hehe! Let’s hurry, Master."

When they arrived inside the dungeon, Zhang Fei saw that many demons from outside were fighting with the demons inside. He found it strange to see them fighting each other because they were all from the demon race.
However, Zhang Fei noticed something unusual, and the demons from the dungeon reappeared after some time. "Respawn?"
"I don’t know how to put it, but all the demons in this dungeon will respawn some time after their death." Yuan Xiajie explained.
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "If that’s the case, we don’t need to hold back, and we’ll kill them to our heart’s content."

chapters.title: Chapter 1773: The Prison Dungeon
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [4] was inside the beast space to meet Feng Yao. "Yao’er, what kind of place exactly is the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon?"
"Prison." Zhang Fei [4] and Long Wuzhao were both in shock. "You’re asking this matter because all the demons inside the dungeon will respawn after they die, right?"
"Yes,"
Long Wuzhao was puzzled. "What do you two mean they will respawn?"

"Every time those demons die, they will come back to life after a while. The more often they die, the more they will lose their memories, and they will turn into mindless demons." Long Wuzhao looked at Zhang Fei [4], but he responded with a shake of his head, which made Feng Yao chuckle at their expressions. "As I said before, the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon is a prison, and the ancients of the past built it to imprison the strongest demons of their era."
"The ancients of the past? The strongest ancient demons?"

Feng Yao nodded to Long Wuzhao. "The ancients of the past were the first ancestors of the other ancient races, and they lived since the beginning of the Ancient Realm. They were much stronger than the current ancient races, but they died before the past disaster struck that realm."
"Before the past disaster?"

"Yes," Feng Yao continued. "Long before the past disaster occurred, there was a war between the ancients of the other races and the ancient demons. Their war did not last long, and it was marked by the defeat of the ancient demons. Even though the ancient demons suffered a major defeat, their leaders did not die. The ancients of the other races also suffered significant damage, which weakened them."
"Then?"

"Since they couldn’t eradicate the ancient demons, the ancients of the other races imprisoned them in an empty domain, which was the Myriad Abyss Domain. They built that dungeon and imprisoned them there, but they had to pay a harsh price, which was their lives."
"So, you’re saying that those ancient demons are still alive?"

"Those ancient demons are still alive, but they can’t leave the dungeon." Zhang Fei [4] fell into deep thought after hearing Feng Yao’s statement. "The ancients of the other races imprisoned their leaders on the last floor of the dungeon and their subordinates on the top five floors, and they installed an ancient formation that made those demons like eternal creatures."
"An ancient formation?"
"The Samsara Binding Formation."
Zhang Fei [4] took a deep breath. "So, the ancients of the other races created the formation using their lives?"

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded. "They sacrificed their lives to create that formation and their souls to activate it, thus preventing them from being reincarnated. The current ancient races know nothing of that war or the origin of that dungeon, as their first ancestors had erased everything from history to prevent those ancient demons from being freed."

Then, Long Wuzhao asked. "Why did the ancients of the other races imprison those ancient demons there? Since the current ancient demons live in that domain, there’s a chance they’ll learn about the dungeon’s mysteries one day, right?"

"At the time, the ancients of the other races probably didn’t think that far ahead, nor did they expect those demons to go to that domain and settle there. Back then, that domain was too gloomy and uninhabited, so they made such a decision." Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei [4]. "What do you know about the dungeon?"
"I only know that the dungeon has five floors down."

Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "Actually, that dungeon has six floors, husband. The first and fifth floors are prisons for members of the ancient demons, and their ancestors are imprisoned on the sixth floor."
"The sixth floor?" Zhang Fei [4] frowned. "Do those demons not know about that matter?"

Feng Yao shook her head. "No one from the current ancient races knows about this matter, husband. Although those demons have lived in that domain for a long time, they don’t know about the existence of the sixth floor."
"How many ancient demon leaders are imprisoned in the dungeon?"
"Two."
"Oh? Only two?" Initially, Zhang Fei [4] thought that the number of those ancient demons was quite large, but it turned out there were only two.

"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "There were only two of them, but they were able to overwhelm the ancients of the other races. Thus, you should be able to guess their strengths, right? Mo Qingwen is the strongest demon god now, but he is no different from an ant before these two. If they manage to break free from their prison, the current ancient races will not be able to defeat them."
"Even though they are both strong, I am sure that they are not as strong as the primordial demon."
"That’s for sure!"
Zhang Fei [4] thought while looking at Feng Yao. "Given your current strength, you should be able to kill those two ancient demons, right?"

"Do you need to ask that, husband?" Zhang Fei [4] rubbed his nose. "I can show you the entrance to the sixth floor if you want to meet those two ancient demon leaders, but I think you shouldn’t kill them, and you can use them for your other purposes."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] rubbed his chin in thought. "Do you think they will be of any use to me?"

"You can use them as guardians for the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and no one can enter that domain with them there." Zhang Fei [4] agreed with Feng Yao’s idea. "However, we have to postpone this matter for now, and I will help you free the two of them from that place after we succeed in eradicating those creatures. If we free them now, those creatures will attack them to take over their bodies, and they will bring greater disaster to the Ancient Realm."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "I have to go now, and I will think about this matter first."
"Alright."
"Are there still hidden things in this universe that you haven’t told your husband?"

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly. "This universe is too vast and too mysterious, so there are many hidden things in it. Even if I tell my husband everything now, he can’t do anything about them, so I’ll reveal them gradually to avoid burdening him."
Long Wuzhao nodded in agreement. "What is the strongest hidden thing?"
"Those primordial beings."
Long Wuzhao had long suspected that there were other primordial beings besides the two primordial beasts, and Feng Yao’s words proved his guess. "How many of them are there?"
"There are three others besides the two primordial beasts, and they have been sleeping since the primordial realm was destroyed."
"Who are they?"
"You will know about them when the time comes."
"Fine!" Long Wuzhao was always frustrated whenever Feng Yao acted secretively. "When will you bring your husband to the Primordial Realm?"
"Once his cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm, I will bring him to the Primordial Realm, and I think that day will come sooner than I expected."

Long Wuzhao fell into a deep thought because Zhang Fei’s cultivation speed was too terrifying, and he believed that he would reach the Celestial God Realm much faster than all cultivators, including him.

On the first floor of the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon, Yan Tianling and his three followers observed Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe from a distance. The prince of the Crimson Demon Race was eager to obtain the four female demon gods, but he was aware of the disparity in their strength, so he didn’t dare approach them.
"Do you want those four women, Prince?" One of Yan Tianling’s female subordinates asked.

The other female demon eyed the four of them. "There are so many beautiful female demons in this domain, like Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, and Tang Zhiyao. However, their beauty cannot surpass that of those four women, Prince."

"The four of them are indeed beautiful and sexy, and I wonder what their expressions would be like if they were under me in bed." Yan Tianling smiled lecherously as he imagined that. "Unfortunately, they are demon gods, so I don’t dare approach them with my current cultivation."
"Have you contacted your father and told him about the four of them, Prince?" Yan Tianling’s male subordinate asked

"I’ve already told my father about the four of them, but he’s currently in a meeting with some demon gods, and he’ll come here as soon as he’s finished." Yan Tianling shifted his gaze to Zhang Fei, and he furrowed his brows because Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue were so familiar with him. "Have any of you ever seen a nine-tailed lust demon?"
"We’ve never seen a nine-tailed lust demon, Prince," the three answered in unison. "That man shouldn’t be a resident of this domain, and he probably came from another domain."

"That bastard must have come from another domain!" Yan Tianling narrowed his eyes. "I’ve wanted Mo Cangyue for a long time, but she rejected me too many times, yet she was so close to that male lust demon."

The three demons exchanged glances without saying anything, as they had long known about Yan Tianling’s obsession with Mo Cangyue. They also knew that she never liked men, and she rejected him repeatedly because of that.
"Let’s wait for my father to come here; I’m sure he can capture them easily." A gleam of cruelty flashed across Yan Tianling’s eyes. "Do you two want to have that male lust demon?"
The two female demons laughed. "Prince, that male lust demon is quite handsome, so we won’t refuse if you want to give him to us."
"Alright," Yan Tianling nodded. "After my father captures them, I’ll give that male lust demon to you two, and you can enjoy your time with him."
"Thank you, Prince."
