"Since they couldn’t eradicate the ancient demons, the ancients of the other races imprisoned them in an empty domain, which was the Myriad Abyss Domain.
They built that dungeon and imprisoned them there, but they had to pay a harsh price, which was their lives."
"So, you’re saying that those ancient demons are still alive?"
"Those ancient demons are still alive, but they can’t leave the dungeon." Zhang Fei [4] fell into deep thought after hearing Feng Yao’s statement.

"The ancients of the other races imprisoned their leaders on the last floor of the dungeon and their subordinates on the top five floors, and they installed an ancient formation that made those demons like eternal creatures."
"An ancient formation?"
"The Samsara Binding Formation."
Zhang Fei [4] took a deep breath.
"So, the ancients of the other races created the formation using their lives?"
"Yes," Feng Yao nodded.
"They sacrificed their lives to create that formation and their souls to activate it, thus preventing them from being reincarnated.
The current ancient races know nothing of that war or the origin of that dungeon, as their first ancestors had erased everything from history to prevent those ancient demons from being freed."
Then, Long Wuzhao asked.
"Why did the ancients of the other races imprison those ancient demons there?
Since the current ancient demons live in that domain, there’s a chance they’ll learn about the dungeon’s mysteries one day, right?"
"At the time, the ancients of the other races probably didn’t think that far ahead, nor did they expect those demons to go to that domain and settle there.
Back then, that domain was too gloomy and uninhabited, so they made such a decision." Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei [4].
"What do you know about the dungeon?"
"I only know that the dungeon has five floors down."
Feng Yao nodded in understanding.
"Actually, that dungeon has six floors, husband.
The first and fifth floors are prisons for members of the ancient demons, and their ancestors are imprisoned on the sixth floor."
"The sixth floor?" Zhang Fei [4] frowned.
"Do those demons not know about that matter?"
Feng Yao shook her head.
"No one from the current ancient races knows about this matter, husband.
Although those demons have lived in that domain for a long time, they don’t know about the existence of the sixth floor."
"How many ancient demon leaders are imprisoned in the dungeon?"
"Two."
"Oh?
Only two?" Initially, Zhang Fei [4] thought that the number of those ancient demons was quite large, but it turned out there were only two.
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled.
"There were only two of them, but they were able to overwhelm the ancients of the other races.
Thus, you should be able to guess their strengths, right?
Mo Qingwen is the strongest demon god now, but he is no different from an ant before these two.
If they manage to break free from their prison, the current ancient races will not be able to defeat them."
"Even though they are both strong, I am sure that they are not as strong as the primordial demon."
"That’s for sure!"
Zhang Fei [4] thought while looking at Feng Yao.
"Given your current strength, you should be able to kill those two ancient demons, right?"
"Do you need to ask that, husband?" Zhang Fei [4] rubbed his nose.
"I can show you the entrance to the sixth floor if you want to meet those two ancient demon leaders, but I think you shouldn’t kill them, and you can use them for your other purposes."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] rubbed his chin in thought.
"Do you think they will be of any use to me?"
"You can use them as guardians for the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and no one can enter that domain with them there." Zhang Fei [4] agreed with Feng Yao’s idea.
"However, we have to postpone this matter for now, and I will help you free the two of them from that place after we succeed in eradicating those creatures.
If we free them now, those creatures will attack them to take over their bodies, and they will bring greater disaster to the Ancient Realm."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding.
"I have to go now, and I will think about this matter first."
"Alright."
"Are there still hidden things in this universe that you haven’t told your husband?"
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly.
"This universe is too vast and too mysterious, so there are many hidden things in it.
Even if I tell my husband everything now, he can’t do anything about them, so I’ll reveal them gradually to avoid burdening him."
Long Wuzhao nodded in agreement.
"What is the strongest hidden thing?"
"Those primordial beings."
Long Wuzhao had long suspected that there were other primordial beings besides the two primordial beasts, and Feng Yao’s words proved his guess.
"How many of them are there?"
"There are three others besides the two primordial beasts, and they have been sleeping since the primordial realm was destroyed."
"Who are they?"
"You will know about them when the time comes."
"Fine!" Long Wuzhao was always frustrated whenever Feng Yao acted secretively.
"When will you bring your husband to the Primordial Realm?"
"Once his cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm, I will bring him to the Primordial Realm, and I think that day will come sooner than I expected."

Long Wuzhao fell into a deep thought because Zhang Fei’s cultivation speed was too terrifying, and he believed that he would reach the Celestial God Realm much faster than all cultivators, including him.
On the first floor of the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon, Yan Tianling and his three followers observed Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe from a distance.
The prince of the Crimson Demon Race was eager to obtain the four female demon gods, but he was aware of the disparity in their strength, so he didn’t dare approach them.
"Do you want those four women, Prince?" One of Yan Tianling’s female subordinates asked.
The other female demon eyed the four of them.
"There are so many beautiful female demons in this domain, like Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, and Tang Zhiyao.
However, their beauty cannot surpass that of those four women, Prince."
"The four of them are indeed beautiful and sexy, and I wonder what their expressions would be like if they were under me in bed." Yan Tianling smiled lecherously as he imagined that.
"Unfortunately, they are demon gods, so I don’t dare approach them with my current cultivation."
"Have you contacted your father and told him about the four of them, Prince?" Yan Tianling’s male subordinate asked

"I’ve already told my father about the four of them, but he’s currently in a meeting with some demon gods, and he’ll come here as soon as he’s finished." Yan Tianling shifted his gaze to Zhang Fei, and he furrowed his brows because Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue were so familiar with him.
"Have any of you ever seen a nine-tailed lust demon?"
"We’ve never seen a nine-tailed lust demon, Prince," the three answered in unison.
"That man shouldn’t be a resident of this domain, and he probably came from another domain."
"That bastard must have come from another domain!" Yan Tianling narrowed his eyes.
"I’ve wanted Mo Cangyue for a long time, but she rejected me too many times, yet she was so close to that male lust demon."
The three demons exchanged glances without saying anything, as they had long known about Yan Tianling’s obsession with Mo Cangyue.
They also knew that she never liked men, and she rejected him repeatedly because of that.
"Let’s wait for my father to come here; I’m sure he can capture them easily." A gleam of cruelty flashed across Yan Tianling’s eyes.
"Do you two want to have that male lust demon?"
The two female demons laughed.
"Prince, that male lust demon is quite handsome, so we won’t refuse if you want to give him to us."
"Alright," Yan Tianling nodded.
"After my father captures them, I’ll give that male lust demon to you two, and you can enjoy your time with him."
"Thank you, Prince."

chapters.title: Chapter 1774: Gu Yanshu’s Idea
paragraphs: Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe were eager to kill demons in the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon. After all, those demons would revive shortly after their deaths, so the four women didn’t hold back.

Unlike the four female demon gods, Zhang Fei was more relaxed, and he let the two female sword spirits control the Demon Extermination Sword to slaughter the demons, so he only needed to collect the items that appeared after their deaths. "Somehow, I feel that this dungeon is more similar to games on Earth."
[I don’t have information about how the ancients of the other races created the Samsara Binding Formation, but I think all the demons in the dungeon are beneficial to you, Master.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei. The dungeon stored many demon items, especially the materials for upgrading demon ranks. He devised several plans for the materials, considering giving them to his demon acquaintances to upgrade their demon ranks.

[If you give them those demon materials, they might become stronger than your other acquaintances in the future, Master. Currently, they submit to you because you are stronger than them, but that might change if their demon ranks break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks.]

Naturally, Zhang Fei had considered that possibility, but he wasn’t too worried about them, and he would kill them as soon as they showed signs of betraying him. For him, they were friends and supporters, but he would never spare anyone if they thought of betraying him. "It’s time for me to take Oz the second and the others to the Paradise Realm, and I will leave them in the Endless Domain. As for Mo Tianshen and Morgana, I will take them both to this domain, so they can cultivate faster by using the demon qi here."

[I think that would be a waste of time, Master. Rather than you sending them to the Endless Domain in the Paradise Realm, I think you should send them to this domain directly. Most of them are not demon cultivators, and the demon aura in this domain is much more beneficial to them.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked at the Demon Extermination Sword, stretched his hand forward, and sucked the sword back into his hand. "Let’s do it, Hei’an."
Jian Hei’an came out of the sword after Zhang Fei summoned her, surprising Mo Cangyue, who had been paying attention to him the entire time. "Are you going to make a move, Master?"
"What master? Call me husband!" Zhang Fei chided playfully.
"Hehe," Jian Hei’an giggled. "Shall we move now, husband?"
"Good wife!" Zhang Fei leapt forward and swung his sword horizontally. "First move: Severing Slash!"
Mo Cangyue’s jaws dropped as huge sword qi shot out from Zhang Fei’s sword, slicing through all the demons in its path.

Zhang Fei sucked up all the items that appeared on the ground, and he moved to attack the other demons after that. Fortunately, the first floor of the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon was quite spacious, so his actions didn’t disturb Qi Qingxiu and the others.
"First move: Severing Slash!"
"Seventh move! Heaven Break!"

"Do you understand now, Sister Cangyue?" Mo Cangyue turned to Yuan Xiajie. "Zhang Fei is no ordinary cultivator, and he holds many titles under his belt, such as the god-rank swordmaster, the alchemy god, and several others. The sword techniques he uses just now are not his ultimate sword techniques, but he can kill all these demons with a single slash. If he uses his ultimate sword techniques, we will both die in his hands."
"Have you ever witnessed his ultimate sword techniques before?"

"He used two ultimate sword techniques in our last fight, and I was resigned to dying then. However, he canceled his techniques; otherwise, we would never have met again." Yuan Xiajie touched Mo Cangyue’s forehead, sharing her memories of when Zhang Fei used the Ashen Bloom and the Sever the Heavenly Path. "You can see for yourself both of his sword techniques, and you will understand his terror as a god-rank swordmaster."

Mo Cangyue nodded and looked at Yuan Xiajie’s memories. The appearance of the giant golden sword and the flurry of petals terrified her, even though she did not witness either of them directly. She opened her eyes and looked at Zhang Fei, who was enjoying himself in slaughtering those demons. "How did he achieve such great things at his young age?"

"Zhang Fei is different from other cultivators, and he is destined to achieve many things in life." Yuan Xiajie propped her chin with both hands. "Sister Cangyue, I know you have never liked men, but you have to build a good relationship with him and never become his enemy. Uncle Mo and Aunt Gu are powerful demon gods, but they are still not his opponents, especially with Feng Yao and Huo Ling by his side."

Mo Cangyue was a hot-headed woman, but she wasn’t stupid. After learning that Feng Yao was Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, she naturally didn’t dare underestimate Zhang Fei, let alone find trouble with him. "Let’s join him, Xiajie!"
"Hmm?" Yuan Xiajie was taken aback for a moment, but she immediately smiled and followed Mo Cangyue. ’Haha! Sister Cangyue is always on fire whenever she meets cultivators who are better than her.’

Yan Tianling’s face turned ugly as he watched the lust demon that he looked down on slaughter those demons. He wasn’t a swordmaster like him, but that didn’t mean he didn’t know anything about the sword path, and he could see that Zhang Fei’s sword techniques were extraordinary.

Yan Tianling’s three subordinates also reacted the same as him, but the two female demons behind him became more eager to get Zhang Fei, and they only needed to wait for Yan Washeng to come to the dungeon.

"Where exactly did that bastard come from? How could a lust demon like him reach such a high level in the sword path?" Yan Tianling’s gaze was drawn to the Demon Extermination Sword in Zhang Fei’s hand. "What kind of sword is that? Why do I feel a terrifying aura from it? Moreover, that sword can slice through the bodies of some demons like tofu, even though their bodies are much stronger than other demons."
"Do you want to get that sword, Prince?"

Yan Tianling turned to the male demon with a frown. "Can’t you sense the aura of that sword? That sword is no ordinary sword, and it was forged specifically for slaying demons. Even though that bastard’s cultivation is far below mine, I will die if I approach him while he is holding that sword, so I won’t do something that crazy."
"What if we contact the others and attack him together, Prince?"

"Naive!" Yan Tianling shouted, shaking his head. "Even my father doesn’t necessarily dare to approach that sword, let alone those people. Perhaps I should contact that crazy bastard, and he might be able to help me get rid of that sword."
"Who?"

"Gui Ya." Yan Tianling’s three subordinates were taken back for a moment when they heard that name. "That crazy bastard’s ghost summons are quite unique, so I’m sure he can get rid of that sword for me. Unfortunately, he’s still in seclusion right now, but he should be out soon, and I’ll contact him then. Sigh! Forget it! We have to focus on our initial goal, and we have to get as many of those materials as possible."
"Yes, Prince."
When Mo Qingwen returned to his royal chamber, he was stunned to see his wife’s new appearance, which looked much younger than before they parted a few hours ago.
Gu Yanshu smiled as she approached her husband. She walked around Mo Qingwen with a seductive look. "Do you like my changes, Husband?"

"I do." Mo Qingwen hugged his wife’s waist and kissed her. "How did you become so young? Your appearance now is no different from when we first met, and you look like you’ve never given birth before."
"Hehe," Gu Yanshu pulled her husband to sit on the bed. "My appearance became this young after I swallowed Zhang Fei’s two beauty pills."
Mo Qingwen raised an eyebrow. "Are that kid’s pills that effective? Does that mean he’s an alchemy god?"
"I found it hard to believe at first, but Zhang Fei is indeed an alchemy god, husband." Gu Yanshu leaned against her husband. "What do you think if we bring our daughter closer to him?"
Mo Qingwen was shocked by his wife’s idea. "What exactly are you planning? You know that our daughter has never liked any men, and she prefers women."

"I know." Gu Yanshu nodded. "Our daughter has never liked men, but her sexual orientation might change once she gets to know Zhang Fei better. Besides, he’s no ordinary lust demon, and all the women by his side are much better than our daughter’s, so I think he’s the best choice to be her husband."

"Tell me more about him." Gu Yanshu recounted her conversation with Hua Qianmei and her meeting with Zhang Fei to her husband, which shocked Mo Qingwen. "I didn’t expect that Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation had already returned to this realm, and she was one of his wives. Moreover, he could defeat the avatars of both primordial beasts, and he could also kill those creatures, which means his strength is much higher than I previously thought. Besides, he has four female demon gods as his wives, which is really unbelievable."
"That’s right." Gu Yanshu nodded. "That’s why I thought of drawing Zhang Fei to our side, and we could use our daughter for that."

Mo Qingwen shook his head. "Wife, I want our daughter to choose her own path in life, so I will never use her for that kind of purpose. Besides, our daughter might not necessarily be attractive to Zhang Fei, especially with the presence of so many beautiful women by his side."

chapters.title: Chapter 1775: Enemies Appear
paragraphs: Since Mo Qingwen had already said so, Gu Yanshu didn’t press the issue and changed the subject. "What about those people? Who decided to side with Yan Washeng?"

"Gongsun Zhilan, Gui Ye, Chang Moyu, Zuo Hentian, and Hou Wuyan have decided to join Yan Washeng." Gu Yanshu was surprised to hear the last two names; she didn’t expect that they would join the enemy’s side. "Hou Wuyan hasn’t made a decision yet, but the other four have already decided to join that bastard."

Gu Yanshu nodded slightly. "I’m not surprised that Gongsun Zhilan chose to become our enemy, but I don’t understand the reason behind Huo Wuyan’s decision. He’s an ingrate because he became a demon god thanks to your help, but he chose to become your enemy after he achieved success."

"Forget it," Mo Qingwen sighed. "Even if the five of them join forces, I’m confident in defeating them, so you don’t need to worry too much about this matter. Did our daughter tell you anything else?"
"She wants to follow Zhang Fei to the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon, but I don’t know if they’ve arrived there yet."

Mo Qingwen nodded in understanding. "I want to go see Zhang Fei, but I won’t do it now; otherwise, he’ll get involved in trouble in our domain. After I take care of them, I’ll go see him at Hua Qianmei’s palace."
"Alright." Even though Zhang Fei had Feng Yao by his side, Gu Yanshu didn’t want him to get involved in the unrest in their domain.
In the Crimson Demon Palace.
Yan Washeng sat together with the other four demon gods, discussing several matters regarding Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu.

"I don’t need anything else, and I only want Mo Qingwen." Gongsun Zhilan looked at the others. "After we dethrone him, you guys can decide for yourselves who our next leader will be, and I don’t care about that."
"Hehehe," Gui Ye laughed eerily. "I don’t understand why you’re so obsessed with Mo Qingwen, Zhilan. All of us here are no less handsome and strong than him, but—"

"Do you think you’re handsome, dead ghost?" Gongsun Zhilan asked disdainfully. "Look at you! You don’t look like a living being or a ghost; only those dead ghosts think you’re handsome! As for strength, you can’t even defeat me, so you should stop dreaming of defeating Mo Qingwen."
"Humph!" Gui Ye snorted in response. ’Once we’re done with Mo Qingwen, I’ll kill you and absorb your demon essence!’
*Clap... Clap...*
"Hahaha," Chang Moyu laughed as he clapped his hands. "Old Ghost! You already know that Gongsun Zhilan has a venomous tongue, just like her title, so you’ll never win an argument with her!"
"Humph!" Gui Ye snorted again.
Chang Moyu looked at Yan Washeng, who seemed lost in his own thoughts. "What are you thinking, Old Yan?"

"Have you guys ever heard or seen a nine-tailed lust demon?" Gongsun Zhilan and the others looked at Yan Washeng with mocking and questioning looks. "My eldest son previously contacted me, and he told me that he met with a nine-tailed male lust demon in the dungeon. I know that a lust demon can modify every part of his body, but he was so sure that his tails were real. Besides, that male lust demon seems to have a good relationship with Mo Qingwen and Hua Qianmei, especially since Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue went with him to the dungeon."
The expressions of Gongsun Zhilan and the others changed after Yan Washeng mentioned the names Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue.

They knew that Mo Cangyue was a lily, and she had never wanted to be close to any man before, so the news was quite a shock to them. They knew that Yuan Xiajie was Hua Qianmei’s adopted sister, but she had been missing for quite some time, so they didn’t expect her to return so suddenly.

"Forget it." Gui Ye rose from his seat. "I don’t want to waste my time with those weak demons! Moreover, we don’t have any evidence regarding that nine-tailed lust demon yet, so I’ll return to my palace now."
"I’m going back to my palace, and you guys should contact me when it’s time for us to make a move on Mo Qingwen."
Without waiting for the others’ reply, Gui Ye and Chang Moyu disappeared from the place, leaving the other three behind."
"Do you want to join me and Old Zuo in the dungeon, Zhilan?" Yan Washeng asked.

Gongsun Zhilan tapped her slender fingers against the arm of her chair in thought. "I’m curious about that nine-tailed lust demon, but I still have other matters at hand, so I’ll wait for your information regarding him. "Are you that afraid of Hua Qianmei?"

Once you fall under her influence, you will never be able to extricate yourself, and you will be completely obedient to her."

"I agree with her, Old Zuo," Yan Washeng sighed. "Long ago, I tried to get close to Hua Qianmei, but I didn’t realize that I had already fallen under her abilities. By the time she freed me from her techniques, a hundred years had already passed, and I’ve been avoiding her ever since. Thus, you should never underestimate her; otherwise, you would suffer a fate like me."

"The only demon god who can counter Hua Qianmei’s abilities is the Dream Demon God, Tang Zhiyao. She can do that because she never uses her real body outside, so her abilities have no effect on her." After saying that, Gongsun Zhilan immediately stood up. "You two can go to the dungeon now, and I’ll return to my palace to take care of something."
After Gongsun Zhilan left, Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian also left the place, and they rushed towards the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon.
"Hey, Old Yan! You’re hiding something from them on purpose, right?"

"Hahaha," Yan Washeng laughed. "My eldest son told me that there were four female demons on that nine-tailed male lust demon’s side. He also said that they were much more beautiful and sexier than Hua Qianmei and Tang Zhiyao. If I had told you about those women earlier, Old Gui and Old Chang would have come with us. If that had happened, we would have had no choice but to share the four women with them."
"Are they really that pretty and sexy?" Zuo Hentian asked curiously.

Yan Washeng shrugged. "My eldest son is weak, but his taste in women’s affairs is unquestionable. Based on his statement, I believe that the four women are indeed beautiful and sexy. However, I’m still confused about their identities, especially since he told me that they are demon gods like the two of us."

"Hmm?" Zuo Hentian was surprised. "If your eldest son is correct, they should have come from other demon domains. However, it’s been a long time since any other demons have come to our domain, and they shouldn’t have been able to enter our barrier."
"That’s true." Yan Washeng realized something. "Could it be Yuan Xiajie who brought them to our domain? After all, they appeared at the same time, and they were together in the dungeon."
"Perhaps your guess is correct, Old Yan. Was Hua Qianmei with them in the dungeon?"
"No." Yan Washeng shook his head. "The four women went into the dungeon with that male lust demon, Yuan Xiajie, and Mo Cangyue."

Zuo Hentian nodded slightly. "Since Hua Qianmei isn’t in the dungeon with them, we might be able to capture the four women. We must also capture Mo Cangyue today, or our plans against Mo Qingwen will face further delays. However, Yuan Xiajie’s presence with them will bring other troubles for us, but I’m hesitant to do anything about her."
"We’ll think about that later, and we have to go to the dungeon quickly." Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian immediately increased their flying speed.
On the first floor of the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon, Huli Chenying and Xuanyuan Yue sat against the wall near the ceiling, with their eyes focused on Zhang Fei.

Huli Chenying and Xuanyuan Yue saw Zhang Fei create countless qi swords to kill the crowd of mindless demons there, forcing the other demons, including Yan Tianling and his three subordinates, to stay away from him.

Although Zhang Fei hadn’t activated the soul link, he had no difficulty killing the mindless demons because their strength was not much different from his. Besides, he also used his light and darkness elements together in his attacks, making it easier for him to kill them.
Huli Chenying propped her head on her knees. "Master, he managed to combine the two elements; even your father couldn’t do that when he was his age."

"That’s true." Xuanyuan Xue nodded in agreement. "According to Mother Xi, my father was quite slow to develop as a cultivator, and she had to constantly protect him at the beginning of his cultivation path. As for Zhang Fei, he had to rely on himself from the start, and he gained many allies after he went to the Sky Jade Realm. Although he had many allies, he did not depend on them, and he preferred to face his problems on his own."

"Hehe," Huli Chenying laughed. "When it comes to their wives, your father and Zhang Fei are quite similar, Master. They are both reluctant to let their wives fight, and they try hard to deal with all their problems on their own."

chapters.title: Chapter 1776: Waiting For The Enemies
paragraphs: Huli Chenying turned to her master. "Don’t you want to meet him face-to-face, Master?"
"Why are you so eager to meet him?" Xuanyuan Yue was amused by the female fox’s behavior. "Are you so aroused that you want to offer your body to him?"

"Hehe," Huli Chenying giggled and hugged her master’s arm in a spoiled manner. "Master, I’m getting too old, but I haven’t found a suitable mate for me. I feel that he is the most suitable mate for me, but I’m your contract beast, so I won’t go ahead of you."
Xuanyuan Yue facepalmed after hearing that. "Tch! If you want to hand over your body to him, you should go down there and meet him."
"How about we meet him together, Master?"
"Come on, Master! You should stop talking nonsense! I know for sure that you want to see him!"
Xuanyuan Yue shook her head, ignored Huli Chenying, and returned her gaze to Zhang Fei without saying anything.
Huli Chenying’s lips curled up, but she didn’t say anything else and focused on watching Zhang Fei kill those mindless demons. ’Sigh! My master is too timid and thinks too much!’
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was busy fighting some mindless demons using his qi swords, with the Demon Extermination Sword flying around and killing other targets.

In areas a little away from Zhang Fei, the four female demon gods were enjoying themselves killing those mindless demons. Even though they were demon gods, they had no regrets about killing the mindless demons, as they would revive again and again after a short period of time.
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe did not forget to collect demon materials lying on the ground because those items were their goal in entering the dungeon.

Yuan Xiajie wasn’t interested in killing those mindless demons, and she wanted to search for nine demon souls for the Nine Yin Soul Banner because Zhang Fei destroyed the previous nine. Unfortunately, she couldn’t do that in the dungeon due to the Samsara Binding Formation, which kept the mindless demons reviving in an endless cycle. ’Sigh! I have to ask my big sister for help to find nine new souls; otherwise, the banner will be no different from a junk item.’

At first, Mo Cangyue had no interest in killing those mindless demons, but Zhang Fei’s actions ignited her enthusiasm, and she killed those who stood in her way. She repeatedly stole glances at him, but he didn’t glance at her at all, and he was completely focused on killing them. ’Tch! He keeps looking down on me! I will prove to him that I am much better than him!’

The demons, who were also hunting for materials in the dungeon, recognized Mo Cangyue. However, they were confused when they saw her expression, as she looked furious and frustrated at the same time. None of them dared to approach her because her status far surpassed theirs, and they deliberately kept their distance from her as much as possible.

Yan Tianling and his three subordinates were still hunting for materials on the first floor, but they were annoyed because Zhang Fei’s attack area was too wide, which limited their movement. Furthermore, they could sense something unusual from his sword qi, but they couldn’t identify it because he combined his light and darkness elements.

Yan Tianling’s eyes lit up after he received a voice transmission from Yan Washeng, who told him that he and Zuo Hentian were on their way to the dungeon. "My father and Demon God Zuo will arrive here soon, and they will move against those four female demon gods."
"Then, what should we do, Prince?"
Yan Tianling glanced at Mo Cangyue. "Our job is to capture her, but we have to wait for my father and Demon God Zuo to arrive first because that male lust demon cannot be underestimated."
"What about Yuan Xiajie? Are we going to capture her too?"
Yan Tianling nodded. "We will capture her, but we can’t do anything to her; otherwise, we will incur Hua Qianmei’s wrath."

Yan Tianling’s three subordinates trembled as soon as he mentioned Hua Qianmei. Although the female demon god appeared gentle and amiable on the outside, she was extremely terrifying, and no one could escape the influence of her demon abilities.
Yan Tianling’s gaze became increasingly lustful as he stared at Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe. "Heh!"
*Slash... Slash...*
*Splurt... Splurt...*

After he killed those mindless demons, Zhang Fei sucked all the demon materials on the ground and stored them in his system inventory. Although he obtained many demon materials, the materials for concocting the Demon Soul Elixir were extremely difficult to obtain.

Zhang Fei glanced at Yan Tianling and his three subordinates, narrowing his eyes with a glint of killing intent. Although he had previously been focused on the mindless demons, he never stopped observing the four of them, and he listened to their conversation about Yan Washing and Zuo Hentian. "Since you guys can’t wait to die, I’ll grant your wish, but I’ll wait for the two demon gods to arrive first."
"What are you thinking about?" Yuan Xiajie asked.
"Them." Yuan Xiajie raised an eyebrow for a moment and followed Zhang Fei’s gaze. "Why are you looking at Yan Tianling and his three subordinates? Is there something wrong with them?"
Zhang Fei nodded. "Yan Tianling previously contacted his father, and Yan Washeng was on his way here with Zuo Hentian."
Since she had lived with Zhang Fei for some time and was familiar with the people around him, Yuan Xiajie didn’t doubt his words in the slightest.

Yuan Xiajie tilted her head to the side, and she could see the anger in Zhang Fei’s eyes, which meant Yan Tianling had planned something against him, or more specifically, the four female demon gods. "Do they intend to capture Qi Qingxiu and the others?"

"What else?" Zhang Fei shrugged. "Yan Tianling doesn’t dare to face me directly, yet he thought about laying his hands on them. Since Yan Washeng will come here for them, I will take care of the father and son at the same time."
After she saw Zhang Fei fight against the avatars of the two primordial beasts, Yuan Xiajie had no doubts that he could defeat Yan Washeng.
"Hey! What are you two talking about?" Yuan Xiajie turned to Mo Cangyue and explained the situation to her, causing her expression to turn ugly. "I will—"
"No need." Zhang Fei stopped her. "You don’t need to disturb your parents with this matter, and I will take care of Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian myself."

After seeing Zhang Fei’s abilities earlier, Mo Cangyue’s opinion of him changed slightly, and she no longer dared to underestimate him as before. Even so, she was worried about the situation because the two demon gods were powerful enough to put pressure on her father, and she wasn’t confident that he could fight them both at the same time. "Are you sure you want to fight for Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian?"

"You can see everything for yourself after Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian arrive here." Zhang Fei looked at her. "By the way, does your father have any problems with them? Your reaction just now makes me think they do, and it’s definitely not a simple problem."

Mo Cangyue sighed softly. "I’ve never been involved in politics, but my brother told me that Yan Washeng and several other demon gods wanted to overthrow my father. They didn’t dare to fight him one-on-one, so they decided to work together to achieve their ambitions."
"Do you know which demon gods decided to join Yan Washeng?"
"The Ghost Demon God Gui Ye, the Venomous Demon God Gongsun Zhilan, the Slaughter Demon God Zuo Hentian, and the Tempest Demon God Chang Moyu."

Zhang Fei had heard their names from Yuan Xiajie before, but he did not expect that the Venomous Demon God Gongsun Zhilan would join forces with Yan Washeng to fight Mo Qingwen, and he was sure there was a story behind her decision. "Did Gongsun Zhilan decide to join them because of romance?"

"Eh? Can you guess it?" Zhang Fei just smiled at Mo Cangyue. "Gongsun Zhilan fell in love with my father when they were young, but he disliked her character, and he chose my mother as his wife. Since then, that woman had hated my parents to her core, but she didn’t dare to do anything because my father was stronger than her. She was really stubborn and hateful, and she chose to join Yan Washeng because of it."

Zhang Fei wasn’t too surprised by that, as love often blinds everyone, and powerful demon gods were not spared. "I have no interest in interfering in the affairs of this domain, but I can’t stand idly by since Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian are planning to capture Qi Qingxiu and the others. Besides, they are also thinking about capturing you, and they want to use you to force your parents to surrender."
"I’m not surprised by that." Mo Cangyue sighed deeply. "Are you confident to face Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian?"
"Let’s wait for their arrival first."
Zhang Fei asked Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe to gather before explaining the situation to them.
Unlike Mo Cangyue, the four female demon gods completely trusted Zhang Fei because he had done many things they could never do in the Paradise Realm, and he had also kept their four demon races safe.

Mo Cangyue didn’t know where Zhang Fei’s confidence came from, as his cultivation was still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but she remembered that Feng Yao was one of his wives. Even so, she decided to contact her father and inform him of the matter.

"By the way, does your father have any problems with them?
Your reaction just now makes me think they do, and it’s definitely not a simple problem."
Mo Cangyue sighed softly.
"I’ve never been involved in politics, but my brother told me that Yan Washeng and several other demon gods wanted to overthrow my father.
They didn’t dare to fight him one-on-one, so they decided to work together to achieve their ambitions."
"Do you know which demon gods decided to join Yan Washeng?"
"The Ghost Demon God Gui Ye, the Venomous Demon God Gongsun Zhilan, the Slaughter Demon God Zuo Hentian, and the Tempest Demon God Chang Moyu."

Zhang Fei had heard their names from Yuan Xiajie before, but he did not expect that the Venomous Demon God Gongsun Zhilan would join forces with Yan Washeng to fight Mo Qingwen, and he was sure there was a story behind her decision.
"Did Gongsun Zhilan decide to join them because of romance?"
"Eh?
Can you guess it?" Zhang Fei just smiled at Mo Cangyue.
"Gongsun Zhilan fell in love with my father when they were young, but he disliked her character, and he chose my mother as his wife.
Since then, that woman had hated my parents to her core, but she didn’t dare to do anything because my father was stronger than her.
She was really stubborn and hateful, and she chose to join Yan Washeng because of it."
Zhang Fei wasn’t too surprised by that, as love often blinds everyone, and powerful demon gods were not spared.
"I have no interest in interfering in the affairs of this domain, but I can’t stand idly by since Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian are planning to capture Qi Qingxiu and the others.
Besides, they are also thinking about capturing you, and they want to use you to force your parents to surrender."
"I’m not surprised by that." Mo Cangyue sighed deeply.
"Are you confident to face Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian?"
"Let’s wait for their arrival first."
Zhang Fei asked Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe to gather before explaining the situation to them.
Unlike Mo Cangyue, the four female demon gods completely trusted Zhang Fei because he had done many things they could never do in the Paradise Realm, and he had also kept their four demon races safe.
Mo Cangyue didn’t know where Zhang Fei’s confidence came from, as his cultivation was still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but she remembered that Feng Yao was one of his wives.
Even so, she decided to contact her father and inform him of the matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1777: Move His Old Allies
paragraphs: "What happened, husband?" Gu Yanshu, who was lying naked beside her husband, asked.

Mo Qingwen momentarily frowned before telling his wife about Mo Cangyue’s voice message. "Our daughter met Yan Tianling in the dungeon. He informed Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian about Zhang Fei and the four female demon gods by his side."
"I see." Gu Yanshu immediately understood the situation. "Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian are on their way to the dungeon to capture our daughter and the four female demon gods, right?"

"Yes," Mo Qingwen nodded to his wife. "Zhang Fei told our daughter not to contact me, but she contacted me anyway because she wasn’t confident in her ability to deal with Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian."

"Zhang Fei is far more capable than our daughter thinks, and Hua Qianmei shares the same opinion as me, so I’m confident that he will be able to handle Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian on his own." Mo Qingwen looked at Gu Yanshu. "Besides, the other demon gods are still monitoring our movements, and I’m afraid they’ll act even more brazenly if you go there."
Mo Qingwen nodded in agreement. "Since Guang Zhiyi is one of Zhang Fei’s wives, and she lives by his side, she should be able to protect them."

"That’s right." Gu Yanshu pulled her husband to lie down beside her. "Don’t worry, everything will be fine, and this situation might even work out in our favor. If Zhang Fei kills Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian, he will reduce our enemies by two, and our tension will ease significantly."
Mu Qingwen hugged his wife. "If Zhang Fei manages to kill Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian, I’ll give him a token of my gratitude."
Gu Yanshu looked at her husband. "Do you want to give that thing to Zhang Fei? I don’t think he needs that item, and he needs demon materials to upgrade the demon ranks of all his wives."
"Demon materials." Mo Qingwen contacted someone and asked him to find several sets of demon materials for upgrading demon ranks. "I’ve already asked Mo Hanyin to look for them."
"That’s good." Gu Yanshu smiled to herself, mulling over some things in her mind. "Let’s continue, husband."
Mo Qingwen smiled amusedly, looking at his impatient wife. He didn’t refuse Gu Yanshu and continued their activities directly.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] was at the Celestial Dragon Palace, talking with Tianshi Bailong, Tianshi Lingyue, Long Xukong, and Long Lixuan about the four perils’ plans to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
"Is everything ready, Father-in-law?"

Tianshi Bailong nodded. "Since you informed me about the activities of the four perils a month ago, I have been preparing everything. Moreover, Brother Xukong is here now, so I’m confident that we will be able to fight them without Brother Wuzhao."

Tianshi Lingyue sighed. "Fortunately, you have Wu Mian on your side, son. If the faceless demon god hadn’t been monitoring the movements of the four perils, we would never have known about their plans to invade this domain, and it would have been too late if they had arrived."
"Have you contacted them, kid?" Long Xukong asked.

Zhang Fei [4] nodded slightly. "I have already spoken with Jia Leixuan, Lu Wangyi, Ju Jushen, and all the leaders of the natural races regarding this matter. They have agreed to help us, and I will bring them here when the four perils and their armies are about to arrive in this domain."
"Why don’t you take care of them yourself, Zhang Fei?" Long Lixuan curiously asked. "With your current strength and Senior Huo Ling’s help, you should be able to defeat them, right?"

Zhang Fei [4] smiled. "Senior Lixuan, I can ask Huo Ling to clean up the four pearls and their armies, but I have another goal. As I told you some time ago, I plan to move many people to the Ancient Realm in the future, and the cultivators there are far stronger than those in the Paradise Realm, so I want to use the four perils and their armies to test their readiness to go to that realm."
Tianshi Bailong, Tianshi Lingyue, Long Xukong, and Long Lixuan nodded in understanding.

Zhang Fei [4] continued. "Honestly, I want to help them directly, but I have to learn from past experiences. In the past, I did everything myself, and I never let any of my wives fight with our enemies, which left them with far less fighting experience."
"Does that mean you will allow them to fight in the future?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [4] nodded seriously. "On that day, I will bring all my wives to this domain, and they will join you guys to fight the four perils and their armies. Among them, only Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Yue Xuelian, Yue Qianrou, and Yue Ningxue have the strength to fight the four perils. As for my other wives, I ask them to fight their armies."
"What about those female demon gods?"

"They will not participate in that war, and they will focus on cultivating in the Myriad Abyss Domain. Besides, I need them to search for a lot of demon materials, and all of those items are difficult to obtain."
"Demon materials?"

"Demon materials to upgrade their demon ranks." Tianshi Bailong, Tianshi Lingyue, Long Xukong, and Long Lixuan didn’t know the details about the demon ranks, so Zhang Fei [4] explained it to them. "All my demon wives have reached the Empress Rank, but only a few of them have reached the Seven Supreme Demon Rank, so I want to focus on finding those demon materials first. If I take them to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley before that, I’m afraid they won’t be able to face the situation there."
The four dragons understood Zhang Fei’s intention, but then Long Xukong asked him, "How’s the situation in the Myriad Abyss Domain? Have you found any new women there?"
"Hey, Senior Xukong, do you think I’m a cheap man?" Zhang Fei [4] asked in a complaining tone.
Long Xukong raised both hands. "Isn’t that the truth? Otherwise, you wouldn’t have over a hundred wives, right?"

"I’m a healthy and strong young man, so it’s natural for me to have many wives, right?" The two male dragons cursed at Zhang Fei [4]’s shamelessness in their hearts, and the two female dragons laughed when they heard that. "I met a beautiful female demon god, but I didn’t have that kind of thought towards her, and my real body was focused on looking for demon materials in the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon. Unfortunately, I’ve already made quite a few enemies, even though I’ve only lived there two days."
"Enemies? Who are they?"

"The Crimson Demon God Yan Washeng and the Slaughter Demon God Zuo Hentian," Zhang Fei [4] sighed. "They are stronger than Mo Shentian and the four perils, and they intend to capture Qi Qingxiu and the others."
"Beauty always brings trouble everywhere." Tianshi Lingyue said with a shake of her head.
"Hehe," Long Lixuan chuckled. "Are you remembering the past, Lingyue?"
Tianshi Lingyue nodded. "At that time, I hadn’t married my husband yet, and my beauty always brought trouble wherever I went."

Zhang Fei [4] smiled amusedly after hearing that, but he had to admit that his mother-in-law was a natural beauty, and Tianshi Shengjie inherited her mother’s beauty. "I still have other things to do, so I have to go now."

Tianshi Bailong let out a soft sigh after Zhang Fei [4] left. "Somehow, I feel useless as a senior, Brother Xukong. That kid is much younger than my daughter, but he has already done many things that I can’t."

"I understand how you feel, Brother Bailong," Long Xukong said with a bitter smile. "I previously traveled with that kid for several months, and I witnessed some of his actions firsthand, including his battles with those creatures and Yuan Xiajie. Even if I don’t want to admit it, I still have to admit that he is much better than us, and we need his help to achieve a better future."
Listening to their two husbands’ words, Tianshi Lingyue and Long Lixuan exchanged glances for a moment, and they immediately left them.
Zhang Fei [4] had already arrived at the mountain in the Endless Domain to meet Mo Tianshen and Morgana.
"Why did you suddenly come here?"

"I’ll send you two to a demon domain in the Ancient Realm, and you can cultivate faster there." Mo Tianshen and Morgana were momentarily surprised to hear this news. "The demon qi in the Myriad Abyss Domain is much stronger than in this domain, and a friend lent me a special place there. One of my clones and all my demon wives have started cultivating there, so I will send you two there, and you can cultivate without interruption there."
Mo Tianshen and Morgana looked and nodded to each other. "Alright, we accept your offer."
"Good!" After he sent them into the Yin-Yang Space, Zhang Fei [4] opened the gate to the Demon Purgatory Realm, which was Wang Yin’s old base in the Three Mortal Realms.

In that realm, Zhang Fei [4] went to meet Oz the Second, Virgil, Tharnon, and the demons who used to live in the Diyu Realm. Several decades had passed for him, but only a month and a half had passed for them.
They were truly surprised to see Zhang Fei [4]’s change, and he had become much more mature than their last meeting. He didn’t say much to them and offered to move them to the Myriad Abyss Domain.

They were initially hesitant about it, but they eventually agreed after Zhang Fei [4] told them that the Myriad Abyss Domain was a demon domain. They didn’t need much preparation to move, and he sent them to the domain once their preparations were complete.

chapters.title: Chapter 1778: Enemies Arrival
paragraphs: After bringing all the demons from the Demon Purgatory Realm to that secret place in the Myriad Abyss Domain to cultivate, Zhang Fei [5] went to Hua Qianmei’s palace to meet the female demon god.

Hua Qianmei had no objections to Zhang Fei [5]’s wish, as no one had used the place since her master died. "Do you need my help dealing with Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian? Compared to the former, the latter is much stronger, and you might have a hard time fighting him."
"Is Zuo Hentian stronger than Asura Demon God?"

"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5]’s question surprised Hua Qianmei. "Have you ever met the Asura Demon God in the Paradise Realm? Actually, there used to be the Asura Demon Race in this domain during my master’s era, but their demon god decided to move his race members to another domain, and they have lived there since then."

Zhang Fei [5] was not too surprised to hear about the Asura Demon Race from the Ancient Realm, but he had no interest in meeting them, and he was more focused on the demon gods in the Myriad Abyss Domain.
"If you compare the strength of the Slaughter Demon God and the Asura Demon God, the latter is far stronger than the former, especially if he uses his strengthening technique."

"I’ve met the Asura Demon God in the Paradise Realm, but I’ve never fought him. I’ve fought his sister and his four asura guardians, and I have to admit that they’re strong." Hua Qianmei felt awkward when she noticed Zhang Fei [5] observing her body. "Since Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian wanted to capture my mother-in-law and three wives, I plan to kill them. Before I do that, I want to know whether their deaths will bring significant chaos to this domain or not."

Hua Qianmei could understand Zhang Fei [5]’s worries. "They are demon gods, so their deaths will cause significant chaos in this domain. However, you don’t need to worry about that, and I’m sure that Mo Qingwen has already prepared a plan to stabilize the situation."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.

Hua Qianmei looked at Zhang Fei [5] in thought for a while. "If you kill Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian, you must be prepared to face Gongsun Zhilan, Gui Ye, Chang Moyu, and Hou Wuyan. After all, they are allied to take down Mo Qingwen, and they will hunt you down if they know that both of them died by your hands."

"If they come to kill me, I can kill them too, right?" Zhang Fei [5]’s answer left Hua Qianmei smiling bitterly. "I don’t want to have problems with anyone, but I will never hesitate to kill anyone who targets my women. Besides, I’m thinking about setting up my base here, so I’m thinking about taking over their two cities."

Hua Qianmei was speechless in response to Zhang Fei [5]. "If you take over those two cities, you will face more enemies, and the situation in this domain will become too chaotic if you kill them. My suggestion is that you forget about those two cities, and you can bring your people to settle down in my city. Although my city is not as big as the others, the situation here is much more stable, and they can live safely."
"I think you’re right," Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "In that case, I will depend on you from now on, and I hope you are willing to protect my people."
Hua Qianmei’s lips curled up. "I will protect your people, but you also have to help me, so our relationship will work both ways."
"Do you want me to be your bed warmer?" Zhang Fei [5] pretended to be surprised.

"Tch! Who wants you to be my bed warmer?" Hua Qianmei’s expression betrayed her own words. "Cough! What I mean is you have to help me with your pills! You gave Little Xiajie some other pills, including your basic pills, right?"

"Oh." Zhang Fei [5] took out two pill bottles and threw them to Hua Qianmei. "There are several other pills in those two bottles, such as healing pills, qi recovery pills, core refining pills, yin purifying pills, and several other types of pills."
"Yin Purifying Pill?"

Zhang Fei[5] nodded. "The yin purifying pill will make the Yin Qi produced by the body two times purer. Actually, the pill is more useful for cultivators with cultivation below the Celestial God Realm, but it doesn’t matter if you swallow it too. Do you want other items?"
"You suddenly became so generous, huh?" Hua Qianmei teased him.
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Actually, I have always been generous towards those who choose to be on my side."
"What other items do you have?"
"Er? My yang qi?" Hua Qianmei was momentarily stunned as she stared at Zhang Fei. "My yang qi is much more valuable than my pills, you know?"
Hua Qianmei rolled her eyes, but she was also curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s yang qi. "Give me a bottle."
"Are you sure?"
"I’m sure."
Zhang Fei [5] took a bottle of his yang qi and handed it to her. "Try it."

Hua Qianmei was embarrassed to drink Zhang Fei [5]’s yang qi in front of him, but she quickly put aside her embarrassment and drank it directly. "Hmm? Your cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but your yang qi is much stronger than your cultivation level, and I can sense many things within it."

"After all, I’m a lust demon, a calamity demon dragon, and a heavenly fox. I’ve also mastered several things, so my yang qi is stronger than it should be." Zhang Fei [5] gave Hua Qianmei several more bottles of yang qi. "I won’t bother you anymore, so I’ll go back to that place, and you can use my pills now."
Hua Qianmei sighed softly after Zhang Fei [5] left. She opened one of the bottles, pouring his basic pills into her hand.

"An alchemy god like him is indeed different; even his basic pills are superior-grade ones." Thereafter, Hua Qianmei began to swallow the pills one by one, according to the notes Zhang Fei [5] left on the bottle. "With the help of these pills, I will become stronger in the future."
After waiting for quite a long time, Huli Chenying’s fox ears twitched a few times. "Master, the two demon gods are almost here in this dungeon."

"Yes," Xuanyuan Yue’s gaze never left Zhang Fei’s figure, and her lips curled into a smile. "Wherever he goes, his presence always attracts trouble, and those foolish demon gods will be his next victims."

"Haha," Huli Chenying laughed. "In this matter, your father and Zhang Fei are polar opposites, Master. When your father was not as strong as he is now, he spent more time in his sect or residence, and his enemies were not as many as this kid. This kid always went here and there, and he always met new enemies every time he went to a new place."

Xuanyuan Yue agreed with her contract beast. From the time she was born, her father spent more time at their residence with all his wives, and he rarely went to other realms. "If my father acted like Zhang Fei, the cultivators who died in our universe would be countless."
"That’s true." Hui Chenying smiled faintly as she recalled past incidents. "In the past, your father sent my sisters to other realms several times, and he ordered them to destroy too many clans."

Xuanyuan Yue looked towards the dungeon entrance, where she saw Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian walking down side by side. "Here they come! They look so arrogant, but they still don’t realize that death awaits them here."
"Which of them will die first, Master?"
"Who else but Yan Tianling? Zhang Fei has been targeting him ever since he contacted his father, so he will be the first victim to fall."
"Let’s watch them."
"Father! Uncle Zuo!" Yan Tianling hurriedly approached Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian, followed by his three subordinates.
"Where are those women?" Yan Washeng asked.
"There." Yan Tianling pointed to where Zhang Fei and the women were resting. "Are those four women really demon gods, Father?"

Yan Washeng looked in that direction before nodding to his son. "They are indeed demon gods like me and Old Zuo! However, I can sense that they are weaker than us, so I’m sure they reached that stage not long ago."
Unfortunately, Yan Washeng’s guess was wrong because he didn’t know that Qi Qingxiu and the three female gods were not natives of the Ancient Realm but the Paradise Realm.
Yan Washeng turned to Zuo Hentian. "That male demon is really a nine-tailed lust demon, Old Zuo."
"Yes," Zuo Hentian nodded as he observed Zhang Fei from afar. "Old Yan, for some reason I have a bad feeling, and the source is that male demon."
"Hmm?" Yan Washeng raised an eyebrow. "Are you afraid of that male demon, Old Zuo? His cultivation is only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, so it won’t be difficult for us to kill him."
Naturally, Zuo Hentian was aware of this, but something inside him urged him to leave the dungeon as soon as possible.
"If you’re afraid of that male demon, you should return to your palace, and I’ll deal with him myself," Yan Washeng said mockingly as he led his son toward Zhang Fei and the others.

Zuo Hentian didn’t like Yan Washeng’s words, and he also coveted those female demon gods, but he had a feeling that he would regret it if he approached them. After thinking it over, he turned around and hurriedly left the dungeon. "I hope you won’t regret your choice, Old Yan."

sentences.text: After bringing all the demons from the Demon Purgatory Realm to that secret place in the Myriad Abyss Domain to cultivate, Zhang Fei [5] went to Hua Qianmei’s palace to meet the female demon god.
Hua Qianmei had no objections to Zhang Fei [5]’s wish, as no one had used the place since her master died.
"Do you need my help dealing with Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian?
Compared to the former, the latter is much stronger, and you might have a hard time fighting him."
"Is Zuo Hentian stronger than Asura Demon God?"
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5]’s question surprised Hua Qianmei.
"Have you ever met the Asura Demon God in the Paradise Realm?
Actually, there used to be the Asura Demon Race in this domain during my master’s era, but their demon god decided to move his race members to another domain, and they have lived there since then."

Zhang Fei [5] was not too surprised to hear about the Asura Demon Race from the Ancient Realm, but he had no interest in meeting them, and he was more focused on the demon gods in the Myriad Abyss Domain.
"If you compare the strength of the Slaughter Demon God and the Asura Demon God, the latter is far stronger than the former, especially if he uses his strengthening technique."
"I’ve met the Asura Demon God in the Paradise Realm, but I’ve never fought him.
I’ve fought his sister and his four asura guardians, and I have to admit that they’re strong." Hua Qianmei felt awkward when she noticed Zhang Fei [5] observing her body.
"Since Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian wanted to capture my mother-in-law and three wives, I plan to kill them.
Before I do that, I want to know whether their deaths will bring significant chaos to this domain or not."
Hua Qianmei could understand Zhang Fei [5]’s worries.
"They are demon gods, so their deaths will cause significant chaos in this domain.
However, you don’t need to worry about that, and I’m sure that Mo Qingwen has already prepared a plan to stabilize the situation."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
Hua Qianmei looked at Zhang Fei [5] in thought for a while.
"If you kill Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian, you must be prepared to face Gongsun Zhilan, Gui Ye, Chang Moyu, and Hou Wuyan.
After all, they are allied to take down Mo Qingwen, and they will hunt you down if they know that both of them died by your hands."
"If they come to kill me, I can kill them too, right?" Zhang Fei [5]’s answer left Hua Qianmei smiling bitterly.
"I don’t want to have problems with anyone, but I will never hesitate to kill anyone who targets my women.
Besides, I’m thinking about setting up my base here, so I’m thinking about taking over their two cities."
Hua Qianmei was speechless in response to Zhang Fei [5].
"If you take over those two cities, you will face more enemies, and the situation in this domain will become too chaotic if you kill them.
My suggestion is that you forget about those two cities, and you can bring your people to settle down in my city.
Although my city is not as big as the others, the situation here is much more stable, and they can live safely."
"I think you’re right," Zhang Fei [5] sighed.
"In that case, I will depend on you from now on, and I hope you are willing to protect my people."
Hua Qianmei’s lips curled up.
"I will protect your people, but you also have to help me, so our relationship will work both ways."
"Do you want me to be your bed warmer?" Zhang Fei [5] pretended to be surprised.
"Tch!
Who wants you to be my bed warmer?" Hua Qianmei’s expression betrayed her own words.
"Cough!
What I mean is you have to help me with your pills!
You gave Little Xiajie some other pills, including your basic pills, right?"
"Oh." Zhang Fei [5] took out two pill bottles and threw them to Hua Qianmei.
"There are several other pills in those two bottles, such as healing pills, qi recovery pills, core refining pills, yin purifying pills, and several other types of pills."
"Yin Purifying Pill?"
Zhang Fei[5] nodded.
"The yin purifying pill will make the Yin Qi produced by the body two times purer.
Actually, the pill is more useful for cultivators with cultivation below the Celestial God Realm, but it doesn’t matter if you swallow it too.
Do you want other items?"
"You suddenly became so generous, huh?" Hua Qianmei teased him.
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed.
"Actually, I have always been generous towards those who choose to be on my side."
"What other items do you have?"
"Er?
My yang qi?" Hua Qianmei was momentarily stunned as she stared at Zhang Fei.
"My yang qi is much more valuable than my pills, you know?"
Hua Qianmei rolled her eyes, but she was also curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s yang qi.
"Give me a bottle."
"Are you sure?"
"I’m sure."
Zhang Fei [5] took a bottle of his yang qi and handed it to her.
"Try it."
Hua Qianmei was embarrassed to drink Zhang Fei [5]’s yang qi in front of him, but she quickly put aside her embarrassment and drank it directly.
"Hmm?
Your cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but your yang qi is much stronger than your cultivation level, and I can sense many things within it."
"After all, I’m a lust demon, a calamity demon dragon, and a heavenly fox.
I’ve also mastered several things, so my yang qi is stronger than it should be." Zhang Fei [5] gave Hua Qianmei several more bottles of yang qi.
"I won’t bother you anymore, so I’ll go back to that place, and you can use my pills now."
Hua Qianmei sighed softly after Zhang Fei [5] left.
She opened one of the bottles, pouring his basic pills into her hand.

"An alchemy god like him is indeed different; even his basic pills are superior-grade ones." Thereafter, Hua Qianmei began to swallow the pills one by one, according to the notes Zhang Fei [5] left on the bottle.
"With the help of these pills, I will become stronger in the future."
After waiting for quite a long time, Huli Chenying’s fox ears twitched a few times.
"Master, the two demon gods are almost here in this dungeon."
"Yes," Xuanyuan Yue’s gaze never left Zhang Fei’s figure, and her lips curled into a smile.
"Wherever he goes, his presence always attracts trouble, and those foolish demon gods will be his next victims."
"Haha," Huli Chenying laughed.
"In this matter, your father and Zhang Fei are polar opposites, Master.
When your father was not as strong as he is now, he spent more time in his sect or residence, and his enemies were not as many as this kid.
This kid always went here and there, and he always met new enemies every time he went to a new place."
Xuanyuan Yue agreed with her contract beast.
From the time she was born, her father spent more time at their residence with all his wives, and he rarely went to other realms.
"If my father acted like Zhang Fei, the cultivators who died in our universe would be countless."
"That’s true." Hui Chenying smiled faintly as she recalled past incidents.
"In the past, your father sent my sisters to other realms several times, and he ordered them to destroy too many clans."
Xuanyuan Yue looked towards the dungeon entrance, where she saw Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian walking down side by side.
"Here they come!
They look so arrogant, but they still don’t realize that death awaits them here."
"Which of them will die first, Master?"
"Who else but Yan Tianling?
Zhang Fei has been targeting him ever since he contacted his father, so he will be the first victim to fall."
"Let’s watch them."
"Father!
Uncle Zuo!" Yan Tianling hurriedly approached Yan Washeng and Zuo Hentian, followed by his three subordinates.
"Where are those women?" Yan Washeng asked.
"There." Yan Tianling pointed to where Zhang Fei and the women were resting.
"Are those four women really demon gods, Father?"
Yan Washeng looked in that direction before nodding to his son.
"They are indeed demon gods like me and Old Zuo!
However, I can sense that they are weaker than us, so I’m sure they reached that stage not long ago."
Unfortunately, Yan Washeng’s guess was wrong because he didn’t know that Qi Qingxiu and the three female gods were not natives of the Ancient Realm but the Paradise Realm.
Yan Washeng turned to Zuo Hentian.
"That male demon is really a nine-tailed lust demon, Old Zuo."
"Yes," Zuo Hentian nodded as he observed Zhang Fei from afar.
"Old Yan, for some reason I have a bad feeling, and the source is that male demon."
"Hmm?" Yan Washeng raised an eyebrow.
"Are you afraid of that male demon, Old Zuo?
His cultivation is only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, so it won’t be difficult for us to kill him."
Naturally, Zuo Hentian was aware of this, but something inside him urged him to leave the dungeon as soon as possible.
"If you’re afraid of that male demon, you should return to your palace, and I’ll deal with him myself," Yan Washeng said mockingly as he led his son toward Zhang Fei and the others.
Zuo Hentian didn’t like Yan Washeng’s words, and he also coveted those female demon gods, but he had a feeling that he would regret it if he approached them.
After thinking it over, he turned around and hurriedly left the dungeon.
"I hope you won’t regret your choice, Old Yan."

chapters.title: Chapter 1779: Yan Washeng’s Offer
paragraphs: Yan Washeng’s overbearing demon god aura forced all the demons present on the first floor of the dungeon to move to the edge, whether they were normal or mindless ones.

Walking behind his father, Yan Tianling’s gaze focused on Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, Nalan Shizhe, and Mo Cangyue. He also had an interest in Yuan Xiajie, but he didn’t dare look at her, mainly because of her relationship with Hua Qianmei.

Yan Tianling’s three subordinates also looked at them, but the male demon didn’t dare to look at Qi Qingxiu and the others for too long. However, the two female demons continued to stare at Zhang Fei, occasionally licking their lips.
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe noticed Yan Tianling’s lustful gaze at them. They snorted disdainfully, feeling no fear towards Yan Washeng or Yan Tianling.

Yuan Xiajie also felt no fear towards Yan Washeng or Yan Tianling; she had protection that she never showed to others, and Hua Qianmei would appear if they attacked her. She looked at Zhang Fei, who continued to act nonchalantly while ignoring the male demon god. Even though he didn’t say anything, she knew that he was ready to face them, and they would probably die by his hands.

Unlike them, Mo Cangyue was extremely anxious because of Yan Washeng’s presence. She didn’t fear Yan Tianling; however, his father was a demon god who was on the same level as her own father. Moreover, her father had already said he wouldn’t come, and he asked her to trust Zhang Fei’s abilities. ’Tch! Father, you’ve never met him or seen him fight, yet you’re asking me to trust his abilities.’

As he walked towards them, Yan Washeng looked at the four female demon gods one by one, but the one who caught his attention the most was Dong Xuanyin because she was still a virgin. Even so, he had to admit the beauty of Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe. There were three female demon gods in the Myriad Abyss Domain, but he felt that their beauty was inferior to the three women in front of him.
Yan Washeng raised an eyebrow as he arrived before them, as Zhang Fei didn’t spare a single glance at him, nor did he feel pressured by his presence.
Yan Tianling wanted to say something to Zhang Fei, but Yan Washeng stopped him and signaled him to be patient.

Yan Washeng looked at Zhang Fei, who still didn’t look at him. At first, he thought that the young lust demon in front of him was afraid of him, but he was mistaken because he didn’t see any fear on his face; instead, he looked composed. "A nine-tailed lust demon, I’ve never seen one like you since I was born, kid. Besides, all demons will cower in fear and run away once they see me, but you look indifferent in front of me."
"Do I need to be afraid of you?" Zhang Fei asked, looking at Yan Washeng with a bone-chilling gaze. "They may fear you, but you are no different from an ordinary demon in my eyes."

’Damn it, Zhang Fei!’ Mo Cangyue cursed in her heart, but she noticed that Qi Qingxiu and the others were still as calm as ever, without the slightest fear on their expressions. ’Do they trust him that much?’
The faces of Yan Tianling and his three subordinates twisted with anger, as they did not expect that Zhang Fei would speak to Yan Washeng like that. "You—"

"Silence." Yan Washeng’s eyes met Zhang Fei’s eyes as he tried to probe him. As a demon god, his existence was greatly feared in the Myriad Abyss Domain and in other domains, and this encounter was the first time he met a fearless young demon. "How about you join me? You just have to say the word, and I will fulfill all your requests."

Mo Cangyue’s heart tightened; she was worried that Zhang Fei would be tempted by Yan Washeng’s offer. She stole a glance at Yuan Xiajie and the four female demon gods, but their expressions showed no emotion, which confused her.
Noticing the worry on Mo Cangyue’s pale face, Yuan Xiajie grabbed her hand and rubbed it, signaling her to stay calm.
"Join you?" Zhang Fei’s lips curled up into a sinister smile. "Are you really going to fulfill any request I make if I join you?"
"Anything."
Zhang Fei rose to his feet and looked at Yan Washeng. "What if I ask for your and your son’s lives? Will you fulfill my request?"

"Insolence!" Yan Tianling shouted in rage and prepared to attack Zhang Fei, but Yan Washeng stopped him once again. "Father! You can’t let him treat you like this! You’ve already given him a good offer, but he’s asking for a ridiculous request!"
"Shut up." Yan Washeng and Zhang Fei looked at each other. "Are you really unwilling to accept my good will?"
"Good will?" Zhang Fei smirked. "Does a traitorous demon god like you have good will? I’ve heard a few things about your relationship with Mo Qingwen, so I know quite a bit about you."
Yan Washeng glanced at Mo Cangyue, who was sitting behind Yuan Xiajie with her head lowered. Even though it was subtle, he could still see that her body was trembling in fear.
Yan Washeng looked at Zhang Fei again. "Since you’re so ungrateful, then don’t blame me for acting against you."
"Hey! Are you done talking? I’ve met many demon gods, but you’re the most talkative among them." Zhang Fei spoke calmly; his gaze was firm and did not waver.
"Very well." Yan Washeng unleashed his demon aura to suppress Zhang Fei and the six female demons, but something he didn’t expect happened, and his demon aura disappeared on its own. "What—Gah!"
Yan Tianling was shocked when Yan Washeng was sent flying backwards. Before he could react, he heard the screams of his three subordinates, and their blood spurted out, drenching his body.
"Argh!" Yan Tianling screamed in pain as the black sword pierced through his body from behind, and a powerful demon aura pressed against him, causing him to fall on his knees.

Behind Yuan Xiajie, Mo Cangyue stared at Zhang Fei’s back with her mouth wide open in an O shape. She had heard stories about him fighting the avatars of the primordial beasts, but his actions just now were beyond her imagination. He sent Yan Washeng flying backwards, killed the three demons, and captured Yan Tianling in seconds. ’He... he’s really amazing! He was decisive in his actions!’
Yuan Xiajie glanced at Mo Cangyue with a look that said ’told you, right?’
Yan Washeng, who had just stabilized himself, looked at Zhang Fei in shock. The young lust demon suppressed his son with his sword, piercing his chest. "Let go of my son!"
"Hehe," Zhang Fei snickered. "Hey! Are you an idiot? Are you still unaware of your stupidity? I dispelled your demon aura, and I attacked you without you realizing it."

Yan Washeng frowned as he realized this. He was utterly shocked when Zhang Fei dispelled his demonic aura, and he couldn’t see his movements just now. Moreover, his punch just now was incredibly painful, making him realize that his strength was equal to or even superior to his.

Yan Washeng tried to check Zhang Fei’s cultivation, but the results shocked him because it was also at the Celestial God Realm, which meant he was using a strengthening technique to increase his cultivation.
Yan Washeng took a deep breath. "Release my son, or you will pay dearly for the consequences."
"Consequences? Do you think I’m afraid of the consequences?" Zhang Fei asked calmly.
"You may not be afraid of the consequences, but—" Yan Washeng pointed to Qi Qingxiu and the three female demon gods. "But can you bear to watch your four wives die?"
"Haha!" Zhang Fei laughed, turning his head to them. "Are you guys afraid of death?"

Qi Qingxiu nonchalantly shrugged. "The foolish demon god is indeed stronger than me, but he is far inferior to Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, right, husband? Since I don’t fear them, I don’t need to fear him either."
"You’re here with us, so we’re not afraid of him, husband." Ye Mingran said with a relaxed smile.
Nalan Shizhe looked at Yan Washeng. "Compared to that demon god, I’m more afraid of you, son."
"Just kill his son, husband. I don’t like the way he looks at me lustfully, so I want him dead." Dong Xuanyin said casually.
"Hahaha," Yuan Xiajie laughed. "If I hadn’t seen you fighting Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi before, I might have been afraid of our current situation."
Mo Cangyue looked at Zhang Fei. "I believe you will get us out of this place safely."

"Didn’t you doubt my abilities before, Princess Lily? You even contacted your parents and asked them to save us." Mo Cangyue choked at Zhang Fei’s teasing. He looked at Yan Washeng again. "You heard their words yourself, right? None of them are afraid of the consequences! Honestly, I’m a peace-loving demon, and I don’t like having problems with anyone. However, your son has made a fatal mistake by coveting my women, so he must face the consequences."
"Save me, Father! I—Ahh!" Once again, Yan Tianling wailed aloud in pain as soon as Zhang Fei gouged out both his eyes. "Argh!"
"Bastard! I’ll kill you!" Yan Washeng roared and flew towards them at high speed, but his speed was far below Zhang Fei’s.

Zhang Fei enveloped Yuan Xiajie, Mo Cangyue, and Yan Tianling with his aura, transporting them away from their original location. He was not worried about Qi Qingxiu and the three female demon gods because they had been training for decades in his training space, and they had already adapted to the level nine gravity feature.
