chapters.title: Chapter 1780: Killing Yan Tianling
paragraphs: *Boom*
A huge explosion erupted, and Yan Washeng stood in the center of the crater. However, his attack was ineffective because Zhang Fei and the others had already moved to another area.
Yan Washeng looked at Zhang Fei and the others, wondering how they could move so quickly.
"Father! Save me!" Yan Tianling screamed desperately, blood continuously pouring out of his eye sockets, and his body trembling uncontrollably.

"Tsk... Tsk..." Zhang Fei pressed his sword against Yan Tianling’s back. "Such a stupid and cowardly prince! You can’t even do anything without your father, but you dare to covet my wives. Do you think all my wives are cheap public commodities?"
"Spare... spare me... please let me live!" Yan Tianling begged Zhang Fei fearfully.

"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted. "Why should I spare your life? We didn’t know each other before, but you want to kill me and capture all my wives! A man must be responsible for his actions, and you must bear the consequences for your stupidity!"
"Don’t you dare!"
Yan Washeng roared as he flew towards Zhang Fei, but flame arrows suddenly shot out towards him. He immediately activated his defense, creating a crimson sphere that enveloped his body to block them.
Yan Washeng misjudged because those flame arrows easily broke his defense before penetrating his body.
"Gah!"
Yan Washeng rolled in the air several times before landing on his two feet; several small holes appeared on his body due to those flame arrows, and reddish-black blood flowed out of them.

The demons who were in the area gasped in shock after seeing Yan Washeng’s condition. He was one of the most arrogant demon gods, and his son often took advantage of his status to do as he pleased. They have long wanted the father and son to die, and they feel their hope will come true soon. Subconsciously, they started cheering excitedly, hoping that Zhang Fei would kill them immediately.
Hearing the excited cheers of the other demons, Mo Cangyue, who was previously afraid of Yan Washeng, cheered with them.
Yuan Xiajie felt helpless when she saw Mo Cangyue become excited like that. "Sister Cangyue, you are really childish."
"Haha," Mo Cangyue softly laughed. "I have never seen Yan Washeng so scared before! He’s really scared of Zhang Fei now."
Yuan Xiajie shook her head without saying anything, but a faint smile appeared on her face when she looked at Yan Washeng.
"Hah... Hah... Who exactly are you?" Yan Washeng asked warily; he didn’t expect that Zhang Fei could break his defense so easily.
"My identity is not important! What’s important is that you and your sons are lusting over my wife, and I will never spare anyone who sets their eyes on them."
After Zhang Fei said that, he used his two absorbing abilities on Yan Tianling, causing him to scream in pain. "Argh! Father! Save me!"

"Bastard!" Yan Washeng released his full strength and prepared to attack Zhang Fei, but a pressure far stronger than his own suddenly pressed down on him from above, forcing him to fall to his knees. "Impossible! How—"

"What’s impossible?" Yan Washeng’s eyes widened as he looked at Huo Ling, who had just emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "In my eyes, a demon god like you is no different from an ant. Unfortunately, my husband forbids me from killing you, so I’ll suppress you for now, and you can witness the death of your idiot son with your own eyes."
"Please... please let go of my son; I will do anything for you," Yan Washeng begged Zhang Fei.
Huo Ling looked at Zhang Fei. "Are you really going to kill this foolish demon god?"

"At first, I thought about killing him, but I changed my mind." Mo Cangyue looked at Zhang Fei and wanted to say something to him, but Yuan Xiajie immediately covered her mouth with her hand. "There are still several other demon gods trying to overthrow Mo Qingwen, so I think it would be better if I let him live, and I can use him to do something to them. Moreover, I can go to the Frozen Yin Domain whenever I want, and I can use those yin demons to increase my strength."

"That’s true." Huo Ling nodded in agreement. "Even though most of those yin demons haven’t reached the Celestial God Realm, their yin qi is quite abundant compared to other female demons, so I think they are enough to help you. Do you want me to do it?"
"No need," Zhang Fei refused. "For now, you just need to suppress him, and I will do it myself after I kill his son."

Yan Washeng’s face turned pale after hearing that. He couldn’t possibly let his son die in Zhang Fei’s hands. He gritted his teeth and used his last resort straight away. His aura instantly exploded, and his flames spread throughout the area.
"You—" Yan Washeng was shocked as his flames disappeared and an even stronger pressure restricted his movements. "Impossible! I’ve already used my last resort, but I’m still powerless."

"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted disdainfully. "You’re just a frog in a well who doesn’t know the vastness and depth of the universe! Your flame? Heh! Do you think your meager flames can compare to my Eternal Flame?"

Yan Washeng was even more shocked to hear that from Huo Ling. As a native of the Ancient Realm, he naturally knew about the Eternal Flame, but the flame had disappeared for so long, and no one had managed to find its whereabouts.
Huo Ling deliberately mentioned the Eternal Flame because people in the Ancient Realm didn’t know about the Primordial Flame, and Yan Washeng’s reaction was just as she expected.
Huo Ling stretched her right hand forward, and the small primordial flame appeared in her palm. "In front of my flame, other flames must submit, so you will never be able to use your abilities."

Seeing the primordial flame in Huo Ling’s palm made Yan Washeng feel deep regret. If only he hadn’t been tempted by those female demons, he and his son would never have suffered such a terrible fate. He never imagined that the young lust demon he had underestimated would possess such unfathomable strength, and he also possessed the spirit of the Eternal Flame by his side. "If only I had listened to Old Zuo and left this place, I wouldn’t have suffered this fate today."
"Regret always comes last!" Huo Ling pulled Yan Washeng towards her and forced him to kneel in front of Zhang Fei. "You should just keep quiet and watch your son die at my husband’s hands."

No parent could bear to witness the death of their child, including Yan Washeng. Seeing Yan Tianling’s expression and screams of pain, he closed both his eyes. "Please forgive me, Son. I am a useless father; I am powerless to save you."

Even though she hated Yan Washeng because he planned to kill her father, Mo Cangyue felt pity for him when she saw his tears. Despite this, she didn’t stop Zhang Fei from killing Yan Tianling because he had disturbed her life for too long, and his death would make her life much more peaceful.

Yuan Xiajie breathed a sigh of relief as the final result matched her predictions. From the beginning, she had hoped that Zhang Fei wouldn’t kill Yan Washeng, as he would be useful for other purposes. But she didn’t say anything to him and let him decide for himself.
Above, Huli Chenying propped her chin on her hands, swinging her legs. "As you’d expect from Zhang Fei, Master. He didn’t spare Yan Tianling, but he didn’t intend to kill Yan Washeng."

"Yes," Xuanyuan Yue nodded with a smile. "Yan Tianling is useless to Zhang Fei because he can only rely on his father, so he didn’t hesitate to kill him. On the contrary, Yan Washeng is a demon god; he also initiated a plan to rebel and kill Mo Qingwen."
"Even so, Zhang Fei didn’t do that for Mo Qingwen, and he did everything for the safety of all his wives, right?"

Xuanyuan Yue had been observing Zhang Fei since day one, so she was familiar with his character, and his character was similar to her father’s. Even though both of them were unfaithful and had too many wives, they were very loving and protective of them.
Huli Chenying looked at her master’s smile. "Have you decided to meet Zhang Fei in person, Master? Your smile is different when you look at him, and you look like an infatuated woman."
"Let’s wait and observe the situation for now, Sister Chenying."

Huli Chenying sighed. "Master, your mother is much braver than you, you know? Everyone knows that she’s a reserved and cold woman, but she becomes a different woman whenever she’s in front of your father, and she never hesitates to show her love for him. If you continue to be passive and indecisive like this, you will never find your true happiness, and you will live alone for the rest of your life."
"Don’t I have you by my side, Sister Chenying? You will never leave me, right?"

Huli Chenying was helpless. "I’m your contract beast, so I can’t possibly leave you. It’s just that you’ve been searching for your true happiness for a long time, and Zhang Fei is right in front of you now, so you shouldn’t waste your chance and go meet him now."
Xuanyuan Yue didn’t say anything to reply or refute Huli Chenying, and her gaze solely focused on Zhang Fei and those demons.

Huli Chenying inwardly sighed because her master was too timid when it came to romance. She immediately jumped down, causing Xuanyuan Yue to frown. "Since you don’t want to see Zhang Fei, I’ll go see him myself, Master."

chapters.title: Chapter 1781: Zhang Fei - Huli Chenying
paragraphs: [Ding]
[You gained 30,000,000 Qi from Yan Tianling.]
[You gained 30,000,000 female essences from Yan Tianling.]
Yang Washeng’s heart tightened when he saw his son die with a dried-up body, especially after his qi and demon essence were absorbed by Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei stood dumbfounded in his spot, staring at the two notifications. He remembered obtaining only ten million yin qi and female essences from dual cultivation with Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran, whereas he had received twelve million from Dong Xuanyin. Yet, he had received three times that amount from Yan Tianling, despite the fact that the male demon had not yet reached Demon God Rank.

[The difference between cultivators in the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm is too wide, Master. If you dual cultivate with Hua Qianmei, I estimate that you will gain more than fifty million yin qi and female essence from her.]

Zhang Fei agreed with Mei, but he hasn’t thought about it yet. He pulled the Demon Extermination Sword from Yan Tianling’s body, letting his corpse fall to the ground. He rubbed the blade of the sword and asked. "Did you two absorb enough his qi, Hei’an and Guang’an?"
Zing...Zing...
The Demon Extermination Sword vibrated in excitement.

"I’ll find more qi for you two." Zhang Fei returned the Demon Extermination Sword into his body before turning his head towards the sound of light footsteps heading towards them. "A non-demon female fox?" ’Scan her status, Mei.’
[The system failed to scan that female fox’s status, Master.]

Zhang Fei’s expression turned serious after Mei made that statement, as the system had previously failed to scan other people’s status only twice. Additionally, he sensed something unusual about the female fox, but he was uncertain about his intuition.

Noticing Zhang Fei’s strange gaze, Qi Qingxiu and the others turned their heads to the female fox. They were momentarily stunned by her beauty, especially when they saw her smile. They felt oppressed by her presence and aura, but the pressure emanating from her was far different from any pressure they had ever experienced before.

The female fox was none other than Huli Chenying. She didn’t look at the others. Her playful, seductive gaze was completely focused on Zhang Fei. She stopped in front of them and pointed to Yan Tianling’s corpse. "Do you still need his corpse? If you don’t need it anymore, can you give it to me?"

Yan Washeng, who was still mourning the death of his eldest son, looked at Huli Chenying. However, he quickly averted his gaze when he saw the look in her eyes; even his body trembled inexplicably, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
Zhang Fei wanted to ask Huli Chenying something regarding his suspicions about her, but he felt that the time and location were not right to ask that.
"Hey!" Huli Chenying looked at Huo Ling, who was sitting on Zhang Fei’s shoulders. "Where is your master? Did she come here with you?"
"Eh?" Huli Chenying was taken aback. "Do you know anything about me?"
Huo Ling shook her head. "I’ve never met you before, so I don’t know anything about you. However, I’ve met your master and her mother about two decades ago."
Zhang Fei sucked in a deep breath because Huo Ling’s words proved his suspicions, and he was sure that Huli Chenying was Xuanyuan Yue’s contract beast.
Zhang Fei’s reaction told Ye Mingran and the others that he knew something about Huli Chenying, but they restrained themselves from asking him.

"Oh." Huli Chenying remembered Xuanyuan Yue’s story about her meeting with Feng Yao at that time, but her master didn’t say anything about Huo Ling. "My master was in this dungeon, but she was too shy to meet this young man because he was too handsome."
Zhang Fei and Huo Ling spread their senses to locate Xuanyuan Yue within the dungeon, but they couldn’t sense her aura or presence at all, as if she didn’t exist.

"Hehe," Huli Chenying stood in front of Zhang Fei, pressing her index finger against his chest. "Are you eager to meet my master, handsome? Actually, she wants to meet you, but she’s overthinking about something, so she doesn’t want to appear in front of you. By the way, you don’t need to look for her because you won’t be able to find her with your current cultivation, and your efforts will just be in vain."
Zhang Fei was shocked to hear that. "Does that mean her cultivation is higher than Huo Ling’s?"

"Yes," Huli Chenying’s answer shocked not only Zhang Fei and Huo Ling but also everyone who heard her words. "I can’t say too much about my master, but I can say for sure that not a single living creature in the universe can defeat her, including Feng Yao and the two primordial beasts."
"That’s impossible, right?" Qi Qingxiu blurted out. "Sister Yao... She—"

Huli Chenying looked at Qi Qingxiu. "Little Demon God, nothing is impossible in the world of cultivation. Feng Yao has long been aware that she cannot defeat my master, even if she uses her past strength."

Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe looked at Huli Chenying like they were looking at a monster. If her master was much stronger than Feng Yao, they were sure that she was as strong as her master.
Mo Cangyue seemed confused by their situation and Huli Chenying’s identity. She looked at Yuan Xiajie, who responded with a shake of her head.
’Who exactly is this woman? Her aura is so calm, but I feel a powerful pressure radiating from her, and it’s far stronger than Feng Yao’s.’ Yuan Xiajie inwardly wondered.
Huli Chenying looked at Zhang Fei again. "So, can you give this demon’s corpse to me?"
"Take it." Zhang Fei nodded.
"Thank you." Huli Chenying transformed into her fox form, opened her mouth wide, and swallowed Yan Tianling’s corpse directly. Her actions left Zhang Fei and the others speechless.
Yan Washing clenched his fists tightly, but he didn’t dare utter a single word, and he could only silently mourn his son’s death.
Zhang Fei looked at Huli Chenying’s fox form with admiration, but he couldn’t recognize her fox race because she came from another universe, and the system couldn’t check her status.
Huli Chenying returned to her human form, pulled Zhang Fei into her embrace, and kissed him.

’Fuck! She took advantage of me!’ Zhang Fei wanted to return Huli Chenying’s kiss, but his body couldn’t move at all even though their soul link was still active, so he could only passively accept as she kissed him.
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Dong Xuanyin smiled in amusement at the sight. Usually, Zhang Fei was in control when they kissed him, but this time, he couldn’t do anything to Huli Chenying.

Zhang Fei froze as Huli Chenying absorbed his beast essence, but his worries disappeared as she only absorbed it for a few seconds. She stopped their kissing and licked her lips. "Honestly, I want to completely absorb your beast essence, but I can’t do that because my master would be furious and would lock me up."
"Can you take me to see her?"

"No," Zhang Fei was disappointed by Huli Chenying’s refusal because he wanted to meet Xuanyuan Yue in person. "If you want to see my master, you must evolve into a ten-tailed fox first, and you can ask Feng Yao to take you to the Primordial Realm at that time."

Unlike Zhang Fei and the others, all the cultivators in the Ancient Realm never knew about the existence of the Primordial Realm, so Mo Cangyue and Yan Washeng looked shocked after Huli Chenying mentioned that realm.
"So, your master stayed and watched over me from the Primordial Realm?"

"My master came here using her spaceship artifact, and she doesn’t want to be seen by anyone, so the most suitable place is the Primordial Realm. Although some primordials are still alive, they have long since entered the deep slumber, so they are unaware of her presence in their realm." Huli Chenying brought her face next to Zhang Fei’s ear. ’Actually, my master has already fallen in love with you after she followed your journey as a cultivator since the first day, but she didn’t dare to accept her feelings. Therefore, you must think of a way to win her over, and we can have fun together in the future.’
"Cough... Cough..." Zhang Fei coughed hard, looking at Huli Chenying strangely.
"Haha," Huli Chenying laughed. "I didn’t lie to you, okay? You—"

"Sister Chenying! I will lock you up for a thousand years if you continue talking nonsense." Xuanyuan Yue’s voice echoed throughout the first floor of the dungeon, and everyone present tried to find her hiding place to no avail. "Zhang Fei! If you wish to meet me, I will be waiting for you at that place."
"See? What did I say? My master—"

"Sister Chenying! Return to my side now!" Huli Chenying shuddered at the anger in Xuanyuan Yue’s voice, and she immediately disappeared from everyone’s sight. "Work hard and let’s meet in the future, Zhang Fei."
"Don’t worry! I’ll definitely meet you there." Xuanyuan Yue didn’t respond to Zhang Fei, disappointing him.

Huo Ling immediately spoke to him. "Since she can come here, her strength is immeasurable. Thus, you don’t need to feel disappointed, husband. One day, you will surpass my master, and you will reach her level, so you can meet her at that time."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei looked at Yan Washeng. "Honestly, I want to kill you, but your death will only bring new problems for me. Although I won’t kill you, I won’t let you go free without control."
Yan Washeng raised his head. "Do as you wish."
After implanting his demon slave mark and cloning Yan Washing’s soul, Zhang Fei ordered him to leave the dungeon. He also gave him several orders regarding the other demon gods.

"Yes," Huli Chenying’s answer shocked not only Zhang Fei and Huo Ling but also everyone who heard her words.
"I can’t say too much about my master, but I can say for sure that not a single living creature in the universe can defeat her, including Feng Yao and the two primordial beasts."
"That’s impossible, right?" Qi Qingxiu blurted out.
"Sister Yao...
She—"
Huli Chenying looked at Qi Qingxiu.
"Little Demon God, nothing is impossible in the world of cultivation.
Feng Yao has long been aware that she cannot defeat my master, even if she uses her past strength."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe looked at Huli Chenying like they were looking at a monster.
If her master was much stronger than Feng Yao, they were sure that she was as strong as her master.
Mo Cangyue seemed confused by their situation and Huli Chenying’s identity.
She looked at Yuan Xiajie, who responded with a shake of her head.
’Who exactly is this woman?
Her aura is so calm, but I feel a powerful pressure radiating from her, and it’s far stronger than Feng Yao’s.’ Yuan Xiajie inwardly wondered.
Huli Chenying looked at Zhang Fei again.
"So, can you give this demon’s corpse to me?"
"Take it." Zhang Fei nodded.
"Thank you." Huli Chenying transformed into her fox form, opened her mouth wide, and swallowed Yan Tianling’s corpse directly.
Her actions left Zhang Fei and the others speechless.
Yan Washing clenched his fists tightly, but he didn’t dare utter a single word, and he could only silently mourn his son’s death.
Zhang Fei looked at Huli Chenying’s fox form with admiration, but he couldn’t recognize her fox race because she came from another universe, and the system couldn’t check her status.
Huli Chenying returned to her human form, pulled Zhang Fei into her embrace, and kissed him.
’Fuck!

She took advantage of me!’ Zhang Fei wanted to return Huli Chenying’s kiss, but his body couldn’t move at all even though their soul link was still active, so he could only passively accept as she kissed him.
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Dong Xuanyin smiled in amusement at the sight.
Usually, Zhang Fei was in control when they kissed him, but this time, he couldn’t do anything to Huli Chenying.
Zhang Fei froze as Huli Chenying absorbed his beast essence, but his worries disappeared as she only absorbed it for a few seconds.
She stopped their kissing and licked her lips.
"Honestly, I want to completely absorb your beast essence, but I can’t do that because my master would be furious and would lock me up."
"Can you take me to see her?"
"No," Zhang Fei was disappointed by Huli Chenying’s refusal because he wanted to meet Xuanyuan Yue in person.
"If you want to see my master, you must evolve into a ten-tailed fox first, and you can ask Feng Yao to take you to the Primordial Realm at that time."

Unlike Zhang Fei and the others, all the cultivators in the Ancient Realm never knew about the existence of the Primordial Realm, so Mo Cangyue and Yan Washeng looked shocked after Huli Chenying mentioned that realm.
"So, your master stayed and watched over me from the Primordial Realm?"
"My master came here using her spaceship artifact, and she doesn’t want to be seen by anyone, so the most suitable place is the Primordial Realm.

Although some primordials are still alive, they have long since entered the deep slumber, so they are unaware of her presence in their realm." Huli Chenying brought her face next to Zhang Fei’s ear. ’Actually, my master has already fallen in love with you after she followed your journey as a cultivator since the first day, but she didn’t dare to accept her feelings.
Therefore, you must think of a way to win her over, and we can have fun together in the future.’
"Cough...
Cough..." Zhang Fei coughed hard, looking at Huli Chenying strangely.
"Haha," Huli Chenying laughed.
"I didn’t lie to you, okay?
You—"
"Sister Chenying!

I will lock you up for a thousand years if you continue talking nonsense." Xuanyuan Yue’s voice echoed throughout the first floor of the dungeon, and everyone present tried to find her hiding place to no avail.
"Zhang Fei!
If you wish to meet me, I will be waiting for you at that place."
"See?
What did I say?
My master—"
"Sister Chenying!
Return to my side now!" Huli Chenying shuddered at the anger in Xuanyuan Yue’s voice, and she immediately disappeared from everyone’s sight.
"Work hard and let’s meet in the future, Zhang Fei."
"Don’t worry!
I’ll definitely meet you there." Xuanyuan Yue didn’t respond to Zhang Fei, disappointing him.
Huo Ling immediately spoke to him.
"Since she can come here, her strength is immeasurable.
Thus, you don’t need to feel disappointed, husband.
One day, you will surpass my master, and you will reach her level, so you can meet her at that time."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei looked at Yan Washeng.
"Honestly, I want to kill you, but your death will only bring new problems for me.
Although I won’t kill you, I won’t let you go free without control."
Yan Washeng raised his head.
"Do as you wish."
After implanting his demon slave mark and cloning Yan Washing’s soul, Zhang Fei ordered him to leave the dungeon.
He also gave him several orders regarding the other demon gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1782: Toward The Second Ground Floor
paragraphs: Huli Chenying had already returned to Xuanyuan Yue’s side, who watched Zhang Fei and his group go to the second ground floor. "Master, that kid is quite interesting! Why don’t you meet him today? He’s right in front of you now, so you shouldn’t waste this opportunity."
Xuanyuan Yue looked at Huli Chenying, cupped her face, and kissed her lips directly.
Huli Chenying happily welcomed Xuanyuan Yue’s tongue, linked their tongues together, and kissed her back.
Once she was satisfied, Xuanyuan Yue separated their lips and stood up. "Let’s go back."
"But-"
"No buts!" Xuanyuan Yue grabbed Huli Chenying’s shoulder, and the two of them immediately disappeared from the dungeon.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and his group walked to the second ground floor because the items he needed were difficult to find on the first floor.

At the back of the line, Mo Cangyue informed her father about Zhang Fei’s actions regarding Yan Washeng and Yan Tianling, but she did not mention Huli Chenying’s appearance or the Primordial Realm. "Hey, Zhang Fei! Can you tell me about that fox woman and that realm?"
"I don’t know her name because today is our first meeting, but you’ve heard her master address her as Sister Chenying."
Mo Cangyue doubted Zhang Fei’s answer because Huli Chenying kissed him before.

"The Primordial Realm is the highest realm in this universe, and several primordials still live in a deep slumber there, including the two primordial beasts. You don’t need to ask about the path to go to that realm because I don’t know anything about it, but Feng Yao and Huo Ling should know about it."

Mo Cangyue felt a little dizzy, but she immediately asked some other questions. "Does that mean Feng Yao is a primordial like them? Who are Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi? Is Huo Ling really the spirit of the Eternal Flame?"

"Feng Yao’s first life was Shen Yuanshi, one of the primordials. Actually, the Eternal Flame is the Primordial Flame, but the ancients didn’t know anything about it, and they named it the Eternal Flame. As for Huo Ling, she is the flame spirit, but she is also the flame itself."
Mo Cangyue was completely shocked when Zhang Fei mentioned those two pieces of information.
"Huang Yuanzhi is the Primordial Genesis Beast, and Xu Yuanshi is the Primordial Nihility Beast."

Mo Cangyue was increasingly confused and understood less and less about Zhang Fei. He was clearly much younger than her, but he possessed so much knowledge that the ancients never knew, and he could even defeat Yan Washeng that easily.

Zhang Fei tilted his head to the side. "Just like your parents, I didn’t know about all that information at first, but I gradually learned many things thanks to Feng Yao. She shared all that information gradually to broaden my horizons so I could be prepared to face everything that would happen in the future."
"How did you get to know Feng Yao?"
"We met on a planet called the Sky Jade Realm, which is located in the lower realm of the Three Mortal Realms."
As a native of the Ancient Realm, Mo Cangyue doesn’t know anything about the Paradise Realm, let alone the Three Mortal Realms.
"At that time, I hadn’t long started my cultivation path, and my cultivation was still at the Foundation Realm." Zhang Fei shared many stories about his past with Mo Cangyue.
On their side, Yuan Xiajie listened attentively to all of Zhang Fei’s stories. She had known him for a long time, but prior to their initial encounter, she was unaware of his past.
Mo Cangyue took a deep breath after listening to everything. "Why are you telling me all this? Aren’t you afraid that I have bad intentions towards you?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei softly laughed. "Even if you had bad intentions towards me, you wouldn’t be able to do anything to me."
Mo Cangyue pouted her lips.
"Additionally, one of my demon abilities allows me to see someone’s soul, so I can confidently say that you have no ill intentions towards me, as you are just like an innocent little girl."
"Ugh!" Mo Cangyue stomped her legs. "I’m not a little girl! I’m much older than you!"

"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed out loud. "You always say that, but do you realize that age has nothing to do with a person’s maturity? Look at you; your behavior just now was no different from a little girl, even my Ling’er was much more mature than you when she was ten years old."
Mo Cangyue was at a loss for words to refute Zhang Fei, but she realized that her behavior was indeed childish.
"As for your parents, I’m not the least bit afraid of them, and I’m confident in defeating them."

Mo Cangyue did not doubt his words, especially with Huo Ling and Feng Yao at his side. Although her father was powerful, she knew that his strength was only a few levels above Yan Washeng’s, so she believed that Zhang Fei would be able to defeat him if they fought.
"Just like you, I also used my demon technique on your mother without her knowing, so I know that she has no ill intentions towards me or all my wives."

Mo Cangyue smiled with satisfaction upon hearing this. "Although my parents are powerful, they are not evil people, and they always treat everyone fairly and equally. Unfortunately, some demon gods are dissatisfied with them, and they never stop trying to bring down my father."

"Such things are inevitable in our lives, right?" Zhang Fei sighed. "There are countless living beings in this universe; many of them are satisfied with their lives, some of them are ambitious to achieve better things, and some others are too greedy even though they already have many things in their possession. As for me, I don’t care about them, and I live for the people closest to me. If they come to us and bring us trouble, I will kill them all for the sake of the peace of our lives."

Qi Qingxu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe smiled upon hearing this. Zhang Fei was indeed a debauchee, but he always tried hard for all his wives and the people around him. If it weren’t for him, they would never have known about the Ancient Realm and the Primordial Realm, much less gone to either.
Yuan Xiajie also felt that Zhang Fei was different from other men, especially after she lived with him and all his wives in the training space for several months.

Mo Cangyue sighed. "If this domain were peaceful, I could live my life in peace. Unfortunately, it will never happen because all demon gods have their ambitions, and many of them aspire to be the sole ruler."

"You’re wrong about that," Zhang Fei said with a shake of his head. "Peace won’t come by itself, but everyone must work together to achieve it. Everyone has big ambitions, including me and your parents. The most important thing is how we make our ambitions and dreams come true, and to achieve everything will definitely require many sacrifices."
"Sacrifices." Mo Cangyue muttered to herself.

Zhang Fei continued, "These parasites will destroy our ambitions and dreams, so the best solution is to eliminate them from the root. If I were your father, I would gather the other demon gods who align with me, and we would eliminate the problematic ones together."
"Some demon gods are indeed in line with my father, but they don’t have the guts to change the situation, and they are already satisfied with what they have."

"We can’t blame them for that because not everyone has the same ambition." Zhang Fei pointed to Qi Qingxiu and the others. "You can ask them about all my actions in the Paradise Realm. Unlike your father, I mostly act alone, and people from various races and different domains are on my side now. Some people have the same character as Yan Washeng, but I don’t think much of them, and I’ll get rid of them if they come looking for trouble with me first."

Yuan Xiajie spoke straight away. "Sister Cangyue, I was present at Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding, so I witnessed all the races coming together as one at their wedding, including the Xuanyuan and the Puyang Clans."
"I’ve never heard of the Xuanyuan Clan, but I’ve heard of the Puyang Clan, and their ancestor is Puyang Shenmi."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei nodded in response. "Puyang Shenmi is the ancestor of the Puyang Clan, and I met her because Feng Yao brought me to their clan."
"Oh." Mo Cangyue nodded in understanding, but she realized something. "How could the Puyang Clan accept a demon like you? As far as I remember, the clan members have never been fond of demons."
Zhang Fei smiled and returned to his human form, causing Mo Cangyue’s jaw to drop. "As you can see, I was originally human, but I transformed into a lust demon because of that female fox’s master."

"Eh?" Mo Cangyue was not surprised to hear that a human turned into a demon, but she did not expect that Zhang Fei became a lust demon because of that female fox’s master. "How did that happen? Why did she turn you into a lust demon?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "I won’t explain the details to you, but I can tell you that she accidentally killed me a few years ago, and she turned me into a lust demon to revive me."
"Oh." Since Zhang Fei didn’t want to explain further, Mo Cangyue didn’t force him to spill the beans. "So, are we going to hunt mindless demons on this floor?"
"My goal in coming to this dungeon is to find materials to upgrade my wives’ demon ranks, so I’ll focus on finding those items."
"In that case, we should go to the third-to-fifth ground floors to look for them, Zhang Fei. We can only find the Abyssal Demon Heart and the Demon Ritual Sigil on the fifth ground floor."

chapters.title: Chapter 1783: Mo Qingwen’s Order
paragraphs: Zhang Fei wanted to gather all the demon materials to upgrade all his wives’ demon ranks, but they needed five types of items, and the chance of obtaining each item was slim. Wu Zu could help him concoct the Demon Soul Elixir, but he had to find the other four items himself.

Zhang Fei thought about bringing his other four clones to the dungeon to look for the other four items, but the four perils and their armies had already departed from the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, so he had no other choice to leave one clone in the Paradise Realm.
Even though the place provided by Hua Qianmei was safe, Zhang Fei could not rest assured leaving his demon wives unguarded, so he left one clone to protect them.

As for Zhang Fei’s other three clones, they are still absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon in the training space. He could have confined the female demon in the Yin-Yang Space, but the absorption rate of the tube was too slow compared to him absorbing it directly.

Besides, all his demon wives also needed other demon materials for the future, so Zhang Fei decided to hunt mindless demons on the second ground floor first. With his current strength combined with the six female demons, he was confident that they could gather as many demon materials as possible quickly, and they would move on to the third ground floor after that.

Unlike on the first floor, the mindless demons on the second ground floor were much stronger. There were many other demon races hunting them as well, so Zhang Fei had no choice but to compete with them.

As soon as they arrived on that floor, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, Yuan Xiajie, and Mo Cangyue deliberately stayed away from Zhang Fei’s location by spreading out to several different areas.

Just like before, Zhang Fei summoned the Demon Extermination Sword, and he allowed the two female sword spirits to control the sword. Mostly Jian Guang’an was in control of the sword because he had the light element, while Jian Hei’an had the darkness element.

Zhang Fei himself used another sword to hunt those mindless demons, combining it with his light element, light elemental law, and light domain. The demons, who witnessed his actions, chose to keep their distance from him. His light element was their nemesis, and they didn’t want to die at his hands.
"Yan Tianling is dead." Gu Yanshu and Mo Luoxie looked at Mo Qingwen in shock. "Zhang Fei killed him in front of Yan Washeng."

Mo Qingwen explained to Gu Yanshu and Mo Luoxie about all the incidents in the dungeon based on reports from Mo Cangyue, including Yan Tianling’s death. "I didn’t expect that Zhang Fei was so decisive and ruthless in his actions. Not only did he kill Yan Tianling, but he also enslaved Yan Washeng."
"Isn’t that good news for us, husband? With Yan Washeng under Zhang Fei’s control, that rebel group will lose their way, and their plans against us will be thrown into disarray."

Mo Qingwen nodded to his wife. "Yan Washeng was the initiator of the rebellion, and Zhang Fei’s action gave us a breath of fresh air. Unfortunately, he hasn’t said anything about his plans against Old Yan, so we have to wait for the right time to find out everything."
"Since Zhang Fei is still covering up his plans against Yan Washeng, we can only wait for now, and our daughter doesn’t need to pry information out of him."
"I told our daughter not to ask Zhang Fei anything."
"Who exactly is Zhang Fei, Father?" Mo Luoxie asked.
"Zhang Fei is Feng Yao’s husband, and that woman is Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation."
Mo Luoxie naturally knew Guang Zhiyi, but he felt something was strange. "Didn’t that woman never want to be close to any man in the past? Why did her reincarnation decide to marry Zhang Fei?"

"I haven’t met Feng Yao, so I don’t know the reason behind her decision." Gu Yanshu paused, looking at her son. "Luoxie, you should establish a good relationship with Zhang Fei, and it will be beneficial for you."
Mo Luoxie looked at his mother in confusion. "Why should I establish a good relationship with Zhang Fei? Is it because he’s the husband of Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation?"

"No," Gu Yanshu shook her head. "I want you to build a relationship with Zhang Fei not because of his relationship with Feng Yao, but because of him himself. As your father just said, he killed Yan Tianling and enslaved Yan Washeng. You have always been smart, so you should be able to guess some things about him, right?"

Mo Qingwen spoke to his son. "Zhang Fei is no ordinary demon, and he has extensive connections. According to your brother, he has close ties with the Puyang Clan, and that clan is one of the strongest human clans. Furthermore, he has Feng Yao by his side, and that woman has regained her former strength, so she is stronger than me or any other demon god. If a woman as powerful as her chose him as her husband, it means he possesses an advantage that other cultivators don’t possess."
"Did Feng Yao help Zhang Fei kill Yan Tianling and enslave Yan Washeng?"

"Feng Yao didn’t show up in the dungeon, and Zhang Fei did everything himself." Mo Luoxie doubted this because Yan Washeng was a powerful demon god, although he wasn’t as powerful as Mo Qingwen. "Your sister said that he possesses a strengthening technique, and his cultivation becomes on par with demon gods when he activates it."
"A strengthening technique?" Mo Luoxie was shocked. "What kind of technique is that? I also mastered a strengthening technique, but my strength cannot match that of demon gods."

Mo Qingwen shook his head. "Even though Zhang Fei accepted your sister into his group, he still kept many important matters from her. After all, they’ve only known each other for two days, so it’s natural that he doesn’t fully trust her yet. At least, he doesn’t show any hostility towards us, and we have the opportunity to establish a better relationship with him."
"Alright! I will follow your wishes." Mo Luoxie was also curious about Zhang Fei’s strength, and he wanted to see it with his own eyes. "I’m going to the dungeon to catch up with them now."

Gu Yanshu immediately warned his son. "Luoxie, you must avoid looking at Zhang Fei’s wives. They are demon gods, and their beauty is unmatched. However, he is very possessive, and I’m afraid that he will be hostile to you if you look at them too often."

"Do you think I would be interested in other people’s wives, Mother?" Mo Luoxie asked helplessly. "Even if Zhang Fei’s wives are as beautiful as you say, I only love Yuan Xuan, and I will never look at other women."
Gu Yanshu chuckled. "In that case, you should bring Yuan Xuan to the dungeon, and she can learn many things from those female demon gods."
"Alright." Mo Luoxie got up from his seat and walked away. He also contacted Yuan Xuan, asking her to go with him to the dungeon.
Gu Yanshu watched her son leave. "Do you really think our son won’t be tempted by them, husband?"

"Trust him, wife. Our son is not stupid, and he is not a womanizer either. Even if he is fascinated by the beauty of Zhang Fei’s wives, he will not try to approach them." Mo Qingwen spoke confidently as he believed in his son’s character. "Since Yan Washeng is under Zhang Fei’s control, I will wait for his group’s next action."
"Do you think Gongsun Zhilan and the others will realize that Yan Washeng is under Zhang Fei’s control?"
"I don’t think so." Mo Qingwen rose to his feet. "I’ll meet Old Yuan and the others to discuss this matter, but I won’t tell them about Zhang Fei."

"I’ll go meet them now."

Yan Washeng let his wife help him to sit in bed. "Calm down, Su Lan! My injuries aren’t serious, and I’ve already taken healing pills, so I’ll recover soon. I went into the dungeon earlier, but I encountered a powerful female cultivator there, and she attacked me."
"Huh?" Su Lan was shocked. "Who was that female cultivator? Why did she attack you?"

Wan Washeng shook his head helplessly. "I don’t know that woman’s identity, but she’s far stronger than all the demon gods, including Mo Qingwen. For now, you must not tell anyone about this matter, or we will face great danger, and our demon race may become extinct."

"Okay," Su Lan readily agreed, seeing her husband’s serious expression. "By the way, where is our eldest son? I remember he brought three of his subordinates to the dungeon yesterday, so you should meet them there."
"Our eldest son died at the hands of that female cultivator."

sentences.text: Zhang Fei wanted to gather all the demon materials to upgrade all his wives’ demon ranks, but they needed five types of items, and the chance of obtaining each item was slim.
Wu Zu could help him concoct the Demon Soul Elixir, but he had to find the other four items himself.

Zhang Fei thought about bringing his other four clones to the dungeon to look for the other four items, but the four perils and their armies had already departed from the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, so he had no other choice to leave one clone in the Paradise Realm.
Even though the place provided by Hua Qianmei was safe, Zhang Fei could not rest assured leaving his demon wives unguarded, so he left one clone to protect them.
As for Zhang Fei’s other three clones, they are still absorbing the yin qi from the female yin demon in the training space.
He could have confined the female demon in the Yin-Yang Space, but the absorption rate of the tube was too slow compared to him absorbing it directly.
Besides, all his demon wives also needed other demon materials for the future, so Zhang Fei decided to hunt mindless demons on the second ground floor first.

With his current strength combined with the six female demons, he was confident that they could gather as many demon materials as possible quickly, and they would move on to the third ground floor after that.
Unlike on the first floor, the mindless demons on the second ground floor were much stronger.
There were many other demon races hunting them as well, so Zhang Fei had no choice but to compete with them.

As soon as they arrived on that floor, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, Yuan Xiajie, and Mo Cangyue deliberately stayed away from Zhang Fei’s location by spreading out to several different areas.
Just like before, Zhang Fei summoned the Demon Extermination Sword, and he allowed the two female sword spirits to control the sword.
Mostly Jian Guang’an was in control of the sword because he had the light element, while Jian Hei’an had the darkness element.
Zhang Fei himself used another sword to hunt those mindless demons, combining it with his light element, light elemental law, and light domain.
The demons, who witnessed his actions, chose to keep their distance from him.
His light element was their nemesis, and they didn’t want to die at his hands.

"Zhang Fei killed him in front of Yan Washeng."
Mo Qingwen explained to Gu Yanshu and Mo Luoxie about all the incidents in the dungeon based on reports from Mo Cangyue, including Yan Tianling’s death.

"Isn’t that good news for us, husband?

Unfortunately, he hasn’t said anything about his plans against Old Yan, so we have to wait for the right time to find out everything."
"Since Zhang Fei is still covering up his plans against Yan Washeng, we can only wait for now, and our daughter doesn’t need to pry information out of him."
"I told our daughter not to ask Zhang Fei anything."

"Zhang Fei is Feng Yao’s husband, and that woman is Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation."

"Didn’t that woman never want to be close to any man in the past?
Why did her reincarnation decide to marry Zhang Fei?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1784: Su Lan’s Sorrow
paragraphs: "What... what did you say? She... she killed our eldest son?" Su Lan’s voice trembled, and tears fell from her eyes.

Yan Washeng sighed and hugged her. "Wife, I understand how you feel because it pained me to see our eldest son die! I tried to save him from that woman, but she was too strong for me, and I would have died in the dungeon if someone hadn’t stopped her."
"What... what really happened? Why... why did that woman kill our eldest son?" Su Lan buried her face into her husband’s chest, asking while crying.

"Aren’t you aware of our eldest son’s character?" Yan Washeng felt deep regret. "He tried to seduce the woman and her friend by acting lasciviously, which made them furious. She had warned him not to stay away from them, but he didn’t listen to her and continued to disturb their time."
After all, Yan Washeng’s clone soul had merged with Zhang Fei’s soul, allowing them to communicate easily.

Zhang Fei arranged everything that way because he didn’t want to deal with Yan Washeng’s family members yet, and he hoped that his family members wouldn’t start looking for trouble with him, which would only waste his time.
"Who... who exactly is that woman and her friends?" Su Lan felt such deep sorrow that her tears couldn’t stop flowing, and they flowed even more freely.

Yan Washeng hugged his wife tighter. "I don’t know that woman’s identity, but one of her friends is a fox beast, and both of them are much stronger than all the demon gods in this domain. I tried to fight them, but they suppressed me with their aura, and I couldn’t move at all under their pressure."
"Where... where exactly did they come from? Why... why did they come to our domain? If they didn’t come to our domain, our eldest son wouldn’t have suffered such a fate."
"I don’t know their origins or their purpose in coming to this domain." Yan Washeng was silent for a few seconds. "I wanted to bring home our eldest son’s corpse, but the female fox ate it."
Upon hearing that, Su Lan fell deeper into sorrow, her tears flowing even more freely, and her cries growing louder.

Yan Washeng continued. "Wife, I am also saddened by our eldest son’s death, but we should put this matter behind us. That woman threatened to come here if we mess with her again, and she would slaughter both of our demon races. She is not an ordinary woman, and her strength is superior to ours, so we will never be able to defeat her if all the demon races unite."

Su Lan didn’t say anything and continued crying in her husband’s embrace. They had two other children, but her eldest son had always been the best in her eyes, and his death dealt a heavy blow to her. "Husband, we—"

"Forget it, Wife." Yan Washeng sighed heavily, knowing his wife’s thoughts. "Do you want to see our two demon races wiped out? I have a tremendous responsibility towards our two races, and I cannot watch them perish at the hands of that woman. Besides, we still have two children, and I can impregnate you again if you want another child."

Su Lan clenched her fists and hugged her husband tighter. She wanted revenge against the murderer of her eldest son, but she was a rational woman, and she was aware that her husband’s words were true. If that mysterious woman could suppress and injure her husband, then no one from their two demon races could fight her.
Yan Washeng released his wife from his arms and laid her on the bed. "Please forgive me, wife. I am a demon god, but I was powerless to protect our eldest son."
"No," Su Lan’s voice grew weaker. "I know you tried to save our eldest son, so his death wasn’t your fault. If we hadn’t spoiled him too much, he wouldn’t have died at that woman’s hands."
Yan Washeng felt a little relieved after hearing that. "For now, I won’t go anywhere, and I’ll accompany you through this sorrow."
"Yes," Su Lan pulled her husband to lie beside her and hugged him again. "Husband, we have to warn our two children about that woman so they won’t meet her or look for trouble with her."
"I will meet them after this, and I will forbid them from approaching that woman."
"That’s good." Su Lan closed her eyes. Even though she harbored a grudge against the mysterious woman, she had to think about the big picture for the sake of their two demon races.

Time passed quickly; Mo Luoxie finally arrived at the dungeon together with Yuan Xuan. He immediately led his lover into the dungeon, but they didn’t spend time on the first floor, and they went straight to the second ground floor to meet Mo Cangyue and the others.
"Is Zhang Fei really that strong, Luoxie?"

Mo Luoxie shook his head. "I’ve never met Zhang Fei, so I don’t know anything about his strength. My parents said that he killed Yan Tianling and enslaved Yan Washeng, so his strength shouldn’t be underestimated."
"Although Yan Washeng isn’t as strong as Uncle Mo, he’s still a powerful demon; otherwise, he wouldn’t have become one of the demon gods in this domain."

"That’s right." Mo Luoxie nodded in agreement. "My sister has already begun building a relationship with Zhang Fei, and our parents asked me to do the same, so I specifically asked you to accompany me here."

Yuan Xuan turned to him. "Why did you ask me to accompany you here? You usually go around alone, so I’m a little suspicious of you. Additionally, you have not provided me with a detailed explanation about Zhang Fei, which makes me suspect that your decision is related to him."
"Is that so?" Mo Luoxie smiled awkwardly. "According to my parents, Zhang Fei had four beautiful demon gods as his wives, my mother said that their beauty was peerless and unmatched."
"Haha," Yuan Xuan laughed. "So, you brought me here to meet them because you were afraid that you would be charmed by their beauty?"
Mo Luoxie sighed. "Xuan, you know my feelings for you, right? I love you wholeheartedly, but I’m still just a man, and I’m afraid that I’ll be captivated by their beauty."
"At least you are honest, Luoxie." Yuan Xuan chuckled. "One of the reasons I accepted you was your honesty, and I hope you will continue to be yourself forever."
"Thank you, Xuan."

Some time later, Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan arrived at the second ground floor, but the scene there stunned them. They looked at Zhang Fei, who was floating in midair while attacking the mindless demons.
"Is he Zhang Fei?" Yuan Xuan looked in that direction with awe, especially since she had never seen a nine-tailed lust demon before.

"I think so." Mo Luoxie looked at the surrounding area, finding the other demons keeping their distance from Zhang Fei’s attack area. "His cultivation was only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but his attacks were simply too powerful, and he killed those mindless demons with high-precision attacks."
Yuan Xuan nodded in agreement, but she felt something else from Zhang Fei’s attacks, giving her a sense of fear. "Luoxie, can you sense anything different from his attacks?"
"Yes," Mo Luoxie seriously observed Zhang Fei. "He used—"
"The light element." Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan turned to Mo Cangyue. "Zhang Fei is a demon, but he’s not an ordinary demon, and he possesses the light element."
Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan were shocked to hear that. "How can Zhang Fei have the light element, Sister?"
"I can’t explain in detail, Brother." Mo Cangyue looked at Zhang Fei. "You can observe everything directly, and you’ll learn a lot about him as time goes by."
Yuan Xuan observed Mo Cangyue’s face, and she noticed something different in her expression. "Cangyue, are you interested in Zhang Fei?"

"Huh?" Mo Cangyue abruptly looked at Yuan Xuan. "You know that I never liked men, right? Zhang Fei is different from other demons, but I don’t have that kind of feeling for him, and I only admire him. You didn’t watch his fight with Yan Tianling and Yan Washeng, and I can say that he’s really badass."
"Did he really defeat them on his own, Sister?"

"Yes," Mo Cangyue nodded. "Everyone always says that Yan Tianling is one of the talented demons in this domain, but he was completely immobile in front of Zhang Fei. He stabbed him with his sword, he gouged out both his eyeballs, and he killed him before Yan Washeng’s eyes."
Mo Luoxie felt sick hearing Zhang Fei gouging out Yan Tianling’s eyeballs before killing him. "Is he really that ruthless?"

"He is." Mo Cangyue nodded. "Zhang Fei didn’t kill Yan Tianling directly, but he killed him slowly by absorbing his demon qi clean. Yan Washeng tried to attack him, but he sent that foolish demon god flying with just one punch."
Mo Luoxie took a deep breath. He had a strengthening technique like Zhang Fei, but he couldn’t possibly do something like that to a powerful demon god like Yan Washeng.
"Where are those powerful female demon gods, Cangyue?" Yuan Xuan asked.

Mo Cangyue pointed at four different ones. "They are Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe. Although they are demon gods, their strength cannot compare to Zhang Fei’s. They are looking for demon items, so we should not disturb them for now, and I will introduce you two to them when they are resting."

"Hmm?" Yuan Xuan felt that her suspicions about Mo Cangyue were correct, and she began to be attracted to Zhang Fei; otherwise, she wouldn’t have continued to praise him. "I heard Yuan Xiajie has returned to this domain, where is she now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1785: Toward The Fourth Ground Floor
paragraphs: "Xiajie, she—"
Mo Cangyue hadn’t finished answering Yuan Xuan when they suddenly heard Zhang Fei shout a warning.
"Everybody moves further away!"
Before any of the demons could move, they saw Zhang Fei raise his right hand. The Primordial Flame slowly spread throughout the area, and the heat on the second ground floor instantly skyrocketed.
Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan were shocked by Zhang Fei’s action, and their feet were rooted to the spot. "What is he actually planning? What kind of flame is that?"
Mo Cangyue reacted quickly by pulling the two of them away to the edge of the floor, warning them at the same time. "Activate your shields now."

Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe followed all the demons present on that floor by flying to the edge before activating their barriers. They did not expect that Zhang Fei became impatient and used the Primordial Flame all of a sudden.

In the air, Zhang Fei looked up and used more of his fire qi and spread the flame further. Huo Ling emerged from his body, and the Primordial Flame instantly became much stronger and hotter. "Haha! Why are you suddenly showing off, husband? Are you doing this to lure the other demon gods to you?"
"Do you really think I would do that?"
"Well? Your actions are sometimes unpredictable, husband."

"Haha," Zhang Fei softly laughed, spread his senses, and locked all the mindless demons on the floor. He counted the number of those mindless demons in his mind. "Let’s kill them a few times, Ling’er."
"Alright." Huo Ling’s body turned into flame; she hugged Zhang Fei from behind. "Let’s do it, husband."

"Okay!" After the Primordial Flame enveloped the sky of the second ground floor, Zhang Fei waved his right hand down, followed by countless flame spears corresponding to the number of those mindless demons descending from the sky.

All the demons present on the second ground floor closed their eyes because Zhang Fei’s action made the area extremely bright, and sweat drenched their bodies because the Primordial Flame was scorching hot.
In a matter of seconds, the roars of those mindless demons echoed across the second ground floor, but it didn’t last long because they died too quickly.

After he sucked all the demon items on the floor and those mindless demons respawned, Zhang Fei immediately attacked them again. For several minutes, the roars of those mindless demons echoed on the floor, shocking all the demons present there.
At first, Mo Luoxie still doubted Zhang Fei’s abilities because he hadn’t seen him in action, but his doubts had disappeared from his mind now. "Xuan, I admit defeat to him."

"I know." Yuan Xuan grabbed Mo Luoxie’s hand, interlocking their fingers. "No wonder Uncle Mo wants you to build a good relationship with Zhang Fei, Luoxie. He is really a monster, and his strength is beyond his cultivation level."
Mo Cangyue glanced at Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan, and her lips curved involuntarily into a faint smile. "Brother, no demon in our generation can match Zhang Fei’s strength."

"Yes," Mo Luoxie nodded in agreement as he gazed at Zhang Fei in admiration. "No wonder he can defeat Yan Washeng! His strength is truly terrifying! Judging by his current cultivation, he hasn’t used his strengthening technique yet, but he can kill those mindless demons with one strike. If he uses his strengthening technique, he should be able to defeat our father."

After a few minutes and getting many demon items, Zhang Fei dispelled the Primordial Flame, and Huo Ling returned to her human form. The two immediately landed on the ground, looking at the area around them. They found all the demons present there stunned speechlessly, except for Qi Qingxiu and a few others.

"Haha," Huo Ling laughed, looking at them. "After today, your name will be famous in the Myriad Abyss Domain, husband. All the demon gods in this domain will surely hear of your name, and many of them will surely seek you out, either to befriend you or to kill you."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "If they come to befriend me, I will welcome them with open arms. If they come to kill me, I will kill them by torturing them slowly, like Yan Tianling."
"Husband!" Zhang Fei turned to Qi Qingxiu and the other three. "Do you really intend to lure those demon gods?"
"Everything has already happened, so you don’t need to ask that again, Qingxiu." Ye Mingran said.
Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement. "Those demon gods will eventually come to you, so you have to be prepared to face them, son."
"Those demon gods are powerful, but they are not as powerful as Sister Ling, so our husband will have no difficulty dealing with them." Dong Xuanyin said confidently.
"Zhang Fei," Mo Cangyue said as she strode quickly towards them, accompanied by Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan. "These two are my brother and my future sister-in-law, Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan."
Zhang Fei looked at Mo Luoxie. "Did your father send you here?"
"Yes," Mo Luoxie admitted without beating around the bush. "My father wants me to build a good relationship with you, and he also wants me to learn a lot from you."

Zhang Fei glanced at Mo Cangyue, who turned her face to the side while smiling awkwardly. "Don’t look at me like that! I only told my father about your actions against Yan Tianling and Yan Washeng, and he sent my brother here on his own decision."

Yuan Xuan looked at Zhang Fei and Mo Cangyue in turn; her future sister-in-law’s reaction further confirmed her previous guess. ’I think her love will bloom soon, and Aunt Gu won’t have to worry about her sexual orientation anymore.’

"Honestly, I have no problem with your father’s intentions, but I don’t have anything special I can teach you." Zhang Fei had the Demon Extermination Sword returned to him before inserting it into his body again. "If you want to learn from me, you can fight alongside me on the third ground floor."
"Xuan and I have no problem with that." Mo Luoxie replied with a smile.
"Good!" Zhang Fei looked at Mo Cangyue again. "I can look for the Infernal Blood Core and the Demon Essence Drop on the fourth floor, right?"

"You can look for the Demon Essence Drop on the third floor, but very few mindless demons drop that item." Zhang Fei fell into thought after hearing Mo Cangyue’s suggestion. "I think we should look for the Infernal Blood Core on the fourth ground floor first, and we’ll return to the third floor after we hunt the Abyssal Demon Heart and the Demon Ritual Sigil on the fifth ground floor."

Zhang Fei thought Mo Cangyue’s suggestion was better, so they didn’t need to waste much time looking for the Demon Essence Drop. "In that case, we will go to the fourth ground floor straight away, and we will go to the fifth ground floor after I get enough Infernal Blood Cores."

"Speaking of the fifth ground floor, several children of the other demon gods are there now." Zhang Fei looked at Mo Luoxie with a questioning look. "Chang Qifeng, Zuo Zhenlin, and a few others invited me to join them a few days ago. However, I was busy with my own personal affairs, so I decided not to join them."

"Chang Qifeng is Chang Moyu’s son, and Zuo Zhenlin is Zuo Hentian’s son, right?" Mo Luoxie glanced at his sister, but Mo Cangyue responded with a shake of her head. "Yuan Xiajie told me about their identities."

"I see." Mo Luoxie nodded in understanding. "Chang Moyu and Zuo Hentian were my father’s enemies, and they joined forces with Yan Washeng to overthrow him. I didn’t join them because I felt they had prepared a trap for me, and they would use me to pressure my father. Apart from them, we have to be careful of Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "Yuan Xiajie told me that Gu Ting is Gu Ye’s daughter, but she didn’t tell me about Gongsun Jiuxue. What is her relationship with Gongsun Zhilan?"

"Gongsun Jiuxue is Gongsun Zhilan’s niece." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Even though she is not as venomous as her aunt, she is still dangerous, and she is more dangerous than Chang Qifeng, Zuo Zhenlin, and Gui Ting."
Zhang Fei thought. "Since Gui Ting is Gui Ye’s daughter, her abilities should also be related to ghosts, right?"

"Yes," Mo Luoxie created a qi screen. "Compared to Gui Ye’s other children, Gui Ting is his perfect heir, and he passed down all his techniques to her. If he decides to retire, she will take his place."

"I can’t wait to meet Gui Ting, and I want to test her ghost techniques myself." Mo Luoxie simply smiled in response to Zhang Fei’s statement. "I’ve met ghost cultivators in the past, but their techniques were so-so, so I’m curious about her techniques."

Mo Cangyue was elated because she was tired of fighting those mindless demons on the second ground floor. "So, what are we waiting for? Yuan Xiajie has already gone to the third ground floor earlier, and she is waiting for us there, so we have to go now."
"Let’s go." Zhang Fei immediately led those female demons to the third ground floor, with Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan following behind them.

Yuan Xuan kept watching Mo Cangyue from behind, and she looked much more cheerful than usual. She tugged Mo Luoxie’s sleeve and whispered to him. ’I guess my guess was right; your sister was smitten by Zhang Fei.’
Mo Luoxie had also noticed the difference in Mo Cangyue’s attitude, but he wasn’t sure if his sister was in love with Zhang Fei, and she was being so cheerful for another reason.

When they arrived at the third ground floor, Yuan Xiajie immediately joined them. As originally planned, they didn’t hunt mindless demons on that floor; instead, they rushed to the fourth ground floor to search for the Infernal Blood Core.

chapters.title: Chapter 1786: His Name Spreads Widely I
paragraphs: As Huo Ling had said, Zhang Fei’s name quickly spread throughout the Myriad Abyss Domain. All the demon gods received reports about him from their race members in the dungeon, including Gongsun Zhilan, Gui Ye, and Chang Moyu.

The news of Yan Tianling’s death shocked them the most; they immediately contacted Yan Washeng for confirmation, but he refused to answer them and asked them to wait, which made them even more curious about Zhang Fei’s identity.
Mo Qingwen and his wife, Gu Yanshu, sat together in their room, discussing the news about Zhang Fei.
"What exactly is he thinking? Why is he deliberately flaunting his abilities to the public?" Gu Yanshu wondered.

Mo Qingwen also had difficulty understanding Zhang Fei’s intentions. He knew he was powerful, but he felt that his decision was too reckless, and his actions in the dungeon would inevitably attract the attention of all the demon gods, especially regarding Yan Tianling’s death. "Since he’s already decided to show his abilities, he must have his ideas. For now, we just need to monitor the situation, and I’ll help him if the other demon gods intend to attack him."

"Even though Zhang Fei has Feng Yao by his side, we still have to help him resolve this matter; only then will we have a good relationship with him." Gu Yanshu immediately contacted the members of the Gu Demon Race and gave them some instructions regarding the matter. "Somehow, I feel that the situation in our domain will become lively soon, and that kid will become the center of everyone’s attention."
Mo Qingwen nodded in agreement. "Zhang Fei managed to defeat and enslave Yan Washeng, but I believe that he has not shown all his abilities, and we will see everything through this matter."
"In your opinion, who among them will make the first move, husband?"

"I can’t confirm that." Mo Qingwen paused. "Our son said that Chang Qifeng, Hou Zhenlin, Gui Ting, and Gongsun Jiuxue are currently on the fifth ground floor of the dungeon. I am familiar with their parents’ characters, and they will probably order the four of them to attack Zhang Fei."

Gu Yanshu raised an eyebrow. "I’m not worried about Chang Qifeng and Hou Zhenlin, and their strength isn’t as strong as they’ve shown off. However, Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue are different from them, especially the former. She inherited all of Gu Ye’s ghost techniques, and her strength is slightly above our son."

"Compared to other techniques, the ghost technique is more troublesome, so Zhang Fei must be careful if he meets Gui Ting in the dungeon." Gu Yanshu agreed with her husband. "Gongsun Jiuxue’s strength is not as high as hers, but she is a venomous woman, just like her aunt, Gongsun Zhilan. Zhang Fei will face danger if exposed to her poison, even though it’s not as potent as her aunt’s."

Unfortunately, Mo Qingwen didn’t know Zhang Fei very well, so he didn’t know that he possessed poison immunity. Gongsun Zhilan and Gongsun Jiuxue’s poisons wouldn’t affect him, which made him their nemesis.
Gu Yanshu sighed. "I hope Zhang Fei can get through this situation, husband."
"Don’t worry, that kid will definitely get through everything well. After all, he has Feng Yao and Huo Ling by his side, and they will never let their husband get hurt, let alone die."
"I hope so."

In her chamber, Hua Qianmei also received reports from her subordinates about Zhang Fei’s actions in the dungeon. However, she was different from Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu, and she had sparred with him before, so she was familiar with his abilities.

"That kid’s action is unpredictable! He previously said that he wanted to find peace for the sake of all his demon wives, but his actions in the dungeon contradicted his words. Right now, all the demon gods must have heard of his act of killing Yan Tianling, and I’m sure they will be interested in him. Some of them might want to be friends with him, but some of them will try to get rid of him before he becomes a thorn in their plans." Hua Qianmei’s lips curved up, forming a beautiful, charming smile. "Let’s see who will move first among them, but I’m guessing that Gui Ye or Gongsun Zhilan will be the first."

Hua Qianmei raised an eyebrow when an ethereal woman appeared in her chamber, but her figure was blurry, which made her unrecognizable. However, the Bewitching Demon God was familiar with that woman, and she asked her directly. "What brings you to my palace today, Demon God Tang Zhiyao? Are you also curious about Zhang Fei?"
"Haha," Tang Zhiyao laughed. "I didn’t expect that you would accept Zhang Fei into your palace, Qianmei. Has your sexual orientation changed now?"
Hua Qianmei wore a flirtatious look. "Do you want to personally test my sexual orientation, Zhiyao? Come! Don’t be shy! I learned some new techniques, and you will definitely be satisfied."
"Humph!" Tang Zhiyao snorted. "I’m not a lily like you, so I’m not interested in your offer, and you can spend your time with that little demon. Tell me, what do you know about Zhang Fei?"

"Zhang Fei is handsome, dashing, and strong." Tang Zhiyao’s face darkened. "If you meet him, I’m sure you’ll like him. However, I warn you not to look for troubles with him because he is not an ordinary lust demon, and he has two backers who are above our league. If you have bad intentions towards him, he will have no qualms about making you suffer, and you won’t be able to do anything to refuse him."
Tang Zhiyao didn’t mock Hua Qianmei because she didn’t like to show off like the other demon gods. "Who are Zhang Fei’s two backers?"
"You’re familiar with one of them."
"Who?"

"Guang Zhiyi." Tang Zhiyao froze after Hua Qianmei mentioned the name. "Her current name is Feng Yao, and her current strength is already on par with her past strength, so the two of us are not her match. Apart from her, Zhang Fei still has one other backer who is also one of his wives, Huo Ling."
"Huh?" Tang Zhiyao was shocked. "Does that mean Feng Yao is also Zhang Fei’s wife?"

Hua Qianmei nodded. "Surprised, right? We both know Guang Zhiyi’s past character, but Feng Yao is completely different from her past self. Initially, I was also shocked to hear about their relationship; however, Yuan Xiajie witnessed their dual cultivation with her own eyes."

"Crazy." Tang Zhiyao mumbled to herself. "If Feng Yao is Zhang Fei’s wife and has regained her past strength, then none of the demon gods can defeat them, and they will die foolish deaths if they mess with them."

"That’s right." Hua Qianmei created a qi screen, displaying her spar with Zhang Fei. However, she didn’t show everything, especially when he summoned the silhouettes of those mythical beasts. "You can see his abilities for yourself."

Tang Zhiyao looked at the qi screen, her eyes flickering repeatedly. "This! How can Zhang Fei’s speed be so fast? You didn’t even have a chance to move when he moved in front of you! Besides, he was composed when the two of you sparred, and he parried all your attacks so easily."

"I haven’t known Zhang Fei for long, so he didn’t tell me in detail about his abilities. His speed was the fastest I’ve ever seen; I didn’t even have time to blink." Hua Qianmei let out a self-deprecating sigh. "Not only is his speed fast, but his fighting prowess is also extraordinary. All of his attacks are simple but have high accuracy. If I become his enemy, my brain may not have time to process my death."
Tang Zhiyao nodded in agreement. "Do you think Zhang Fei has the ability to withstand the effects of my abilities?"

"I don’t know," Hua Qianmei replied with a shake of her head. "If you want to know, you should meet him in the dungeon and use your abilities on him. However, you shouldn’t show any hostility towards him, so he won’t do anything bad to you. In my opinion, being on his good side is the best choice for us, and I’m sure that he will lead us to bring change in this domain."
"With Feng Yao by Zhang Fei’s side, only foolish people would choose to be on the opposite side from him."
"Hahaha! Yan Washeng is one of those fools!" Hua Qianmei said with a satisfied laugh. "His eldest son has died in Zhang Fei’s hands, and he himself has become his slave."
Tang Zhiyao was shocked once again. "Are you serious about that? Is Yan Washeng really Zhang Fei’s slave now?"
"Yuan Xiajie witnessed everything herself, and she told me about it." Hua Qianmei paused. "Apart from me, only Mo Qingwen and his family members know about this matter."

Tang Zhiyao herself had heard that Mo Cangyue and Mo Luoxie were in the dungeon with Zhang Fei, so she wasn’t surprised that Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu knew about that matter. "Hey! Let’s go to the dungeon!"
"No," Hua Qianmei refused. "I have to protect Zhang Fei’s demon wives, so I won’t be going anywhere for now, and you should go to the dungeon by yourself."
"Zhang Fei’s demon wives?"
"Yes," Hua Qianmei nodded. "Zhang Fei has dozens of demon wives, and they are cultivating in my late master’s private place."
Tang Zhiyao knew the place Hua Qianmei was referring to. "Take me to meet them."
"Hmm?" Hua Qianmei raised an eyebrow, but she remembered that one of Zhang Fei’s clones was there. "Alright! I’ll take you to meet them now."
"Eh? You agreed just like that?"
Hua Qianmei got off the bed and shrugged. "One of Zhang Fei’s clones is there now, so you can meet him too."
