However, Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue are different from them, especially the former.
She inherited all of Gu Ye’s ghost techniques, and her strength is slightly above our son."
"Compared to other techniques, the ghost technique is more troublesome, so Zhang Fei must be careful if he meets Gui Ting in the dungeon." Gu Yanshu agreed with her husband.
"Gongsun Jiuxue’s strength is not as high as hers, but she is a venomous woman, just like her aunt, Gongsun Zhilan.
Zhang Fei will face danger if exposed to her poison, even though it’s not as potent as her aunt’s."
Unfortunately, Mo Qingwen didn’t know Zhang Fei very well, so he didn’t know that he possessed poison immunity.
Gongsun Zhilan and Gongsun Jiuxue’s poisons wouldn’t affect him, which made him their nemesis.
Gu Yanshu sighed.
"I hope Zhang Fei can get through this situation, husband."
"Don’t worry, that kid will definitely get through everything well.
After all, he has Feng Yao and Huo Ling by his side, and they will never let their husband get hurt, let alone die."
"I hope so."
In her chamber, Hua Qianmei also received reports from her subordinates about Zhang Fei’s actions in the dungeon.
However, she was different from Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu, and she had sparred with him before, so she was familiar with his abilities.
"That kid’s action is unpredictable!
He previously said that he wanted to find peace for the sake of all his demon wives, but his actions in the dungeon contradicted his words.
Right now, all the demon gods must have heard of his act of killing Yan Tianling, and I’m sure they will be interested in him.

Some of them might want to be friends with him, but some of them will try to get rid of him before he becomes a thorn in their plans." Hua Qianmei’s lips curved up, forming a beautiful, charming smile.
"Let’s see who will move first among them, but I’m guessing that Gui Ye or Gongsun Zhilan will be the first."
Hua Qianmei raised an eyebrow when an ethereal woman appeared in her chamber, but her figure was blurry, which made her unrecognizable.
However, the Bewitching Demon God was familiar with that woman, and she asked her directly.
"What brings you to my palace today, Demon God Tang Zhiyao?
Are you also curious about Zhang Fei?"
"Haha," Tang Zhiyao laughed.
"I didn’t expect that you would accept Zhang Fei into your palace, Qianmei.
Has your sexual orientation changed now?"
Hua Qianmei wore a flirtatious look.
"Do you want to personally test my sexual orientation, Zhiyao?
Come!
Don’t be shy!
I learned some new techniques, and you will definitely be satisfied."
"Humph!" Tang Zhiyao snorted.
"I’m not a lily like you, so I’m not interested in your offer, and you can spend your time with that little demon.
Tell me, what do you know about Zhang Fei?"
"Zhang Fei is handsome, dashing, and strong." Tang Zhiyao’s face darkened.
"If you meet him, I’m sure you’ll like him.
However, I warn you not to look for troubles with him because he is not an ordinary lust demon, and he has two backers who are above our league.
If you have bad intentions towards him, he will have no qualms about making you suffer, and you won’t be able to do anything to refuse him."
Tang Zhiyao didn’t mock Hua Qianmei because she didn’t like to show off like the other demon gods.
"Who are Zhang Fei’s two backers?"
"You’re familiar with one of them."
"Who?"
"Guang Zhiyi." Tang Zhiyao froze after Hua Qianmei mentioned the name.
"Her current name is Feng Yao, and her current strength is already on par with her past strength, so the two of us are not her match.
Apart from her, Zhang Fei still has one other backer who is also one of his wives, Huo Ling."
"Huh?" Tang Zhiyao was shocked.
"Does that mean Feng Yao is also Zhang Fei’s wife?"
Hua Qianmei nodded.
"Surprised, right?
We both know Guang Zhiyi’s past character, but Feng Yao is completely different from her past self.
Initially, I was also shocked to hear about their relationship; however, Yuan Xiajie witnessed their dual cultivation with her own eyes."
"Crazy." Tang Zhiyao mumbled to herself.
"If Feng Yao is Zhang Fei’s wife and has regained her past strength, then none of the demon gods can defeat them, and they will die foolish deaths if they mess with them."
"That’s right." Hua Qianmei created a qi screen, displaying her spar with Zhang Fei.
However, she didn’t show everything, especially when he summoned the silhouettes of those mythical beasts.
"You can see his abilities for yourself."
Tang Zhiyao looked at the qi screen, her eyes flickering repeatedly.
"This!
How can Zhang Fei’s speed be so fast?
You didn’t even have a chance to move when he moved in front of you!
Besides, he was composed when the two of you sparred, and he parried all your attacks so easily."
"I haven’t known Zhang Fei for long, so he didn’t tell me in detail about his abilities.
His speed was the fastest I’ve ever seen; I didn’t even have time to blink." Hua Qianmei let out a self-deprecating sigh.
"Not only is his speed fast, but his fighting prowess is also extraordinary.
All of his attacks are simple but have high accuracy.
If I become his enemy, my brain may not have time to process my death."
Tang Zhiyao nodded in agreement.
"Do you think Zhang Fei has the ability to withstand the effects of my abilities?"
"I don’t know," Hua Qianmei replied with a shake of her head.
"If you want to know, you should meet him in the dungeon and use your abilities on him.
However, you shouldn’t show any hostility towards him, so he won’t do anything bad to you.
In my opinion, being on his good side is the best choice for us, and I’m sure that he will lead us to bring change in this domain."
"With Feng Yao by Zhang Fei’s side, only foolish people would choose to be on the opposite side from him."
"Hahaha!
Yan Washeng is one of those fools!" Hua Qianmei said with a satisfied laugh.
"His eldest son has died in Zhang Fei’s hands, and he himself has become his slave."
Tang Zhiyao was shocked once again.
"Are you serious about that?
Is Yan Washeng really Zhang Fei’s slave now?"
"Yuan Xiajie witnessed everything herself, and she told me about it." Hua Qianmei paused.
"Apart from me, only Mo Qingwen and his family members know about this matter."
Tang Zhiyao herself had heard that Mo Cangyue and Mo Luoxie were in the dungeon with Zhang Fei, so she wasn’t surprised that Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu knew about that matter.
"Hey!
Let’s go to the dungeon!"
"No," Hua Qianmei refused.
"I have to protect Zhang Fei’s demon wives, so I won’t be going anywhere for now, and you should go to the dungeon by yourself."
"Zhang Fei’s demon wives?"
"Yes," Hua Qianmei nodded.
"Zhang Fei has dozens of demon wives, and they are cultivating in my late master’s private place."
Tang Zhiyao knew the place Hua Qianmei was referring to.
"Take me to meet them."
"Hmm?" Hua Qianmei raised an eyebrow, but she remembered that one of Zhang Fei’s clones was there.
"Alright!
I’ll take you to meet them now."
"Eh?
You agreed just like that?"
Hua Qianmei got off the bed and shrugged.
"One of Zhang Fei’s clones is there now, so you can meet him too."

chapters.title: Chapter 1787: His Name Spreads Widely II
paragraphs: Tang Zhiyao was dumbfounded once she and Hua Qianmei arrived at the private place, her eyes moving around observing all the female demons who were cultivating there. She was jealous of all the women’s beauty, but what shocked her most was that all of them belonged to one man, Zhang Fei.
Tang Zhiyao was a demon god who had lived for a long time, and her experience was immense. Naturally, she knew the nature of lust demons, but none of them could match Zhang Fei’s number of partners.

Tang Zhiyao looked at other areas, finding quite a lot of male demons there. She was sure that they were Zhang Fei’s friends, and he deliberately brought them to the domain because their cultivation was still below the Celestial Demon God Realm.

"Haha," Hua Qianmei laughed. "When I first met them, I was just as shocked as you. Besides, Zhang Fei didn’t bring all his wives to our domain, as they weren’t demons like us, and he still has more wives."
"How many wives does he have?"
"According to Yuan Xiajie, he had more than a hundred wives, and all of them lived in one place in harmony."
"He is the most lustful lust demon I have ever heard of."
"I agree with you! Xie Wang and Xie Qing are the strongest lust demons in the Ancient Realm, but they don’t have as many partners as Zhang Fei."
"Xie Qing is a female lust demon, so it’s natural that she doesn’t have many partners. Xie Wang has five official partners, and he also has fun with other women out there."

"Why did you come here using your illusory body, Dream Demon God?" Hua Qianmei and Tang Zhiyao looked at Zhang Fei [5], who had just returned from another area. "Are you surprised that I know your abilities?"
"No," Tang Zhiyao replied by shaking her head. "Guang Zhiyi is one of your wives, and she should have told you about me and my abilities."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Tang Zhiyao. "Unfortunately, you were mistaken because Feng Yao did not provide me with any information about you; I deduced it using my own abilities."
"Your abilities?"
"That’s right," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "I have a similar ability to yours, so I knew that you were using your illusory body, and your real body should be inside that place."
"What place do you mean?"

"Naturally, that place is a dream space, which suits your title." Zhang Fei [5] could guess that it was because the system couldn’t scan Tang Zhiyao’s status, and he also couldn’t sense any signs of life from her.

"You’re right," Tang Zhiyao admitted after she remembered that lust demons also had dream techniques. "My real body wasn’t in good condition, so I left it there, and I always used my illusory body to monitor this domain."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised. "Did you suffer any injuries in the past?"
"Kind off."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Hua Qianmei. "Try giving her a healing pill."
Tang Zhiyao turned to Hua Qianmei. "Do you have a healing pill?"
"He gave me some pills, including healing pills." Hua Qianmei took the pill bottle and poured one pill into her hand.

"A superior-grade pill!" Tang Zhiyao shouted with wide eyes, looking at the pill in Hua Qianmei’s hand. She calmed herself and looked at Zhang Fei [5] again. "Did you concoct this healing pill yourself?"
Zhang Fei [5] took out his alchemy badge and showed it to Tang Zhiyao. "With this badge, you don’t need to doubt my alchemist status, right?"

"An alchemy god." Tang Zhiyao muttered softly. "It’s rare for a demon to learn alchemy, let alone reach that rank. This domain once had a demon alchemist in the past, but he chose to leave and move to another domain. Since then, we no longer have an alchemist, and we have to buy pills in other domains."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I plan to open two alchemy shops in this domain, and I will open one of them in Senior Hua’s city."
"Huh?" Hua Qianmei was shocked. "Are you really going to open an alchemy shop in my city?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] explained a few things to them. "Apart from them, I still have countless demons under me, but I can’t bring them here, so I want to find demon materials to increase their strength."
"Are they subordinates of your mother-in-law and three wives?" Hua Qianmei asked.
"Among my three wives, Dong Xuanyin is a loner, so she doesn’t have any subordinates."

Hua Qianmei immediately understood that those demons were subordinates of Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe. "When do you want to open your alchemy shop? I’ll prepare an empty building for you, but you’ll have to manage everything yourself."

"I won’t waste my time managing my shop, and I’ll bring some demons from the Paradise Realm here to manage it." Hua Qianmei had no problem with Zhang Fei [5]’s wish because the city was hers, and no one would dare dispute her order. "I plan to clear out some demon gods first, and I’ll open my shop after that."
Hua Qianmei and Tang Zhiyao were shocked, not expecting that Zhang Fei [5] had such a plan. "Who are they?"

"The Ghost Demon God Gui Ye, the Venomous Demon God Gongsun Zhilan, and the Tempest Demon God Chang Moyu. Besides, I heard from Mo Cangyue that the Curse Demon God, Hou Wuyan, is also more inclined to side with them." Hua Qianmei and Tang Zhiyao’s expressions experienced a subtle change when Zhang Fei mentioned those demon gods. "The Slaughter Demon God Zuo Hentian had already seen me in the dungeon before, but he decided to leave, so I won’t do anything to him, at least for now."

Hua Qianmei didn’t doubt Zhang Fei [5]’s words, but Tang Zhiyao had some doubts towards him. Besides, every death of a demon god would cause huge problems for the domain, so she hoped he wouldn’t kill them.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled, looking at Tang Zhiyao’s expression. "I didn’t say that I would kill them, and I might do something else to them, but the final outcome will depend on them. If they attack me and want to kill me, I will kill them first, and I will also annihilate their demon races."

"I see." Tang Zhiyao nodded in understanding. "Zuo Hentian made the right decision by retreating at the last second, so he didn’t suffer the same fate as Yan Washeng. However, I’m sure he won’t give up so easily, and he might attack you together with his allies."
"Let them come, and I will never back down from fighting them." Zhang Fei [5] spoke confidently.
Hua Qianmei spoke immediately. "Gui Ye and Gongsun Zhilan might make a move against you soon, so you must be prepared to face them."

"I’m always ready to face them." Zhang Fei [5] paused for a moment. "Mo Luoxie told me that Chang Qifeng, Zuo Zhenlin, Gui Ting, and Gongsun Jiuxue are on the fifth ground floor right now. I suspect that their seniors will send them to test my abilities first, and they will go to the dungeon if I succeed in defeating their juniors."
"Has Mu Luoxie told you about their abilities?"

"He told me everything, and I’m not afraid of them." Tang Zhiyao wanted to interrupt him, but Zhang Fei [5] stopped her. "I know you want to say that I should be careful of Gongsun Jiuxue’s poison, but I’m not afraid of it. In fact, I’m her nemesis, so she won’t be able to do anything to me. Even if Gongsun Zhilan decides to come, I’m confident in defeating her without using my strengthening technique."

Tang Zhiyao and Hua Qianmei exchanged glances, and they immediately realized that Zhang Fei [5] was immune to poison. If that were true, Gongsun Zhilan’s fate would be sealed if she dared to approach him, and they couldn’t wait to see her expression when she realized that.
"Have they made their move on you?"

"Not yet," Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "They are on the fifth ground floor, and my real body is on the fourth ground floor looking for lots of Infernal Blood Cores. After getting enough, I will go straight down to the next floor, and we will face each other at that time."
"You should tell me after you defeat them," Hua Qianmei spoke with a tinge of impatience in her voice.
Tang Zhiyao nodded in agreement. "If you defeat them, their seniors will go there to look for you. I want to see Gongsun Zhilan’s expression when she fights you, so you must tell us."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled in amusement. "You two hate Gongsun Zhilan, huh?"
"Yes!" Hua Qianmei and Tang Zhiyao exclaimed in unison. "We hate that venomous woman so much, so we want to see her expression when she feels powerless to fight you."
"I’ll inform you two later."
After they discussed a few other things, Hua Qianmei and Tang Zhiyao left, and Zhang Fei [5] helped some of his wives again.

Zhang Fei [5] considered helping Tang Zhiyao recover from her injuries, but he decided against it after second thoughts. It was their first meeting, and he couldn’t check on her because she was using her illusory body.
After they returned to the palace, Hua Qianmei gave Tang Zhiyao a healing pill, and the demon god left immediately after.

Inside her dream space, Tang Zhiyao sat cross-legged and swallowed the healing pill. Just like her illusory body, her real body’s appearance was also unclear, but her body shape showed that she was a sexy and curvaceous woman. After some time, she experienced significant changes in her body. "Zhang Fei, huh? An alchemy god is indeed different! I only took one pill, but my injuries improved by thirty percent."

chapters.title: Chapter 1788: His Name Spreads Widely III
paragraphs: In her demon palace, Gongsun Zhilan stood on the balcony with her hands behind her back, and her eyes stared into the distance, precisely towards the location of the dungeon. "A lust demon named Zhang Fei, huh? Where did he come from? Why didn’t Yan Washeng kill him after he killed Yan Tianling? That really doesn’t make sense, and there must be a story behind it."
Gongsun Zhilan tried to contact Su Lan to ask what really happened, but Yan Washeng’s wife wouldn’t reveal anything, and she asked her to wait for the right time to discuss the matter.
Su Lan’s answer made Gongsun Zhilan’s suspicions grow even more; she believed that Yan Washeng was hiding something from them, and the source was Zhang Fei.

After mulling over it, Gongsun Zhilan contacted Gongsun Jiuxue and asked her niece to look for Zhang Fei in the dungeon as soon as possible. She could have gone straight to the dungeon to look for him, but Yan Washeng and Su Lan’s attitudes gave her a feeling of unease, so she chose to take careful steps.

Gongsun Zhilan hadn’t met Zhang Fei and seen his abilities, but she felt that her niece should be enough to deal with him. After all, Gongsun Jiuxue was stronger and more capable than Yan Tianling, so she felt that her niece would have no difficulty carrying out the task.

However, Gongsun Zhilan forbade her niece from killing Zhang Fei; instead, she asked Gongsun Jiuxue to capture him alive and take him to her palace. "A nine-tailed lust demon is truly an extremely rare creature; he should have many other advantages over the other lust demons. If I can control him, I will use him to carry out my plans against Gu Yanshu and her daughter. If I manage to get rid of them, Mo Qingwen will be mine alone."

In the ghost palace, Gui Ye stood in front of several people after receiving a report about Zhang Fei. He pondered the news thoughtfully, especially since Yan Washeng was unwilling to explain the details of the incident in the dungeon to him.

"What happened? Why did Old Yan accept his son’s death just like that? Does that male lust demon have backers far more powerful than him? Who are his backers?" Various questions kept popping up in Gui Ye’s mind and infuriated him. "Tch! He’s definitely planning something by keeping everything a secret! Heh! Even though I don’t have clear information about that male lust demon, he shouldn’t be my daughter’s opponent, let alone my opponent!"
Gui Ye immediately contacted Gui Ting and asked her to capture Zhang Fei alive. He wanted to kill him, but Yan Washeng’s secrecy sparked his curiosity; he wanted to meet Zhang Fei in person.

Gui Ye looked at his subordinates before him. "Go to the dungeon and help my daughter capture that lust demon! If he’s unwilling to go with you, you can break both of his legs and bring him here by force!"
"Yes, Demon God!"
In another palace, Chang Moyu sat together with Zuo Hentian, discussing Zhang Fei.
"Is that male lust demon really that strong, Old Zuo?" Chang Moyu asked in disbelief.

Zuo Hentian sighed. "If he weren’t that powerful, do you think he could have killed Yan Tianling in front of Old Yan? His cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but I have a feeling that his strength is far superior to his cultivation level, and I also sensed something unusual from him. That’s why I immediately left the dungeon, and as a result, Old Yan lost his eldest son."

"Even though Yan Tianling was the weakest of his generation, he should have been able to face that male lust demon. Unfortunately, the results said otherwise, and he died in his hands." Chang Moyu looked at Zuo Hentian. "Should we join forces? Besides, we can ask Old Gui and Old Gongsun to join us; I don’t believe he can fight all four of us at the same time."
Zuo Hentian pondered this. "If the four of us combine our strength, we should be able to defeat that male lust demon. If Hou Wuyan is willing to join us, our chances of winning will be even higher."

"Isn’t that too much? If we ask Old Hou to join us, that male lust demon will definitely die, and we won’t get the answer to the mystery." Zuo Hentian knew that Chang Moyu was right, but there was something stuck in his heart, and he had a feeling that the strength of the four of them was not enough to defeat Zhang Fei. "Sigh! I’ll contact Old Hou now."
"Alright." Zuo Hentian nodded.

Chang Moyu immediately contacted Hou Wuyan, but his expression turned furious after hearing her reply. "Old Hou is not interested in that male lust demon, and he just wants to bring down Old Mo, so he doesn’t want to get involved in this matter."
Zuo Hentian wasn’t surprised to hear the news because Hou Wuyan’s answer was within his expectations.
"Our two sons are in the dungeon, right? What if we ask them to test the power of that male lust demon first?"
Zuo Hentian glanced at Chang Moyu, knitting his brows. "If we do that, I’m afraid they will die like Yan Tianling."

"What are you afraid of?" Chang Moyu shook his head. "Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue are with their two sons, and their combined strength is quite high. Moreover, the latter has many poisonous abilities like Old Gongsun, so I believe they will be fine. Besides, we don’t need to ask them to fight seriously, and they only need to fight that male lust demon to test the depth of his strength. As long as they don’t intend to kill him, he won’t kill them either."
Zou Hentian exhaled softly. "Alright! We will ask our two sons to check on Zhang Fei together with Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue."
Zou Hentian and Chang Moyu immediately contacted their two sons, ordering them to meet Zhang Fei. However, they forbade the two of them to show any killing intent when they met him later.
On the fifth ground floor of the dungeon, two male demons and two female demons discussed the orders of their seniors. They were Chang Qifeng, Zuo Zhenlin, Gui Ting, and Gongsun Jiuxue.
They informed each other of their seniors’ orders, all of which shared the same goal: to capture Zhang Fei.
Chang Qifeng looked at the other three and asked. "What do you all think?"

Gongsun Jiuxue didn’t say anything, and she immediately walked towards the stairs leading to the fourth ground floor. She has an oval-shaped face with delicate skin; her eyes are almond-shaped with brown irises, combined with a slender nose and full lips with a subtle rosy hue.

Gongsun Jiuxue’s expression is confident and seductive. She has long, silky, dark brown hair styled in a half-up bun, cascading past her waist. A few strands of her hair frame her cheeks and neck. She has a curvaceous yet graceful figure, combined with voluptuous breasts with a naturally rounded shape. Her long arms have slender fingers; her long legs are smooth and well-proportioned.
Gongsun Jiuxue wears a black gown accented with intricate gold embroidery and ornamental patterns, combined with a deep V-shaped neckline emphasizing her upper body.
Gui Ting gritted her teeth in annoyance. "That bitch always acts annoying like that!"
"Haha," Zuo Zhenlin walked away. "You’ve known her for a long time, so you shouldn’t be surprised by her cold and aloof demeanor, right?"

"Let’s follow them." Chang Qifeng and Gui Ting followed behind Zuo Zhenlin. "Since our seniors asked us to be careful of Zhang Fei, you better not act carelessly, Ting. Otherwise, you will die like that stupid Yan Tianling."
"Humph!" Gui Ting snorted. "That Yan Tianling is indeed foolish! However, I am different from him, and my ghost will help me, so Zhang Fei will not be able to kill me that easily!"
Chang Qifeng looked at her. "Even though you are confident in the power of those ghosts, you must not ignore your father’s warning, or you will regret it."
"Yeah... Yeah..." Gui Ting quickened her pace to catch up with Gongsun Jiuxue. "Hey, Xuexue! Why aren’t you saying anything? Are you sure you can capture Zhang Fei?"

"I don’t dare underestimate Zhang Fei." Gongsun Jiuxue’s answer surprised Gui Ting. "My aunt told me that Uncle Yan should have fought him before, and he probably lost to him, so he’s embarrassed to tell the truth."

"Huh?" Gui Ting’s eyes widened. "Do you really believe that Zhang Fei has defeated Uncle Yan? He is not as strong as my father or your aunt, but he is a demon god like the two of them, and that kid’s cultivation is only at the Celestial Emperor Realm."

Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head. "I trust my aunt’s intuition more, so I won’t underestimate Zhang Fei. For now, we should go upstairs as soon as possible, and we’ll observe him from afar first before we make a move. Moreover, there are four female demon gods, Yuan Xiajie, Mo Cangyue, Mo Luoxie, and Yuan Xuan by his side; thus, we must not act rashly, or we will suffer the same fate as Yan Tianling."
"I think you’re too cautious, Jiuxue."
"It’s better to be careful than to die, don’t you think?"
"Alright! I give up! I never win when arguing with you!" Gongsun Jiuxue said nothing more and walked faster, annoying Gui Ting, who was walking beside her. "Hey! I’m curious about Mo Cangyue!"
"What are you curious about her for?"

"We all know that she is a lily, and she has never gone out with other men besides her father and Mo Luoxie, so I found it strange that she entered this dungeon with Zhang Fei. Do you think she fell in love with him?"
Gongsun Jiuxue sighed softly. "Mo Cangyue’s affair is none of my business."

chapters.title: Chapter 1789: Meeting Each Other
paragraphs: Upon arriving at the fourth ground floor, Gui Ting and the others saw Zhang Fei and Mo Luoxie competing to kill the mindless demons. Neither of them used many techniques, relying solely on their physical strength.

Zhang Fei did not hunt other mindless demons, and his focus was entirely on looking for the Infernal Blood Core. However, the number of infernal demons in that place was small, and he had to wait a while before he could hunt them again.
Mo Luoxie killed all kinds of mindless demons, but he didn’t keep those demon materials; instead, he gave them to Zhang Fei.
Yuan Xiajie, Yuan Xuan, and Mo Cangyue also fought with those mindless demons in three different areas to help Zhang Fei collect demon materials.

Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin’s attention was on Zhang Fei, but they also glanced at Mo Luoxie several times, and a glimmer of cruelty flashed in their eyes. They exchanged glances and nodded to each other, secretly plotting something against Prince Mo.
Gongsun Jiuxue’s attention was only on Zhang Fei, observing his combat ability and techniques. ’He really is a nine-tailed lust demon, but his fighting style is different from other lust demons.’

Even though her father ordered her to capture Zhang Fei, Gui Ting was more curious about the four female demon gods. She focused on finding their location because the area on the floor was quite vast, but soon she found them in four different locations.
"Hmm? Hey! Look at that woman! She is a soul-devouring demon, right?"
Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin looked at Nalan Shizhe, who was pointed at by Gui Ting.
"That woman is indeed a soul-devouring demon, but I’ve never seen her in this domain before. She seems to be one of Zhang Fei’s women, which means she’s a demon god."
Zuo Zhenlin agreed with Chang Feng, but then he looked at Ye Mingran. "That woman fighting in that area comes from the eternal night demon Race, and she’s also a demon god."

"What do you think if we tell Uncle Ye and Uncle Nalan about those two women?" Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin looked at Gui Ting with a frown. "Why are you two looking at me like that? Since they come from the same races, they will be interested in getting those two women. If they come here, it will make it easier for us to capture Zhang Fei."
Chang Qifeng sighed. "Do you want to look for trouble with Zhang Fei? Our fathers ordered us to observe him first, remember?"

"That’s right." Zuo Zhenlin nodded in agreement. "If we contact Uncle Ye and Uncle Nalan and tell them about those two women, they will come here immediately, and their arrival will only bring new trouble."

"Humph!" Gui Ting snorted disdainfully. In her eyes, Zhang Fei was not their opponent because his cultivation and demon rank were below theirs, and she didn’t want to waste too much time capturing him. She turned to Gongsun Jiuxue, but her friend was completely focused on observing their target, and she didn’t care about the others. "Hey! Are you interested in him, Xuexue?"
Gongsun Jiuxue was too focused on Zhang Fei and didn’t hear Gui Ting’s question. "His fighting style is different from other lust demons, and his strength is equal to or surpasses ours."
Gui Ting sneered upon hearing this, but Chang Qifeng and Hou Zhenlin had different thoughts, and they agreed with Gongsun Jiuxue’s opinion of Zhang Fei’s strength.
Gui Ting looked at Mo Cangyue’s location and thought about attacking her, but she abandoned the idea and chose to focus on her main target first. "So, how long are we going to monitor him?"
"Be patient." Chang Qifeng and Hou Zhenlin shouted in unison.

Gui Ting was annoyed with them, and she thought they didn’t have the guts to fight Zhang Fei. She looked at Gongsun Jiuxue once more, but her friend also showed no intention of making a move on him. "A bunch of cowards!"
Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin’s faces darkened as they glared at Gui Ting, who responded to them with a shrug.
"If you’re that impatient, you can make a move on him first, Ting."
"We will observe him for some time before determining our next steps."
"Tch!" Gui Ting gritted her teeth in annoyance.

Zhang Fei noticed the arrival of Chang Qifeng and the others, but he ignored them and focused on his own affairs. Even so, he warned the four female demon gods, Mo Cangyue, Mo Luoxie, Yuan Xuan, and Yuan Xiajie.
Dong Xuanyin, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe remained unperturbed by their presence due to their low cultivation and demon ranks.

Mo Cangyue, Mo Luoxie, Yuan Xuan, and Yuan Xiajie increased their vigilance. After thinking about it, they hurriedly gathered in the same area, as they were afraid that Chang Qifeng and the others would attack them.
"They noticed our presence." Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin agreed with Gongsun Jiuxue. "If I’m not mistaken, it was Zhang Fei who informed Mo Luoxie and the others of our presence."
Gui Ting looked at Gongsun Jiuxue. "Are you serious about that, Xuexue?"

"Yes." Gongsun Jiuxue nodded slightly. "Mo Luoxie and the others clearly didn’t notice our presence, but they suddenly moved and gathered in the same area. Besides, Zhang Fei glanced in our direction a few times, but the three of you didn’t notice his actions."
"Hmm?" Gui Ting did not fully believe Gongsun Jiuxue’s words, but she immediately returned her focus to Zhang Fei. "What actually happened? How could a lust demon like him have nine tails?"
After thinking about the pros and cons, Gongsun Jiuxue decided to meet Zhang Fei, and she immediately flew towards him. Her decision shocked Chang Qifeng, Zuo Zhenlin, and Gui Ting.

Gui Ting felt that there was something strange about Gongsun Jiuxue’s attitude, and she hurriedly flew after her. On the other hand, Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin did not follow them, and they chose to wait for the right time to make their move.

Zhang Fei stopped fighting the mindless demons as soon as Gongsun Jiuxue and Gui Ting landed in his area. He looked at the two women and read their statuses, discovering that their cultivation was at the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. "Who are you two?"
"My name is Gongsun Jiuxue." Zhang Fei showed no reaction when the woman introduced herself. "Are you willing to spar with me?"
"Not interested," Zhang Fei rejected her outright. "I came here to look for demon materials, so I don’t want to waste my time on useless things."

Gongsun Jiuxue’s eyes flickered, not expecting that Zhang Fei would reject her without a second thought. Gui Ting wanted to shout at him, but she hurriedly stopped her friend and asked. "Are you looking for the Infernal Blood Core?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "I need a lot of Infernal Blood Cores for my subordinates."
"How many Infernal Blood Cores do you need?"
"A thousand." Zhang Fei’s answer stunned Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue because the Infernal Blood Core was one of the five demon materials for upgrading demon ranks. "Please don’t bother me."
After saying that, Zhang Fei flew to another area to hunt those infernal demons, leaving Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue behind.

"Tch!" Gui Ting turned to Gongsun Jiuxue. "That brat must be bluffing! The Infernal Blood Core is only used to upgrade demon ranks, but he said he needed a thousand of them! If he said he needed ten, I might believe him, but not a thousand."

Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head slightly. "Ting, you have to remember that he has four female demon gods by his side, and I’m sure he’s looking for those demon items for their sake. Besides, we don’t have any information on them, so we don’t know how many demons are ready to break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks by his side."

"Well? You’re not wrong about that, but we can’t possibly believe that he has a thousand demon gods by his side, right?" Like Gui Ting, Gongsun Jiuxue did not believe Zhang Fei, but she had no evidence that he was bragging. "Ask your aunt, the number of demon gods in this Ancient Realm doesn’t even reach one hundred, yet that brat wants to find a thousand materials!"
"Forget it!" Gongsun Jiuxue flew away, followed by Gui Ting. "Whether it’s true or not is his business, and our business is to monitor him."
Gui Ting sighed. "Why don’t we force him to go with us directly?"

"You can force him if you’re tired of living." Gongsun Jiuxue looked at the four areas of the four female demon gods. "We are no match for those four women, and they will move to protect him if we force him to come with us."
Gui Ting was frustrated with the situation, and she wanted to settle their matters with Zhang Fei as soon as possible. "How long are we going to wait?"
"Until the right opportunity comes."
"What do you think of him, Xuexue?" Chang Qifeng asked as soon as the two women landed.

"We’re not his opponents." Unlike Gui Ting, Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin believed in Gongsun Jiuxue. "For now, we should wait patiently, and we’ll continue to monitor him while waiting for the right time."
Chang Qifeng and Hou Zhenlin nodded in agreement. "Let’s report this matter to our seniors."
"Brother, they seem to be targeting Zhang Fei." Mo Cangyue said in a worried tone.

Mo Luoxie looked at the four of them and nodded in agreement with his sister. "Zhang Fei’s previous actions were too large-scale, and the demons upstairs must have reported his presence to their leaders, so they sent four of them to check."
"Luoxie, I think the other demon gods will send their trusted subordinates soon."

"If I’m not mistaken, it was Zhang Fei who informed Mo Luoxie and the others of our presence."
Gui Ting looked at Gongsun Jiuxue.
"Are you serious about that, Xuexue?"
"Yes." Gongsun Jiuxue nodded slightly.
"Mo Luoxie and the others clearly didn’t notice our presence, but they suddenly moved and gathered in the same area.
Besides, Zhang Fei glanced in our direction a few times, but the three of you didn’t notice his actions."
"Hmm?" Gui Ting did not fully believe Gongsun Jiuxue’s words, but she immediately returned her focus to Zhang Fei.
"What actually happened?
How could a lust demon like him have nine tails?"
After thinking about the pros and cons, Gongsun Jiuxue decided to meet Zhang Fei, and she immediately flew towards him.
Her decision shocked Chang Qifeng, Zuo Zhenlin, and Gui Ting.
Gui Ting felt that there was something strange about Gongsun Jiuxue’s attitude, and she hurriedly flew after her.
On the other hand, Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin did not follow them, and they chose to wait for the right time to make their move.
Zhang Fei stopped fighting the mindless demons as soon as Gongsun Jiuxue and Gui Ting landed in his area.
He looked at the two women and read their statuses, discovering that their cultivation was at the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.
"Who are you two?"
"My name is Gongsun Jiuxue." Zhang Fei showed no reaction when the woman introduced herself.
"Are you willing to spar with me?"
"Not interested," Zhang Fei rejected her outright.
"I came here to look for demon materials, so I don’t want to waste my time on useless things."
Gongsun Jiuxue’s eyes flickered, not expecting that Zhang Fei would reject her without a second thought.
Gui Ting wanted to shout at him, but she hurriedly stopped her friend and asked.
"Are you looking for the Infernal Blood Core?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded.
"I need a lot of Infernal Blood Cores for my subordinates."
"How many Infernal Blood Cores do you need?"
"A thousand." Zhang Fei’s answer stunned Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue because the Infernal Blood Core was one of the five demon materials for upgrading demon ranks.
"Please don’t bother me."
After saying that, Zhang Fei flew to another area to hunt those infernal demons, leaving Gui Ting and Gongsun Jiuxue behind.
"Tch!" Gui Ting turned to Gongsun Jiuxue.
"That brat must be bluffing!
The Infernal Blood Core is only used to upgrade demon ranks, but he said he needed a thousand of them!
If he said he needed ten, I might believe him, but not a thousand."
Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head slightly.
"Ting, you have to remember that he has four female demon gods by his side, and I’m sure he’s looking for those demon items for their sake.
Besides, we don’t have any information on them, so we don’t know how many demons are ready to break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks by his side."
"Well?

You’re not wrong about that, but we can’t possibly believe that he has a thousand demon gods by his side, right?" Like Gui Ting, Gongsun Jiuxue did not believe Zhang Fei, but she had no evidence that he was bragging.
"Ask your aunt, the number of demon gods in this Ancient Realm doesn’t even reach one hundred, yet that brat wants to find a thousand materials!"
"Forget it!" Gongsun Jiuxue flew away, followed by Gui Ting.
"Whether it’s true or not is his business, and our business is to monitor him."
Gui Ting sighed.
"Why don’t we force him to go with us directly?"
"You can force him if you’re tired of living." Gongsun Jiuxue looked at the four areas of the four female demon gods.
"We are no match for those four women, and they will move to protect him if we force him to come with us."
Gui Ting was frustrated with the situation, and she wanted to settle their matters with Zhang Fei as soon as possible.
"How long are we going to wait?"
"Until the right opportunity comes."
"What do you think of him, Xuexue?" Chang Qifeng asked as soon as the two women landed.
"We’re not his opponents." Unlike Gui Ting, Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin believed in Gongsun Jiuxue.
"For now, we should wait patiently, and we’ll continue to monitor him while waiting for the right time."
Chang Qifeng and Hou Zhenlin nodded in agreement.
"Let’s report this matter to our seniors."
"Brother, they seem to be targeting Zhang Fei." Mo Cangyue said in a worried tone.
Mo Luoxie looked at the four of them and nodded in agreement with his sister.
"Zhang Fei’s previous actions were too large-scale, and the demons upstairs must have reported his presence to their leaders, so they sent four of them to check."
"Luoxie, I think the other demon gods will send their trusted subordinates soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1790: Zhang Fei - Gongsun Jiuxue
paragraphs: Just like Yuan Xuan, Mo Luoxie was also worried that the other demon gods would send their subordinates to the tower to capture Zhang Fei. Some of them were fierce and ruthless, and they would use any means to capture him.

"Instead of worrying about Zhang Fei, you guys should worry about your own safety." Yuan Xuan and Mo Luoxie looked at Yuan Xiajie. "Have you forgotten that he defeated Yan Washeng and killed Yan Tianling? Gongsun Zhilan and the other demon gods didn’t dare to come here themselves, and they sent their juniors to probe him. If the other demon gods who were weaker than them came here, they would suffer at his hands, and this place would probably become their grave."

"Ahh!" Mo Cangyue clasped her hands. "You’re right, Xiajie! I shouldn’t have to worry about Zhang Fei! His strength has already surpassed that of all demon gods, and he has Senior Huo and Senior Feng by his side, so he will definitely be safe. On the other hand, we are not as strong as him, and we don’t have as strong backers as those two women."

"Hehe," Yuan Xiajie chuckled. "Uncle Mo and Aunt Gu are powerful demon gods, but they will be overwhelmed if they have to face many enemies of equal strength. However, it’s not a big problem as long as you have a good relationship with Zhang Fei, and I’m sure that he will help you if the other demon gods attack you."
"True... True..." Mo Cangyue nodded her head in agreement, and a faint smile appeared on her face.

Yuan Xuan’s eyes flickered as she felt that Mo Cangyue’s behavior was truly unusual, further convincing her that she had fallen in love with Zhang Fei. "Cangyue, you have to be careful of Gui Ting; she is clearly targeting you."
"I’m not surprised about that." Mo Cangyue nodded lightly. "Gui Ting has hated me since that incident, and she always looks at me with a fierce gaze, as if she wants to devour me alive."
Yuan Xiajie walked away. "You three should hunt together, and I’ll go to another area."
"Will she be okay?" Yuan Xuan asked with concern.
"No one dares to touch Yuan Xiajie with Hua Qianmei behind her." Mo Cangyue dashed towards those mindless demons. "Ignore those people! Let’s hunt for now!
Mo Luoxie smiled bitterly and followed his sister, as did Yuan Xuan.

After getting the report from Chang Qifeng and the others, their seniors ordered them to hold back and continue to observe Zhang Fei, except for Gui Ye, who asked his daughter to find a way to act as soon as possible.

Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin sat side by side while watching Zhang Fei. They were quite shocked to see him slaughter so many mindless demons so quickly, but they could see that his main target was those infernal demons because he was looking for a lot of Infernal Blood Cores.

Gongsun Jiuxue didn’t care about Mo Luoxie, Mo Cangyue, Yuan Xiajie, Yuan Xuan, or the four female demon gods. Her gaze was completely focused on Zhang Fei, observing every detail of his actions. His actions pleased her eyes, stirring something in her heart. Her two hands clenched into fists, her blood boiled, and her heart beat fast.

Meanwhile, Gui Ting became annoyed to observe Zhang Fei, and she was impatient to capture him. She had always been confident in her strength and abilities, and she was confident that she could capture him, but the presence of the four female demon gods made her lose confidence.

After thinking about it, Gui Ting decided to contact Uncle Ye and Uncle Nalan, informing them of Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe’s presence. ’Heh! If Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui are willing to come and capture those two women, I will ask them to capture the other two as well. If those four women are gone, we can capture Zhang Fei easily.’

While Gui Ting was elated at the thought, her mood soured as soon as Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui replied to her message. They were interested in getting Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran, but they didn’t want to court death by messing with Zhang Fei. They had already heard about Yan Washeng’s situation and were certain that he was concealing important information.

’Tch! They are such cowards!’ Gui Ting gnashed her teeth; she didn’t expect that Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui would be so cowardly. After all, they were demon gods, but they were frightened by Zhang Fei. However, she didn’t know that Mo Qingwen had already made a move, and he informed the neutral demon gods, including both of them, about several things.

Gui Ting reported everything to her father, and Gui Ye informed her that his subordinates were already on their way to the dungeon, so he asked her to wait for them before making a move on Zhang Fei. ’Heh! I’m sure I can capture him with their help!’

Gui Ting stole glances at Gongsun Jiuxue beside her, but her friend was focused on Zhang Fei. ’Don’t tell me she’s interested in him! I admit that he is handsome, but he doesn’t have any status in this domain, and his cultivation is below us.’
After some thought, Gongsun Jiuxue decided to approach Zhang Fei again. She immediately stood up and flew towards him.
Watching Gongsun Jiuxue leave, Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin exchanged confused glances, as her behavior was different from usual. ’Could it be that she is interested in Zhang Fei?’

Gui Ting wanted to follow Gongsun Jiuxue, but she dropped her intention on second thought, and she chose to wait for her father’s subordinates to arrive. ’Haha! She’s such an idiot! If she’s really interested in him, she’s bound to be disappointed because her aunt also wants him, and she won’t be able to dispute her order.’

Zhang Fei, who was busy killing those mindless demons, immediately stopped his movements. He looked at Gongsun Jiuxue with a puzzled look. "Why have you come to me again? I already said I’m not interested in sparring with you."
"I don’t want to spar with you anymore, and I want to fight by your side." Gongsun Jiuxue calmly answered.
"Oh? Why do you want to fight beside me?"
"Because I’m not your opponent, and I want to see your abilities up close."
"Are you kidding me? I’m weaker than you, so—"

"If you were weak, you wouldn’t have been able to kill Yan Tianling before Yan Washeng’s eyes." Zhang Fei had already expected news about him to spread to the ears of the demon gods, so he was not surprised if Gongsun Jiuxue knew about his previous actions. "Did you defeat Yan Washeng before?"

Zhang Fei simply smiled and asked. "Why do you think that I have defeated Yan Washeng? He is a demon god, and his cultivation is at the Celestial Demon God level. As for me, I’m only an overlord-rank demon, and my cultivation is still at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm."

"My aunt asked Yan Washeng about you, but he didn’t dare say anything to her. That’s why she thought that you’ve defeated him, and you also did something to him, preventing him from saying anything about you."
Zhang Fei floated right in front of Gongsun Jiuxue, leaving their faces a short distance apart. She didn’t waver or back away, and she stared into his eyes. "Do you want to know the truth?"
"Yes." Gongsun Jiuxue nodded.

Zhang Fei smiled faintly. "You are beautiful, but you are a venomous woman. By the way, you are right that I defeated Yan Washeng before, and I also did something to him. Are you satisfied with my answer?"
"I’m satisfied," Gongsun Jiuxue thought for a moment. "How did you defeat Yan Washeng with your current cultivation?"
Zhang Fei shook his head. "We just met today, and we have no relationship whatsoever. Besides, your aunt asked you to capture me, so I won’t tell you about it."
"How did you know that my aunt asked me to capture you?"
"Should I call you Jiuxue or Xuexue?"
Zhang Fei question took Gongsun Jiuxue back. "Either is fine."
"If that’s the case, I’ll call you Xuexue like your three friends."
"Alright."

"Even though I don’t know your aunt, I’ve heard some things about her from Gu Yanshu, Hua Qianmei, and Tang Zhiyao." Gongsun Jiuxue was not surprised to hear the names of the first two women from Zhang Fei’s mouth because the Mo siblings and Yuan Xiajie were with him, but she did not expect that he knew the last woman. "Demons from all races are present in this dungeon, and I believe they have already reported to their leaders about my previous actions against Yan Washeng and Yan Tianling. That’s why I can guess that your aunt and her friends ordered the four of you to capture me."
"I see." Gongsun Jiuxue nodded in understanding. "How do you know Senior Tang Zhiyao? She’s different from my aunt and Hua Qianmei, and she rarely appears in public."
"Would you believe me if I said that Tang Zhiyao came to see me on her own initiative?"
"I believe you."
"Why?"

"Your previous actions against Yan Tianling and Yan Washeng attracted the attention of all the demon gods, and Senior Tang has a close relationship with Hua Qianmei, so I’m not surprised that she decided to meet you in person."
"You seem to respect Tang Zhiyao but not Hua Qianmei."

Gongsun Jiuxue denied it with a shake of her head. "I respect Senior Tang for several reasons, but that doesn’t mean I don’t respect Hua Qianmei. After all, she’s a demon god like my aunt, so I still respect her."
"I see." Zhang Fei looked toward the location of Gui Ting and the other two, enveloping his area with his void element. "Do you want to be my friend or my enemy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1791: Immune To Poisons
paragraphs: Gongsun Jiuxue was shocked when she felt the changes around them. She looked at Zhang Fei with a question mark above her head, but he didn’t want to explain to her. She inwardly sighed and asked him. "Why do you want me to be your friend? You guessed that I came here to capture you, yet you’re giving me such an offer."

"Let’s just say I can judge a person’s character, and I’ve never been wrong in my judgment." Gongsun Jiuxue looked at Zhang Fei while pondering his offer in her heart. "Your aunt and her friends are indeed powerful demon gods, but I’m not afraid of them in the slightest. If I want to get rid of them, I can do it at any time, and they won’t be able to do anything to stop me."

"You’re too cocky." Despite her words, Zhang Fei did not feel that Gongsun Jiuxue looked down on him. After all, Gongsun Zhilan and her friends were powerful demon gods, so it was natural that she didn’t believe in him. "All the poisons my aunt uses are too deadly; even demon gods cannot survive their effects."
"Is that so?"
"Yes."
"Then, why didn’t Gongsun Zhilan attack the other demon gods with her poison?" Zhang Fei curiously asked.

"They knew her abilities, so they were always wary of her, and they had already prepared countermeasures against her. Even though she is a demon god, some of them are stronger than her, especially Mo Qingwen."
Zhang Fei rubbed his chin in thought. "In other words, your aunt couldn’t find a loophole to poison them."
"You can say it like that." Gongsun Jiuxue nodded. "If my aunt finds the opportunity, she won’t hesitate to poison them, and they won’t survive."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "What’s your strongest poison?"
"Huh?" Gongsun Jiuxue was baffled. "What do you want to do? Do you want me to poison you?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei put on a serious look. "You can use your strongest poison on me."
"You—"
"Stop!" Zhang Fei waved his hand in front of Gongsun Jiuxue’s face. "You don’t need to say anything. Use your strongest poison on me, and you’ll get the answer to why I’m not afraid of your aunt."
"I refuse!" Gongsun Jiuxue refused with a shake of her head. "My strongest poison isn’t strong enough to kill a demon god, but it’s enough to kill you, so I won’t use it on you."
"Haish! Why don’t you believe me?"
"I don’t want you—Mhmm!" Gongsun Jiuxue’s eyes widened in shock because Zhang Fei suddenly kissed her, and she didn’t have time to react.
Gongsun Jiuxue came back to her senses as soon as she realized that her lips were poisonous, and she immediately reacted to push him back, but Zhang Fei swiftly hugged her.

Gongsun Jiuxue was completely shocked when Zhang Fei restricted her movements, leaving her powerless to move. His cultivation was clearly below hers, but he was able to restrict her movements, and she couldn’t free herself.

Gongsun Jiuxue panicked when Zhang Fei pried her lips open, inserting his tongue into her mouth. Her body couldn’t move, and she couldn’t resist his advance. She didn’t dare close her eyes and looked at him worriedly, but her worries disappeared when she saw that he was not affected by her poison.
A while later, Zhang Fei stopped kissing Gongsun Jiuxue and released her from his restrictions. He licked his lips and spoke. "See? Your poison is useless to me."

"How could this happen?" Gongsun Jiuxue asked in shock, unbothered by their kiss just now. "The poisons on my lips and mouth are not my strongest poisons, but they are strong enough to kill a cultivator at your level"
Zhang Fei shrugged, not explaining. "If you still don’t believe me, you should use your strongest poison on me."
"Are you sure you want to try my strongest poison?"
"Why not?"
Gongsun Jiuxue took a deep breath and spoke in a serious manner. "My strongest poison is the Hellish Eroding Poison. If someone is hit by my poison, their body and bones will be eroded to nothing."
"Oh? The name of your poison sounds domineering!" Zhang Fei looked right and left, pulling a mindless demon to his side. "Try using your poison on this demon."
Gongsun Jiuxue nodded and used her poison on the mindless demon directly. "Wait for a few seconds to see the effect."
"Alright." Zhang Fei focused his gaze on the mindless demon.
A few seconds later, the mindless demon released an eerie, painful roar. Soon, the mindless demon’s body began to experience erosion, which surprised Zhang Fei.
"Do you still want to try my poison?"
"Hehe," Zhang Fei chuckled. "Your poison affects this mindless demon, but it won’t affect me."
After the mindless demon vanished, Gongsun Jiuxue pressed her palm against Zhang Fei’s chest. "Are you sure you want to do this? You’ll die if—"
"Don’t worry, I won’t die."
"Alright." Gongsun Jiuxue ended up using her poison on Zhang Fei, giving her deep worries. "Do you feel anything?"
Zhang Fei shook his head. "I can feel your poison starting to enter my body, but I don’t feel any pain or anything."
"Really?" Gongsun Jiuxue was in disbelief.
"Does my expression look like I’m in pain?"
"No." Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head. "This is the first time I have met someone who can withstand the effects of my Hellish Eroding Poison."
Zhang Fei smiled. "Do you believe me now?"
"I do." Gongsun Jiuxue stopped her poison and pulled her hand back. "How can you be immune to my poison?"
"Let’s just say that is one of my body’s advantages."

Naturally, Gongsun Jiuxue didn’t believe Zhang Fei, but she realized that she couldn’t force him to tell her the truth. "You really are a strange demon! You are the only lust demon with nine tails, and you are the only living creature that can withstand my poison."
"Hehe," Zhang Fei stretched out his right hand, caressing Gongsun Jiuxue’s cheek. "So, what do you think of my offer? Do you want to be my friend or my enemy?"
"Don’t you already know the answer?"
"I want to hear it from you directly."
Gongsun Jiuxue held Zhang Fei’s hand and pressed it onto her face. "I want to be your friend."
"From today on, you are my friend, and I will help you with several things in the future." Zhang Fei pulled Gongsun Jiuxue close and kissed her again. "Do you have a lover?"
"No," Gongsun Jiuxue replied with a shake of her head. "My body is poisonous, so I have never been interested in having a relationship with any man, and you are the first man to kiss me."
Zhang Fei smiled faintly. "Then, are you willing to be my woman?"

"That’s true."

chapters.title: Chapter 1792: Gui Ye’s Subordinates Arrive
paragraphs: Zuo Hentian and Chang Moyu decided to meet again after their two sons informed them about Zhang Fei and Gongsun Jiuxue’s relationship.
"I didn’t expect Little Jiuxue to move so quickly, and she managed to secure a relationship with Zhang Fei."
Zuo Hentian nodded in agreement. "Little Jiuxue is usually the slowest compared to the others, but she’s acting bolder this time."

"Do you think Little Jiuxue used her body to seduce Zhang Fei? After all, he is a lust demon, and she is quite pretty and sexy, so he fell for her seduction." Chang Moyu couldn’t think of any other opinion besides that.

Zuo Hentian denied with a shake of his head. "We both know that Little Jiuxue isn’t that kind of woman, so I don’t believe that she sacrificed her body to seduce Zhang Fei. Moreover, our two sons already said that they couldn’t see the two of them or eavesdrop on their conversation, so it’s just empty speculation."
"That’s true." Chang Moyu nodded in agreement. "What element did Zhang Fei use back then? Did he use the space element when he spoke to Little Jiuxue?"

Zuo Hentian thought deeply, sorting out several possibilities. "I once fought with a cultivator who possessed the space element in the past. Based on the reports of our two sons, I’m certain Zhang Fei didn’t use that element, and he probably used another element."
"Another element? Is there an element that can be used for something like that besides the space element?"
"I don’t know for sure, but I’m sure that Zhang Fei’s element is not the space element."

Cang Moyu sighed in disappointment. "Since Zhang Fei has decided to choose Little Jiuxue, he will definitely side with Gongsun Zhilan soon, and their cooperation will probably bring us a lot of trouble in the future."

"I agree with you." Zuo Hentian’s expression turned gloomy at the thought. "We both know Gongsun Zhilan’s ambition is to get rid of Gu Yanshu and get Mo Qingwen, and she will become the new ruler if she succeeds in getting him. If that happens, I’m sure that she won’t stop there, and she might target us next."
Chang Moyu thought of a solution to prevent that problem. "Should we attack Zhang Fei and kill him?"

"I’m also worried about the situation, but we shouldn’t do that." Zuo Hentian’s fingers tapped the table thoughtfully. "I think we should step back for a moment and understand the situation first. Previously, our two sons couldn’t eavesdrop on Zhang Fei’s conversation with Little Jiuxue, so they don’t know for sure whether he’s siding with Gongsun Zhilan or not."
"Won’t it be too late?"
"It won’t be too late."
"I hope you’re right," Chang Moyu sighed. "What about Gui Ye? He dispatched his subordinates to the dungeon to capture Zhang Fei."

Zuo Hentian shook his head. "Gui Ye underestimates Zhang Fei too much, and his attempt to capture him will end in failure. Contact your son and tell him not to interfere if Old Gui’s subordinates fight with Zhang Fei, and you should also tell him to stay away from Gui Ting for now."
"I know." Chang Moyu and Zu Hentian contacted their two sons. "Do you think Zhang Fei dares to kill Gui Ting?"

"Haha," Zuo Hentian laughed. "Why do you think Zhang Fei will kill Gui Ting? Her figure may not be comparable to Little Jiuxue’s, but she is one of the most beautiful women in our domain. Besides, Zhang Fei is a lust demon, so he might not kill her but enslave her."
Chang Moyu nodded in agreement. "Even though Gui Ting is not as strong as Yan Washeng, she is Gui Ye’s beloved daughter, and Zhang Fei will probably use her to coerce her father to submit to him."
"Let’s wait for the result! If Zhang Fei kills Gui Ye’s subordinates, it will also benefit us."
"Hahaha!" Chang Moyu laughed excitedly. "If that really happens, Gui Ye’s overall power will be weakened, and we will reap the benefits without having to work hard."
Zuo Hentian smiled. "I really hope that Zhang Fei will kill Gui Ye’s subordinate and enslave his daughter."

Gongsun Zhilan’s eyes flickered when she received her niece’s voice message, and her smile widened after she finished listening. "I didn’t expect Little Jiuxue to work so efficiently, and she managed to gain Zhang Fei’s attention."
Gongsun Zhilan immediately replied to Gongsun Jiuxue’s message, and she asked her niece to take Zhang Fei to her palace.

"Haha!" Gongsun Zhilan laughed to herself as she walked to the balcony. "Once Little Jiuxue brings Zhang Fei here, I will use that poison on him. Once he fully submits to me, I will order him to seduce Gu Yanshu, and Mo Qingwen will be mine."
Unfortunately, Gongsun Zhilan didn’t know Zhang Fei, and Gongsun Jiuxue didn’t tell her that he was immune to poisons.
According to their fathers’ orders, Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin kept their distance from Gui Ting while observing Zhang Fei and Gongsun Jiuxue, who were seriously slaughtering the mindless demons.

Gui Ting didn’t notice the change in Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin’s attitudes, as her attention was completely focused on Zhang Fei. She received news that her father’s subordinates would arrive soon.

Gui Ting’s lips curved up; there was a glint of disdain in her eyes. She looked at Gongsun Jiuxue and inwardly scoffed. ’I don’t know what you promised him, but that lust demon will fall into my hands soon, and he will help my father bring down your aunt.’
Gui Ting’s eyes lit up as her father’s subordinates contacted her, informing her that they had entered the dungeon. She contacted them and ordered them to go to the fourth ground floor immediately.
Gui Ting looked at Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin, who were deliberately keeping their distance from her. "Hey! What are you two doing? Why are you acting so strange?"
"What’s strange about us?" Chang Qifeng asked with a flat tone.
Zuo Zhenlin shook his head. "We’re just observing Zhang Fei, that’s all."

"Do you think I’ll believe you two?" Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin ignored Gui Ting. "Humph! My father’s subordinates have arrived in this dungeon, and they’re on their way here to help me capture Zhang Fei."

Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin raised their eyebrows, not expecting Gui Ye to be so rash and impatient to capture Zhang Fei. However, they doubted that those people would succeed in carrying out their duties, especially after they had observed him for some time.
"Would you two like to join us?"
Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin shook their heads. "Our fathers asked us to wait, so we won’t do anything without their orders."

"Then, it’s your loss!" Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin chose not to respond to Gui Ting. Although they were friends, they each had their own goals. ’Haha! After we capture Zhang Fei, I’ll take him back to the castle, and I’ll have fun with him before my father uses him to do something to Gongsun Zhilan.’

Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin exchanged glances, seeing the strange smile on Gui Ting’s face. ’Does she think she’s invincible? Uncle Gui’s subordinates may be strong, but they’re not as strong as those four female demon gods. Besides, Zhang Fei was able to kill Yan Tianling in front of Uncle Yan, which means his abilities are not to be underestimated.’

Zhang Fei suddenly felt Gui Ting’s intense gaze on him, and he looked over, finding her expression quite unusual. Unlike her, he could see that Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin were calmer, and they seemed to be deliberately keeping their distance from her.
"Gui Ye sent his subordinates here, and they should have arrived." Zhang Fei looked at Gongsun Jiuxue. "They came to capture you."
Zhang Fei responded casually. "Have you informed your aunt?"
"I told her the truth, and she asked me to take you to her palace."
Zhang Fei thought for a moment. "In that case, I will take care of Gui Ye’s subordinates first, and we will go to your aunt’s palace after that."
"Do you really want to meet my aunt?" Gongsun Jiuxue asked worriedly.
Zhang Fei gave her a light nod. "Since your aunt wants to capture me, I’ll go meet her in person."
"What if—"
"You don’t have to worry about me, okay? Your aunt may be a powerful demon god, but she’s still a woman, and her poison doesn’t work on me either."
"Are you going to kill my aunt?"

"Why should I kill a powerful demon god like her?" Zhang Fei turned the question around. "I didn’t kill Yan Washeng, remember? Your aunt hasn’t done anything to deserve death, so I won’t kill her, and I just want to talk to her."
Gongsun Jiuxue was relieved to hear that. "Zhang Fei, my aunt wanted to capture you to fulfill her ambition of getting Mo Qingwen, so—"
"I already knew about your aunt’s feelings for Mo Qingwen, and I guessed from the start that she wanted to capture me. She wanted to use me to do something to Gu Yanshu, right?"

"That’s right." Gongsun Jiuxue nodded. "My aunt has been obsessed with Mo Qingwen since they were young, but he disliked her possessive character, so he chose Gu Yanshu as his wife. Since then, she tried several times to get rid of her, but she never succeeded in doing it. After she heard the news about you, she got the idea to use you."
"Let’s talk about that later." Zhang Fei looked towards the stairs leading to the third ground floor, seeing two people walking down. "They move really fast, huh?"
Gongsun Jiuxue also looked in that direction. "They’re Gui Ye’s direct subordinates, and they’re powerful."
"They may be strong, but I will not be afraid to face them, and this place will be their grave."

"Gui Ye sent his subordinates here, and they should have arrived." Zhang Fei looked at Gongsun Jiuxue.
"They came to capture you."
Zhang Fei responded casually.
"Have you informed your aunt?"
"I told her the truth, and she asked me to take you to her palace."
Zhang Fei thought for a moment.
"In that case, I will take care of Gui Ye’s subordinates first, and we will go to your aunt’s palace after that."
"Do you really want to meet my aunt?" Gongsun Jiuxue asked worriedly.
Zhang Fei gave her a light nod.
"Since your aunt wants to capture me, I’ll go meet her in person."
"What if—"
"You don’t have to worry about me, okay?
Your aunt may be a powerful demon god, but she’s still a woman, and her poison doesn’t work on me either."
"Are you going to kill my aunt?"
"Why should I kill a powerful demon god like her?" Zhang Fei turned the question around.
"I didn’t kill Yan Washeng, remember?
Your aunt hasn’t done anything to deserve death, so I won’t kill her, and I just want to talk to her."
Gongsun Jiuxue was relieved to hear that.
"Zhang Fei, my aunt wanted to capture you to fulfill her ambition of getting Mo Qingwen, so—"
"I already knew about your aunt’s feelings for Mo Qingwen, and I guessed from the start that she wanted to capture me.
She wanted to use me to do something to Gu Yanshu, right?"
"That’s right." Gongsun Jiuxue nodded.
"My aunt has been obsessed with Mo Qingwen since they were young, but he disliked her possessive character, so he chose Gu Yanshu as his wife.
Since then, she tried several times to get rid of her, but she never succeeded in doing it.
After she heard the news about you, she got the idea to use you."
"Let’s talk about that later." Zhang Fei looked towards the stairs leading to the third ground floor, seeing two people walking down.
"They move really fast, huh?"
Gongsun Jiuxue also looked in that direction.
"They’re Gui Ye’s direct subordinates, and they’re powerful."
"They may be strong, but I will not be afraid to face them, and this place will be their grave."

chapters.title: Chapter 1793: Defeat And Capture
paragraphs: Dong Xuanyin, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe didn’t care about the arrival of Gui Ye’s two subordinates because Zhang Fei could deal with them himself. Since they needed many demon materials, the four female demon gods focused more on fighting with those mindless demons.
As soon as Zhang Fei informed them about the arrival of Gui Ye’s two subordinates, Mo Luoxie pulled Yuan Xuan and Mo Cangyue into hiding because they were not the two people’s opponents.

At first, Mo Cangyue was worried about Zhang Fei’s safety if he fought with Gui Ye’s two subordinates, but she suddenly remembered his fight against Yan Washeng, and the worry in her heart disappeared by itself.

In another area, Yuan Xiajie looked briefly at Gui Ye’s two subordinates before shaking her head. She felt that the Ghost Demon God was overconfident in the abilities of his subordinates who were clearly below Yan Washeng. Furthermore, she had already witnessed Zhang Fei fighting the two avatars of Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, which were much stronger than all the demon gods in the Myriad Abyss Domain. ’Stupid ghost! He sent his right and left hands to die.’

Zhang Fei looked at the two men and checked their status. "Gui Lan and Gui Zhou, huh? Gui Ye underestimated me by sending two ghost cultivators with cultivations at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm."
"They are Gui Ye’s right and left hands, and they are really powerful."
Zhang Fei looked at Gongsun Jiuxue. "Are they more powerful than Yan Washeng?"
"Of course not! Yan Washeng’s strength is on par with Gui Ye’s."

"Then, why are you so worried about them? Have you forgotten that I defeated Yan Washeng?" Gongsun Jiuxue smiled awkwardly as she just remembered that matter. "Since they are Gui Ye’s right and left hands, his strength will decrease significantly if I kill them, right?"

Gongsun Jiuxue nodded. "If you kill Gui Lan and Gui Zhou, and the other demon gods hear of their deaths, those who hold grudges with Gui Ye will attack him. That’s why I think you shouldn’t kill them, and you should use them to face their leader."
"You’re right." Zhang Fei agreed with Gongsun Jiuxue’s idea. "Let’s wait for them to come to me."

Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin were shocked to see the two men sent by Gui Ye. They knew that these two men were the right and left hands of the Ghost Demon God, and their status was only below him. They hurriedly reported Gui Lan and Gui Zhou’s arrival to their two fathers, and they moved away from the area.

Gui Ting snorted coldly, and she considered Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin to be cowards. She immediately approached Gui Lan and Gui Zhou, pointing her slender finger at Zhang Fei. "He is our target, so you two have to capture him."
"Yes, Princess." Gui Lan and Gui Zhou flew towards Zhang Fei and Gongsun Jiuxue, with Gui Ting following behind them.
When they arrived in front of them, Gui Ting looked at Gongsun Jiuxue and snorted in disdain. "Zhang Fei! You’d better surrender yourself and come with us; otherwise, my two seniors will harm you."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed mockingly. "I’ve met many fools in the past, but I didn’t expect you to be even more foolish than them. Stop barking and attack me now."
"Do you want to interfere in this matter, Xuexue?"
Gongsun Jiuxue shrugged and floated away. "I pity you for your stupidity, Ting."
Gu Ting’s face darkened due to Gongsun Jiuxue’s ridicule, but she refrained from attacking and instead ordered her two seniors. "Capture Zhang Fei now!"
"Yes, Princess."
Gui Lan and Gui Zhou mustered their strength and attacked Zhang Fei using their physical strength, but he easily dodged all their attacks, no matter how fast they attacked him.
In Zhang Fei’s eyes, Gui Lan and Gui Zhou’s physical attacks looked like slow motion because his speed far surpassed theirs, which shocked them.

Gui Ting was also shocked after seeing this, and she instinctively flew away from them. However, she suddenly couldn’t move, and the area around her was sealed. She shivered when she saw the grin on Zhang Fei’s face, and she finally realized that she had foolishly stepped into a trap prepared by him. She tried to contact her father, but the void element cut off her connection with the outside world, preventing her from doing so.
Since they couldn’t attack Zhang Fei using physical attacks, Gui Lan and Gui Zhou summoned two enormous ghosts, whose presence caused the air temperature in that area to drop rapidly.
The two ghosts attacked Zhang Fei as soon as Gui Lan and Gui Zhou ordered, but their movements were too slow due to their size.

Gui Lan and Gui Zhou also attacked Zhang Fei at the same time as the two ghosts, but all their attacks could never hit his body. They tried to restrict his movements with their aura, but something or someone dispelled it, further shocking them.

Chang Qifeng, Zuo Zhenlin, and all the demons present on the floor were stunned to the point of jaw-dropping. They knew that Gui Lan and Gui Zhou were far stronger than Zhang Fei, yet they never landed a hit on him.
"Is this the extent of your abilities? I’m really disappointed!"
Zhang Fei activated soul link to borrow the power of the beasts in the beast space.

Gui Lan and Gui Zhou were shocked once Zhang Fei’s cultivation increased drastically; their bodies trembled as they realized his cultivation had become on par with Gui Ye. Before they could react, he swiftly restricted their movements.
Zhang Fei looked at the two ghosts, stretched his right hand forward, and shot several light bullets at them.
*Roar*
The two ghosts released loud roars before they disappeared; Gui Lan and Gui Zhou spat out quite a lot of blood from their mouths.
Gui Ting, who witnessed that from inside Zhang Fei’s void prison, turned deathly pale.

Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin exchanged glances for a moment, and they immediately flew towards the stairs up to the third ground floor. They were truly shocked by Zhang Fei’s strength, and they were afraid that he would kill them like he killed Yan Tianling, so they decided to run away.
Zhang Fei did not chase Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin because they had not attacked him yet, and his action just now was enough to provide deterrence to Zuo Hentian and Chang Moyu.

In the distance, Mo Cangyue cheered happily while jumping up and down on her spot, as Zhang Fei had already secured his victory. Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan felt relieved after witnessing that, and they informed their parents about the incident.
Yuan Xiajie, Dong Xuanyin, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe did not watch their fight because Zhang Fei’s victory was already guaranteed from the start.
Zhang Fei briefly glanced at Gui Ting before floating in front of Gui Lan and Gui Zhou.

"Your demon god is such an idiot! He already knew that I killed Yan Tianling in front of Yan Washing, and the latter couldn’t stop me, yet he sent you two to me." Gui Lan and Gui Zhou broke out in cold sweat as Zhang Fei pressed both palms onto their chests, and he implanted his demon slave mark into their souls. "Honestly, I want to kill you two, but I still need you to do a few things. From now on, you two are my slaves, and my slave mark will kill you immediately if you even think about betraying me."
Zhang Fei released Gui Lan and Gui Zhou from his restraints, and he floated before Gui Ting, who was terrified of him. He removed the void prison, pulled her forward, and strangled her neck.
"Please... please spare me..." Gui Ting begged with difficulty.
"Why should I spare you?" Zhang Fei smirked. "Hey! I have a lot of male demons under me, and I think you’re pretty enough to serve them."
Gui Ting panicked when she heard that. "No... no... I don’t want to serve your subordinates! I’m... I’m willing to do anything for you, but please don’t send me to your subordinates."
"What can you do for me?" Zhang Fei looked at Gui Ting’s body up and down. "Your face is not as pretty as my wives’, and your figure is just so-so."
Gui Ting was truly afraid that Zhang Fei would hand her over to his subordinates. "Any... anything... I’ll do anything as long as you don’t send me to your subordinates."
"Are you really going to hand her over to your subordinates?" Gongsun Jiuxue felt that Zhang Fei was too cruel to Gui Ting.
Zhang Fei turned to Gongsun Jiuxue. "What do you think?"
"I don’t know." Gongsun Jiuxue looked at Gui Ting with pity. "Why don’t you enslave her? Gui Ye doted on her very much, and you can use her to do something to him."
"Haha! I just wanted to scare her." Then, Zhang Fei asked her. "What if I give her to you as a gift for the beginning of our relationship?"
"Hmm?" Gongsun Jiuxue tilted her head to the side. "Won’t you lose if you give her to me?"

"Not at all." Zhang Fei shook his head. "Her cultivation is quite high, but her demon qi is too weak for a demon of her level. Furthermore, I have too many demon wives, and three of them are demon gods, so I don’t need her."
Gui Ting looked at Gongsun Jiuxue with a pitiful expression, hoping she would accept Zhang Fei’s offer.
Gongsun Jiuxue sighed. "Alright, I will accept her."
"That’s good." Gongsun Jiuxue was shocked as soon as Zhang Fei pulled Gui Ting’s soul out of her body and merged it with his. "Do you have a slave mark?"
