chapters.title: Chapter 1794: Meet Gongsun Zhilan
paragraphs: Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head. "I’ve never used that kind of technique, but I have something else to control her."
Since she had been friends with Gongsun Jiuxue for a long time, Gui Ting naturally knew her methods of controlling someone, and she was truly terrified. "Xuexue, please don’t use—Mhmm!"
Zhang Fei clutched Gui Ting’s face, preventing her from speaking. "What kind of method do you have to control her?"
"I am a venomous woman, remember?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed and pressed his other hand against Gui Ting’s chest, implanting his demon slave mark into her soul.
Gui Ting’s face turned deathly pale, realizing that he had become Zhang Fei’s slave. Her tears streamed down from both eyes, regretting her original arrogance.
"Your turn."
Gongsun Jiuxue nodded, made a small cut on her finger, and forced Gui Ting to suck her blood. She pressed her palm to her chest, chanting words that couldn’t be heard clearly.

Gui Ting truly regretted her previous decision. If only she had listened to Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin, she would never have suffered such a terrible fate. Not only had she become Zhang Fei’s slave, but her life was also now in Gongsun Jiuxue’s hands, which would make her life miserable in the future.
After Gongsun Jiuxue finished, she pulled her finger from Gui Ting’s mouth, and a small purplish-black symbol appeared in the middle of her chest.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei observed the symbol. "What will happen to her?"
Gongsun Jiuxue smiled and explained. "If she thinks about betraying me, this symbol will release venom. The venom will not kill her directly, and her internal organs will die slowly."
"It must be painful, right?"

Gongsun Jiuxue nodded. "It will be extremely painful, and she will die from internal organ failure if she takes the antidote too late. As for the antidote, I am the only person who can make it, and the main ingredient is my blood."
"I think that’s enough." Zhang Fei released Gui Ting and gave her a pill. "Go back and give this pill to your father. When I have time, I will go to your palace to see him."
"Yes... yes..." Gui Ting was truly terrified, and she hurriedly led her father’s right and left hands away.
Gongsun Jiuxue asked Zhang Fei. "Do you want to go see my aunt now?"

Zhang Fei thought for a moment before opening a portal to the training room, surprising Gongsun Jiuxue. She was even more surprised when her clone walked out of it, especially since his cultivation was the same as his real body’s.

Zhang Fei looked at Qi Qingxiu and the others, informing them that he would go with Gongsun Jiuxue to meet Gongsun Zhilan. Mo Cangyue was worried about that, but she didn’t stop him. After all, he had already defeated Yan Washeng, so there was no point in worrying about him.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei opened the gate to the domain, so he and Gongsun Jiuxue didn’t need to exit the dungeon manually.
After they left, Zhang Fei’s clone began hunting infernal demons again, and no demons dared to disturb him after witnessing his previous actions.
"What do you think he will do to Gongsun Zhilan?" Qi Qingxiu asked the others.
Ye Mingran had some guesses. "Everything depends on Gongsun Zhilan."
"If Gongsun Zhilan chooses to become his enemy, she will suffer the same fate as Gui Ting, and her demon race will be under our husband’s control," Dong Xuanyin said.

Nalan Shizhe sighed with a complicated look. "Before he appeared in our realm, I felt my strength as a demon god was almost unmatched. His appearance brought so many changes, and I felt that I had fallen far behind him."

Dong Xuanyin, Qi Qingxiu, and Ye Mingran also felt the same way. However, they didn’t bother with it because they were Zhang Fei’s wives, and they were happy if their husband was much stronger than them.

Thereafter, the four female demon gods continued their hunt for demon materials. They intended to bring members of their race to the Ancient Realm in the future, but their strength wasn’t yet sufficient to compete with the native cultivators of that realm.
"Yan Washeng has fallen, and Gui Ye is next." Mo Luoxie muttered to himself.
Yuan Xuan spoke to her. "You’re wrong, Luoxie. Gongsun Zhilan is also arrogant, remember? Since Zhang Fei said he would meet her, she will most likely be his next target."

"Isn’t that good news?" Mo Cangyue was excited at the thought of Gongsun Zhilan becoming Zhang Fei’s slave like Yan Washeng and Gui Ting. "If he does something to her, our parents won’t have to worry about her anymore, and our lives will be peaceful."

"Yes," Mo Luoxie informed his parents about Zhang Fei’s actions toward Gui Ting and Gui Ye’s right and left hands. He also told them that he went with Gongsun Jiuxue to meet Gongsun Zhilan. "Let’s continue! We can’t do anything to help him with anything else, but we can help him gather demon materials."
"Let’s go, brother!" Mo Cangyue became increasingly enthusiastic about hunting those mindless demons.

Gongsun Jiuxue stared at Zhang Fei in amazement. Gongsun Zhilan’s city and palace were quite far from the dungeon, and it should have taken them a little over a day to get there, but he had brought them there in a matter of seconds. "I really can’t understand you."
"What can’t you understand about me?" Zhang Fei asked with a smile.

Gongsun Jiuxue explained directly. "Your cultivation level is only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, yet your speed surpasses that of all demon gods. Besides, your strengthening technique is truly extraordinary, and your cultivation level is now on par with that of cultivators in the Celestial God Realm."

"Haha," Zhang Fei hugged her waist and kissed her. "Would you believe me if I said that I am the fastest cultivator in this universe? I was mistaken; the fastest cultivators in this universe are actually some of my wives."
"Your wives? Do you mean the three female demon gods?"
"Their speed is much faster than mine, but I have two other wives whose speed is above them."
Gongsun Jiuxue was curious about the identities of the two. From the beginning, she had suspected that Zhang Fei had many wives because he was a lust demon, but he hadn’t revealed their identities.

"Actually, I have over a hundred wives, and I brought some of them to this domain because they are demons." Gongsun Jiuxue was surprised to hear the number of Zhang Fei’s wives, but her face showed no reaction. "The first woman was Feng Yao, and all the demons in this domain knew her as Guang Zhiyi in the past."
Gongsun Jiuxue’s calm expression turned to shock as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned the name. "Are you serious about that? Is Guang Zhiyi really one of your wives?"
"I didn’t lie to you, Jiuxue. Feng Yao is Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, and we met in the Three Mortal Realms."
"The Three Mortal Realms?" Gongsun Jiuxue had heard of the Paradise Realm, but she had never heard of the Three Mortal Realms.

"The Three Mortal Realms are below the Paradise Realm, and the highest cultivation there is the Quasi-Divine Realm." Zhang Fei touched Gongsun Jiuxue’s forehead, sharing Feng Yao’s image when she used Guang Zhiyi’s form in the past. "The second woman is Huo Ling, and she is the flame spirit."

"A flame spirit." Gongsun Zhiyi looked at Feng Yao’s image in her mind, and she finally believed that the woman was Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation. "I often heard that Guang Zhiyi was never close to any men in the past, but her reincarnation became your wife. No wonder you are so powerful even though your cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, and you can even defeat Yan Washeng."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "If it weren’t for Feng Yao, I wouldn’t have known about the Ancient Realm, let alone come here from the Paradise Realm."
Gongsun Jiuxue nodded. "Then, what does Huo Ling look like?"

"What? Why are you curious about me?" Gongsun Jiuxue looked at Huo Ling, who had just emerged from Zhang Fei’s body, in a daze. After all, the flame spirit used Guang Zhiyi’s form as her human form, so she was stunned when she saw her face. "Hey! Why are you stunned?"
Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head. "Your face is identical to Guang Zhiyi, Senior."
"Humph! Guang Zhiyi was my master in the past, and I used her form after I was born." Huo Ling looked at Zhang Fei. "Let’s go; we have to meet Gongsun Zhilan now, husband."
"Alright."
After that, Gongsun Jiuxue led Zhang Fei and Huo Ling to the palace to meet Gongsun Zhilan.
"Are you in there, Aunt?"
Her niece’s voice startled Gongsun Zhilan, who was sitting and reading a scroll.
"Come in, Xuexue."

Gongsun Zhilan froze for a moment, and her gaze focused on Zhang Fei, who was walking beside Gongsun Jiuxue. She raised an eyebrow when she saw Huo Ling on his shoulder, and she couldn’t feel her cultivation.
Huo Ling did not say anything, but her gaze was filled with disdain when she looked at Gongsun Zhilan. She decided to go with Zhang Fei, even though he could defeat the venomous demon god on his own.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei didn’t look at Gongsun Zhilan, preferring to gaze at the gothic interior. He could feel the room filled with a thin, poisonous smoke emanating from her body.
When they arrived in front of Gongsun Zhilan, Gongsun Jiuxue immediately introduced them to her aunt. "This is Zhang Fei, and the woman on his shoulder is his wife, Senior Huo Ling."
"Do you want to be my ally or enemy, Gongsun Zhilan?" Zhang Fei asked without beating around the bush.

sentences.text: Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head.
"I’ve never used that kind of technique, but I have something else to control her."
Since she had been friends with Gongsun Jiuxue for a long time, Gui Ting naturally knew her methods of controlling someone, and she was truly terrified.
"Xuexue, please don’t use—Mhmm!"
Zhang Fei clutched Gui Ting’s face, preventing her from speaking.
"What kind of method do you have to control her?"
"I am a venomous woman, remember?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed and pressed his other hand against Gui Ting’s chest, implanting his demon slave mark into her soul.
Gui Ting’s face turned deathly pale, realizing that he had become Zhang Fei’s slave.
Her tears streamed down from both eyes, regretting her original arrogance.
"Your turn."
Gongsun Jiuxue nodded, made a small cut on her finger, and forced Gui Ting to suck her blood.
She pressed her palm to her chest, chanting words that couldn’t be heard clearly.
Gui Ting truly regretted her previous decision.
If only she had listened to Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin, she would never have suffered such a terrible fate.
Not only had she become Zhang Fei’s slave, but her life was also now in Gongsun Jiuxue’s hands, which would make her life miserable in the future.
After Gongsun Jiuxue finished, she pulled her finger from Gui Ting’s mouth, and a small purplish-black symbol appeared in the middle of her chest.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei observed the symbol.
"What will happen to her?"
Gongsun Jiuxue smiled and explained.
"If she thinks about betraying me, this symbol will release venom.
The venom will not kill her directly, and her internal organs will die slowly."
"It must be painful, right?"
Gongsun Jiuxue nodded.
"It will be extremely painful, and she will die from internal organ failure if she takes the antidote too late.
As for the antidote, I am the only person who can make it, and the main ingredient is my blood."
"I think that’s enough." Zhang Fei released Gui Ting and gave her a pill.
"Go back and give this pill to your father.
When I have time, I will go to your palace to see him."
"Yes... yes..." Gui Ting was truly terrified, and she hurriedly led her father’s right and left hands away.
Gongsun Jiuxue asked Zhang Fei.
"Do you want to go see my aunt now?"
Zhang Fei thought for a moment before opening a portal to the training room, surprising Gongsun Jiuxue.
She was even more surprised when her clone walked out of it, especially since his cultivation was the same as his real body’s.
Zhang Fei looked at Qi Qingxiu and the others, informing them that he would go with Gongsun Jiuxue to meet Gongsun Zhilan.
Mo Cangyue was worried about that, but she didn’t stop him.
After all, he had already defeated Yan Washeng, so there was no point in worrying about him.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei opened the gate to the domain, so he and Gongsun Jiuxue didn’t need to exit the dungeon manually.
After they left, Zhang Fei’s clone began hunting infernal demons again, and no demons dared to disturb him after witnessing his previous actions.
"What do you think he will do to Gongsun Zhilan?" Qi Qingxiu asked the others.
Ye Mingran had some guesses.
"Everything depends on Gongsun Zhilan."
"If Gongsun Zhilan chooses to become his enemy, she will suffer the same fate as Gui Ting, and her demon race will be under our husband’s control," Dong Xuanyin said.
Nalan Shizhe sighed with a complicated look.
"Before he appeared in our realm, I felt my strength as a demon god was almost unmatched.
His appearance brought so many changes, and I felt that I had fallen far behind him."
Dong Xuanyin, Qi Qingxiu, and Ye Mingran also felt the same way.
However, they didn’t bother with it because they were Zhang Fei’s wives, and they were happy if their husband was much stronger than them.
Thereafter, the four female demon gods continued their hunt for demon materials.
They intended to bring members of their race to the Ancient Realm in the future, but their strength wasn’t yet sufficient to compete with the native cultivators of that realm.
"Yan Washeng has fallen, and Gui Ye is next." Mo Luoxie muttered to himself.
Yuan Xuan spoke to her.
"You’re wrong, Luoxie.
Gongsun Zhilan is also arrogant, remember?
Since Zhang Fei said he would meet her, she will most likely be his next target."
"Isn’t that good news?" Mo Cangyue was excited at the thought of Gongsun Zhilan becoming Zhang Fei’s slave like Yan Washeng and Gui Ting.
"If he does something to her, our parents won’t have to worry about her anymore, and our lives will be peaceful."
"Yes," Mo Luoxie informed his parents about Zhang Fei’s actions toward Gui Ting and Gui Ye’s right and left hands.
He also told them that he went with Gongsun Jiuxue to meet Gongsun Zhilan.
"Let’s continue!
We can’t do anything to help him with anything else, but we can help him gather demon materials."
"Let’s go, brother!" Mo Cangyue became increasingly enthusiastic about hunting those mindless demons.
Gongsun Jiuxue stared at Zhang Fei in amazement.
Gongsun Zhilan’s city and palace were quite far from the dungeon, and it should have taken them a little over a day to get there, but he had brought them there in a matter of seconds.
"I really can’t understand you."
"What can’t you understand about me?" Zhang Fei asked with a smile.
Gongsun Jiuxue explained directly.
"Your cultivation level is only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, yet your speed surpasses that of all demon gods.
Besides, your strengthening technique is truly extraordinary, and your cultivation level is now on par with that of cultivators in the Celestial God Realm."
"Haha," Zhang Fei hugged her waist and kissed her.
"Would you believe me if I said that I am the fastest cultivator in this universe?
I was mistaken; the fastest cultivators in this universe are actually some of my wives."
"Your wives?
Do you mean the three female demon gods?"
"Their speed is much faster than mine, but I have two other wives whose speed is above them."
Gongsun Jiuxue was curious about the identities of the two.
From the beginning, she had suspected that Zhang Fei had many wives because he was a lust demon, but he hadn’t revealed their identities.

"Actually, I have over a hundred wives, and I brought some of them to this domain because they are demons." Gongsun Jiuxue was surprised to hear the number of Zhang Fei’s wives, but her face showed no reaction.
"The first woman was Feng Yao, and all the demons in this domain knew her as Guang Zhiyi in the past."
Gongsun Jiuxue’s calm expression turned to shock as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned the name.
"Are you serious about that?
Is Guang Zhiyi really one of your wives?"
"I didn’t lie to you, Jiuxue.
Feng Yao is Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, and we met in the Three Mortal Realms."
"The Three Mortal Realms?" Gongsun Jiuxue had heard of the Paradise Realm, but she had never heard of the Three Mortal Realms.

"The Three Mortal Realms are below the Paradise Realm, and the highest cultivation there is the Quasi-Divine Realm." Zhang Fei touched Gongsun Jiuxue’s forehead, sharing Feng Yao’s image when she used Guang Zhiyi’s form in the past.
"The second woman is Huo Ling, and she is the flame spirit."
"A flame spirit." Gongsun Zhiyi looked at Feng Yao’s image in her mind, and she finally believed that the woman was Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation.
"I often heard that Guang Zhiyi was never close to any men in the past, but her reincarnation became your wife.
No wonder you are so powerful even though your cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, and you can even defeat Yan Washeng."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"If it weren’t for Feng Yao, I wouldn’t have known about the Ancient Realm, let alone come here from the Paradise Realm."
Gongsun Jiuxue nodded.
"Then, what does Huo Ling look like?"
"What?
Why are you curious about me?" Gongsun Jiuxue looked at Huo Ling, who had just emerged from Zhang Fei’s body, in a daze.
After all, the flame spirit used Guang Zhiyi’s form as her human form, so she was stunned when she saw her face.
"Hey!
Why are you stunned?"
Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head.
"Your face is identical to Guang Zhiyi, Senior."
"Humph!
Guang Zhiyi was my master in the past, and I used her form after I was born." Huo Ling looked at Zhang Fei.
"Let’s go; we have to meet Gongsun Zhilan now, husband."
"Alright."
After that, Gongsun Jiuxue led Zhang Fei and Huo Ling to the palace to meet Gongsun Zhilan.
"Are you in there, Aunt?"
Her niece’s voice startled Gongsun Zhilan, who was sitting and reading a scroll.
"Come in, Xuexue."
Gongsun Zhilan froze for a moment, and her gaze focused on Zhang Fei, who was walking beside Gongsun Jiuxue.
She raised an eyebrow when she saw Huo Ling on his shoulder, and she couldn’t feel her cultivation.
Huo Ling did not say anything, but her gaze was filled with disdain when she looked at Gongsun Zhilan.
She decided to go with Zhang Fei, even though he could defeat the venomous demon god on his own.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei didn’t look at Gongsun Zhilan, preferring to gaze at the gothic interior.
He could feel the room filled with a thin, poisonous smoke emanating from her body.
When they arrived in front of Gongsun Zhilan, Gongsun Jiuxue immediately introduced them to her aunt.
"This is Zhang Fei, and the woman on his shoulder is his wife, Senior Huo Ling."
"Do you want to be my ally or enemy, Gongsun Zhilan?" Zhang Fei asked without beating around the bush.

chapters.title: Chapter 1795: Gongsun Zhilan’s Choice
paragraphs: Gongsun Zhilan rolled up the scroll and placed it on the table. She wanted to beat Zhang Fei up for speaking like that to her, but she canceled her intention because of Huo Ling’s presence.

Gongsun Zhilan’s heart trembled after she realized that Zhang Fei was unaffected by the poisonous smoke leaking from her body. Although the poison wasn’t deadly, it should have been enough to weaken him, but he showed no signs of weakening.

Gongsun Zhilan calmed herself and spoke, "Aren’t you being too arrogant? I know you did something to Yan Washeng before, which is why he didn’t dare to say anything about you. If my guess is correct, that woman on your shoulder helped you do that to him, right?"

"You are mistaken in distinguishing between arrogance and confidence. The dead Yan Tianling was arrogant, but he didn’t have sufficient strength to back up his arrogance, and he ended up dying by my hands. As for me, I am confident in my strength, which is why I dared to come here to see you." Gongsun Zhilan glanced at the flame spirit, but Huo Ling responded with a look of scorn and condescension. "By the way, I don’t need Ling’er’s help to deal with Yan Washeng, and I can do whatever I want with him. The purpose of my coming to see you today is because I want to confirm whether you will choose to be my ally or my enemy, and I will leave after you give me your answer."

At first, Gongsun Zhilan was confident that she could suppress Zhang Fei and use him to her advantage, but her confidence wavered because he was not affected by her poisonous smoke, coupled with the presence of Huo Ling by his side.
Gongsun Zhilan fell into deep thought; her eyes moved between Zhang Fei and Huo Ling. "What do I gain if I become your ally? What will I lose if I become your enemy?"
"I won’t talk about the benefits first." Zhang Fei paused and stared at her. "If you choose to be my enemy, you will be my servant for the rest of your life."

Gongsun Zhilan was furious upon hearing Zhang Fei’s last sentence. She was a powerful demon god, yet he dared to say that he would make her a servant for the rest of her life. "Hahaha! In my entire life, I have never met an arrogant braggart like you! I don’t believe you can defeat Yan Washeng with your current cultivation level, and I rather believe the woman on your shoulder will help you with that."

"Ling’er, please step back, and you don’t need to interfere in our affairs." Huo Ling snorted disdainfully at Gongsun Zhilan before entering Zhang Fei’s body. "Do you really think that I can’t do anything without Ling’er’s help?"

"Heh!" Gongsun Zhilan snorted and released her aura to suppress Zhang Fei. To her shock, he didn’t fall to the floor, but instead, he looked at her with a relaxed smile. She abruptly rose to her feet and stared at him with trembling eyes. "Impossible! How can you withstand my pressure from my aura?"
"I told you before that I don’t need Ling’er’s help to fight Yan Washeng, but you were too arrogant and underestimated me."

Gongsun Zhilan’s eyes widened in shock as soon as Zhang Fei revealed his cultivation in the Celestial God Realm. She staggered backwards; her chair fell backwards because of it. "How... how is this possible? You... you must have used strengthening techniques, right?"

"That’s right," Zhang Fei answered frankly. "Although this is not my original strength, it is more than enough to defeat Yan Washeng. You are stronger than him, but the difference in strength between the two of you is not that great. Since I can defeat him, I can defeat you too."

Gongsun Zhilan became even more furious when she heard that; she stretched her right hand forward. A dark green liquid shot out from her fingers and entered Zhang Fei’s body. "Heh! Do you think I can’t do anything to you? You may be immune to my poisonous smoke, but my heart dominion poison is different, and it will corrupt your heart until you submit it to me."
"Heh." Zhang Fei looked at Gongsun Jiuxue, who had been silent all this time. "Xuexue, your aunt brags too much about her poison. What do you think I should do to her?"
Gongsun Zhilan frowned and looked at her niece. "Don’t tell me that you have fallen for this man, Xuexue."
"Aunt Zhilan, I’ve decided to be Zhang Fei’s woman." Gongsun Jiuxue’s confession caught Gongsun Zhilan off guard. "He is the only man immune to my poison."
"What?" Gongsun Zhilan exclaimed in shock. "What did you say? He’s immune to your poison?"
"He—" Zhang Fei hugged Gongsun Jiuxue’s waist, pulled her closer, and kissed her in front of Gongsun Zhilan’s eyes.

Gongsun Zhilan was completely shocked when she saw that. Although Gongsun Jiuxue’s poison wasn’t as potent as hers, it was powerful enough to kill a cultivator of Zhang Fei’s level, yet he dared to kiss her niece.
Gongsun Jiuxue didn’t feel embarrassed about kissing in front of her aunt; instead, she wrapped her arms around Zhang Fei’s neck and kissed him back.

"How... how is this possible?" Gongsun Zhilan muttered in shock because she didn’t see any changes in Zhang Fei’s body, which meant her niece’s poison didn’t work on him. "Is... is he really immune to her poison?"

After a few minutes, Zhang Fei stopped kissing Gongsun Jiuxue and looked at Gongsun Zhilan. "Do you still believe your heart dominion poison will work on me? If you still don’t believe me, I’ll prove it to you another way."

"What—" Gongsun Zhilan was shocked when she felt her body immobilized, and she immediately realized that Zhang Fei had restricted her movements. She couldn’t react when he moved in front of her, hugged her waist, and sealed her lips. ’Damn it! I had kept my first kiss for so long, and I wanted to give it to Mo Qingwen, but this brat stole it.’

Gongsun Jiuxue couldn’t help shaking her head, but she didn’t disturb them and sat down on the chair in front of the table. She knew her aunt repeatedly rejected other demon gods’ marriage proposals because she only loved Mo Qingwen, but Zhang Fei suddenly acted like a rogue and stole her kiss.

Gongsun Zhilan’s lust suddenly ignited, and she realized that Zhang Fei had used his lust demon abilities on her. Although her body couldn’t move, she could still use her poison, and she injected some of the poison inside her body into his body through their mouths. ’Damn! I will definitely kill this brat!’
Unfortunately, Gongsun Zhilan’s attempt to poison Zhang Fei was in vain due to his poison immunity, and he used the opportunity to insert his tongue into her mouth.

Zhang Fei’s aggressive kiss made Gongsun Zhilan’s head spin, intensifying her lust. Even though she resisted his kiss at first, she slowly began to enjoy it as her lust burned more and more. She closed her eyes and enjoyed his slow, deep kiss.

Zhang Fei smiled in his heart, and he took advantage of the situation by pulling Gongsun Zhilan’s soul out of her body before duplicating it. He merged her duplicated soul with his, allowing him to control her without using his demon slave mark.

Gongsun Zhilan was still unaware of Zhang Fei’s actions, but Gongsun Jiuxue witnessed it and sighed in her heart. ’This way, my aunt is already under his control, and she won’t be able to do anything to him.’
Gongsun Zhilan opened her eyes after Zhang Fei stopped their kiss, which made her feel like she had lost the sensation of their kiss.

"Why are you looking at me like that? Do you want me to kiss you again?" Zhang Fei didn’t wait for Gongsun Zhilan’s answer and kissed her again, but he only gave her a brief kiss before removing his restriction from her.

"You bastard!" Gongsun Zhilan tried to strangle Zhang Fei’s neck, but he swiftly grabbed both of her hands. He reversed their positions, forced her to lie on the table, and pressed her lower body with his. "Let me go! From today onwards, you are my eternal enemy, and I will do anything to kill you!"
"Haha," Zhang Fei softly laughed. "You can’t even free yourself from me, yet you want to kill me. Isn’t that ridiculous?"
"You—" Gongsun Zhilan wanted to shout at Zhang Fei, but she stopped when he showed her six pills. "Superior... superior grade pills!"

Zhang Fei smirked. "Five of them are basic pills, but their effects are much stronger than other pills. The sixth pill is the Yin Purifying Pill, and the Yin Qi in your body will become two times purer after you swallow it. I know that pills are extremely rare in this domain because there are no alchemists here, and you guys have to go to other domains to buy them. As for me, I am an alchemist, and my alchemist rank has long reached the god rank. Thus, you should already know the benefits of becoming my ally, right?"
"Are... are you really an alchemy god?" Gongsun Zhilan asked in shock and excitement.
Zhang Fei released Gongsun Zhilan, lifted her chair, and sat down. He took out his alchemy badge and showed it to her. "Do you still doubt me?"
"No," Gongsun Zhilan shook her head, and her expression softened after learning that Zhang Fei was an alchemy god. "What are the benefits of your five basic pills?"

Zhang Fei explained to Gongsun Zhilan the names and effects of each pill, which brightened her eyes. He grabbed her hand and placed the pills in her palm. "You can swallow them now, and I will give you more beneficial pills if you are loyal to me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1796: Zhang Fei Giving Task
paragraphs: Zhang Fei sat on a chair with Gongsun Jiuxue on his lap, both of them watching Gongsun Zhilan swallow the pills.
Gongsun Jiuxue turned to him. "I originally thought you were going to use your demon slave mark on her, but it turned out you only duplicated her soul."

"Even if I don’t use my demon slave mark on your aunt, she can’t defy my orders, and she will obey me for the rest of her life." Gongsun Jiuxue was curious about Zhang Fei’s technique because no demon had mastered it before. "My technique is not a demon technique but a soul technique, and I am a soul cultivator, with my soul level being at the perfection stage of the divine soul level."

"Huh?" Gongsun Jiuxue was shocked because Zhang Fei’s level had already reached its maximum at such a young age. "How is it possible that your soul level has reached such a maximum level with your current age?"
"Maximum level?"
"Isn’t the divine soul the maximum level in soul cultivation?"
"Oh! I forgot that you also a soul cultivator, and your soul level is at the intermediate stage of the saint soul level."
"My soul level reached this stage a hundred years ago, and it couldn’t break through again after that."
Zhang Fei patted Gongsun Jiuxue’s head. "After this, you should follow me, and I will help you to improve your soul power."
Gongsun Jiuxue smiled as she nodded. "Alright, I will follow you."
"Do you really not mind the number of my wives?"

"No," Gongsun Jiuxue shook her head. "Previously, no living creature could withstand the effects of my poisonous body, but now I’ve found you. As long as I can be with you, I don’t mind the number of your wives."
Zhang Fei rubbed his chin. "All living creatures will die because of your poisonous body, huh?"

"Yes," Gongsun Jiuxue nodded seriously. "As long as I don’t touch them, they won’t die. My aunt taught me how to control the poison in my body, but it’s completely useless, and they’ll die a horrible death if I touch them."
Zhang Fei felt a little sorry for Gongsun Jiuxue. "Don’t worry, okay? You have me now, and I will make your life more colorful in the future."
"Hehe," Gongsun Jiuxue rested her head on his shoulders. "I’m really happy to meet you."
Zhang Fei looked at Gongsun Zhilan, who had just opened her eyes. "How do you feel after swallowing all my pills?"

"I’ve taken basic pills in the past, but their effects weren’t as good as yours." Gongsun Zhilan got up from the chair. "My Qi absorption speed, bones, meridians, dantian, soul, and yin qi have become much stronger than before."

Zhang Fei shifted Gongsun Jiuxue to the side and stood up. He pulled Gongsun Zhilan into his arms and kissed her, leaving her stunned and angry. "Haha! You don’t have to look at me like that, right? I know you love Mo Qingwen, but you’re mine now, so you should forget about him."
"Humph!" Gongsun Zhilan snorted. "I am not yours, and I will snatch Mo Qingwen from that bitch in the future."
Zhang Fei’s face darkened upon hearing that. He restricted Gongsun Zhilan’s movement, laid her on her stomach, and spanked her buttocks.
*Smack*
"Ahh!" Gongsun Zhilan screamed loudly. "What are you doing? Why are you—Ahh!"
*Smack*
"Stop—Ahh!"

Gongsun Jiuxue covered her mouth to suppress her laughter; she didn’t expect Zhang Fei to treat her arrogant aunt like that. ’If her subordinates see my aunt’s situation, they will probably die of shock.’
*Smack*
"Ahh! You bastard!" Gongsun Zhilan’s face turned red and black with shame and anger. "Stop! Please stop!"
"Humph!" Zhang Fei smacked Gongsun Zhilan a few more times before letting go of her.

Gongsun Zhilan rubbed her buttocks as she stared at Zhang Fei with hatred and shame. She was a demon god, and she led so many members of her race, but he treated her like a child. Worse, she couldn’t fight him back, and she could only surrender helplessly when he smacked her buttocks.

"I have some tasks for you." Gongsun Zhilan wanted to refuse, but Zhang Fei directly handed over two bottles. "The white bottle contains the Core Refining Pill and the True Dantian Pill; you must swallow both after this."
"What are the effects of the two pills?"

"One pill will enhance the purity and density of your cultivation core, and the other will expand the dantian, allowing you to store more qi." Gongsun Zhilan’s eyes brightened after hearing the effects of the two pills. "I’m giving them both to you now because you can only swallow them after you swallow my basic pills."
"Then, what’s in the red bottle?"
"The Heart-Rupturing Pill."
"What effect does the pill have?"

"One will suffer from the pain of one’s heart breaking for six hours each day after consuming it. Each time the effect occurs, it will become even stronger, and the effect will not disappear without my antidote." Gongsun Zhilan broke out in a cold sweat imagining her fate if Zhang Fei forced her to swallow the Heart-Rupturing Pill. "There are two pills inside, and I want you to give them to Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui."

"Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui? Have you met them before?" Gongsun Zhilan remembered that Zhang Fei had arrived in their domain not long ago, and he had gone straight to the dungeon, so he shouldn’t have met the two men yet.
Zhang Fei shook his head. "Gui Ting told them about my two wives, and they might be targeting them in the future, so I have to take precautions against them."
"Why do you think that they would target your two wives?"

Zhang Fei explained directly. "There are the Soul-Devouring Demon God and the Eternal Night Demon God by my side. Since you are a demon god like them, you should already understand my reasons, right?"
"I heard from Xuexue that you have four demon gods as your wives, but I didn’t expect that two of them would be the Soul-Devouring Demon God and the Eternal Night Demon God."
"You’re wrong about that."
"Hmm?"
"The Eternal Night Demon God is my wife, but the Soul-Devouring Demon God is my mother-in-law. The other two are my wives; one is the Seven Emotions Demon God, and the other one is a demon beast."

"The Seven Emotions Demon God," Gongsun Zhilan muttered in shock. "The Seven Emotions Demon Race used to exist in this domain, but they suddenly disappeared. I thought they were extinct long ago, but it turns out they are still alive, and their demon god became your wife."

"I’ve heard about her race from Hua Qianmei." Gongsun Zhilan was furious as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned the woman. "I still have to search for demon materials to upgrade my wives’ demon rank, so I don’t have time to take care of Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui. Thus, I want you to give those two pills to them, and I will give you other useful pills after you succeed."

"Fine! I’ll find a way to get them to swallow your pills, and I’ll contact you once I succeed." Gongsun Zhilan was irritated by that. She was a demon god, yet Zhang Fei ordered her around like an errand. "Where do you actually live?"

"I don’t have a permanent residence in this domain yet, and I’m more focused on looking for those demon materials." Gongsun Zhilan did not believe Zhang Fei, and she suspected that he lived in Hua Qianmei’s city. "If you already know that, why do you have to ask me?"
"Huh?" Gongsun Zhilan was confused by this. "What do you mean?"
"Didn’t you think I lived in Hua Qianmei’s city?" Gongsun Zhilan was confused about how Zhang Fei knew what was on her mind. "Just say I can read your mind, so you won’t be able to lie to me."
"Tch!" Gongsun Zhilan gnashed her teeth in annoyance.

Zhang Fei chuckled and kissed Gongsun Zhilan again before lifting Gongsun Jiuxue to her feet. "I’ll take your niece with me, and you must inform me after you give the two pills to Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui."
"Aunt, I’ll go with Zhang Fei now, and you can contact me if you need any help," Gongsun Jiuxue said.

Gongsun Zhilan inwardly sighed, not expecting that her niece would fall into the arms of the scoundrel. If she fell for him too, it would mean she would have to share her husband with her niece. "Alright! You two can go now, and I will contact you if I need your help."

After Zhang Fei took Gongsun Jiuxue away, Gongsun Zhilan sat in her chair and contacted Hua Qianmei, but the Bewitching Demon God didn’t reply to her message. "Could it be that woman also fell for that scoundrel?"

As soon as Gongsun Jiuxue walked out of the portal, she saw dozens of female demons cultivating in that place. She looked at Zhang Fei [5], who was helping some of them with dual soul cultivation. "How many clones does he actually have?"
"Five." Gongsun Jiuxue looked at Mo Zainan. "You must be his new woman, right?"
"Yes," Gongsun Jiuxue shamelessly admitted. "If I’m not mistaken, you are a Celestial Demon, right?"
Mo Zainan nodded. "I am indeed a Celestial Demon, and he brought me from the Paradise Realm. By the way, he’s still busy helping the others, so you should wait for them to finish."
"I have no problem with that." Gongsun Jiuxue sat beside Mo Zainan. "Please tell me more about him and the identities of these women."
"Alright."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had returned to the fourth ground floor of the dungeon because his clone had to continue absorbing yin qi from the female yin demon.
"What about your business with Gongsun Zhilan, Zhang Fei?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1797: Toward The Fifth Ground Floor
paragraphs: Zhang Fei looked at Mo Cangyue and explained to her about Gongsun Zhilan, which caused her eyes to brighten. "From now on, she won’t bother your parents anymore, so they can live peacefully without her interference."

"Haha," Mo Cangyue laughed heartily. "Gongsun Zhilan finally has her day! She’s been eyeing my father for thousands of years, but her efforts were never successful because my father only loved my mother, and she ultimately fell into your arms."

Zhang Fei smiled amusedly seeing Mo Cangyue excited like a little girl. "Honestly, I did that to Gongsun Zhilan not because of your parents but for the sake of me and all my wives. Since she targeted me and wanted to capture me, I had to do something to her so she wouldn’t bring trouble to me in the future. By the way, there are no threats on this floor, so I will go down to the fifth ground floor to look for the Abyssal Demon Heart and the Demon Ritual Sigil."
"What about the Infernal Blood Core and the Demon Essence Drop?"
Zhang Fei pointed to Qi Qingxiu and the other three women, who were hunting the mindless demons in another area. "Each of them can defeat those demons easily, so I don’t need to worry about that."

"In that case, Yuan Xiajie and I will accompany you to the fifth ground floor." Mo Cangyue decided on the spot. "My brother and Yuan Xuan will help the four of them search for the Infernal Blood Core and the Demon Essence Drop, so we can collect everything more quickly, and all your demon wives can upgrade their demon ranks."
Zhang Fei looked at Mo Cangyue with a strange gaze. "Hey! Don’t tell me that you’ve fallen in love with me, little princess."

"Of course not!" Mo Cangyue refuted in a loud voice. "I already told you that I don’t like men, and I only like Yuan Xiajie, so I would never be interested in you. Although you said that your actions against Gonsun Zhiyan were for the sake of yourself and all your wives, it was also a blessing for my parents, so I will repay your kindness by helping you find those two demon materials."
Zhang Fei did not press further and walked towards the stairs down to the fifth ground floor, followed by Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie.

Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan looked at their backs while thinking about Mo Cangyue’s expression just now. Her expression clearly showed that her feelings had undergone subtle changes, and she subconsciously began to have feelings for Zhang Fei.
Mo Luoxie contacted his parents and informed them about Zhang Fei’s action against Gongsun Zhilan, which surprised Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu. "Let’s continue, Xuan."
"Alright." Since Qi Qingxiu and the three female demons were also hunting on that floor, Mo Luoxie and Yuan Xuan hunted in another area so they wouldn’t cross paths.
After they arrived at the fifth ground floor, Huo Ling emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "Follow me, husband."
"To that place?"
"Yes!"
"Alright." Huo Ling led Zhang Fei to the place Feng Yao had indicated, which was the secret passage to the sixth ground floor.
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie exchanged confused glances for a moment, and then they followed Zhang Fei and Huo Ling.
Soon, they arrived at the south-left corner of the floor, but Zhang Fei, Mo Cangyue, and Yuan Xiajie couldn’t see anything other than stone walls.
"Is there something special in this place, Sister Ling?" Yuan Xiajie asked.
"Do you two know there is a secret in this dungeon?"

"A secret?" Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie thought for a moment before shaking their heads. Let alone the two of them, even demon gods like Mo Qingwen and Hua Qianmei didn’t know anything about the secrets in the dungeon.

Huo Ling spread her senses throughout the entire area of the floor, and she withdrew them after confirming that there were no other demons besides those mindless demons there. "In fact, this dungeon is a prison, and there is another floor below this floor."
"What?"
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie cried out in shock.
"Is this dungeon really a prison, Senior Ling?"
"Who are the people imprisoned in this dungeon, Sister Ling?"
"They are the strongest ancient demons in the Ancient Realm, and they have lived since this realm first existed." Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie gasped in shock. "Their names are Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin."
"How come we’ve never heard of their names?" Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie asked in unison.

"Actually, no one from the current ancient races knows about them, and the people who knew their identities died long ago without leaving any records about them." Huo Ling explained to Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie about the war that occurred in the past, which was the war between the ancient demons and the ancients of the other races. "After imprisoning the two demons in this dungeon, they erased their names from history. In fact, those mindless demons were their past subordinates, and the Samsara Binding Formation in this dungeon caused them to lose their consciousness."
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie took a deep breath; they didn’t expect that their domain held the lost history of the two ancient demons.
"Since the ancients of the other races couldn’t kill Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin, that means they were both more powerful than them, right?"

Huo Ling nodded. "Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin were simply too powerful for them, so they couldn’t kill them. They built this dungeon to imprison them and erase their existence from the Ancient Realm. Even though they had been imprisoned on the sixth ground floor for so long, they were still alive to this day. If they were to break free, no cultivator in this realm would be able to stop them."
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie swallowed their saliva. "What are we going to do now?"
"You two should wait here, and I will bring my husband to see them."
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie were curious about Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin, but they were aware of their strength, and they were not sure they could survive under the pressure of the two ancient demons.
Huo Ling held Zhang Fei’s hand, pulled him forward, and disappeared into the wall.
Mo Cangyue looked at Yuan Xiajie. "Do they want to free the two ancient demons?"

"Sister Ling and Zhang Fei wouldn’t be so careless as to release them." Yuan Xiajie thought of several possibilities in his mind. "If my guess is correct, she just wants to take him to see them for now, so he can measure their strength. I’m sure that he will conquer them in the future, and they will become additional ammunition for him."

Mo Cangyue could more or less grasp Yuan Xiajie’s meaning. "They’ll probably be in there for a while, so we shouldn’t waste time waiting for them; instead, we should help Zhang Fei search for those two demon materials."
"Sister Cangyue."
"Yes?"
"Are you starting to have feelings for Zhang Fei?"
Mo Cangyue wrinkled her brows. "Why do you ask that, Xiajie? Don’t you know that I’ve never liked men?"

"You can lie to others, but you can’t lie to me." Mo Cangyue turned her head to the side, uncomfortable by Yuan Xiajie’s intense gaze. "See? My guess was right that you have started to have feelings for Zhang Fei. Is it because you feel that he is different from other men?"

Mo Cangyue sighed and nodded. "In my entire life, no man has dared to insult me, but Zhang Fei repeatedly insulted me. At first, I was frustrated because of it, but my feelings began to change after I witnessed all his actions, especially those toward Yan Tianling and Yan Washeng. Compared to people of my generation and my father’s generation, he was far more capable than them. Even so, I haven’t fallen in love with him, and I only admire him."
"I see." Yuan Xiajie put her arm around Mo Cangyue’s shoulder. "The more time you spend with him, the stronger your feelings will become, and you will eventually fall in love with him."

"Even though I admire him, I wouldn’t fall in love with him that easily. For me, relationships between women are much more thrilling." Mo Cangyue faced Yuan Xiajie and kissed her. "I know you love Hua Qianmei, but you are my first love, and you will always be in my heart."

Yuan Xiajie smiled awkwardly. "Actually, I love you too, Sister Cangyue. When Big Sister Qianmei first brought me to this domain, I didn’t have a single friend, and I always spent my time with her. You were my first friend in this domain, and you always made time for me. If I didn’t have feelings for you, I would never have spent time with you."

"Hehe," Mo Cangyue giggled. "I’m glad to hear that, Xiajie. By the way, don’t say anything to Zhang Fei about my feelings, okay? If I really fall in love with him in the future, I will meet him and confess my feelings to him."
Yuan Xiajie nodded. "My mouth is sealed, Sister Cangyue."
"Let’s hunt those mindless demons."
"Alright."
Unlike the five floors above, the path to the sixth ground floor was very long, and Zhang Fei could see many symbols on the walls on both sides.

"These symbols are written in an ancient language, and they are used to suppress the power of the two ancient demons." Zhang Fei nodded to Huo Ling, but he didn’t feel any pressure from those symbols. "Normally, all demons who enter that place will experience suppression, but you are different from other demons. You are essentially human, and you have multiple identities due to Xuanyuan Yue’s past actions, so these symbols are useless against you."
"Are we still far from the bottom?"

"Alright." Huo Ling led Zhang Fei to the place Feng Yao had indicated, which was the secret passage to the sixth ground floor.
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie exchanged confused glances for a moment, and then they followed Zhang Fei and Huo Ling.
Soon, they arrived at the south-left corner of the floor, but Zhang Fei, Mo Cangyue, and Yuan Xiajie couldn’t see anything other than stone walls.
"Is there something special in this place, Sister Ling?" Yuan Xiajie asked.
"Do you two know there is a secret in this dungeon?"
"A secret?" Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie thought for a moment before shaking their heads.
Let alone the two of them, even demon gods like Mo Qingwen and Hua Qianmei didn’t know anything about the secrets in the dungeon.
Huo Ling spread her senses throughout the entire area of the floor, and she withdrew them after confirming that there were no other demons besides those mindless demons there.
"In fact, this dungeon is a prison, and there is another floor below this floor."
"What?"
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie cried out in shock.
"Is this dungeon really a prison, Senior Ling?"
"Who are the people imprisoned in this dungeon, Sister Ling?"
"They are the strongest ancient demons in the Ancient Realm, and they have lived since this realm first existed." Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie gasped in shock.
"Their names are Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin."
"How come we’ve never heard of their names?" Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie asked in unison.

"Actually, no one from the current ancient races knows about them, and the people who knew their identities died long ago without leaving any records about them." Huo Ling explained to Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie about the war that occurred in the past, which was the war between the ancient demons and the ancients of the other races.
"After imprisoning the two demons in this dungeon, they erased their names from history.
In fact, those mindless demons were their past subordinates, and the Samsara Binding Formation in this dungeon caused them to lose their consciousness."
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie took a deep breath; they didn’t expect that their domain held the lost history of the two ancient demons.
"Since the ancients of the other races couldn’t kill Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin, that means they were both more powerful than them, right?"
Huo Ling nodded.
"Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin were simply too powerful for them, so they couldn’t kill them.
They built this dungeon to imprison them and erase their existence from the Ancient Realm.
Even though they had been imprisoned on the sixth ground floor for so long, they were still alive to this day.
If they were to break free, no cultivator in this realm would be able to stop them."
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie swallowed their saliva.
"What are we going to do now?"
"You two should wait here, and I will bring my husband to see them."
Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie were curious about Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin, but they were aware of their strength, and they were not sure they could survive under the pressure of the two ancient demons.
Huo Ling held Zhang Fei’s hand, pulled him forward, and disappeared into the wall.
Mo Cangyue looked at Yuan Xiajie.
"Do they want to free the two ancient demons?"
"Sister Ling and Zhang Fei wouldn’t be so careless as to release them." Yuan Xiajie thought of several possibilities in his mind.
"If my guess is correct, she just wants to take him to see them for now, so he can measure their strength.
I’m sure that he will conquer them in the future, and they will become additional ammunition for him."
Mo Cangyue could more or less grasp Yuan Xiajie’s meaning.
"They’ll probably be in there for a while, so we shouldn’t waste time waiting for them; instead, we should help Zhang Fei search for those two demon materials."
"Sister Cangyue."
"Yes?"
"Are you starting to have feelings for Zhang Fei?"
Mo Cangyue wrinkled her brows.
"Why do you ask that, Xiajie?
Don’t you know that I’ve never liked men?"
"You can lie to others, but you can’t lie to me." Mo Cangyue turned her head to the side, uncomfortable by Yuan Xiajie’s intense gaze.
"See?
My guess was right that you have started to have feelings for Zhang Fei.
Is it because you feel that he is different from other men?"
Mo Cangyue sighed and nodded.
"In my entire life, no man has dared to insult me, but Zhang Fei repeatedly insulted me.
At first, I was frustrated because of it, but my feelings began to change after I witnessed all his actions, especially those toward Yan Tianling and Yan Washeng.
Compared to people of my generation and my father’s generation, he was far more capable than them.
Even so, I haven’t fallen in love with him, and I only admire him."
"I see." Yuan Xiajie put her arm around Mo Cangyue’s shoulder.
"The more time you spend with him, the stronger your feelings will become, and you will eventually fall in love with him."
"Even though I admire him, I wouldn’t fall in love with him that easily.
For me, relationships between women are much more thrilling." Mo Cangyue faced Yuan Xiajie and kissed her.
"I know you love Hua Qianmei, but you are my first love, and you will always be in my heart."
Yuan Xiajie smiled awkwardly.
"Actually, I love you too, Sister Cangyue.
When Big Sister Qianmei first brought me to this domain, I didn’t have a single friend, and I always spent my time with her.
You were my first friend in this domain, and you always made time for me.
If I didn’t have feelings for you, I would never have spent time with you."
"Hehe," Mo Cangyue giggled.
"I’m glad to hear that, Xiajie.
By the way, don’t say anything to Zhang Fei about my feelings, okay?
If I really fall in love with him in the future, I will meet him and confess my feelings to him."
Yuan Xiajie nodded.
"My mouth is sealed, Sister Cangyue."
"Let’s hunt those mindless demons."
"Alright."
Unlike the five floors above, the path to the sixth ground floor was very long, and Zhang Fei could see many symbols on the walls on both sides.

"These symbols are written in an ancient language, and they are used to suppress the power of the two ancient demons." Zhang Fei nodded to Huo Ling, but he didn’t feel any pressure from those symbols.
"Normally, all demons who enter that place will experience suppression, but you are different from other demons.
You are essentially human, and you have multiple identities due to Xuanyuan Yue’s past actions, so these symbols are useless against you."
"Are we still far from the bottom?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1798: Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin
paragraphs: When they arrived at the entrance to the sixth ground floor, Zhang Fei had difficulty breathing due to the fierce aura of the two ancient demons. He had faced many powerful cultivators, including the two avatars of Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi.
Zhang Fei felt no fear when he faced the two avatars of Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, but the aura of Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin frightened him.

When he met Yuan Xiajie in the past, Zhang Fei was also terrified of her, and his fear lasted for years until their last meeting. However, his fear back then was different from what he experienced now, and the aura of Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin gave him deep fear. He activated the soul link to borrow Feng Yao’s strength, but it could not ease the fear in his heart. "Crazy! We haven’t faced each other yet, but I’m scared of them."

"Haha," Huo Ling wanted to protect him with her aura, but Zhang Fei stopped her. Although he feared the two ancient demons, the pressure they exerted on him would be beneficial to him. "Who is scarier between the two ancient demons and the two primordial beasts?"

Zhang Fei wiped the sweat off his forehead. "I haven’t met the real bodies of the two primordial beasts, so I can’t say anything about them. However, I can say that the two ancient demons are truly frightening; even my body can’t stop trembling."

"If you encounter Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi in their real bodies, you won’t be able to move, and you’ll be suppressed to death by their auras." Zhang Fei didn’t take Huo Ling’s words lightly because she was the spirit of the Primordial Flame, so she knew for sure the strength of the two beasts. "However, you don’t need to be afraid of them because they can’t use their real bodies, at least for now. Once you evolve into the ten-tailed fox, you will be equal to them based on your beast rank, and their aura will not have much of an effect on you."

Zhang Fei sighed in his heart. He had long harbored the desire to evolve into the ten-tailed fox; he had already obtained almost all of Hu Tianlang’s soul, but he still wasn’t ready to face his wrath soul.
"Are you ready to see them, husband?"
"We can only see them from the gate, right?"
"The gate is the main seal of their prison, and I can’t open it, so we can’t go in there to meet them directly."
"I don’t dare to meet them face to face, so we will peek at them from the gate."
"Let’s go."
As Zhang Fei and Huo Ling approached the gate, two powerful demon auras swept towards them, followed by two loud laughs.
"Hahahaha! After so long, two people finally come to see us, Yin."
"Hehehe! Mo, these two are different from those people, especially the woman."

Zhang Fei’s pupils shrank as soon as he saw the figures of the two ancient demons. He could recognize them because their faces were similar to two of the seven statues in the second room in the Era of the Beginning. "Ling’er, they—"
"You’re right, husband." Huo Ling nodded. "The four of them lived in two different eras, but these two are the direct descendants of the two direct subordinates of the Primordial Demon."
"Ho?" Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin were taken aback when they heard Huo Ling’s statement. "Little girl, you seem to know our ancestors and the Primordial Demon."

"Little girl, your ass!" Huo Ling furiously shouted. "Even your two ancestors didn’t dare to fight me, yet you two dare to call me little girl! If it weren’t for this seal, I would have gone in there and roasted you two alive using my primordial flame!"
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin were stunned by Huo Ling’s outburst.
"Are you really the spirit of the primordial flame?"

"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted. "Lowly demon brats like you two don’t deserve to ask me! I came here just to show my husband how pathetic you two are! You two were born as powerful demons, but you lost to those people and were imprisoned in this place! If your two ancestors saw your situation, they would definitely die of shame!"
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin rubbed their heads with awkward smiles.
"Is that weakling really your husband?"
"Why did a powerful spirit like you choose him as your husband?"

"How dare you insult my husband!" Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin shivered as soon as Huo Ling released her aura, which made them realize that her strength far surpassed theirs. "If you two dare insult my husband one more time, I will obliterate your souls!"
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin were speechless because of Huo Ling’s fiery temper.
"Calm down, Ling’er." Zhang Fei looked at Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin while releasing the aura from the demon seed within his body.
"This! The aura of the demon seed!" Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin screamed in shock.
"Where did you get the demon seed in your body, kid?"
"However, I can only sense the aura of one demon seed out of ten."

"I got it in the lower realm." Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin looked at Zhang Fei in confusion, as they didn’t know anything about the Three Mortal Realms. "Actually, I managed to find the ten demon seeds a few years ago, but each seed chose ten different people."
"What the hell?"
"Are you joking with us? The ten demon seeds are one entity, so they couldn’t possibly choose ten different demons as their masters."

"I’m not joking with you two, okay?" Zhang Fei felt helpless to explain to them. When he met the soul of the primordial demon in the past, he was also shocked by the ten demon seeds’ decision to choose ten different demons. "If you don’t believe me, I can bring the other nine here because they are my wives. However, their cultivation is still low, and they won’t be able to withstand your aura, so you should suppress it as deeply as possible first."
"Alright." Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin instantly suppressed their auras, giving Zhang Fei some relief. "Bring them here."
"Wait."
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei opened a portal to the Yin-Yang Space, and nine female demons walked out from it. They were Janette, Balena, Ilsath, Orith, Zilvora, Eve, Fyr, Angela, and Yan Zhixiu.

Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin were shocked when they sensed the aura of nine demon seeds from the bodies of the nine female demons, which proved the truth of Zhang Fei’s previous words. "Three lust demons, a spider queen, a dryad, a whale demon, a dark elf, a blood-sucking demon, and a rainbow fish demon."
"You were wrong about her." Zhang Fei pointed to Angela. "She’s not a rainbow fish demon but a Rainbow-Shelled Tortoise Demon."
"Huh?" Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin looked at Angela in confusion. "Why have we never heard of her demon race?"
Zhang Fei answered them directly. "Naturally, you two have never heard of her demon race because she is the first."
"What do you mean by that, kid?"

"She used to be a rainbow fish demon, but I used some body parts from the black tortoise beast to upgrade her, and she’s been a Rainbow-Shelled Tortoise Demon Beast ever since." Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin didn’t believe that Zhang Fei could do such a thing, but they couldn’t refute him because Angela was the proof. "I can’t explain the details to you two, but the truth is before your eyes now, and she is the only one of her demon race."
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin fell silent for a while, but they observed the nine female demons seriously.
"Since the ten demon seeds chose the ten of you, you guys must fight together to maximize their strength."
"Kid, you are the main, and they are your supports."
"Can you explain it to me?" Zhang Fei didn’t want to involve all his wives in the fight, and he could fight his enemies alone, but he was also curious about it.

"The ten demon seeds have the same power, but the seed in your body is the main seed." Zhang Fei and the others were confused by this revelation. "I don’t know what exactly happened, but the seeds shouldn’t have been chosen ten different demons, and they should have chosen you as their sole owner."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "In the past, I met the memories of the Primordial Demon, and he also said the same thing as you. However, his time was running out, so he couldn’t explain too much to me."
"The memories of the Primordial Demon," Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin muttered to themselves.
To prove his point, Zhang Fei created a qi screen that displayed his encounter with the Primordial Demon several years ago.
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin trembled as soon as they saw the image of the Primordial Demon; tears streamed down from their tired eyes.
"Our god!"
"Our benefactor!"
Zhang Fei and the others were baffled by their extreme reaction, but they didn’t bother any of them.

Zhen Yin wiped away her tears. "Kid, you may be confident in your abilities, but I can tell you that you must bring your nine wives with you if you encounter a powerful enemy. You still don’t understand the true power of the ten demon seeds, and you can only know the truth if they fight by your side."
"If they fight alongside you, no demon can defeat you." Zhen Mo added. "Besides, all demons in this universe will submit to you if you unleash the true power of the ten demon seeds."
Zhang Fei blinked a few times. "Back then, the Primordial Demon also said the same thing to me, but I don’t want all my wives to get involved in the fight, and I want them to live safely."

chapters.title: Chapter 1799: Converstation With Ancient Demons
paragraphs: Zhen Yin shook her head and patronized Zhang Fei. "Everyone, including us, also wants a peaceful life. However, this universe is full of dangers and two-faced people, so you shouldn’t think that all your women can live peacefully for long. To prevent the unexpected, you must prepare them well so they can protect themselves when you are not by their side."
"Do you know the most dangerous enemy, kid?" Zhen Mo asked.
"Who?"

"Our people." Zhang Fei wanted to refute that, but Zhen Mo stopped him and continued. "I have the ability to read people’s hearts and souls, just like you, so I’m always relaxed when I’m around my people. However, living creatures are always fickle, and we can’t possibly monitor them every day."
"You mean?"

"Yes," Zhen Mo nodded and continued. "My wife and I ended up in this place because our trusted people betrayed us, including our children. We didn’t know they were in cahoots with the ancestors of the other races, and it was too late when we realized it. However, they were too conceited, and they trusted those people too much. After those people succeeded in weakening and capturing us, they turned back on their words, and they killed them in front of us."

Zhen Yin spoke again. "People always say that the demon race is evil and ruthless, but in reality, people from other races are far more wicked and ruthless than us, especially those humans. Compared to other races, humans are the most cunning and greedy living creatures, and they will do anything to realize their ambitions, including sacrificing other people."
"I can’t argue with you," Zhang Fei sighed. "Back to our previous discussion, so the past war occurred because of the betrayal of your trusted people and children, right?"

"Not really." Zhen Mo shook his head. "In the past, the other races already hated our demon race, and they tried to eradicate us to no avail. I don’t know how they did it back then, but the situation turned around after our people betrayed us. At that time, they managed to weaken and capture us, but we also caused them serious injuries, and they sacrificed their lives to imprison us in this place."

"Actually, one of my wives already told me about your war with the ancestors of the other races, and she also told me that you two are still alive in this place." Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin exchanged confused glances because Zhang Fei was still too young, and they felt that his wife was as young as him, so she couldn’t possibly know about the past war. "However, she didn’t tell me the details, including the betrayal of your trusted people and children."

Huo Ling, who was sitting on Zhang Fei’s shoulder, immediately spoke. "My master knows about this matter, husband. She didn’t tell you the details because she wanted you to find out the truth yourself, and you’ve already found out the truth now."
"Huh?" Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin stared at Huo Ling in shock. "Is her master really your wife, kid?"

"Humph! Do you two think I’m making up stories? My master is Guang Zhiyi, and she is my husband’s wife." Huo Ling suddenly realized something. "Forget it! You two don’t know my master’s name because she was reincarnated in this realm after you were imprisoned in this place!"

Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin took a deep breath, thinking about something based on Huo Ling’s words. The woman in front of them was the spirit of the Primordial Flame, and the ancients knew nothing about the flame. The two of them had information about it for some reason, which meant her master was a higher living being than the ancients.
"Is your master a primordial being like the primordial demon?"
"Heh!" Huo Ling snorted in mockery. "My master is indeed a primordial being, but don’t compare her to that weak primordial demon, who died at the hands of the two primordial beasts!"

Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin smiled bitterly, as they didn’t understand why Huo Ling seemed to hate them so much, and she kept her overbearing nature in front of them. They didn’t know that she was vengeful, and they had previously called Zhang Fei a weakling, which made her hostile and condescending towards them.

Zhen Yin ignored Huo Ling and spoke to Zhang Fei again. "As we said before, you can’t let your wives relax too much, or they won’t be prepared if an unexpected situation arises. You have to guide them to become strong and skilled at fighting, and they can help you face future problems."
"However," Zhen Mo looked at the nine female demons. "However, you can’t trust them completely, and you must prepare countermeasures against them, or else you will suffer the same fate as us."

Janette, Balena, Ilsath, Orith, Zilvora, Eve, Fyr, Angela, and Yan Zhixiu glared at Zhen Mo while frowning. However, they didn’t dare to say anything because he was too strong for them, and they had complete trust in Zhang Fei.

"I understand what you mean, but I trust all my wives." Zhen Mo and Zhen Lin felt helpless after Zhang Fei said that. "Even though I completely trust them, I have prepared several precautions. If they dare betray me, I will kill them with myself. Honestly, I want to free you two from this place, and I want you to follow me. Unfortunately, there is great danger out there, so I can’t do that right now."
"What do you mean by a great danger? Are the other races still hunting the demon race?"
"Tch! Even though a long time has passed, those despicable people never change!"

"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "In fact, all the races are standing on their own now, and they have problems with each other. However, I am not referring to the races; instead, I am talking about other creatures that are much more powerful than all of them."
"What creatures?"
Zhang Fei created a qi screen that displayed those shadowy creatures, causing Zhen Mo and Zhen Lin to frown. "Those creatures, especially their leader, are far more powerful than all races."
Zhen Mo and Zhen Lin were seriously watching the qi screen, but they were shocked after seeing the leader of those creatures manage to destroy a domain using a small attack.

Zhang Fei continued. "They are too powerful; even Ling’er has difficulty eliminating them. Currently, they have invaded various domains in this Ancient Realm, and they once tried to invade this domain, but the demons in this domain managed to repel them and set up a barrier."

"Oh?" Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin were surprised to hear that. "Do the demon races really live in this domain now? As I recall, this domain used to be empty, and those people built this place to imprison us."

Zhang Fei changed the image on the qi screen, which now showed the situation in the Myriad Abyss Domain. "As you two can see, many demon races live in this domain now, and they are led by several demon gods. However, none of them know of this place due to the barrier that surrounds it, so you two have never encountered them."
"Haish!" Zhen Mo sighed softly. "It doesn’t matter if they don’t know about us, but I’m glad to know that the demon race is thriving now."
Zhen Yin nodded in agreement. "Are you serious about freeing us from this place, kid?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded seriously. "I need the help of many people to protect my people in the future, including the demon races. Thus, I was thinking of freeing you two from this place, and you can help me protect them. By the way, the people by my side are not only the demon race but also the other races, and they live in harmony."
"Huh? Are you serious about that?"
"How can all races live in harmony?"

Zhang Fei displayed all the situations in the Moonlit Passion Temple, which astonished them. "See? That place is my sect, and all races gather together in harmony there. They are in the Paradise Realm now, but I will bring them to this Ancient Realm in the future, and I need powerful guardians to protect them."
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin exchanged glances for a moment.
"If you can free us from this place, we will join you, and we will protect them."
"We have been imprisoned in this place for too long, and we no longer care about other matters. If you can free us, we will retire and enjoy the rest of our lives in your domain."

"We will discuss that matter in the future." Zhang Fei sent the nine female demons back to the Yin-Yang Space. "For now, I don’t have the power to stop those creatures, but I will get rid of them in the future. By the way, I have to go now because I have to search for demon materials for all my wives, but I will see you two from time to time."
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin watched Zhang Fei walk away thoughtfully.
"Husband, that kid is truly unique, and he still has many secrets."

"Yes," Zhen Mo nodded in agreement. "Since one of his wives is a primordial being and the other is the spirit of the Primordial Flame, I’m confident that he will be able to free us from this place. Much time has passed, and this universe should have changed a lot. Although I still hate those races, I don’t want to think about them anymore, and I want to live a peaceful life with you."
"Hahaha," Zhen Yin laughed. "I can’t wait for that day to come."
"Me too."

"Do you know the most dangerous enemy, kid?" Zhen Mo asked.
"Who?"
"Our people." Zhang Fei wanted to refute that, but Zhen Mo stopped him and continued.
"I have the ability to read people’s hearts and souls, just like you, so I’m always relaxed when I’m around my people.
However, living creatures are always fickle, and we can’t possibly monitor them every day."
"You mean?"

"My wife and I ended up in this place because our trusted people betrayed us, including our children.
We didn’t know they were in cahoots with the ancestors of the other races, and it was too late when we realized it.
However, they were too conceited, and they trusted those people too much.
After those people succeeded in weakening and capturing us, they turned back on their words, and they killed them in front of us."
Zhen Yin spoke again.
"People always say that the demon race is evil and ruthless, but in reality, people from other races are far more wicked and ruthless than us, especially those humans.
Compared to other races, humans are the most cunning and greedy living creatures, and they will do anything to realize their ambitions, including sacrificing other people."
"I can’t argue with you," Zhang Fei sighed.
"Back to our previous discussion, so the past war occurred because of the betrayal of your trusted people and children, right?"
"Not really." Zhen Mo shook his head.
"In the past, the other races already hated our demon race, and they tried to eradicate us to no avail.
I don’t know how they did it back then, but the situation turned around after our people betrayed us.
At that time, they managed to weaken and capture us, but we also caused them serious injuries, and they sacrificed their lives to imprison us in this place."
