chapters.title: Chapter 1800: Demon Gods Go To The Dungeon
paragraphs: After returning to the fifth ground floor, Zhang Fei explained a few things to Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue. Thereafter, the three of them hunted those mindless demons, looking for the Abyssal Demon Heart and the Demon Ritual Sigil.

Since there were almost no other demons on the floor except for the mindless demons, Zhang Fei didn’t hold back and used his full strength to hunt them. After all, he had too many demon wives by his side, and the vast majority of them were stuck at the Empress Rank.
If their demon rank breaks through to the Seven Supreme Demon Rank, their demon forms will evolve into higher forms, and they will become even stronger.
Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin went to their fathers, Chang Moyu and Zuo Hentian, and informed them about Zhang Fei’s actions and Gui Ting’s situation.
Chang Moyu sucked in a deep breath of air. "Fortunately, we forbade our two sons from attacking him, Old Zuo. If we hadn’t done that, he would have enslaved them, just like what he did to Gui Ting."

"Yes," Zuo Hentian nodded solemnly. "Since he has already enslaved Gui Ting, his next target should be Old Gui. I can’t predict the old ghost’s next move, but he will probably suffer the same fate as Old Yan if he insists on fighting that kid."
"I think we should stay away from him, or we’ll suffer the same fate as them."
"I agree with you."
"Father." Chang Moyu and Zuo Hentian looked at Zuo Zhenlin. "His second target doesn’t seem to be Uncle Gui but Aunt Gongsun."
"Gongsun Zhilan?"
"Why do you think that he will target her?"
Chang Qifeng and Zuo Zhenlin explained to their two fathers regarding Zhang Fei’s relationship with Gongsun Jiuxue.

Chang Moyu and Zuo Hentian didn’t expect Gongsun Jiuxue to choose Zhang Fei as her husband, which truly surprised them. Furthermore, they already knew about his relationship with Mo Cangyue and Mo Luoxie, and Gongsun Zhilan was clearly targeting Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu.
"Do you think he will make a move against Old Gongsun, Old Zuo?"
"That’s possible." Zuo Hentian hurriedly contacted Gongsun Zhilan and asked her about Zhang Fei.
Gongsun Zhilan didn’t hide anything from Zuo Hentian, and she told him that Zhang Fei had come to see her, but she didn’t tell him the details.

Zuo Hentian sighed and looked at Chang Moyu. "Zhang Fei has already met Gongsun Zhilan, but she didn’t reveal the contents of their previous conversation. I suspect that she has already fallen under his control like Old Yan, and she is embarrassed to admit it."

"If that’s true, only the two of us will be left of our group, so our chances of defeating Mo Qingwen are getting smaller." Chang Moyu was annoyed because Zhang Fei’s arrival had changed many things, and the plans they had prepared for so long had been thrown into disarray. "As for Hou Wuyan, he—"
"Let’s not talk about him." Zuo Hentian rose to his feet. "For the time being, we must stay low, and we must not provoke Zhang Fei."
"Alright." After Zuo Hentian and Zuo Zhenlin left, Chang Moyu spoke to his son. "Qifeng, you know what you should do, right?"
Chang Qifeng nodded seriously. "Don’t worry, Father. I’ll keep my distance from them and focus on my cultivation."
"Good!"
Elsewhere.
Gui Ye looked at his daughter and two subordinates with a dark face, but he still didn’t realize that the three of them were already under Zhang Fei’s control.
Gui Ting herself couldn’t tell her father about the matter due to Zhang Fei’s demon slave mark in her soul. Not to mention, Gongsun Jiuxue had also poisoned her, so her life was in their hands.
Meanwhile, Gui Ye’s two subordinates informed him that they couldn’t defeat Zhang Fei, and the wounds on their bodies were proof.
"You two leave this place first and treat your wounds." Gui Ye’s two subordinates left the place directly. "What do you think about Zhang Fei, Ting’er?"

"Father, I hope you stop bothering Zhang Fei." Gui Ye stared at his daughter sharply. "He is not an ordinary demon, and his strength surpasses yours. He can destroy our ghost summons with one attack, and his speed is incredibly fast. If you continue to disturb him, I’m afraid he will attack our demon race, and we will be wiped out."
"Did Gongsun Jiuxue really choose him as her husband?"
"She did." Gui Ting nodded repeatedly. "They previously said that they were going to see Aunt Gongsun, but I don’t know whether they have gone there or not."
Gui Ye silently contacted Gongsun Zhilan and asked her about it, but she didn’t give him an answer. "What if you use your body to lure Zhang Fei to our side?"

’Do you think I can do that, Father? I’m his slave now, and he can do whatever he wants to me,’ Gui Ting muttered with bitterness in her heart. "Father, you haven’t met his four wives, and I can tell you that no female demons in this domain can rival their beauty, including Hua Qianmei and Tang Zhiyao. Compared to them, I’m nothing, so you should forget your idea."
"You may leave now." Gui Ting sighed in relief and hurriedly left Gui Ye’s room. "Who exactly is Zhang Fei? How can he be so powerful?"
Gui Ye took the pill Gui Ting had given him earlier, but he didn’t dare swallow it and crushed it directly. After that, he left the room and went somewhere else.

As per Zhang Fei’s orders, Gongsun Zhilan went to meet Nalan Wuji and Ye Qisui to give them both pills. She didn’t stay long with the two demon gods, and she left immediately after they swallowed the pills.
Thereafter, Gongsun Zhilan did not return to her palace; instead, she went to the dungeon out of curiosity about Zhang Fei’s fighting abilities.

Gongsun Zhilan was unaware that Tang Zhiyao was monitoring her, and she had witnessed all of Zhang Fei’s actions towards her. "That kid is truly swift and effective in every action, and she’s already under his control now."
Tang Zhiyao immediately disappeared from that place, and she rushed to the dungeon to witness Zhang Fei’s fighting abilities firsthand.
Hua Qianmei had naturally heard about Zhang Fei’s actions against Gui Ting, and her lips curled up as soon as Tang Zhiyao informed her about his actions against Gongsun Zhilan.

"His clone is busy helping all his wives, so I won’t disturb him." Hua Qianmei stretched her body, got out of bed, and got dressed. "Since he’s done something to those people, I think I should help him collect those demon materials, so I’ll go to the dungeon now."
Hua Qianmei contacted several of her subordinates, ordered them to prepare an empty building for Zhang Fei, and disappeared from her chamber afterwards.

Meanwhile, Gu Yanshu was still in shock because of Zhang Fei’s swift actions. Previously, he had killed Yan Tianling and enslaved Yan Washeng, and her son informed her that he had also enslaved Gui Ting and Gui Ye’s two subordinates. Not to mention, Gongsun Jiuxue chose him as her husband, and they went to meet Gongsun Zhilan afterwards.

What shocked Gu Yanshu most was the news from her daughter that Zhang Fei had also done something to Gongsun Zhilan, and that woman was now under his control, so she would not bother her and her husband anymore.
Gu Yanshu let out a sigh of relief because Gongsun Zhilan was a terrifying enemy for her, and Zhang Fei’s action indirectly ended the problem between them.
Gu Yanshu looked at her husband, who had just arrived. "Have you heard about Gongsun Zhilan?"

"Yes." Mo Qingwen sat beside his wife. "Our daughter has already told me about Zhang Fei’s actions towards Gongsun Zhilan, so we can both rest assured from now on. Besides, our son also told me about his actions against Gui Ting, so I’m certain that his next target is Gui Ye."
Gu Yanshu nodded in agreement. "If Gui Ye also falls into Zhang Fei’s control, only Chang Moyu and Zuo Hentian are left of their group, and they won’t dare to look for trouble with us."
"That’s right." Mo Qingwen let out a sigh of relief. "Do you want to go to the dungeon with me?"
"Do you want to see Zhang Fei?"
"He has done several things that have indirectly helped us, so I think it’s time for me to meet him, and I will thank him in person."
"Let’s go then."

The day passed quickly, and Tang Zhiyao was the first to arrive at the dungeon. She immediately went to the fifth ground floor to look for Zhang Fei, but she didn’t show herself to him, instead observing him from afar.
Gongsun Zhilan arrived shortly after Tang Zhiyao, but she didn’t immediately look for Zhang Fei; instead, she stopped on the fourth ground floor and observed the four female demon gods.

Gongsun Zhilan became jealous after seeing the beauty of Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Nalan Shizhe. She couldn’t understand how the four women could be so beautiful since Zhang Fei hadn’t given her the two beauty pills.
Gongsun Zhilan saw Hua Qianmei arrive on that floor, but she did not greet her, and she went straight to the fifth ground floor.

Hua Qianmei did not greet Gongsun Zhilan, and she also did not follow her to the fifth ground floor. Instead, she helped Dong Xuanyin and the others to collect the Infernal Blood Core and the Demon Essence Drop.

Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu also arrived at the fourth ground floor a few minutes later. They observed their son and future daughter-in-law for a while before rushing to the fifth ground floor to meet Zhang Fei.
